jobs.title: Application Technical Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Title

Application Technical Specialist

About Citco

Since the 1940s Citco has provided specialist financial services to alternative investment funds, investors, multinationals and private clients worldwide. With over 6,000 employees in 45 countries we pioneer innovative solutions that meet our clients’ evolving needs, and deliver exceptional service.

Our continuous investment in learning means our people are among the best in the industry. And our corporate social responsibility programs provide meaningful and fulfilling work in the community.

A career at Citco isn’t just a job – it’s an opportunity to excel in an environment that genuinely supports your personal and professional development.

About the Role:

Citco IT is a global team of IT professionals that is responsible for the development and support of IT applications throughout Citco Group’s divisions.

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Developer to work within a very exciting and challenging role on a new strategic financial application. The successful candidate will be working with a specialized technical teams serving a wide range of buines groups.

We are seeking a Technical Specialist to take technical ownership of significant products and modules within our Banking platform. You will define technical direction and architecture, mentor developers, and liaise with Business Analysis, Application Support, QA, IT Security, and enterprise architecture to ensure delivery from analysis through production and support.

Job Duties in Brief:

  • Technical ownership of critical banking product(s) and module(s)

  • Design and develop new functionality across React frontends, Java/Spring backends, relational databases, and REST API integrations

  • Maintain systems documentation and knowledge base

  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and code reviews

  • Define architecture requirements considering throughput, latency, and reliability

  • Drive CI/CD practices for cloud and on-premise deployments

  • Champion clean code principles, integrated testing practices, and effective use of AI-assisted coding tools

About You :

Required IT skills

  • 7+ years hands-on enterprise SDLC experience

  • 5+ years in financial services; 3+ years in banking

  • Strong proficiency in Java (Spring, Maven) and React

  • Solid experience with relational databases and REST API integration

  • Advanced OOP, design patterns, Git branching, build management, and debugging skills

  • Commitment to clean code, refactoring, and maintainable software design

  • Experience writing and maintaining integrated tests (unit, integration, API)

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Amazon Q, GitHub Copilot) and ability to leverage them effectively

  • Strong communication across technical and non-technical audiences

  • Ability to lead technical teams on complex, long-duration tasks

  • Strong solution design mindset, marrying best practices with best of technologies

  • Innovative mindset with strong understanding and interest evolving technologies

  • Strong AI understanding and ability to apply it effectively

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent; Master's preferred

Beneficial IT skills

  • AWS experience

  • Application server deployments (JBoss/WildFly)

  • Messaging systems (e.g., IBM MQ)

  • CI/CD pipeline tooling for cloud and on-premise

Personal skills

  • We are looking for ambitious individuals that are keen to develop their technical skills in a dynamic environment

  • Strong interpersonal, communication skills and the ability to deal effectively in a team environment

  • The candidate must be able to present diagnostic, troubleshooting steps and conclusions to a varied audience

  • Someone proactive, that can work autonomously, and take ownership of their tasks.

  • Collaborates with other developers in the construction of software - strong ability to partner with and team with colleagues
    • Provide mentoring and guidance to junior team members

What We Offer:

  • A challenging and rewarding role in an award-winning global business

  • Opportunities for personal and professional career development

  • Great working environment, competitive salary and benefits, and opportunities for educational support

  • Be part of an industry leading global team, renowned for excellence

Remuneration:

A highly competitive salary package will be awarded the successful candidate.

Confidentiality Assured.

Overview

AtkinsRéalis is seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Architectural Technician to join our Dublin-based architectural team. This role supports a diverse range of medium to large-scale projects, offering the opportunity to take ownership of technical delivery within a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.

The successful candidate will bring strong technical and site-based experience, playing a key role in the coordination, detailing and construction-stage delivery of complex projects.

Your role

The successful candidate will:

  • Lead the preparation and coordination of detailed technical and construction drawings.
  • Support architectural teams throughout detailed design, tender and construction stages.
  • Provide technical input during site works, including inspections, RFIs and coordination with contractors.
  • Ensure full compliance with Irish Building Regulations and BCAR requirements.

  • Liaise effectively with consultants, contractors and internal teams.
  • Assist in resolving construction-stage technical issues.
  • Support and mentor junior team members where required.
  • Manage workload efficiently across multiple concurrent projects.

  • Demonstrable experience working on projects in Ireland.
  • Solid understanding of: Irish Building Regulations and Technical Guidance Documents BCAR compliance and inspection processes Construction detailing and coordination.
  • Advanced proficiency in Revit / BIM.
  • Strong organisational and communication skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience in large-scale or highly regulated projects.

jobs.title: Graduate Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Would you like to use your engineering skills to positively impact the human condition? Does interfacing with the world’s leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies excite you?

While we don’t make medicine, we facilitate the successful manufacture thereof - every single day.

If this sounds enticing to you, perhaps you’re a fit with our Applications Engineering team.

Who is Meissner?

The goal at Meissner is to be more than simply good; it is to be extraordinary. Extraordinary performance comes from extraordinary people.

Meissner as a group is passionate about helping our clients manufacture lifesaving and life enhancing drugs, therapies, and vaccines. We develop, manufacture, supply and service advanced microfiltration products and single-use systems worldwide.

We know that when you are passionate about what you do, it’s more than just a job.

Meissner is focused on the development of the whole individual, and we have programs and tools in place to help us stay at our best mentally and physically. In alignment with our commitment to support the growth and development of the whole individual, Meissner has inaugurated a Learning and Development department to solely focus on cultivating our team. When you grow, we grow.

Meissner is seeking a Graduate Design Engineer to join us at our Manufacturing facility in Castlebar, Co. Mayo. The candidate will undergo a period of training and development to gain the necessary competencies to fulfil the role, inclusive of spending time training at our HQ facility in Camarillo, California.

The Graduate Design Engineer will be responsible for developing, designing, documenting, and approving single-use systems for primarily but not limited to the biopharmaceutical industry, providing assistance and technical support to end-users necessary to ensure the successful implementation thereof.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

As part of the Applications Engineering team, you will develop, design, optimise and implement solutions for the industries we serve. Throughout this process you will interface with all facets of our organisation including Quality, Operations, Engineering, Production, Sales and Supply Chain to ensure that the solutions which are developed meet the needs of our customer base while at the same time being compatible with the regulatory environment our customers function in. While Meissner is recognised as a leading provider of innovative solutions to the life sciences field, we are also known as a world class manufacturing organisation. As a Design Engineer you will be tasked with training and development along with specific, project-based endeavours that may include the following:

Duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Develops single-use systems designs based on user and process requirements:
    • Creates detailed product specifications which meet user requirement specifications (URS) while allowing for lean production and cost-effective solutions.
    • Analyses product specifications and performance requirements to determine designs which can be produced via existing component portfolio (Meissner Design Space), processing facilities and techniques.
    • Prepares process flow diagrams (PFDs), specification prints featuring detailed Bills of Materials, comprehensive URS responses and other documents necessary for completion of projects.
    • Generates pricing based on value engineering principals in concert with Global Finance and Accounting.

  • Manages library of single-use componentry for use in single-use assemblies:
    • Evaluates single-use components to ensure fitness for purpose, e.g. sensor functionality, engagement testing, etc.
    • Qualifies new components for use in production including generation of QC prints and performance testing.
    • Works with Quality, Planning, and Procurement to ensure consistent supply of single-use components.

  • Supports single-use systems production:
    • Ensures designs are manufactured accurate to approved specifications.
    • Facilitates new bio container design implementation.
    • Promotes efficient and ergonomic manufacturing techniques.
    • Interfaces with and offers continuous improvement support for the MES/ERP systems.

  • Provides pre and post-sale product support for single-use systems
    • Creates support documentation including process flow and recommended usage diagrams.
    • Confers with customers and sales staff to discuss project status, provide technical support, and otherwise facilitate implementation of product portfolios.

  • Manages single-use systems projects to ensure that initiatives are met, timelines are adhered to, associated costs targets are achieved, etc.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to utilise basic computer skills is essential including the use of word-processing, spreadsheets.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at once.

jobs.description:
About BAM

What if your next step made a real difference?

We are BAM. One of Europe's leading construction and civil engineering businesses.

For over 150 years, we have been creating the places, spaces and infrastructure that people rely on every day. But what drives us is not just what we are building, it is how and why we are building it.

We want to leave a lasting legacy, improving local communities, protecting our environment and benefiting society as a whole. So, no matter where you join us, you will be part of something bigger.

Because here, the world we all want to live in will be made by you.

About our Graduate Programme

As a graduate at BAM, you will take on real responsibility from day one, contributing to projects that make a lasting difference while continuing to build your technical knowledge, professional skills and commercial understanding.

You will follow a structured development programme, receive support from experienced colleagues and work towards the professional chartership that is right for your discipline. Along the way, you will build confidence, broaden your experience and discover where your career can take you.

As a Graduate Digital Project Solutions Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting the digital delivery of some of Ireland's most exciting construction and infrastructure projects.

This is a onsite role, providing the opportunity to work alongside project teams, engineers, designers and digital specialists, you will help drive the use of digital tools, systems and processes that improve collaboration, efficiency and project performance across the project lifecycle.

You will gain practical experience in areas such as Building Information Modelling (BIM), digital design coordination, information management, data analysis, project systems and digital construction technologies, while building a strong understanding of how digital innovation is transforming the construction industry.

This role offers the opportunity to develop your technical expertise, strengthen your problem-solving skills and gain valuable experience supporting projects from design through to delivery.

You will be resilient, positive and ready to make the most of every opportunity that comes your way.

  • Be due to graduate in Summer 2027 or have recently graduated.
  • Have a genuine interest in digital technologies and innovation within the construction industry.
  • Demonstrate strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Be eager to learn, broaden your experience and take on responsibility.
  • Have strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving abilities.
  • Be comfortable working with digital systems, technology and data.
  • Have a desire to continue developing your technical knowledge and digital expertise.

Most importantly, we are looking for individuals who are enthusiastic, motivated and excited to help build a more sustainable tomorrow.

Joining BAM means becoming part of a business that is committed to developing people and creating places that make a lasting difference.

Alongside a competitive salary, you will benefit from structured development, support from experienced mentors and opportunities to work towards professional qualifications.

You will also have access to a wide range of benefits, including:

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. jobs.title: Training and Online Learning Officer
jobs.description:
Training and Online Learning Officer

About Tyndall
Tyndall National Institute is an international leader in semiconductors, photonics and deep-tech research and innovation. As a leading collaborative European research institute, Tyndall is a key actor and hosting partner in the delivery of the ‘Chips for Europe Initiative’ (EU Chips Act).

Tyndall is Ireland’s leading research and innovation organisation, and it is the national focal point for excellence in deep-tech research, development and graduate training at the convergence of nanotechnology, microelectronics, photonics, electronics and AI. Tyndall is recognised as an international research leader in semiconductor, chip and digital technologies, particularly as applied to the fields of Information & Communications, Health & Life Sciences, Agritech & Food Security, Energy and Climate Mitigation, emerging fields such as quantum, and novel computing paradigms.

The Institute’s key objective is to see frontier research activities having a significant impact on economic development and societal challenges in Ireland, Europe and beyond. Central to Tyndall’s mission is delivering economic impact through research excellence in partnership with industry and academia. With an annual turnover of more than €50m, the Institute has a community of over 600 researchers, engineers, support staff, postgraduate students, interns and industry researchers-in-residence.

With significant committed Irish government support, Tyndall will grow to be 1,000 people by 2030, with approximately 750 researchers, including 250 PhD students. A new 17,000 m2 research building is under development adjacent to the Cork headquarters and there are developing plans to expand Tyndall’s existing Dublin research labs and to establish other research sites within Ireland.

Tyndall’s expansion is also supported by recent national and EU funding wins for significant (M€10’s) additional research equipment across a range of areas such as semiconductor processing, microscopy, quantum technologies, heterogeneous integration, ultra-high speed optical communications and RF through THz characterisation.

About the Team
The Photonics Packaging and Systems Integration Group at Tyndall National Institute invites applications for the position of Training and Online Learning Officer. This role focuses on supporting the development and delivery of the PIXEurope Training Programme, working closely with the Training Programme Manager and a diverse network of technical experts and collaborators across Europe. The successful candidate will join a collaborative and multidisciplinary team that combines research, innovation, training and workforce development activities. The role offers the opportunity to contribute to a growing European initiative while developing expertise in online learning, training programme delivery, and stakeholder engagement.

About the Role
PIXEurope is a European pilot line initiative supporting the development and industrialisation of Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) technologies, with an associated training programme designed to support building the workforce capabilities required by the sector, targeting to train 1,000 individuals annually from 2028. The successful candidate will contribute to the development and delivery of this training programme, with a particular focus on the development and expansion of digital learning activities, including online training delivery, webinars, learner engagement, and learning management systems. The role offers opportunities for professional growth and increasing responsibility, including ownership of dedicated programme activities and the development of scalable learning solutions for a European audience.

The position will involve regular interaction with technical experts, project partners, and stakeholders across Europe.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
  • Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the PIXEurope Training Programme.
  • Lead the development and operation of digital learning activities, including webinars, on-demand learning resources, and online training content.
  • Manage the administration, maintenance and ongoing enhancement of learning management systems (LMS).
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of training activities, including planning, scheduling, delivery, evaluation, and reporting.
  • Monitor participation, learner engagement, and programme performance through the collection and analysis of training metrics and KPIs.
  • Work with technical experts and project partners across Europe to translate emerging technologies and research outputs into accessible training content, learning resources, and educational activities.
  • Support quality assurance activities to ensure training content, learning resources, and delivery formats meet programme standards and learner needs.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance learner engagement, user experience, and the overall effectiveness of training activities.
  • Analyse learner feedback and performance data to support the continuous improvement of training activities and learning resources.
  • Manage stakeholders to identify training needs, provide learning and development solutions and take ownership of assigned training and online learning activities, ensuring timely delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate the production and maintenance of training materials and learning resources.
  • Support the organisation of in-person training events, workshops, and partner meetings across Europe.
  • Represent the training programme at relevant meetings, conferences, workshops, and networking events.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer – Rust
jobs.description:
Location-adjusted, based on experience and local market conditions, with an absolute maximum of €250 per working day

Remote, worldwide

About MedoSync

MedoSync is an Irish healthcare technology company building software that reduces waste and complexity in medical billing.

Our systems support healthcare providers, insurers and consultants. The work involves complex business rules, third-party integrations, asynchronous processing and software that must remain reliable as customer and regulatory requirements change.

We are expanding our engineering team internationally and are looking for an experienced backend engineer who can contribute production-quality Rust within an established development team.

The role

You will build and maintain backend services, integrations and internal tooling, primarily in Rust. This is not a greenfield role where every difficult component can be replaced or rewritten. You will work within an established shared codebase, understand existing behaviour and make safe, incremental improvements.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and maintaining backend services in Rust.
  • Building and supporting REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Working with asynchronous processes, queues and background services.
  • Reviewing code and responding constructively to reviews of your own work.
  • Diagnosing defects and production issues.
  • Writing automated tests and maintaining backward compatibility.
  • Working with relational databases, SQL and schema migrations.
  • Documenting technical decisions and operational behaviour.
  • Working with deadlines and competing priorities.
  • Opening clear, reviewable pull requests for approval by the EU engineering team.
  • Taking ownership of your work when something does not behave as expected.

Required experience

You must have:

  • At least five years of professional software-development experience.
  • Demonstrable experience building production software in Rust.
  • Professional experience with at least one other backend language, such as Python, Go, Java, C#, C++ or TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Strong SQL and relational-database experience.
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
  • Experience working within an established engineering team.
  • Experience maintaining a shared production codebase.
  • Experience both reviewing code and receiving detailed code review.
  • Experience supporting systems used by real customers.
  • Experience diagnosing incidents and contributing to their resolution.
  • Experience working with deadlines and conflicting priorities.
  • Experience completing safe database or schema migrations involving production data.
  • An understanding of backward compatibility and controlled releases.
  • Experience working with security and access controls, ideally within a regulated organisation.
  • Clear written and spoken English.

Personal projects are welcome as additional evidence, but they do not replace the required professional production experience.

Useful experience

Experience in any of the following would be beneficial:

  • Tokio, SeaORM, Axum, Serde or the wider Rust asynchronous ecosystem.
  • PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server or MySQL.
  • RabbitMQ, Kafka, NATS or another message broker.
  • Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Azure or another major cloud platform.
  • OpenTelemetry, structured logging and production monitoring.
  • Keycloak, OAuth 2.0 or OpenID Connect.
  • SOAP, XML, HL7 or healthcare integrations.
  • CI/CD pipelines and controlled deployment processes.
  • Working in healthcare, financial services, government or another regulated sector.

Healthcare experience is useful but not required. We can teach the domain; we need you to bring sound engineering judgement and proven production experience.

Security and access model

MedoSync processes sensitive healthcare information, so international contractors work within a deliberately restricted security model.

You will:

  • Work with synthetic, anonymised or non-production data.
  • Have no direct access to real customer personally identifiable information.
  • Receive access only to the repositories and systems required for your work.
  • Work through feature branches and pull requests.
  • Have your changes reviewed, approved and released by authorised EU-based engineers.
  • Be expected to follow MedoSync’s security, confidentiality and development procedures.

These controls protect our customers while allowing international engineers to contribute meaningfully to the product.

Contract terms

  • This is a business-to-business contractor engagement.
  • The maximum rate is €250 per working day.
  • Contractors are responsible for their own taxes, insurance, equipment and local legal obligations.
  • The contract does not include paid annual leave, sick leave, pension contributions or employee benefits.
  • The engagement is subject to identity, professional-reference, right-to-contract and security verification.
  • You must be legally permitted to provide services from your country of residence.
  • Recruitment agencies and third-party candidate representatives will not be considered.

Contract rate

jobs.title: Method Development & Validation Analyst
jobs.description:
Basic Role Summary:

This role offers a unique opportunity to be an analytical method development scientist within a dynamic pharmaceutical RD Medical team. You will be instrumental in supporting Chanelle Pharma's vision to be the most valued global provider of high-quality, competitively priced pharmaceutical products while delivering excellent technical support to customers and stakeholders.


As a Method Development Validation Analyst, you will take ownership of stability-indicating method (SIM) development, method validation studies, and nitrosamine impurity testing, ensuring all analytical methods meet ICH Q2(R2) guidelines and regulatory expectations. This is a hands-on analytical chemistry role requiring strong technical competence, attention to data integrity, and the ability to troubleshoot complex chromatographic challenges.


Location: Onsite at our facility in Loughrea.


As our Method Development Validation Analyst, your key responsibilities will include:

  • Lead or co-lead development of stability-indicating methods (assay, related substances, preservatives, cleaning methods) for pipeline products, including forced degradation studies and impurity characterization.

  • Execute analytical method validation studies in accordance with ICH Q2(R2) guidelines and prepare comprehensive validation protocols and final reports.

  • Develop and validate nitrosamine impurity test methods in line with ICH M7 recommendations and regulatory expectations (FDA, EMA), maintaining knowledge of evolving nitrosamine guidance.

  • Characterize active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and reference materials for proposed medical products.

  • Conduct stability testing of medical products in accordance with stability protocols (lab trials, pilot batches) and prepare stability reports in line with ICH Q1A/Q1B requirements.

  • Perform process validation testing and support manufacturing process qualification activities.

  • Maintain the RD analytical laboratory to GMP standards and ensure compliance during internal audits and inspections.

  • Complete and maintain laboratory notebooks and experiment registers to ensure traceability and data integrity.

  • Ensure timely availability of analytical standards, chromatographic columns, and reagents to prevent testing delays.

  • Review and verify analytical RD raw data associated with method validation, process validation, trial batches, and stability studies.

  • Coordinate shipment of validation and stability samples to contract laboratories and track external testing results.

  • Support internal and external audits, including client audits and regulatory inspections, and respond to audit findings related to analytical methods.

  • 5+ years of experience in analytical method development, preferably involving pipeline or developmental pharmaceutical products.

jobs.title: Commercial Analyst Buyer
jobs.description:
Role Introduction:

Established in 1992, Applegreen is a leading convenience roadside retailer in the Republic of Ireland, the UK and the US in both large-scale Motorway Service Areas and Travel Plazas, as well as smaller petrol stations. The business has grown to over 3BN in annual revenue, operating 600 Motorway Service Plazas and forecourt sites internationally and employing over 16,000 people.

Applegreen is in a rapid growth phase and, to support this ambition, we are seeking to appoint a Commercial Analyst Buyer / Junior Buyer to assist with the commercial and operational performance of the coffee team. This role reports to the Commercial Coffee Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

As Applegreen expands, the responsibilities will evolve and change over time. The core responsibilities will centre around the following areas:

1. Commercial Analysis & Insight

  • Build, maintain and continuously improve BI dashboards and reporting tools to track sales, margin, pricing and performance KPIs
  • Analyse performance across sales, margin %, ATV, product mix and site performance and translate into clear commercial actions
  • Support forecasting, budgeting and performance tracking across the category
  • Identify trends, risks and opportunities and proactively make recommendations
  • Provide board-ready summaries and insights for senior stakeholders

2. Reporting & Data Management

  • Own and manage all core reporting outputs (weekly, monthly and ad hoc)
  • Extract, clean and structure data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency
  • Deliver automated and scalable reporting solutions using BI tools
  • Maintain data integrity and governance, ensuring one version of the truth
  • Build user-friendly dashboards for cross-functional teams (Commercial, Ops, Finance, Brand)

3. Pricing & Commercial Support

  • Support development and maintenance of pricing models, including margin analysis and cost/ retail tracking
  • Track and validate supplier pricing (/kg, rebates, cost movements) in line with open-book agreements
  • Model impact of pricing changes, promotions and cost fluctuations

4. Buying & Supplier Management / NPD pipeline

  • Support and manage day-to-day buying activities across allocated product areas
  • Raise and manage purchase orders, pricing files and supplier communications
  • Track cost prices, volumes and supplier performance
  • Support negotiations with data and cost analysis
  • Ensure product availability, continuity of supply and issue resolution
  • Maintain accurate product, pricing and supplier records
  • Lead out on managing a strong NPD pipeline in coffee, food and merchandise from research to launch

5. Cross-Functional Delivery

The Candidate should have the following:

Qualifications, experience & skills

  • Minimum of two years experience in a commercial analyst, data analyst or similar role (ideally within retail, foodservice or FMCG)
  • Advanced Excel skills(must-have), including:

o Complex formulas (INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS)

o Pivot tables and data modelling

o Scenario modelling and forecasting

  • Proven experience building and managing BI tools / dashboards (e.g. Power BI, Tableau or similar)
  • Ability to extract, manipulate and interpret data from multiple sources
  • Strong commercial awareness with understanding of margin, pricing and cost drivers
  • High level of attention to detail and accuracy
  • Experience with buying, procurement or supplier management (desirable)
  • Exposure to open-book pricing models or commodity-led categories (desirable)
  • Understanding of foodservice or coffee category (desirable)

Additional key skills & attributes:

  • A dynamic individual who adapts well to change and can thrive in a rapidly growing organisation that continues to evolve.
  • Proven track record of delivering to tight deadlines.
  • A highly organised individual with ability to plan and prioritise workloads effectively for maximum impact and adapt around changing priorities as required.
  • Ability to execute directly at high quality and pace.
  • Excellent drive, enthusiasm and commitment and a keen interest in developing a career in Applegreen.
  • A can do attitude and a positive solution focused mindset.
  • Has strong commercial acumen and a focus on delivering value to the business.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, and ability to engage and develop relationships with individuals at all levels of the organisation.
  • Be a self-starter, and also be able to work collaboratively as a member of a highly interdependent team across many parts of Applegreen.
  • Is resilient, calm under pressure and comfortable dealing with ambiguity.
  • Has sound judgement and objective logical decision-making skills.
  • Has strong leadership potential and management skills, who will be a role model for the people and culture at Applegreen.

Willing to travel ad hoc.

jobs.description:

LGT Fund Managers provides in-house fund administration services for LGT Capital Partners and administers predominantly closed-ended private market fund structures across Liechtenstein, Ireland and Luxembourg. To support the continued build-out of our Dublin Operations team, we are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Fund Operations Analyst to join our Fund Managers Operations setup.

In addition, the successful candidate will support broader fund operations workstreams as the Dublin team continues to grow and functions become more integrated across locations.

You will join an international, multi-locational operations team that values ownership, quality, continuous improvement, respect and strong collaboration. The role offers the opportunity to build deep operational knowledge across private markets fund administration, contribute to robust control processes and support the continued development of our Dublin-based operational capabilities.

As a Fund Operations Analyst, you will assume responsibility for a range of operational tasks across invoice processing, accounting-related controls and payment execution support. Your key responsibilities will include:

jobs.title: Business & Technology Consulting Graduate Programme FY28
jobs.description:
Description


Technology is changing the world faster than ever before – and at the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team.

Every day around the world, we work with exceptional people, the latest and greatest tech and leading companies across industries. You'll learn, grow and advance in a diverse culture of shared success, where we’ll empower you to bring your skills, your curiosity and your best true self to your work.
Join us and do extraordinary things.

Through our Business & Technology Graduate Programme, you’ll work at the intersection of business, technology and innovation, helping clients solve complex challenges and create lasting value. You’ll explore how organisations can reinvent the way they operate, grow, and serve their customers by combining strategic thinking, data-driven insight, AI-powered transformation and practical technology solutions.
This streamlined programme brings together opportunities across business and technology consulting into one pathway. Through a single application, we’ll consider your skills, interests and potential, then guide you into the work that best fits you, whether that leans towards business and management consulting, hands-on technology delivery, or a blend of both. You don’t need to have it all figured out on day one; you need to be curious about where you could go.

What You'll Do

From day one, you’ll work as part of collaborative project teams, building trusted relationships with clients and colleagues while developing your consulting, analytical and technology skills. The work is varied, fast-paced and practical, and no two projects are the same. You’ll build breadth by working across different technologies, industries and client challenges rather than being boxed into a single specialism.
In your first year, you might find yourself:
  • Supporting the adoption of emerging technologies and helping teams put AI to work on real client problems
  • Working within a project team to help a client deliver a large-scale digital transformation programme
  • Using analytics and data to identify opportunities and shape recommendations for a client
  • Designing, refining, building, testing & deploying technology solutions as part of a delivery team
  • Running business analysis, project management or process improvement to keep delivery on track
There are many directions your career can take from here, across areas such as technology strategy and transformation, AI-powered customer experience, talent & change management, operating model & business process design, data and analytics, testing, project and programme management, and cloud. Some of our graduates build broad consulting careers; others develop deep specialist and technical expertise. The programme is designed to give you the exposure to work out which path is yours, and the support to pursue it.


What We're Looking For


The world of consulting is changing. As AI takes on more of the routine, execution-based work, the analyst role is shifting from doing the work to directing it, using AI and new technologies to generate outputs, then applying judgement, critical thinking and accountability to validate, refine and deliver work our clients can trust. Technical foundations still matter, but what really sets our best people apart is how they think and how they work.
That’s why, more than any specific degree or set of skills, we’re looking for the behaviours that will help you thrive in an AI-enabled world. You’ll stand out if you:
  • Take initiative: you’re a self-starter who spots opportunities to solve problems in better ways, including with AI, rather than waiting to be told
  • Take ownership: you hold yourself accountable for the quality of what you deliver, and you follow through
  • Are genuinely curious: you love to learn, test out new ideas & technologies, pick things up quickly, and keep developing long after the training ends
  • Think critically: you question, validate and apply judgement rather than taking outputs at face value
  • Adapt with confidence: you’re comfortable operating in ambiguity and navigating change
  • Communicate and connect: you can explain your thinking clearly, tell a compelling story with data, and build trust with clients and colleagues
  • Enjoy variety: you’d rather build breadth across different problems, technologies and industries than stay in one lane
We welcome applicants from all academic disciplines, with a minimum 2:1 degree result obtained or predicted. You do not need to be technical, or to have a business background to apply, and we hire brilliant people from arts, business, STEM and everything in between. What matters most is your curiosity, your adaptability, and a genuine interest in how technology, AI and data are changing the way businesses operate. A STEM background can be beneficial for some paths, but it is not a requirement.


What's In It For You?


Training & Development

Your development begins on day one, and it doesn’t stop after your initial training. We’ll invest in you through a structured induction, hands-on practical training, mentorship from experienced colleagues and leaders, and real project experience, the combination that turns you into a confident, capable Analyst.

jobs.title: Internal Controls Analyst
jobs.description:
This is a hands-on, execution-focused role within the Risk, Controls & Audit (RC&A) function. The Internal Controls Analyst is dedicated to the delivery of FMC's Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance programme, performing process walkthroughs and control testing across FMC's global business units.

The role is responsible for executing a defined annual SOX testing cycle: documenting process walkthroughs, testing the design and operating effectiveness of key controls, obtaining and evaluating supporting evidence, and recording results in line with FMC's SOX methodology and documentation standards.

The Analyst reports to the Internal Controls Manager and works directly with control owners across finance, operations and shared services, both in Cork and at FMC sites internationally.

The position is offered on a 12-month fixed-term contract, reviewed annually with a view to renewal. It is a specialist testing role focused solely on SOX testing and walkthroughs.

Main Tasks:

1. Process Walkthroughs & Documentation

· Perform annual process walkthroughs with control owners across key financial cycles (Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Inventory and Financial Close)

· Update and maintain narratives, process flows and Risk & Control Matrices (RACMs) so that they reflect current process and system reality

· Confirm that key controls remain appropriately designed, are assigned to an accountable owner, and are capable of preventing or detecting material error

· Record walkthrough outcomes and supporting evidence in the SOX documentation repository

2. SOX Control Testing & Evidence Evaluation

· Execute design and operating effectiveness testing for assigned key controls in line with the annual SOX testing plan

· Select samples in accordance with prescribed sample sizes and methodology, and issue evidence requests to control owners

· Assess evidence for completeness, accuracy and relevance, and document conclusions in a clear, reviewable format

· Prepare test workpapers to a standard that can be relied upon by management, Internal Audit and the external auditor

· Deliver assigned testing to agreed deadlines across the interim and year-end roll-forward cycles

3. Exceptions, Deficiencies & Remediation Tracking

· Identify and clearly document control exceptions, deviations and deficiencies

· Escalate exceptions promptly to the Internal Controls Manager with the supporting facts

· Log deficiencies and agreed remediation actions in the internal tracking system and monitor progress through to closure

· Re-test remediated controls and retain the supporting evidence

4. Systems, Data & Excel-Based Testing

· Extract transaction listings, control reports and system evidence from SAP S/4HANA and related applications

· Use Excel (lookups, pivot tables, filtering and reconciliation techniques) to analyse populations and support sample selection

· Verify the completeness and accuracy of key reports and information produced by the entity (IPE) used in the operation of controls

· Suggest practical improvements to testing templates, evidence requests and working practices

5. Stakeholder Engagement & Global Coverage

· Work directly with control owners across finance, operations and shared services to schedule walkthroughs and obtain evidence on time

· Follow up professionally and persistently on outstanding or incomplete evidence requests

· Engage with FMC sites internationally — including Portuguese-speaking sites — to perform walkthroughs and testing, with occasional travel where required

· Act as a credible, responsive first point of contact for day-to-day SOX queries from the business

6. Audit Support & Continuous Improvement

· Provide workpapers, documentation and evidence packs to internal and external auditors and respond to follow-up queries

· Support the annual management certification and SOX reporting process

· Contribute to the upkeep of control libraries, standard testing templates and evidence requirements

· Participate in ad-hoc Risk, Controls & Audit projects as required.

The Internal Controls team in Cork supports FMC's global SOX compliance programme. This is a dedicated testing role within that team, suited to someone who wants to build genuine, practical expertise in internal control and SOX compliance rather than follow a rotational graduate pathway.

We are seeking a qualified Accounting Technician (ATI or IATI) or equivalent. The successful candidate will take pride in accurate, well-documented, on-time work and will be comfortable operating within a defined testing methodology.

jobs.title: Clinical Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Clinical Business Analyst

Location: Bon Secours Health System (Travel across Cork, Galway, Limerick, Dublin and Tralee as required)


Bon Secours Health System (BSHS) is seeking an experienced and motivated Clinical Business Analyst to join our BonsConnect Electronic Health Record (EHR) Programme.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in one of the most significant healthcare transformation initiatives in Ireland. As BSHS continues the implementation of BonsConnect, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about improving healthcare through digital transformation.

Background

The implementation of BonsConnect is a cornerstone of the Bon Secours Health System Strategy and will support the delivery of high-quality, connected care across our hospitals.

The programme will deliver:

  • Improved Patient Care through easier, faster and more accurate access to patient information, enabling better clinical decision-making.
  • Increased Efficiency by streamlining administrative processes, reducing paperwork and minimising manual data entry errors.
  • Revenue Cycle Improvements through enhanced billing processes, accelerated collections and reduced revenue leakage.
  • Improved Patient Engagement by enabling patients to access their health information and participate more actively in their care journey.
  • Clinical Standardisation through common workflows, policies, standards and reporting across the Bon Secours Health System.

Working in partnership with MEDITECH, BSHS is implementing a state-of-the-art Electronic Health Record solution across all five hospitals, transforming how care is delivered and experienced.

About the Role

The Clinical Business Analyst acts as the critical link between clinical users, operational teams and technical specialists throughout the EHR implementation lifecycle.

You will work closely with the Inpatient Medicine Working Group and broader BonsConnect Programme team to analyse current clinical workflows, define future-state processes, support system build and testing activities, and ensure successful adoption of the EHR solution.

The role offers the opportunity to directly influence how clinical care is delivered across the organisation while helping to shape the future digital landscape of healthcare within Bon Secours Health System.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Workflow Analysis and Design

  • Engage with clinical, operational and administrative stakeholders to understand current workflows and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Analyse and document business and clinical requirements.
  • Design future-state workflows aligned with best practice and EHR capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities for clinical workflow standardisation across departments and hospital sites.
  • Assess clinical, operational and organisational impacts of proposed changes.

EHR Design, Build and Validation

  • Support the Inpatient Medicine Working Group in system build reviews, enhancements and configuration activities.
  • Collaborate with application analysts and technical teams during system design and configuration.
  • Validate that system functionality meets agreed business and clinical requirements.
  • Participate in workflow demonstrations, system reviews and configuration validation sessions.
  • Support data migration planning and data validation activities where required.

Testing, Training and Go-Live Support

  • Support system testing activities including workflow validation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), high-level validation and parallel testing.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of policies, procedures and supporting documentation.
  • Facilitate end-user training sessions, workshops and workflow validation activities.
  • Develop training materials, standard operating procedures and quick reference guides.
  • Provide onsite and remote go-live support and assist end users throughout transition periods.
  • Contribute to post-implementation reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration

  • Build effective working relationships with clinicians, nursing staff, allied health professionals, operational managers and executive stakeholders.
  • Facilitate effective communication between clinical users, programme teams and vendors.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project progress effectively.
  • Support issue resolution, decision-making and risk management activities.
  • Collaborate with MEDITECH and other third-party solution providers to support successful programme delivery.

Change Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Support organisational change initiatives associated with EHR implementation.
  • Promote adoption of new digital workflows and ways of working.
  • Contribute to lessons learned and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional duties as required to support successful delivery of the BonsConnect Programme.

Person Specification

Essential Qualifications

  • Third-level qualification in Nursing, Allied Health, or a related healthcare discipline.
  • Experience working within a healthcare environment.

We connect every system in your building, from lighting and heating to occupancy, air quality and more. Our dedicated team of project managers, data analysts and energy specialists are 100% hands-on – this is what makes us different; we go beyond hardware and software. We make buildings work.

Our dedicated teams have been working in the field of WiFi and Smart Connectivity for over 20 years and have built and operated a number of successful brands. The role

At Optimise Everything everyone in the business plays their part in reducing the energy and carbon consumption in the buildings we work with using innovation, software, hardware and common sense.

The Operations Team is at the forefront of this activity, leading the charge on reporting and engaging with internal and external stakeholders to produce impactful results.

In between support items, you’ll assist with monitoring and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and network infrastructure, provide support for network-related incidents.

Excellent communication and organisation skills are key attributes for success in this fast paced role.

Be an all rounder, helping out with the overall operations of the business and getting into the detail of data.

Be prepared to get hands on and make a difference.

Data Quality and Management

- Ensure data accuracy by resolving any inconsistencies or issues.

- Organise digital databases to ensure secure and easy data access.

Collaboration and Communication

- Collaborate with departments like Facility management to align strategies with operational goals.

Bank of America is looking for proactive, risk-focused and analytically minded individuals to join the EMEA Corporate Audit Summer Analyst Program as part of the EMEA Corporate Audit team, which comprises of approximately 100 associates across London, Dublin, Chester, Paris and Istanbul.

Corporate Audit is responsible for providing an independent assessment of whether controlling processes within Bank of America are adequately designed and function effectively to mitigate potential risks. Corporate Audit teammates cover all areas of the corporation, performing validation of the company’s risk management activities through testing of key processes and controls across the company.

Management and the Audit Committee are provided with regular reporting of Bank of America’s risk management systems and internal controls. Additionally, Corporate Audit provides risk-based advice and counsel to management to help develop and maintain an appropriate customer-focused risk management culture that supports the Corporation's business objectives. This is a great opportunity to work within a diverse team of individuals that cover global businesses and their processes. The Corporate Audit Summer Analyst Program is a 10-week summer internship that introduces you to Bank of America and Corporate Audit. It offers you the opportunity to develop an understanding of internal audit across the bank’s Global Banking and Markets businesses and the control functions that support them.

Our goal for summer interns is to have the opportunity to build upon your academic foundation – specifically technical skills, industry knowledge and familiarity with a corporate environment – while pursuing your career based on your interests and background.

Corporate Audit internships provide exposure to internal auditing, access to senior leaders and comprehensive training to support your development. As a summer intern, you will establish meaningful relationships, participate in philanthropic volunteer activities, and explore the auditing profession.

Training and Development

Your training and development is our top priority with extensive formal training offered at the start of the programme in addition to on the job support, educational speaker events and mentorship throughout.

Develop core skills focused on audit practices, methodology and business expertise.
Contribute to the work of the audit team in delivering their planned audit coverage, including performing validation of the company’s risk management activities through testing of key processes and controls across the company.
Write risk-focused conclusions for your audit work to explain the results of the audit process to senior management.
Develop your understanding of the bank’s core products, the control functions that support them and the bank’s risk and control framework.
Complete an audit-focused group project on a current or emerging risk topic.

This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria.


What You’ll Do as Associate Product Owner

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:

  • Understand business challenges and translate them into test-and-learn opportunities through proof of concepts.
  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery and design through development, optimisation and operational support, leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver desired outcomes.
  • Define, maintain and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer needs and strategic priorities.
  • Create and manage user stories, requirements and acceptance criteria to enable clear and effective delivery.
  • Use customer, colleague, market and data insights to prioritise features and enhancements based on value, business impact and cost efficiency.
  • Lead sprint and release planning, manage cross-team dependencies, drive continuous delivery and product improvements, communicate progress, risks and opportunities to stakeholders, support product adoption and ensure compliance with governance frameworks.


What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:

  • Experience in technology delivery, product management, delivery management, or business analysis.
  • Understanding of backlog and roadmap management with experience working in multidisciplinary delivery teams.
  • Experience writing user stories and business requirements to support successful product delivery.
  • Knowledge of Agile frameworks such as Scrum or SAFe and an understanding of product management practices.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to balance cost, value, and customer experience while identifying business opportunities from emerging technologies.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills with the ability to influence business partners, suppliers, technical teams, and non-technical stakeholders across global delivery teams.


Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 480 stores in 18 countries today and growing.

So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.

You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

POSITION SUMMARY

KKR is seeking an Information Security Risk Analyst to join the Information Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team. The role will help build and operate cyber and technology governance processes, identify and document risk issues, support remediation strategies, and manage cyber regulatory initiatives. The successful candidate will work across Information Security, Technology, and control functions to strengthen governance, improve risk visibility, support security assessments, and enhance cyber risk reporting.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Cyber Risk & Issue Management

  • Support the identification, assessment, documentation, and management of cyber and technology risk issues and develop appropriate remediation, mitigation, and risk management strategies..
  • Monitor risk issues and remediation activities, helping ensure risks are appropriately governed through their lifecycle.
  • Maintain and support workflows to help ensure cyber risk and exception processes operate consistently and effectively.

Cyber Governance & Control Frameworks

  • Help develop and enhance cyber and technology governance frameworks, standards, procedures, and supporting documentation.
  • Support the development and maintenance of a cyber control catalog and associated control documentation.
  • Support improvements to governance tooling, workflow design, and documentation.

Security & Technology Risk Assessments

  • Support security risk assessments of applications, systems, technologies, and technology changes.
  • Participate in application security and system design assessments to identify security risks and control requirements.
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to understand system designs, identify risks, and recommend proportionate security controls.

Cyber Regulatory & Compliance Initiatives

  • Support the delivery and coordination of cyber regulatory initiatives in response to new and changing regulatory requirements.
  • Help assess regulatory requirements and translate them into practical governance, risk, and control activities.
  • Help ensure cyber governance processes remain aligned with applicable regulatory obligations and industry frameworks.

Cyber Metrics & Reporting

  • Support the development and enhancement of cyber risk metrics, management information, dashboards, and reporting.
  • Analyze risk and governance data to identify trends, themes, and areas requiring management attention.
  • Help communicate cyber risk information clearly to technical, business, management, and control stakeholders.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Information Systems, Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field—or equivalent work experience.
  • Cybersecurity certification would be advantageous, such as CISSP, CompTIA Security+, or an equivalent industry-recognized certification(s).

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience working within Information Security, Technology Risk, GRC, Internal Controls, or a related technology governance function.
  • Experience identifying, documenting, assessing, and tracking cyber or technology risk issues through remediation or formal risk acceptance.
  • Exposure to cyber governance frameworks, standards, and control models such as NIST or CIS as well as regulatory frameworks like SOX or NIS 2.
  • Experience supporting the development or maintenance of cyber policies, standards, procedures, control catalogs, or governance documentation.
  • Exposure to application security assessments, system design reviews, product security reviews, or broader technology risk assessments.
  • Experience developing or contributing to cyber risk metrics, dashboards, management reporting, or other risk-based management information.
  • Familiarity with GRC platforms, workflow or ticketing tools, risk registers, reporting tools, or data analysis platforms used to support governance and risk processes.

SOFT SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to translate complex security, risk, and regulatory topics into clear, practical, and business-friendly guidance/actions.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build effective relationships across Information Security, Technology, business, risk, compliance, and other control functions.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented, with a willingness to contribute across a global team and work effectively with colleagues from different disciplines and backgrounds.
  • Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership, initiative, and accountability for the quality of work delivered.
  • Comfortable operating in areas of ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities, technologies, regulatory expectations, and business needs.

Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy.The Trust & Safety team at TikTok helps ensure that our global community is safe and empowered to create and enjoy content across all of our applications. We have invested heavily in policy making, product development, and human and automatic moderation to protect billions of users around the globe from harmful content and abusive behaviors.The mission of data science is to help Trust & Safety make many good decisions using data. As a member of our team, you are instrumental in ensuring that we use data to keep our users and community safe. You will help scope out projects, ideate on new strategies, and most importantly, use data to find insights, diagnose problems and tell compelling stories. You will partner with a variety of stakeholders across operations, policy, product and engineering teams - both locally and globally. What You Will do: - Work with large and complex data sets to support project execution and strategic planning- Design and monitor core metrics; perform root cause analysis to explain drivers- Collaborate closely with the global Trust and Safety team, proactively providing insights and recommendations and overseeing the macro direction of the business- Influence stakeholders through data-based recommendations and mobilize cross-functional teams by telling compelling stories with data to drive business impact and innovative breakthrough- Use data and insights to form best-in-class heuristics to proactively detect and disarm safety incidents- Develop metrics and visualization tools to evaluate risks of the platform and the impact of safety strategiesQualificationsMinimum Qualification(s)- 5+ years of experience in data science, analytics or quantitative analysis- Experience working with SQL, ETL, R/Python, Tableau, Excel- Experience building data infrastructure and implementing reporting solutions- Experience with creating data visualizations to communicate metric performance- Independently design, research, develop and apply ML/AI solutions to solve business problems, including prediction, optimization, segmentation and so on. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​We strive to do great things with great people. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​​Diversity & Inclusion​TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. jobs.title: Digital Health Scientist
jobs.description:
Company Description

At Amwell, we're transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don't just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.

We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry's biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care.

We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum, including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.

For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology's role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.

Brief Overview

The Digital Health Scientist is responsible for generating and communicating evidence that demonstrates the clinical, economic, value-based, and business impact of Amwell's digital health and telemedicine solutions. This role leads and supports research initiatives, analyzes complex healthcare data, collaborates with customers and cross-functional teams, and contributes to scientific publications and thought leadership efforts. The Digital Health Scientist plays a critical role in advancing evidence-based virtual care and helping shape the future of digital healthcare delivery.


Core Responsibilities

  • Lead and support research projects focused on clinical, economic, value-based, and business outcomes across Amwell's digital health and telemedicine solutions.
  • Design research methodologies, develop study protocols, and manage project-related research activities.
  • Collect, manage, and analyze quantitative and qualitative data, including surveys, questionnaires, interviews, and large healthcare datasets.
  • Interpret complex findings and translate research outcomes into actionable insights for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Supervise and provide project-level guidance to junior research team members.
  • Collaborate with research leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of research projects and initiatives.
  • Partner with product, engineering, design, sales, marketing, and business intelligence teams to define, measure, and report solution-level and enterprise-level outcomes.
  • Support customers in implementing research studies and establishing success metrics for digital health programs.
  • Present research findings, progress updates, and recommendations to customers, leadership teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Develop customer-facing reports, white papers, infographics, conference presentations, and other evidence-based materials.
  • Prepare, write, submit, and manage peer-reviewed scientific publications, including responding to reviewer feedback and manuscript revisions.
  • Contribute to Amwell's thought leadership and innovation efforts within digital health, telemedicine, and virtual care.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • A PhD (or equivalent research experience) in any specialist area of medicine, health economics, statistics & data analytics or related subjects.
  • Strong understanding of digital health technologies and their role in delivering technology-enabled healthcare services.
  • Experience designing, conducting, and evaluating quantitative and qualitative research studies.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze, interpret, and communicate complex healthcare data and research findings.
  • Experience working with large datasets and generating evidence-based insights.
  • Proven record of peer-reviewed scientific publications.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders across technical, clinical, and business functions.
  • Passion for advancing digital healthcare and improving patient outcomes through evidence-based innovation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience conducting research within the digital health, telemedicine, healthcare technology, or virtual care industry.
  • Experience evaluating digital health interventions within academic, clinical, or healthcare settings.
  • Demonstrated history of research impact through publications, presentations, or customer-facing evidence generation.
  • Experience applying Implementation Science methodologies, including:
  • Normalization Process Theory (NPT)
  • Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR)
  • Exploration, Preparation, Implementation, Sustainment (EPIS)
  • Similar implementation and evaluation frameworks.

Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell.

Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren't just aspirations – they are how we work, every day.

Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages

jobs.title: Production Planner / Co-Ordinator
jobs.description:
The Role

Are you highly organised, enthusiastic, and looking to kick-start your career in a fast-paced manufacturing environment? Alpha Tanks is looking for a Production Planner / Co-ordinator to join our Operations team — a brilliant opportunity for a Business Graduate with technical curiosity, or a Graduate Engineer, to build a career at the heart of the business.

You don't need years of experience — you need a can-do attitude, a willingness to learn, and the drive to get stuck in. Full training and support will be provided.

The Production Planner / Co-ordinator is responsible for translating customer demand and sales forecasts into achievable production schedules, while taking ownership of material availability, material control, and stock accuracy across the operation. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of Planning, Purchasing, Production, and Engineering, and is well suited to a graduate looking to build a career in operations.

The role requires someone who is highly organised, enthusiastic, and comfortable learning on the job — a genuine can-do attitude is more important than a finished skill-set on day one.

Key Responsibilities

Production Planning & Scheduling

  • Develop and maintain the master production schedule in line with customer orders, sales forecasts, and available capacity.
  • Create and issue work orders for planning production
  • Plan individual work cells and machines to balance throughput against on-time delivery (OTD) targets.
  • Adjust plans in response to unplanned events (breakdowns, absenteeism, late material, rush orders) while protecting the schedule as far as possible.
  • Participate in daily planning / production meetings to align priorities across departments.

Material Management & Material Control

  • Monitor and control material and component availability against the production schedule, flagging shortages before they impact the plan.
  • Co-ordinate Purchasing/Procurement to ensure timely inflow of raw materials and bought-in parts.
  • Play a key role in the implementation of the the Stock Management and Bill Of Materials Module in a new ERP system
  • Maintain accurate stock and inventory records within the ERP system, including cycle count and stock reconciliation support.
  • Monitor Work-in-Progress (WIP) and support traceability of materials through the production process.
  • Investigate and resolve stock discrepancies, and support root-cause corrective actions.
  • Support Bill of Materials (BOM) and routing accuracy, updating the master file for product or process changes (process times, work centre routings, etc.).

Co-ordination & Communication

  • Act as a key liaison point between Engineering, Production, Materials and Quality, to keep the schedule realistic and achievable.
  • Escalate any risk to meeting customer requirements promptly, internally and externally, and drive issues to resolution.
  • Update customer portals and respond to customer planning queries where required.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Prepare planning and material reports for management review.
  • Track and report daily/weekly KPIs — OTD, schedule adherence, efficiency, and stock accuracy.
  • Support data analysis to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and Lean initiatives affecting planning and material flow.

Requirements

  • Degree (Level 7 or 8) Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or Engineering degree preferred.
  • Graduate Engineers or Business Graduates with an interest in manufacturing/technical environments are strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Direct experience is not essential — this role is well suited to a graduate or early-career candidate.
  • Any exposure to a manufacturing, planning, materials, or office-based operations environment is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems is a plus but not required — full training will be provided on our new ERP system.

Skills & Attributes

  • Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Enthusiastic, proactive, and genuinely willing to learn on the job.
  • A can-do attitude — this is the single most important quality for this role.
  • Strong numerical and analytical ability; comfortable working with data and Excel.
  • Clear communicator, confident working across departments and with customers.
  • A practical, problem-solving mindset and the resilience to work well under pressure.

What Alpha Tanks Offers

  • Structured mentoring and on-the-job training from experienced professionals
  • Hands-on exposure to production management of projects across pressure vessels, tanks, and bespoke fabrication
  • Supportive, team-based working environment
  • Competitive graduate salary

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short cover letter outlining your interest in the role to info@alphatanks.ie or apply here
