jobs.title: Kinisla Engineering Graduate 2027
jobs.description:
Start Your Career with Kinisla!

Join the Kinisla Graduate Programme in a permanent, full-time role designed for ambitious graduates who aspire to become future senior leaders in our business. This is more than an entry-level graduate job: it is a structured two-year leadership development programme commencing September 2027. It combines formal learning, hands-on operational experience, meaningful projects, mentoring across the business. From day one, you will be challenged to build the commercial, operational and leadership capabilities needed to grow your career with Kinisla.

Assessment centres will take place during the week commencing 18 January 2027. As part of the selection process, you must be available to attend in person during that week.

Working in Engineering at Kinisla:

At Kinisla, Engineering is central to the safe, efficient and sustainable operation of our business. From milk intake through processing to final product packaging, our engineers help ensure every stage of our vertically integrated value chain performs at its best. As a graduate, you will join an experienced team and contribute to live engineering activities and projects from day one. You will work closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Food Safety & Quality, Health & Safety and other teams across the business, building practical knowledge of our production facilities, technologies, processes and products.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Supporting plant operations and troubleshooting equipment issues to maintain safe and reliable production.
  • Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives focused on energy efficiency, waste reduction and process optimisation.
  • Collaborating with Supply Chain, Food Safety & Quality, Health & Safety and Operations to deliver cross-functional solutions.
  • Supporting the implementation of new technologies and automation systems.
  • Participating in capital projects, including equipment upgrades and facility enhancements.
  • Applying lean manufacturing principles and data-led decision-making to improve performance.
  • Building practical knowledge of dairy technologies and processes, including pasteurisation and cheese production.
  • Developing a strong understanding of Kinisla’s product portfolio and its application across retail and foodservice channels.

Developing Kinisla’s Future Leaders

Our Graduate Programme is designed to accelerate your development and prepare you for increasing responsibility and future leadership opportunities at Kinisla. You will benefit from:

  • A permanent role with structured development over two years.
  • Off-the-job learning modules, mentoring and group projects.
  • Hands-on responsibility and meaningful project work from day one.
  • Opportunities to build a broad network across Kinisla.

By the end of the programme, you will have built strong engineering expertise, a broad understanding of the business and the leadership foundations to progress towards more senior roles at Kinisla.

Do You Have What It Takes?

  • You are on track to achieve, or have recently completed, a degree with at least a 2:1 classification in Engineering or a related discipline.
  • You can demonstrate an interest in building a career in Engineering within an FMCG and/or food manufacturing environment.
  • You are curious, open to learning and actively seek feedback.
  • You are a self-starter who takes ownership, prioritises effectively and adapts to changing priorities.
  • You can influence, listen and build trust with internal and external stakeholders.
  • You are ambitious, challenge the status quo and look for practical ways to improve the business.
  • You are flexible to work across different sites and functions.
  • You are eligible to work permanently in the United Kingdom and Republic of Ireland

Discover Your Future with Kinisla:

Kinisla is a vertically integrated dairy, nutritional ingredients and consumer foods business, built on more than 50 years of expertise in milk processing, dairy and nutritional ingredient technology, and product innovation.

Working in close partnership with 2,600 family farms, we produce high-quality, low-carbon-intensity milk for dairy and nutritional ingredient solutions, alongside a strong portfolio of trusted, market-leading consumer products and brands.

With manufacturing operations across Ireland, Northern Ireland and the UK, and a global customer reach, Kinisla is a trusted and forward-looking supplier of high-quality dairy products, ingredients and nutritional solutions. Our four business areas are Agribusiness, Dairy Ingredients, Nutritional Ingredients, and Consumer Foods.

Our purpose is to reimagine dairy for better food and a future worth farming for. Through expertise, innovation and responsible growth, we are helping to shape a more regenerative and climate-conscious future for our dairy.

Rooted in the South-West of Ireland, Kinisla combines deep heritage, global expertise and innovation to create exciting products, partnerships and careers. Our values are Together, Braver, and Further.

jobs.title: Electrical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Electrical Design Engineer

Silent Aire - Dublin


Who We Are

Silent Aire, part of Johnson Controls, is a global leader in designing and manufacturing mission-critical custom air handlers, liquid cooling systems, and modular data centres for hyperscale cloud and colocation providers. We deliver high-performance solutions that prioritise quality, scalability, innovation, and rapid deployment.


What You Will Do

As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will be involved within the electrical design and development of innovative large-scale liquid cooling solutions, CDU projects, and mission-critical HVAC equipment.

You will collaborate with engineering managers, mechanical engineering teams, controls specialists, manufacturing, and project stakeholders to deliver safe, efficient, and compliant electrical designs that meet customer requirements and industry standards.

You will take ownership of electrical system design activities, from concept development and detailed engineering through manufacturing support and final project documentation. Working closely with our Electrical Panel Manufacturing team, you will develop bespoke electrical panel designs, power distribution systems, and control architectures that support high-performance mission-critical facilities.

Your work will directly contribute to the successful delivery of complex projects, ensuring technical excellence, reliability, and scalability throughout the project lifecycle.


How You Will Do It

  • Analyse and interpret customer specifications, technical requirements, and project drawings, ensuring compliance with applicable electrical codes and standards.

  • Develop detailed electrical designs, power distribution schematics, and single-line diagrams using CAD and electrical design software.

  • Produce controls schematics, wiring diagrams, and electrical/control panel layouts for custom air handling and cooling equipment.

  • Perform electrical engineering calculations including load analysis, fault current calculations, cable sizing, MCA, overcurrent protection, and voltage drop assessments.

  • Design and specify electrical power and control systems, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operation.

  • Select, evaluate, and specify electrical components and equipment, preparing accurate bills of materials and technical documentation.

  • Review and approve design deliverables to ensure quality, consistency, and compliance with project requirements.

  • Prepare comprehensive project submittal packages including drawings, calculations, data sheets, specifications, and supporting documentation.

  • Collaborate with mechanical, controls, manufacturing, and project management teams to ensure seamless multidisciplinary integration.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior engineers and designers.

  • Support manufacturing, commissioning, field service, procurement, and customer teams with technical expertise throughout project execution.

  • Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Support business development and bid activities through technical input, design reviews, and cost estimation.


What We Look For

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering (BEng, BSc Eng) or equivalent qualification.

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and AutoCAD Electrical. ePLAN experience would be beneficial.

  • 5+ years' experience in electrical design engineering, preferably within HVAC, data centre, industrial, critical infrastructure, or related industries.

  • Strong knowledge of electrical power distribution systems, motor controls, panel design, and control system integration.

  • Extensive knowledge of relevant electrical codes, standards, and industry best practices.

  • Experience performing electrical calculations and developing engineering design documentation.

  • Strong understanding of electrical protection, control systems, and power system design principles.

  • Ability to review and interpret complex technical specifications and customer requirements.

  • Strong project planning and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to engineering team members.

  • Proactive, self-motivated, and committed to continuous improvement and technical development.

#LI-Onsite

Job Title: CCTV Analyst (part-time)

Based: Northwest Business Park, Dublin (with travel to depots/sites as required)

Reporting to: CCTV and IT Supervisor

Purpose: To support the investigation and resolution of incidents, claims, internal investigations, criminal activity, and other occurrences involving company vehicles, employees, customers, and premises through the effective retrieval, review, analysis, and preservation of CCTV evidence. The role is responsible for ensuring all relevant footage is identified and secured in a timely manner, while liaising with internal stakeholders and external agencies, including An Garda Síochána, insurance providers, local authorities, and regulatory bodies, to assist investigations and support legal, operational, and compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities and Tasks

  • To investigate all incidents, insurance claims, public complaints, occurrences, and criminal acts across the GAI network, using CCTV and other means (desk-top investigations), taking appropriate action where necessary.
  • Accurately update and maintain the internal reporting system of all types of investigations that may have been captured on CCTV to ensure consistent reporting to GAI departments, Gardai, Local Authorities, NTA, etc.
  • Where necessary, present the findings of all types of investigations using the appropriate means to Company Managers, Gardai, Court, NTA and other authorised bodies for action.
  • Conduct CCTV system health checks, ensuring all cameras are working and arrange repairs as appropriate.
  • Liaise with suppliers when errors or faults are found to organise a quick resolution.
  • Attend the scene of an incident where applicable and facilitate the removal of CCTV from a company vehicle as instructed by a GAI Manager or the Gardai.
  • Facilitate and manage all contact with the Gardai for CCTV requests and general enquiries.
  • Review and redact CCTV footage in accordance with GDPR and company procedures.
  • Adhere to the CCTV policy, ensuring data obtained is as per our retention guidelines.
  • Support the IT Supervisor with requests where applicable.
  • Support the Risk and Compliance Manager with new technology or introduced programmes to prevent further incidents and assist with training.
  • To maintain and enforce company policies and procedures, including Dignity in the Workplace, Drugs and Alcohol, Discipline and Grievance etc., for staff reporting to them.
  • To ensure that all colleagues comply with the Health and Safety at Work Act requirements, Company Health and Safety policy and other current legislation.
  • To foster effective working relationships with various bodies, including SIPTU, local authorities, NTA, Gardai, other transport companies, Community Groups etc.
  • Any other reasonable duties as directed by senior management that lies within the scope of the jobholder’s responsibilities.

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

Essential

  • Previous experience reviewing, analysing, and retrieving CCTV or other digital video evidence.
  • Knowledge of CCTV management systems and digital evidence handling processes.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify, assess, and accurately record relevant information.
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests and meet deadlines.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Powerpoint, Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Experience producing clear, factual, and accurate reports.
  • Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgement when prioritising tasks.
  • Understanding of data protection and confidentiality requirements relating to CCTV footage and personal data.
  • Full clean driver’s licence

Desirable

Competencies, desirable traits or attributes:

  • Experience working within the public transport, security, law enforcement, insurance, or investigations sectors.
  • Experience supporting incident investigations, insurance claims, complaints, or disciplinary investigations.
  • Familiarity with GDPR and CCTV-related compliance requirements.
  • Experience liaising with external stakeholders, including An Garda Síochána, insurance companies, solicitors, or regulatory bodies.

Key General Responsibilities:

  • To act in a manner as to ensure the health, safety, welfare, environment and fire safety of yourself and others in the organisation as well as any clients and visitors.
  • Ensure that you and any guests to any company premises understand emergency and evacuation arrangements.
  • Ensure your working environment is maintained in a safe and tidy condition. To act proactively in identifying and any unsafe practices or safety risks in the organisation and reporting these through the appropriate channels.
  • Ensure adherence to all relevant company and Go-Ahead group company policies and procedures.

Note:

This job description is a guide only. Any omission from this job description does not in any way imply that it is not part of the required duties. Employees are expected to comply with the instructions of any Company Official. Go-Ahead Ireland is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome enquiries from everyone and value diversity in our workforce

This is a new role within the company, required due to increase workloads of the department. The right candidate will be a hard-working individual with excellent communication skills and high attention to detail. The role is mainly office-based with some site visit’s if required.   • Good time management and organisation skills

jobs.title: Company Secretary
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Company Secretary to join our Dublin-based Company Secretarial team. This role provides Company Secretarial services to the Dublin Financial Services team, working closely with partners, associates and other professionals on funds-related matters. This is a busy client-facing role that will require a knowledgeable, confident professional who can deliver high-quality work and outstanding client service.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of investment fund clients.
  • Scheduling meetings, assisting with the preparation of agendas.
  • Draft action points and minutes.
  • Facilitating good information flows between board members.
  • Developing a proactive relationship with board members, providing a source of information and advice, and acting as the primary point of contact with non-executive directors.
  • Regular liaison with service providers - Administrator, Depositary, Investment Manager, Lawyers, MLRO and Auditors.
  • Managing the convening and conduct of the AGM and any EGMs.
  • Work with the team to develop use of AI tools for all relevant tasks.
    • Assisting and mentoring junior staff member and the team’s assistants.

Compliance, Regulatory and Internal Control
  • Maintain statutory registers and minute books.
  • Appointed Portal Administrator for the Central Bank’s online system.
  • File CRO & Central Bank forms and relevant documents in a timely manner.
  • Organise execution of documents in between board meetings.
  • Keep abreast of relevant legislative, regulatory and governance developments.
Experience
  • ICSA qualification or working towards same is desirable.
  • 3 years’+ prior company secretarial experience.
    • Exposure to Investment Funds preferable.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • English fluency at native or bilingual level.
  • Excellent interpersonal and organisational skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to multi-task.
  • Ability to prioritise and co-ordinate work.
  • Ability to maintain confidential information.
  • Ability to complete assignments within agreed deadlines by prioritising workload.
  • Ability and willingness to learn new skills as they become necessary.
  • Practice and foster an atmosphere of teamwork and co-operation.
  • Excellent computer skills.
  • Applies highest standards of integrity, honesty and ethics in dealings with others.

This job description is intended to provide an overview of the role and is not an exhaustive list of tasks and responsibilities

jobs.title: Group HR Administrator
jobs.description:
About the role

Reporting directly to the Senior Group HR Generalist, Monument Re is looking to hire a Group HR Administrator. This position will play a vital role in supporting our Group HR function to deliver our priorities and plans across the jurisdictions in which we operate. This position will require the successful candidate to support payroll and HR processes with a strong focus on reporting and analysis to help drive valuable business insights. This role offers an excellent opportunity for growth and development within the wider HR function. This role will be based in Dublin and is an 11-month Fixed Term Contract.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and prepare monthly payroll data for Ireland, the UK and Bermuda, liaising with payroll providers and internal stakeholders to support accurate and timely payroll processing.
  • Administer a range of payroll-related activities, including pension administration, benefit deductions, salary changes, and employee payroll queries.
  • Maintain and update employee records on our HR system, ensuring data accuracy
  • Supporting the preparation of monthly and quarterly HR KPI reports.
  • Monitor and respond to queries received through the HR Operations inbox, escalating issues where required and ensuring timely follow-up.
  • Provide administrative support to the Group HR Team, including drafting letters, preparing documentation, references and responding to ad hoc requests.
  • Support the delivery of an effective onboarding process for new joiners, coordinating documentation, inductions, and employee communications.
  • Coordinate learning and development activities, including training administration, scheduling, logistics management, and communication with participants.
  • Provide administrative support across the recruitment lifecycle when needed, such as advertising, candidate coordination, and interview scheduling.
  • Support the implementation of HR initiatives and projects as and when needed.
  • Provide day-to-day support to the HR team, proactively assisting with the delivery of the Group HR agenda and continuous improvement initiatives.

Role Requirements

This junior role would suit a person who possesses the following skills and attributes:

  • A positive and proactive individual with a strong customer focus.
  • A willingness to learn and support a broad range of HR activities.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ in a HR support role, ideally with exposure to payroll and benefits administration.
  • Excellent organisation and time management skills with a reputation for meeting deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in data and record management.
  • Experience handling confidential employee information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Advanced MS Office skills desirable, particularly in Excel.

Location

Hatch Street, Dublin 2, Ireland. Hybrid working model available.

Closing Date

16th September 2026

Equal Opportunities Statement

The Monument Re Group is an Equal Opportunity employer. Our Corporate values of Trust and Collaboration demonstrate our commitment to fostering an inclusive culture where all our employees feel respected and valued. We recognise that each employee brings their own unique skill sets, capabilities, immutable characteristics, and varied experiences to their work. In turn, the Monument Re Group provides a work environment for all our employees to achieve personal and professional growth and development throughout their careers with us.

jobs.title: Transport Office Administrator
jobs.description:
About us

C.A.B. Freight services is a fast-growing, family-owned Irish logistics company based in Finglas, Dublin. With over 30 years in business, we have built a reputation for reliability, professionalism, and delivering a service our customers can trust.

We operate across two core divisions:

  • Transport – A modern fleet of 30+ trucks providing nationwide deliveries with strong communication, safety and performance standards. Specifically for the Construction Industry.
  • Storage/Office Depot – Secure storage, handling, and fast turnaround times supported by experienced staff and well-maintained equipment.

We continue to invest in our fleet, technology and people as we expand and grow the business. The business is dynamic and exciting while our company continues to focus on our high standards, teamwork and ultimately delivering the best results for our clients and customers.

Due to the scale, pace, and complexity of our business, we are now seeking a Junior Transport Office Administrator to join our existing team. The ideal candidate will be expected to help us to ensure we maintain our strong customer relationships.

Key Responsibilities

To assist in the transport and operations teams with daily operations:

  • Provide administrative support to the transport and management teams.
  • Prepare and process customer documentation accurately.
  • Answer phone calls, emails and customer enquiries professionally.
  • Maintain customer records and update the company Transport System.
  • Assist with job files, invoicing and general office administration.
  • Manage filing, scanning and document organisation.
  • Support vehicle and driver paperwork.
  • Carry out general reception and office duties as required.

This list of responsibilities is not exhaustive and may be updated or modified as needed to meet the evolving needs of the company.

  • Excellent organisational and communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook).
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Positive attitude with a willingness to learn.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to travel independently to our depot in Finglas.
  • Eligibility to work legally in Ireland.

  • working hours will be agreed during the recruitment process.

  • On-site parking

  • Do you have any experience in Administration, Planning and/or routing ?

  • Ireland (required)

jobs.title: Graduate Programme - Store Layouts, In-Store Experience & Technology
jobs.description:
Summary

From our Head Office to the shop floor and everywhere in between our primary goal is to create and deliver a fantastic customer journey for everyone who shops at Lidl.

With over 7,000 colleagues across our stores, warehouses and offices in Ireland and Northern Ireland we are a big and ambitious team. We know our people are our greatest asset and our success is down to the commitment and dedication of our team.

Training and Development

At Lidl, your career isn’t just a job - it’s an investment. We’re big on growth, and we give you all the support, structure, and hands-on experience you need to level up both personally and professionally.

As the only City & Guilds/ILM Accredited Graduate Programme in Ireland , our 18-month Graduate Management Development Programme is built entirely around you .

What makes it different?

  • Tailored To You: Enjoy a bespoke training plan mapped to your unique skills and long-term career goals.
  • Real-World Experience: Get stuck into our stores and distribution centers to learn the heart of our business from the ground up.
  • Blended Learning: Experience dynamic, structured on-the-job training combined with industry-leading modules.

We don't just hire graduates—we build future leaders. Ready to launch yours?

Store Layouts, In-Store Experience & Technology

Ready to shape the future of retail? Sales graduates will gain experience in two distinct teams within the Sales Head Office Department: Store Layouts & Experience and Sales Systems & Solutions.

The Sales department is focussed on in-store experience and technology and is responsible for improving how millions of customers shop and navigate in our 230+ stores. As part of the programme, graduates will spend time working in store at the start of their programme to gain an in-depth experience of how our stores operate.

The Store Layout & Experience team is responsible for creating engaging, intuitive store layouts that maximise space and allow customers to find their favourite products easily. The team leads projects to continually test and refine layouts and works alongside commercial teams to place new and exciting products on Lidl shelves each week.

Sales Systems & Solutions drives the technology customers rely on, including shelf checkouts, electronic shelf labels, and traditional checkouts. The team analyzes customer touchpoints and implements next-generation payment innovations to simplify the customer experience.

What you'll need

  • An expected or attained 2.1 Honours Level 8 degree
  • Full driver’s license is required
  • An innovative and creative approach to problem solving.
  • Customer First: a genuine passion for customer satisfaction.
  • Strong personal, communication and presentation skills that will allow you to work and communicate effectively with multiple stakeholders.
  • Motivated and eager to learn
  • Once your store training is complete, you will be based in our head office and must be able to commute to Dublin

What you'll receive

We offer a competitive and transparent salary system, that ensures pay equality across all positions at Lidl

  • €45,500 per annum pro rata
  • 20 days holidays per annum pro rata
  • Private employee medical insurance
  • Flexible start and finish times
  • City & Guilds/ILM assured programme
  • Initial training and on-going development from an experienced team member
  • Responsibility for and involvement in projects with real business impact
  • Excellent opportunities for career progression
  • Bespoke training plan depending on current skills and career path
  • One-to-one coaching available from a qualified coach in the business
  • A vast array of training and development opportunities from our in-house training catalogue including Leadership Development Programmes
  • Masterclasses with renowned business experts
  • Director and graduate mentorship programme
  • Modern office facility with free parking
  • On-site gym and canteen
  • Up to 2 days remote working per week
  • Mobile and broadband discounts with Three network
  • Unlock a flex pot allowance to spend on a selection of benefits after 6 months of service

Lidl is an equal opportunities employer. If you have any particular requirements, we will ensure any reasonable accommodations are implemented as part of the recruitment and selection process. We value diversity and inclusion in our workplace and want to ensure that all applicants have the same opportunity regardless of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, age, disability, race, religious belief, political opinion or membership of the traveller community.

jobs.description: Job Title: Volunteer CoordinatorLocation: Tallaght, DublinReporting to: Volunteer ManagerContract: Indefinite duration Hours:  37.5 hours per weekSalary: €33,000- €38,000 per annum About FoodCloudFoodCloud has a vision for a world where no good food goes to waste, and the only thing bigger than our vision is our drive. Are you an experienced coordinator who would like to work for one of Ireland's fastest-growing social enterprises? If this sounds like you, we have the ideal role here at FoodCloud.About the Job:Volunteers are the beating heart of FoodCloud, serving as an essential part of our operations to help grow our impact and financial sustainability while controlling operational costs. The Volunteer Coordinator (Community Focus) sits within the Ireland Operations team and reports to the Volunteer Manager.This role is primarily dedicated to our community stakeholders and individual volunteers. You will require strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with teams across FoodCloud who utilise volunteer support to enable their work day to day or during targeted periods or events. This role is responsible for recruiting, coordinating and supervising volunteer involvement in these events in collaboration with other internal and external stakeholders.Additionally, during the late summer and autumn, FoodCloud partners with farms to "glean" leftover crops after harvest as part of our corporate volunteering programme. Graduate Programme Overview

If you're a recent graduate or soon-to-be graduate join us and unlock a world of carefully curated experiences, knowledge, and connections to shape your career. Along the way, you can expect all the training and support you need to make your mark on the world. Put simply, we’ll empower you to help determine how we do things and where we go next. Our graduates are a vital part of our success, and we welcome applications from people from all walks of life. Whoever you are and wherever you want to join us, if you’re curious, creative and ambitious, this is a world in which you can truly belong.

Why the Global Transaction Banking Graduate Programme?

The Global Transaction Banking graduate programme imparts understanding of payment products' importance in our Corporate Banking offering. You will innovate payment solutions for global companies, mastering end-to-end product management with risk controls. Completing the programme will equip you with solid corporate product knowledge for a Corporate Banking career.

There are a huge variety of roles, opportunities and career paths to explore at Transaction Banking. Our teams include people of all levels and experience. We have teams focusing on Technology, Digital, Customer Experience, Data, Specialist Sales, Liquidity, Coverage, Trade, Cash Management, FX, Structuring, Operations and Control, supported by Business Management. Our roles range across the product lifecycle from deep technical specialists to client-facing relationship managers and experts in data, risk and operational rigour. Our Product Managers act like entrepreneurs running their own small business from beginning to end.

This variety gives our people the agility, deep product knowledge and broad commercial understanding to develop their careers in any number of ways. We’re committed to helping our people update and upgrade their skills as they grow with us.

Global Transaction Banking at Barclays

Global Transaction Banking serves a diverse range of clients, including mid-sized corporates, large corporates, financial institutions, and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). These clients are organised based on their specific needs: mid-sized corporates are typically owner-managed and single-banked; large corporates are multi-banked and aligned by industry sectors; financial institutions include banks, payment service providers, and alternative finance companies; and SMEs range from small businesses to more sophisticated financial institution clients.

We provide tailored solutions to meet the unique needs of each client segment, ensuring they receive the appropriate level of service and support.

Barclays Global Transaction Banking is a perfect place to begin, and build, a long, varied and successful career in finance. You’ll be exposed to an unrivalled depth and breadth of experience. You’ll learn skills and gain product knowledge that prepare you for any role in our organisation.

We are a wide ranging and diverse team of people across the UK, Europe, AsiaPac and the US. We have the strategy, leadership, and investment in place to grow our team significantly, upgrade our digital capabilities and drive global expansion. That’s because we are seen by the business as one of Barclays’ key opportunities for growth. With all this growth, there’s also the opportunity to bring a truly global perspective to your career. That could mean managing a global team from your current location, creating products that are adapted for use around the world, or making an exciting international career move.

The work we do touches every aspect of corporate and commercial banking. You’ll also get a unique perspective on global commerce, seeing how financial solutions and working capital support every stage of the corporate value chain.

You’ll be interacting with, and learning from, colleagues from Investment Banking, Corporate Banking, sales, operations, technology, relationship management, compliance and legal teams. You’ll be working closely with Transaction Banking experts who have years of experience and knowledge to share. You’ll be understanding the needs of every size and type of client, across every industry. The relationships and networks you build with colleagues, clients and other financial institutions will be priceless.

Throughout, you’ll be growing our business and forging new ground, with the support of one of the world’s leading corporate and investment banks. So, you’ll enjoy more exposure, access and influence, at an earlier stage, than most established Transaction Banking teams can offer.

There are a whole range of roles to explore, and our commitment to growth means that you’ll have opportunities to innovate, be an entrepreneur and develop your career on a global stage. There are always new products, sectors, markets and regulatory environments to explore.

About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .


Portfolio Price Analyst

Job Overview

The Portfolio Price Analyst supports portfolio-level pricing strategy and quote execution for assigned product areas. This role partners with Business Units, Sales, Finance, and Operations to deliver accurate, competitive, compliant, and data-driven pricing decisions that support revenue growth, margin protection, and long-term price integrity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Portfolio Pricing Strategy: Develop pricing strategies for assigned portfolios, aligning product strategy, market dynamics, customer needs, competitive position, and financial goals.
  • Quote Execution & Escalation Management: Process quotes accurately within SLA targets and escalate strategic, high-volume, restricted, low-margin, or high-value requests as needed.
  • Pricing Compliance & Governance: Ensure pricing decisions follow channel margin policy, end-customer price consistency, LOA, NDA, license, high-risk part, and approval requirements.
  • Margin Protection & Value Capture: Challenge pricing actions that may cause margin leakage, negative precedent, or missed value-capture opportunities.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Business Units and Sales to manage escalations, update pricing strategies, and align decisions with portfolio, account, and opportunity priorities.
  • Market & Portfolio Intelligence: Maintain product and market knowledge and manage price curves based on market movement, lifecycle stage, volume, and competitive intensity.
  • Analytics & Recommendations: Use ADI Price Assistant and data to analyze pipeline, quote conversion, revenue, and margin trends and recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Process Improvement & Knowledge Sharing: Identify process gaps, recommend scalable improvements, support tool enhancements, train new pricers, and share pricing best practices.
  • KPI tracking and success matrix adherence: Demonstrate a clear understanding of the pricer success matrix and adhere to defined KPI expectations to support consistent execution, accountability, pricing discipline, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • 0–3+ years of experience in pricing, sales operations, finance, analytics, contract management, or commercial operations. Strong graduates with relevant internships or corporate experience may also be considered at the appropriate level.
  • Strong business judgment and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret pricing, pipeline, revenue, quote conversion, margin, customer, and portfolio data using ERP, CPQ, CRM, pricing, or reporting tools such as Model N, Pricefx, SAP, or Power BI.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to analyse data and translate findings into clear pricing recommendations.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work under pressure and navigate difficult conversations professionally.
  • High attention to detail in quote accuracy, compliance, documentation, approvals, and SLA commitments.
  • Adaptable and improvement-oriented, with the ability to identify process gaps and support scalable improvements across Pricing, Sales, Business Units, Finance, and Operations.

jobs.description:
Company Description


Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our
services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.


Job Description


Our Impact Assessment Practice team are currently recruiting a graduate within our Dublin office to start between Nov 26 - Jan 27.

About our Team

Impact Assessment is part of the Environment business, which comprises around 730 professionals across the UK and Republic of Ireland. The team delivers environment and sustainability solutions to both public and private sector clients and plays a leading role in addressing the climate and biodiversity emergencies.

It comprises the following practice areas: Acoustics; Air Quality; Ecology; Geospatial & Data Services; Heritage; Landscape; Water Environment; Impact Assessment; Planning; Climate Change, Sustainability & Resilience; Stakeholder Engagement; and ESIA & ESDD (international environment and sustainability work). Our IAPA work includes:

  • Coordinating multidisciplinary environmental inputs across a wide range of infrastructure development projects, helping them to gain development consent
  • Working with clients and design teams to identify environmental constraints, avoid impacts and develop solutions, as well as delivering benefits where possible
  • Coordinating the preparation of environmental assessment reports
  • Post-planning consent support to projects (including during project construction and operation)

Projects

AECOM are at the forefront of delivering Environmental Impact Assessments for the nationally significant infrastructure projects that are providing for our future. Key projects include sustainable energy generation and transmission and water distribution.

Here's what you'll do:

We need people with inquiring minds who can ask the questions to understand and then shape projects to achieve environmentally beneficial outcomes. The ability to work with people with different perspectives is essential to understand what Clients really need, what the design means and how it matters to stakeholders. So, communication – verbal and written – to interact with others and seek understanding, is important, but we accept that it is a skill that develops over time. We like people with an appetite to learn and develop – taking personal responsibility, but understanding how to confirm that we are getting to a good outcome.

Enjoy the Perks

At AECOM, you'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well-being, customised to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days.

Here is what you will get from us!

On the job support and learning

When a graduate starts at AECOM, we pair them with a senior member of the team who will guide and mentor them through their initial period working on live projects and business development tasks, to support with any technical queries.

Graduate Development Programme

Our 2 year graduate ADVANCE programme is designed to help you build your career in AECOM. You will attend a number of instructor-led training sessions where you will meet and hear from people across the business and take part in a series of interactive activities to equip you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed in your role. Alongside the instructor-led elements of the ADVANCE programme, you will also engage with an online curriculum via AECOM University and have the opportunity to join the ADVANCE webinar series. We will provide you with all the support and tools you need to achieve your professional development ambitions, which may include Chartership with the relevant international professional institution eg Institute for Sustainability and Environmental Professionals (ISEP), Institute of Environmental Science (IES).

We have more than 750 graduates on our programmes across the UK and Ireland from more than 40 different disciplines, each making a tangible difference to the environment in which we live and work.

See our digital early careers e-brochure here


Qualifications


Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Ideally, you will have a relevant first degree and, potentially, a relevant post-graduate degree.
Relevant first or post-graduate degree subjects include: environmental impact assessment, environmental economics, environmental management, environmental planning, environmental policy, environmental science, geography, housing (sustainable, planning, regeneration and urban management), social science, sustainable development.

  • A good understanding of the potential for digital solutions to assist in tackling environment and sustainability challenge

This team develops data products, predictive models, machine learning products, and applied AI solutions that help better understand customers and improve go-to-market decisions across the customer lifecycle.

In this role, you will apply machine learning, statistical methods, and practical AI techniques to complex business problems with meaningful impact. You will work across complex, real-world datasets, develop and improve models, and partner with cross-functional stakeholders to turn data into scalable products and business insights. This role is well suited for a strong individual contributor who brings deep technical judgment, thrives in ambiguity, and can guide high-impact work across multiple efforts.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience and a graduate degree in data science, computer science, statistics, or a related quantitative field
  • Advanced Python and SQL skills, including experience working with large-scale data warehouses
  • Experience leading end-to-end development of machine learning models, data science products, or advanced analytical solutions in a business environment
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts, decisions, and tradeoffs to different audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with dbt
  • Familiarity with go-to-market data such as Salesforce, financial metrics, or product usage and engagement data
  • Experience using AI productivity and coding tools

The Ideal Candidate

  • Is flexible and works effectively with their manager, product owners, and stakeholders to prioritize across multiple projects
  • Has strong attention to detail and cares deeply about data quality
  • Proactively engages stakeholders to better understand business needs
  • Enjoys collaborating with team members to drive impact
  • Is comfortable working through ambiguity and bringing structure to open-ended problems

Research


Vacancy Summary

Project Title: Formulation Innovation to Enhance Thermal Stability and Deployability of a Lassa Fever Vaccine

Vaccine deployment is severely constrained by the need for logistics including cold chain distribution. Infectious diseases remain a major threat to health and health security in the EU and globally and thus a proactive approach to the development of vaccines in preparedness for future infectious disease outbreaks is needed. One such threat is Lassa mammarenavirus, which remains a major epidemic threat in West Africa and a priority pathogen for global health security. Our partners have successfully developed a live recombinant virus vector Lassa vaccine to clinical testing. However, this vaccine currently requires ultra-cold chain storage with limited refrigerator stability. This creates challenges for broad deployment and storage, particularly for rapid use in an outbreak response and for routine preventive use in endemic settings in resource-limited regions.

In this Horizon-EU funded project, the consortium will advance this Lassa vaccine candidate toward a next-generation formulation optimized for epidemic deployment. Specifically, the partners will develop and eval-uate a thermostable formulation manufactured using scalable, production technologies and advance it through required preclinical testing and first in human clinical evaluation. Scientists in the Vaccine Immun-isation Technology and Access (VITAL) group in NIBRT will collaborate with the vaccine manufacturing part-ner to identify, develop and verify thermostabilising formulations and processes for this live virus vector vac-cine. We will focus on developing a liquid and a lyophilised form vaccines.

Position Available

Research Fellow

Location

Dublin

Department

Research

Hiring Manager

Professor Anne Moore

Contract Type

24 Month SPC

Application Date

October 2026

Interview Dates

November 2026

Start Date: January 2027

Salary & Benefits

Competitive salary and excellent suite of benefits including pension, private health insurance, income protection scheme, 25 days annual leave plus up to 3 additional company days off, generous training and career development supports, flexible working hours and work from home set up supported.

Role Purpose

We are seeking a motivated and innovative Research Fellow to join the Lassa LIFT consortium at NIBRT. The primary focus is to identify, develop and verify thermostabilising formulations and processes for this live virus vector vaccine using pharmaceutical and virology methodologies. The successful candidate will perform research that focuses on developing drying processes and formulations for this virus vaccine, which can be transferred to a partner for subsequent manufacturing using scalable, production technologies.

The successful candidate will have a background in the pharmaceutical and vaccine sciences, with an ability to work to a high standard. The Fellow must have direct experience of working in vaccine or biopharmaceutical formulation and stabilization, ideally in a commercial environment. The Fellow must have excellent communication motivation, planning, organising skills, practical, problem solving, record-keeping skills and the ability to work as part of a team.

This role represents a step change from Post-Doctoral researcher roles as it combines high-quality, collaborative vaccine biopharmaceutical research with operational leadership. In partnership with the PI, the Fellow will have a leading role in the project within NIBRT. As such, in addition to contributing to the technical development of a stabilised vaccine for enhanced deployment this role offers the opportunity to develop as an independent investigator in the vaccine field and begin to move into a leadership role.

Key Responsibilities

The key responsibilities of the job include:

  • Conduct a specified programme of research under the supervision and direction of a Principal Investigator/Project Leader to the highest standards of research integrity and health and safety.
  • Assume a role in the design as well as the execution of this research.

At AECOM, our Ground Engineering Practice serves a wide range of end markets including the energy, water, nuclear (decommissioning and new build), defence, aviation, ports, data centres, highways and rail. We provide one-stop access to services in feasibility and desktop studies, ground investigation, interpretation, detailed design, contract administration, technical advisory and construction supervision for geotechnical works.

We work for leading UK and International clients, including National Grid, BP, Sellafield, Associated British Ports, Transport Scotland, National Highways, Transport Infrastructure Ireland, Network Rail, and local authorities, as well as for prominent contractors and developers. Our impressive portfolio features a range of regional and national projects, such as the Great Grid Upgrade, STEP Fusion, pumped storage hydro projects in the Scottish Highlands, Snowdonia VIP, A83 Rest and be Thankful, M54-M6 Link Road, water schemes for various water utilities clients (UK&I) and HMNB Devonport redevelopment. As our business continues to expand nationwide, we are dedicated to fostering high-performing teams across all sectors through strong and inspiring leadership.

We are excited to invite applications from candidates located anywhere in the UK!

Technical Director / Associate Director - Ground Engineering Team: In this pivotal senior role, you will drive the technical development of our Ground Engineering team while strengthening its capabilities and supporting business growth through the development and management of strong client relationships.

Here’s what you’ll be doing

  • Overseeing input, peer review and verification of geotechnical data and analyses as well as design calculations based on sound technical understanding and experience.

Qualifications

  • A degree in Civil Engineering or Engineering Geology/Geology, with a 2:1 classification (or equivalent) or higher.
  • An MSc/MEng in Soil Mechanics, Geotechnical Engineering or Engineering Geology is advantageous.
  • Chartered status.
  • Strong knowledge of UK ground conditions and ground investigation practices.
  • Demonstrable understanding of current design codes, standards, and best practices in geotechnical design, but also open to exploring new methods and innovations.
  • Ability to collaborate closely in project delivery, work winning and maintaining high levels of client satisfaction.

  • Ability to develop and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description:
Trinity is Ireland’s leading university and is ranked 75th in the world (QS World University Rankings 2026). Founded in 1592, the University is steeped in history with a reputation for excellence in education, research, and innovation, which has been inspiring generations of thinkers for over 400 years. Thrive: Trinity College Dublin's Strategic Plan 2025 - 2030
Post ID: 039557
Post Summary: The post holder will be part of a multidisciplinary research team, based at St James’ Hospital in Dublin, working on studies related to interventions (drug and on-drug interventions) for Alzheimer disease, Lewy body and other forms of dementia. Our studies use different methods including imaging, biomarkers and neuropsychological methods to assess healthy volunteers, carers and people with lived experience.
The post-holder’s primary job will be coordinating the Lewy Academy programme for training healthcare professionals, producing a policy brief and a systems map of the outputs of EMERALD-Lewy and how they can be integrated into existing policy structures in Ireland. Programme’s goal is to improve the diagnosis, management and lived experience of people with Lewy Body Dementia in Ireland. To this effect, the post holder will work together with the Programme’s stakeholders consisting of clinicians, scientists, industry partners, research assistants, PhD students and people with lived experience of Lewy body dementia and carers to coordinate data collection and drive the work package’s research output.
The Research Assistant will be part of Work Package 2 and Work Package 10. The goal of WP 2 is to develop the clinical research in Ireland for Lewy Body Dementia, including the upskilling of current labour force. The leads of the work package are Prof. Iracema Leroi form Trinity College Dublin and Prof. Suzanne Timmons from University College Cork. The goal of WP 10 is to understand the policy entry points and propose a potential model of implementation of EMERALD-Lewy’s research outputs. This package is led by Prof. Kim Nyugen Huong from University of Queensland. The post holder will specifically support WP2 and WP10 by coordinating the running and assessment of the Lewy Academy training programme and developing a policy map and brief for the entry points of the outputs for EMERALD-Lewy into public policy in Ireland. They will also interface with the existing EMERALD-Lewy research team to support other research outputs.
Post status: Specific Purpose Contract, Full Time
Salary: This appointment will be made on the RA Level 1 Pay Grade according to IUA Salary Scales at a point in line with current Government pay policy.

Name: Anusha Yasoda-Mohan
Email Address: anusha.mohan@tcd.ie
Closing Date: Monday 9th November 2026 at 12:00 noon (Irish Standard time)

Values matter. They are key to the success of our Strategic Plan. We centre our behavioural values around the importance of belonging. Across your rotations, you’ll gain hands-on experience in technical and lab-based environments, learning how our RD&A teams investigate, test and scale foundational technologies that support product development and help shape the future of sustainable nutrition.

  • You’re fluent in English and ideally another language
  • You’re excited by science, technology and new ways of working, and keen to use data, digital tools and AI thoughtfully to improve how products are developed, tested and scaled

Start your career where your ideas, curiosity and technical skills can make a meaningful difference. As a Graduate Engineer at Boston Scientific, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, contribute to innovative medical technologies and build hands-on experience in a collaborative environment.


Depending on your area of assignment, you may support Operations, New Product Development or Sustaining Engineering. In Operations, you will help support products, processes, materials and equipment to achieve production goals across quality, delivery, cost, productivity and safety. Within New Product Development and Sustaining Engineering, you will contribute to the development and advancement of product design deliverables for next-generation and commercialized products.


This is an opportunity to apply what you learned during your studies, develop your technical and problem-solving capabilities and gain valuable experience while contributing to technologies designed to improve patients' lives.

  • Build quality into all aspects of your work by maintaining compliance with all quality requirements.
  • Assist in defining and implementing quality standards and specifications and help ensure corporate and regulatory requirements are met.
  • Identify and resolve moderately complex exceptions to work assignments.
  • Participate, as required, in new product and technology transfers to gain valuable experience and exposure.
  • Apply knowledge of Six Sigma, statistical analysis and Lean principles to investigate and solve problems and improve quality.
  • Demonstrate familiarity with validation techniques and associated regulatory requirements, including the analysis of customer feedback and complaints.
  • Understand and proactively support environmental management requirements.

  • Eligibility to work in Ireland.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the initiative to contribute in a collaborative environment.
  • Strong systems aptitude and an interest in developing technical skills.
  • Enthusiastic, proactive approach to learning and problem-solving.
  • Interest in medical technology, manufacturing, product development or continuous improvement.

jobs.title: GPU Performance Engineer (Inference)
jobs.description: OverviewTensorX is a sovereign AI infrastructure platform headquartered in Dublin. We run frontier open-weight large language models on our own NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs in European datacentres, under EU jurisdiction. Customers reach them through a drop-in OpenAI-compatible API. Nothing they send is retained after the request completes. We serve regulated enterprises in finance, healthcare and government as well as developers and AI platforms. We help them adopt AI without compromising on data privacy, compliance or performance.We are looking for multiple GPU Performance Engineers to join our growing engineering team. Reporting to the CTO, you will make each inference engine in our fleet do more work inside its latency target. You will take engine problems from report to fix, patch the open-source engines we depend on and go beneath them to the kernel when the engine is the limit.Our margin depends on one number: how many requests each GPU answers inside a latency target. That is not the same as peak tokens per second on a benchmark. Passengers carried, not miles per hour. Our customers send very long contexts at high concurrency, so the constraint that matters is rarely the one the headline number measures.The serving engines we depend on, SGLang first, are open source and still maturing. We hit their defects early because we run new models on day zero. We patch them, tune them and change the kernel where the engine itself is the limit. A new open-weight model worth serving arrives most weeks and more GPU capacity is going live now. We are an AI-native team. Tools such as Claude Code and Codex are part of our daily workflow and materially accelerate how we build and operate systems.You will work side by side with our Inference Team, who run NVIDIA Dynamo and the serving fleet. You make each worker faster. They make the fleet of workers behave.We hire on evidence of skill, not years of experience. We will hire across multiple levels. One of the seats may suit someone earlier in their career.This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning engine performance, GPU kernels, model bring-up and cache behaviour.ResponsibilitiesEngine tickets end to end - Take engine problems from report to fix. A model runs out of memory at long context, a patch cuts throughput or a new release breaks tool calling. Reproduce it, find the mechanism, test a fix, patch it and roll it out. Then write down what you found.Investigation & diagnosis - Debug across GPU memory, the engine scheduler, the container, the router and the traffic shape. Many of our hardest problems sit where two of these meet. When you raise a problem with the team, bring a read, not a question: what you think it is and why.Goodput per GPU - Goodput is the number of requests each GPU answers inside the latency target. Find where it is being lost, whether in a kernel, the scheduler, the router or a configuration flag. Win it back. Measure every gain on production traffic patterns rather than a synthetic load.Engine patches & upstream - Patch SGLang and vLLM defects on new models. Bake each fix into the image and keep the patch set consistent across the fleet. Where a fix is not specific to us, open the pull request upstream, not just the issue.GPU kernels - When profiling shows an engine kernel is the bottleneck, write or modify it. Examples include Blackwell attention/indexer paths, FP8/FP4 paths and memory-bound decode. Profile before you form an opinion.Model bring-up - Bring up new models on day zero. Run A/B bake-offs across parallelism layouts, KV cache configurations and speculative decoding settings. Test tensor, data and expert parallelism for each model. Give the Inference Team the best layout for each model so they can size the pools.Cache behaviour - Tune prefix caching, KV cache behaviour and KV replication under tensor parallelism inside the engine. Work with the Inference Team on cache-aware routing and contribute to the router code.Pre-production gate - Share the pre-production gate with the Inference Team so no change reaches a customer unmeasured. Run it on your own changes and on every model you bring up.Documentation - Write up every finding as a report someone else can rerun. Explain trade-offs plainly enough for the Inference Team and for customers. Keep a benchmark method that works without you in the room.Skills & ExperienceEvidence that you can read an inference engine's source to find the mechanism behind a problem rather than only the symptom. A pull request, a write-up or a post-mortem we can checkSolid understanding of GPU architecture and CUDA fundamentals: memory hierarchy, occupancy and what makes a kernel compute-bound or memory-boundWorking knowledge of transformer inference: attention variants (MLA, DSA, GQA), KV cache behaviour, continuous batching and the accuracy impact of quantisationProficiency in Python and comfort reading C++ and CUDAA measure-first habit: one variable per test arm, a pass or fail bar set before you run and a correctness check before you trust a timingHonest about results, including the ones that did not work out. Losing to a baseline and saying so counts in your favourA drive to learn. The stack changes every week. We value someone who reads the source over someone who already knows last year's answerComfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) as part of your daily workflowA clear and concise communicator who thrives in ambiguity and can articulate technical decisions to both technical and non-technical audiencesNice to HaveA track record of writing and benchmarking CUDA kernels on Hopper or BlackwellUpstream contributions to SGLang, vLLM or TensorRT-LLMExperience with Triton, CUTLASS, CuTe, ThunderKittens or similar kernel toolsKernel entries in GPU Mode leaderboards, MLSys contests or FlashInfer challengesExperience profiling memory behaviour and out-of-memory errors on large modelsHands-on time with Blackwell features (tcgen05, TMEM, TMA)Technical w

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Multihog’s R&D department is based at our global HQ in Dundalk, Co. Louth, and we're looking for sharp, enthusiastic engineers to join us!

The opportunity

Multihog is expanding its Engineering Department to support an exciting pipeline of new machines while continuing to improve our established product range. Our goal is straightforward: develop practical, robust and innovative machines that keep us ahead of the competition.

We are hiring both Mechanical Design Engineers and Manufacturing Engineers, from graduate level upwards. Attitude, ability and potential are more important than experience for this role. We want intelligent, motivated people who enjoy solving problems, learn quickly and take pride in turning good ideas into reliable and innovative equipment.

We welcome graduate applications for this role.

What you'll do:

  • Design mechanical components, assemblies and systems for new machine development projects.
  • Create and maintain accurate 3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings and Bills of Materials.
  • Support projects from early concept and design review through prototype build, testing, release and production.
  • Work closely with our production, manufacturing, purchasing, service and quality departments, as well as our supplier network.
  • Improve existing machines for reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, performance and cost.
  • Investigate production and field issues, identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Apply Design for Manufacture and Assembly principles to reduce complexity, waste, rework and build time.
  • Develop or improve jigs, fixtures, work instructions, processes and production layouts where relevant.
  • Take part in prototype builds and hands-on testing, learning directly from the workshop and the machines.
  • Communicate clearly, own actions and contribute constructively during design and project reviews.

Ideally, you will have:

  • A degree, diploma or relevant qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Design, Agricultural Engineering or a related discipline.
  • A genuine passion for engineering, CAD, machines, manufacturing and continuous improvement.
  • Strong problem-solving ability, quick thinking and sound engineering judgement.
  • A practical mindset and an interest in understanding how parts are made, assembled, tested and serviced.
  • The ability to work well within a team while also taking ownership of individual tasks.
  • Honesty, reliability, attention to detail and a strong work ethic.
  • The confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions respectfully and admit when more information is needed.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

CAD and technical experience:

We use Creo, but Creo experience is not essential. Experience with any professional 3D CAD system, including SolidWorks, Inventor, CATIA, Siemens NX or similar, is valuable. What we are really interested in, is how you think and design.

  • 3D part and assembly modelling, including large or complex assemblies.
  • Production of clear 2D manufacturing and assembly drawings.
  • Understanding of tolerances, fits, GD&T, materials and manufacturing processes.
  • Exposure to sheet metal, weldments, machining, castings, plastics, hydraulics, electrical integration or mobile machinery.
  • Experience with PLM/PDM, engineering change control, BOM management, DFM/DFA, FMEA, testing or validation.

The type of person who will thrive here

We are looking for straightforward, credible engineers who contribute to the team. You don't need to know everything, but you should be willing to find out, test your thinking and follow problems through to a practical solution.

  • You enjoy solving real problems and seeing your work become a physical product.
  • You are curious, resourceful and willing to learn from experienced colleagues and production teams.
  • You can move quickly without losing discipline or attention to detail.
  • You speak honestly about risks, mistakes and unknowns, and you avoid jargon or overclaiming.
  • You are happy to spend time at the machine, in the workshop and with the people building and supporting the product.
  • You bring ideas, listen to others and help the wider team succeed.

Practical interests are a real advantage

We value people who build, repair, improve or experiment with things because they genuinely enjoy engineering. Relevant interests might include motorsport, vehicle restoration, farming or agricultural machinery, fabrication, 3D printing, robotics, Formula Student, DIY projects, electronics, coding or workshop activities. These are not requirements, but they can demonstrate the curiosity and practical judgement that suit our environment.

  • Competitive salary of €35,000 - €45,000 depending on experience and capability.
  • Company pension after successful completion of probation.
  • Friday finish at 15:30.
  • A growing Engineering department with a strong pipeline of new machine programmes.
  • Varied work across new product development and continuous improvement of current machines.
  • Exposure to the full product lifecycle, from an initial idea through design, build, test, production and field support.
  • The opportunity to work on complete machines and make a visible contribution to products used internationally.
  • Support from an experienced, multidisciplinary team and opportunities to grow your technical responsibility.

Why join Multihog?

This is a chance to work on real machines, solve practical engineering challenges and influence the next generation of Multihog pro

Junior Product Engineer

European Air-Cooled Chiller Engineering | Dublin, Ireland


What you will do


Johnson Controls has an exciting Product Engineer I opportunity based at our Dublin, Ireland location, supporting our new European air-cooled chiller engineering organization. If you are beginning your engineering career and enjoy mechanical design, hands-on testing, and data analysis, this could be the right position for you.

In this entry-level role you will support the mechanical design and performance of air-cooled chiller components engineered for the European market, working under close supervision to complete design work as part of a project team. You will build your knowledge of our products, support laboratory testing and factory activity, and contribute to new and exciting product development programs while developing your technical expertise.


How you will do it


  • Builds an understanding of the theories, concepts, technical principles, and processes related to the fluid, thermal, refrigeration, and other mechanical aspects of air-cooled chillers
  • Works under close supervision, following work instructions and defined processes, and takes direction from more experienced engineers
  • Follows the project plan and participates in design activities with other team members
  • Supports delivery of engineering deliverables, including design specifications, design reviews, data analysis, etc.
  • Learns and applies European mechanical and safety codes and directives, including CE marking, the Pressure Equipment Directive (PED), and the Machinery Directive, and harmonized standards such as EN 378 (refrigerating systems safety) and EN 14511 (chiller performance rating)
  • Supports the build, instrumentation, and running of laboratory test programs; collects, reduces, and presents test data under guidance
  • Assists with the selection of mechanical components – including heat exchangers, fans, valves, and refrigerant piping – considering cost, performance, and availability
  • Provides day-to-day support to factory operations, the laboratory, and product technical service on assigned components
  • Supports the sustaining of released product, including gathering information to support design changes
  • Communicates with project team members and reports progress on assigned tasks
  • Applies standard technical and mathematical principles, theories, concepts, and best-practice methodologies in the field
  • Continuously increases expertise across chiller design, theory, construction, operation, and applications; participates in process improvement
  • Adheres to the Company’s Code of Conduct and Business Ethics standards


What we look for


Required


  • BS in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline / science
  • Entry level; previous internship, co-op, or work experience in a related field preferred
  • Understanding of fundamental fluid and thermal principles
  • Working knowledge of 3D CAD and engineering drawing practice
  • Willingness to learn and apply European mechanical and refrigeration codes and standards (CE marking, PED, Machinery Directive, EN 378)
  • Able to organize and process large amounts of data
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, schedule-driven, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, primarily within Europe


Preferred

  • Internship, co-op, or placement experience in HVAC, refrigeration, or another industrial product environment
  • Exposure to laboratory testing, instrumentation, and data acquisition
  • Familiarity with refrigeration systems and the EU F-Gas Regulation
  • Familiarity with HVAC systems and motor-driven mechanical engineering design and test
  • Exposure to structural, thermal, or computational fluid dynamics (CFD) analysis
  • Experience with ERP / material resource planning (MRP) software
  • Familiarity with European regulatory standards such as EN 378, EN 14511, and the Ecodesign / ErP framework

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Cloud Operations Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft Azure networking to join our Cloud & Infrastructure Services team. The ideal candidate will operate, secure, troubleshoot, and continuously improve cloud and hybrid network services that support business-critical platforms.

This role combines strong cloud operations capability with advanced knowledge of network architecture and protocols. The successful candidate will take ownership of Azure connectivity and network security services, support hybrid connectivity with on-premises and other cloud environments, automate network deployment and configuration, and lead the diagnosis and resolution of complex connectivity and performance issues.

Previous experience working within regulated industries (e.g., payments, financial services, PCI-DSS, healthcare, or other compliance-driven environments) is highly desirable.

  • Operate, maintain, and improve highly available Azure and hybrid cloud network services.
  • Design and support Azure hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN architectures, virtual networks, subnets, peering, user-defined routes, NAT Gateway, Private Link, private endpoints, and service endpoints.
