jobs.title: Junior Telecommunications Engineer
jobs.description:
Junior Telecommunications Engineer

Location: Dunboyne, Co: Meath


About EMR

EMR Integrated Solutions provides communications, SCADA and instrumentation solutions to sectors including water and power utilities, renewable energy, broadcasting, public safety and commercial industry. Our communications team designs, configures, deploys and supports secure operational networks that connect remote sites, control systems and monitoring platforms.


The opportunity

This is an entry-level role for a recent graduate who wants to build a career in industrial telecommunications and networking. You will apply the networking knowledge gained through your degree while developing practical experience with routers, switches, firewalls, cellular communications, VPNs, monitoring systems and site commissioning. You will work with experienced engineers and follow established designs, procedures and change controls, with increasing responsibility as your competence develops.


Key responsibilities

  • Assist with the preparation, configuration and testing of routers, Ethernet switches, firewalls, cellular routers and other communications equipment using approved templates and procedures.
  • Support the deployment and commissioning of operational networks at utility, renewable-energy and industrial sites, including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, cellular and secure remote-access solutions.
  • Configure and verify basic IP settings such as IPv4 addressing, subnet masks, default gateways, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, NAT, access rules and static routes under engineering supervision.
  • Help activate and verify cellular connectivity, including SIM allocation, APN profiles, signal quality and service stability.
  • Support firewall, port-forwarding and VPN configuration in accordance with approved designs and security requirements.
  • Register devices in network-monitoring platforms, respond to alerts and carry out first-line fault investigation using structured troubleshooting methods.
  • Use tools such as ping, traceroute, packet capture, device logs and monitoring data to investigate connectivity and performance issues, escalating when required.
  • Assist with bench testing, factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing and handover, recording evidence and confirming that agreed traffic flows operate correctly.
  • Prepare and maintain clear technical records, including configuration backups, IP address schedules, network diagrams, test sheets, site photographs and commissioning reports.
  • Work with project managers and senior engineers to gather site information and complete assigned project tasks.
  • Follow EMR health and safety, cybersecurity, quality, incident-management and change-control procedures at all times.
  • Participate in training and product familiarisation, building capability across EMR's communications technologies and customer environments.


Education and essential knowledge

  • We welcome applications from recent graduates. Prior full-time engineering experience is not required. Candidates should have:
  • A recent NFQ Level 7 or Level 8 qualification in networking, telecommunications, computer engineering, information technology, electronic engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • A sound academic and practical foundation in TCP/IP networking, IPv4 addressing and subnetting, Ethernet switching, VLANs and routing fundamentals.
  • An understanding of common network services and security concepts, including DHCP, DNS, NAT, ACLs, firewalls, VPNs and the principle of least privilege.
  • Basic familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems and confidence using command-line diagnostic tools.
  • The ability to follow a technical procedure carefully, record configuration changes accurately and ask for guidance when a task is outside your current competence.
  • A practical problem-solving approach, good attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication.
  • A collaborative attitude and willingness to learn from experienced colleagues, customers and technology partners.
  • A full driving licence, or the ability to meet the travel requirements of the role within an agreed timeframe, as travel to customer sites is required.


Desirable knowledge and experience

Any of the following would be useful but is not required:

  • A college work placement, final-year project, laboratory work or personal project involving network configuration, cybersecurity, IoT or systems administration.
  • Exposure to Fortinet or comparable routing, switching and firewall platforms.
  • Familiarity with packet-analysis tools.
  • Basic scripting or programming experience, particularly Python, PowerShell or shell scripting.
  • Awareness of wireless, cellular, radio, industrial or operational technology networks.
  • Familiarity with network monitoring, virtualisation, cloud networking or Git-based version control.


What you will develop

  • Practical configuration and troubleshooting skills across secure operational networks.
  • Experience of cellular routers, industrial firewalls, remote-access solutions and network monitoring.
  • An understanding of how IT networking principles are applied safely in live utility and industrial environments.
  • Progression toward independently delivering defined work packages once trained and authorised.


Working arrangements

  • Full-time role within EMR's Communications Engineering Team.
  • A mix of office, workshop, remote-support and customer-site work.
  • Travel within Ireland and, where required, occasional travel

About Tricel

Tricel, a family-run business, was founded in 1973 by Anne Stack and Con Stack. This year marks the company’s 50th year in business. The company began by producing

products from glass-reinforced plastics (GRP). It expanded its exports and established manufacturing facilities throughout the UK and Europe by implementing a comprehensive growth strategy in the 1990s and 2000s. The Stack family leads Tricel, which provides market-leading solutions in over 50 countries. Among the markets served by the company are storage tanks, pumps, sewage treatment tanks, construction products, and lubricant and composite distribution. With its headquarters in Killarney, the Tricel Group consists of 15 companies across Europe, including seven manufacturing facilities. The company employs more than 600 people at these locations. The company has grown domestically and internationally by manufacturing locally, exporting, partnering with local distributors, and acquiring companies that enhance its product capabilities and geographical reach. In the next five years, the company’s roadmap for growth will continue to be based on three main pillars: Customer Excellence, Innovation & Sustainability.


How to apply

If you are interested in joining Tricel please email HR@tricel.ie today with your CV and cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you.

Product Engineer

European Air-Cooled Chiller Engineering | Dublin, Ireland


What you will do


Johnson Controls has an exciting Product Engineer II opportunity based at our Dublin, Ireland location, supporting our new European air-cooled chiller engineering organization. If you enjoy mechanical design, testing, and data analysis, this could be the right position for you.

In this role you will support the mechanical design and performance of air-cooled chiller components and systems engineered for the European market, working under general supervision to complete detailed design work. You will provide support to production, laboratory, service, applications, and marketing teams across Europe, and contribute to new and exciting product development programs while continuing to build your expertise.


How you will do it

  • Develops and applies an understanding of the theories, concepts, technical principles, and processes related to the fluid, thermal, refrigeration, and other mechanical aspects of air-cooled chillers
  • Works under general supervision, following work instructions and defined processes to conceptualize and implement design ideas into the product
  • Defines and plans own activities for a project and completes detailed mechanical design work on assigned components and features

  • Works with the design and manufacturing teams to develop layout concepts and system configurations that balance cost, performance, and reliability
  • Selects suitable mechanical components – including heat exchangers, fans, compressors, valves, and refrigerant piping – considering cost, performance, and reliability

  • Responsible for engineering deliverables, including creating design specifications, detailed design reviews, data analysis, etc.
  • Supports the manufacturing and sustaining of the product, including initiating and executing design changes
  • Provides support to application engineers, designers, factory operations, product marketing, and product technical service, and can mentor new hires at the Engineer I level
  • Reports the status of own work, and that of junior team members, to the project team, with good written and verbal communication
  • Contributes to the accurate and on-time completion of projects and regularly reports on the status of assigned work
  • Continuously increases expertise across chiller design, theory, construction, operation, and applications; participates in process improvement
  • Uses standard technical and mathematical principles, theories, concepts, and best-practice methodologies in the field
  • Adheres to the Company’s Code of Conduct and Business Ethics standards


What we look for


Required

  • BS in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline / science
  • Minimum 2 years of work experience in a related field
  • Working knowledge of fluid and thermal principles
  • Working knowledge of European mechanical and refrigeration codes and standards (CE marking, PED, Machinery Directive, EN 378)
  • Proficient in mechanical design, able to conceptualize and implement design ideas into the product
  • Proficient with 3D CAD and the creation of production drawings to ISO / EN drafting conventions
  • Able to organize and process large amounts of data
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, schedule-driven, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, primarily within Europe


Preferred

  • Experience engineering industrial products in engineer-to-order, applied, or made-to-order environments
  • Experience with product development and sustaining of configurable systems
  • Familiarity with refrigeration systems and the EU F-Gas Regulation
  • Familiarity with HVAC systems and motor-driven mechanical engineering design and test
  • Experience with structural, thermal, or computational fluid dynamics (CFD) analysis
  • Experience with ERP / material resource planning (MRP) software
  • Experience applying European regulatory standards such as EN 378, EN 14511, and the Ecodesign / ErP framework

jobs.title: Financial Accountant (Newly Qualified)
jobs.description:
Financial Accountant (Newly Qualified)

Finance | Dublin | Permanent


About Life Scientific

Life Scientific operates in a $250 billion global crop protection market.

We reverse-engineer off-patent products and deliver them with the same quality, safety and performance as the original - operating across multiple countries, currencies and regulatory environments.

As we scale internationally, complexity increases.

More entities.
More intercompany.
More inventory.
More moving parts.

Our Finance team is not a reporting function.

It is an enabling function.

And we are growing it deliberately.

The Opportunity

This role exists because we are expanding.

Not replacing. Building.

As a financial accountant, you will join a high-performing, commercially engaged finance team supporting a multi-entity, multi-currency business.

This is not a narrow ledger role.

You will gain exposure across:

  • Group reporting

  • Technical accounting

  • Audit

  • Tax compliance

  • Budgeting & forecasting

  • Cross-functional business partnering

You will work closely with senior leadership and operational teams - embedding financial clarity into a business that is moving quickly.

We are open to candidates from 1–5 years PQE.

What matters most is not just experience - but mindset.

This role is for you if you…

You enjoy structure - but don’t hide behind it.

You care about the integrity of the general ledger.

You instinctively question reconciling items that don’t feel right.

You can explain complex accounting clearly to non-finance colleagues.

You want to understand the business behind the numbers.

You’re comfortable operating in a multi-entity environment where intercompany and consolidation matter.

You don’t wait to be told what’s wrong - you go looking for it.

You are ambitious - and see this as a stepping stone into broader finance leadership.

You prefer building something in a scaling company over maintaining something static.

What You’ll Own

Financial Reporting & Ledger Integrity

  • Lead preparation of monthly and quarterly management reporting packs

  • Maintain general ledger integrity across multiple entities (accruals, deferrals, intercompany, reclasses)

  • Support group consolidation activities in a multi-currency environment

  • Ensure reporting is accurate, structured and delivered on time

Audit & Compliance

  • Own key elements of statutory audit preparation

  • Liaise directly with external auditors

  • Manage VAT, Intrastat and related compliance filings

  • Ensure adherence to IFRS / FRS 102 accounting standards

Commercial & Operational Support

  • Partner with Supply Chain, R&D and Commercial teams

  • Provide financial insight supporting operational decision-making

  • Contribute to budgeting and forecasting cycles

  • Support analysis that informs growth and investment decisions

Process & Scale

  • Contribute to automation and process improvement initiatives

  • Strengthen controls as the business grows

  • Support and mentor junior finance colleagues

What You Bring

You are a fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or equivalent).

You bring:

  • 1–5 years’ PQE

  • Strong grounding in technical accounting principles (IFRS / FRS 102)

  • Experience in multi-entity, multi-currency environments (group consolidation exposure is highly valuable)

  • Comfort operating in a deadline-driven, fast-paced setting

  • Clear communication skills - able to explain financial matters simply

Highly beneficial:

  • Audit training from a recognised practice

  • Exposure to manufacturing, stock or inventory environments

  • Experience working within ERP systems

But more important than background:

You are curious.
Structured.
Commercially aware.
And motivated to grow beyond traditional accounting boundaries.

What Success Looks Like

Within 18–36 months, you will have:

  • Strengthened ledger control and reporting clarity across entities

  • Built credibility with senior leadership and operational teams

  • Played a visible role in audit and compliance cycles

  • Contributed meaningfully to budgeting and forecasting

  • Positioned yourself for broader responsibility within Finance

Why Join Life Scientific?

Because this is not a static reporting role.

It is a growth role.

You will:

  • Gain exposure across technical, operational and commercial finance

  • Work in a flat, fast-moving structure

  • Have visibility with senior leadership

  • Help shape processes in a scaling international business

Life Scientific is building deliberately.

And this role is part of that build.

If you want early-career breadth, real responsibility and the chance to grow within a business that is scaling internationally - this is your platform.

jobs.title: Ecologist- Barriers Mitigation Division
jobs.description:
Inland Fisheries Ireland (IFI) presents an exciting opportunity for a suitably qualified person to join a new team in IFI as an Ecologist. This role will primarily focus on providing ecological expertise to support the remediation works required to successfully mitigate or remove barriers to fish migration across Ireland.

The aim of the National Barrier Mitigation Programme is to improve river hydromorphology and connectivity in Irish catchments by strategically targeting significant barriers to fish passage and structures degrading river form, flow and function. Iconic species such as Atlantic salmon and the European eel are threatened species and IFI is mandated to protect them under law. Removing barriers will open up habitat to various species in an era where habitat loss is impacting severely on biodiversity both nationally and internationally.

The Ecologist will be responsible for ecological aspects of these projects, including preparing and reviewing Appropriate Assessment (AA) screenings, procuring ecological surveys and reports, undertaking ecological surveys, and ensuring alignment with the Habitats Directive and Wildlife Act. The Ecologist will be required to coordinate and undertake ecological surveys including fish habitat, mammal, invasive species, habitat, and electrofishing surveys as part of a team. The successful candidate will play a key role in guiding mitigation on projects from the initial feasibility and option selection phases through complex planning and consenting processes, all the way to project construction, environmental monitoring and completion.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated a high level of competence in relation to Appropriate Assessments under the Habitats Directive and will be required to both deliver and procure relevant reports. A comprehensive knowledge of ecosystem science and its associated statutory and regulatory processes will also be important. The work will involve the compilation of ecosystem and geographical data to support applications for consent for barrier removal or mitigation projects at river sites where river hydromorphology has been physically impacted by human activity. The successful candidate will also be required to contribute to the development of project plans, providing supporting documentation relating to Appropriate Assessment, WFD, fish populations and water quality/ecological status. The successful candidate will collate all necessary project details to secure necessary consents from relevant authorities.

Reporting to the Environmental Specialist, the Ecologist will be experienced in civil engineering works that pertain to the water based/marine environment and will have the ability to understand the impacts of ecosystem dynamics associated with barrier removal and mitigation.


ABOUT US

Inland Fisheries Ireland are the environmental agency responsible for protecting, managing and conserving Ireland's inland fisheries and sea angling resources.

More information can be found by visiting our website.

VISION, MISSION & VALUES

Vision

To place the inland fisheries resource in the best sustainable position possible for the benefit of future generations.

Mission

To protect, manage and conserve Ireland’s inland fisheries and sea angling resources and to maximise their sustainability and natural biodiversity.

Values

  • We are committed to the environment and sustainability.
  • We work collaboratively and with professionalism.
  • We communicate openly and transparently.
  • We act with respect, integrity, and accountability

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Main duties will include:

  • Day to day ecological input to projects under the supervision of the Environmental Specialist
  • Work closely with colleagues in the National Barrier Mitigation Programme to facilitate the implementation of barrier removal or mitigation projects, ensuring all ecological regulations and conditions are met.
  • Collecting, collating or sourcing ecological information such as survey data pertaining to mammals, bats, invasive species, habitats, fish, other aquatic species, and water quality data.
  • Co-ordinate and monitor the progress of Assessments through the IFI Appropriate Assessment Determination process.
  • Carry out ad-hoc Screening for Appropriate Assessment for development projects
  • Evaluate, prepare and present findings on ecological aspects of technical proposals, and make recommendations for incorporation into design and specifications.
  • Provision of essential information to IFI senior management and consenting authorities.

Management

  • Production of tendering and procurement documents for ecological surveys and assessments.
  • Coordinate habitat, electrofishing and other surveys for the wider environmental team.
  • Compilation of essential project details for submission to project stakeholders and partners including NPWS, consultants, contractors and relevant authorities.
  • Coordination or procurement of necessary environmental evaluations and assessments, ensuring that all required documentation is available and comply with regulatory standards.
  • Provide guidance and expert opinion on ecological receptors and associated regulations, to the wider NBMP team.
  • Compile standard operating procedures (SOPs) and risk assessments for the habitat restoration process.

Survey

  • Assist with fish stock, habitat and water quality surveys to support barrier mitigation projects.
  • Undertake surveys to identify invasive species, signs of mammals, bats, birds, habitats, aquatic species such as white-clawed crayfish and aquatic invertebrates.

jobs.title: Analyst
jobs.description:
We are currently seeking analysts with a minimum of 1 years relevant experience working within an energy, safety, water, process industry or a related sector.

The Position

Job Title: Analyst

Starting Salary: *44,678 (Salary scale: 44,678 - 63,230) *Please see below for further information.

Location: The Exchange, Belgard Square North, Tallaght, Dublin 24.

Working Hours: 37.5 hours per week

Hybrid working: Up to 3 days per week remote working available

Closing Date: 12.00 noon, Monday, 19th October, 2026.

Tenure: Appointment will be on a permanent basis, subject to successful passing of the probationary period.

The Role of Analyst

We are seeking candidates with experience in economics, engineering, legal, public policy and other relevant fields to fill posts in the following areas:

Security of Supply and Wholesale

Ensuring a secure energy transition to 2030, delivering on our 80% renewable electricity target and overseeing the wholesale all-island Single Electricity Market (SEM) in co-operation with the Utility Regulator in Belfast.

Networks and Economic Regulation

Working with Uisce Éireann and energy companies, enhancing the CRUs economic regulation of these critical networks, ensuring that they support customers, underpin economic growth and play a transformational role in climate change adaptation and mitigation.

Customer Policy and Protection (incl. Legal)

Empowering and protecting customers, overseeing competition and consumer protection across Irelands energy retail markets and playing an important role in supporting the National Energy Affordability Taskforce. The Legal, Compliance and Enforcement teams are also part of this Division, providing legal advice and support and compliance and enforcement duties across the organisation on a broad range of regulatory and corporate matters.

Energy Safety

Regulating safety of gas (networks, supply, storage, use and liquefied petroleum gas distribution), petroleum (upstream onshore and offshore exploration and production of hydrocarbons), gas installers and electrical contractors.

Decarbonisation

Delivering new CRU regulatory frameworks for offshore renewables, green hydrogen, district heating and other new technologies and leading cross-cutting decarbonisation projects, including electricity connection policy, interconnector regulation and Projects of Common Interest.

Operations and Organisational Development

Supporting and empowering the CRU teams to achieve outcomes in our Strategic Plan in the areas of process improvement, finance and governance, human resources, information technology, and communications.

Duties and Responsibilities

Reporting to a manager, the successful candidate will be involved in a varied role working to tight deadlines in a dynamic environment. CRU Analyst roles typically include activities such as:

  • Preparing CRU consultation and decision papers, preparing reports and making presentations both internally and externally.
  • Working as a member of a team and on specific cross-functional project teams as required.
  • Engaging with internal and external stakeholders in a constructive manner in order to further CRU objectives.
  • Engaging with NI, GB or EU counterparts on all-island or EU policy, markets or industry developments.
  • Maintaining an awareness of policy developments and best practice within the energy and water industry and related industries, both in Ireland and internationally.
  • Researching policy issues and identifying data/trends, using this to suggest policy courses of action for the CRU.
  • Analysing spreadsheets of energy/water/safety data, and financial modelling.
  • Carrying out such other functions as may be required from time to time to fulfil the business objectives of the CRU and as appropriate to the grade.

The above list is not exhaustive. While the successful candidate will be assigned to a particular team within the CRU, they will also be expected to contribute to the work of the wider Division/CRU as requirements dictate.

The CRU may establish a shortlist of suitable candidates for potential future positions that may arise within the organisation.

Qualifications and Experience

Essential Requirements

Candidates must have on or before the closing date for applications the following:

1. An appropriate NFQ Level 8 or higher qualification, preferably in economics, law, engineering, science, health and safety (process safety), business or other closely related discipline;

2. A minimum of 1 years relevant experience working within an energy, safety, water, process industry or a related sector.

Desirable Requirements

1. Knowledge/experience of existing and developing policy frameworks in the regulated energy sectors;

2. Experience working in a regulated sector or governmental organisation.

The Package

Wills Bros Ltd is one of Ireland’s leading Tier 1 civil engineering and infrastructure contractors, delivering complex and high-profile projects nationwide. We are hiring a Procurement Administrator to join our busy Procurement Department in Kiltimagh, Co. Mayo.

The Automation and Controls Specialist is responsible for designing, programming, and implementing control strategies to optimize manufacturing processes using advanced automation technologies. While the role focuses on Smart Manufacturing and CapEx projects implementation, on a day-to-day it may also support diagnosis and resolution of issues related to control systems.

jobs.title: Graduate Utilities Engineer
jobs.description:
Main Purpose and Objectives of Position

The Graduate Utilities Engineer is an entry-level engineering role, designed to build the knowledge, skills and confidence needed to support the reliable operation and qualified state of clean utility systems and supporting grey systems within Biotech manufacturing. Working closely with mentors and experienced engineers, the Graduate Utilities Engineer will progressively develop the technical and professional capability to help ensure processes are in-control and compliant, while contributing to process continuous improvement as part of a structured development programme.

The following are the main areas of development for the Graduate Utilities Engineer role:

● Develop a strong safety mindset by following safety rules and actively contributing to improving the safety culture.

● Build clean system engineering knowledge as a developing member of the area team, supported by experienced colleagues.

● Learn how clean system unit operations and equipment are maintained in a qualified and reliable state.

● Gain exposure to establishing and monitoring critical parameters for clean systems, to support processes remaining in control.

● Support troubleshooting of unit operations, equipment and operational issues, building problem-solving skills under guidance.

● Learn to evaluate activities for their impact on the qualified state of equipment, and to use the appropriate tools and processes.

Personal Considerations: At times, the Graduate Utilities Engineer may need to travel offsite to other locations, other companies, conferences, off-site training, or to support capital projects.

Educational Requirements: Third Level Engineering Qualification (recent graduate, or in final year of study)

License/Certificate Requirements: None

Language Requirements: Proficient in English

Key Responsibilities

In line with the job outlined above, and as part of a graduate development plan, the following are typically the key tasks the role will be introduced to and will grow into over time, with support from a mentor and the wider team:

Safety

● Learn to contribute to the safe design and safe operation of equipment within the area.

● Actively participate in safety-related activities (audits, hazard reviews, pre-start-up safety reviews) to build safety awareness and drive ongoing improvement.

Bio-process Technical Support

● Develop into a competent point of contact for equipment and processes in an assigned area of responsibility, building a clear understanding of unit operations and associated equipment.

● Learn to monitor clean utility systems and support the optimisation of unit operations and equipment performance.

● Support troubleshooting efforts relating to unit operations, equipment and operational issues, working alongside experienced engineers.

● Learn and apply formal problem-solving techniques, including Root Cause Analysis, to help resolve unit operations and equipment issues.

● Respond to unit operations issues and equipment failures under guidance, document appropriately, and support resolution of events through appropriate actions.

● Communicate effectively with others, especially team members, operations and crafts personnel.

Maintain Qualified and Reliable State

● Learn to evaluate activities for their impact on the qualified state of unit operations/equipment, and to use the appropriate business processes (e.g. change control).

● Gain exposure to system/component classification and maintenance strategy for equipment.

● Support the implementation of corrections, corrective actions, and countermeasures arising from investigations.

● Participate in Periodic Reviews for systems and equipment.

● Support IQ/OQ/PQ activities (including commissioning activities of new unit operations/equipment), building towards leading elements of this work with experience.

Asset Management

● Contribute to the scoping of capital projects targeted at both short and longer-term needs, and support the user representative role for local projects.

● Build an understanding of equipment reliability issues, with the objective of identifying improvement opportunities.

Improve the Business

● Identify and support improvement opportunities (procedural changes, upgrades, projects etc.) associated with unit operations/equipment within the area.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Work Location: In person

The successful candidates will play a key role in the installation, qualification, maintenance, troubleshooting and optimisation of highly sophisticated semiconductor capital equipment within a world-class cleanroom manufacturing facility.

jobs.description:

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.


Job Description


ServiceNow is the fastest growing enterprise cloud software company in the world above $1 billion, and we believe it’s the great people who will keep us there. We hire carefully, we hire the best, we celebrate our people.

ServiceNow is looking for driven, ambitious candidates to join our Global Business Acceleration Internship Program. As a Business Development Representative Intern, you’ll play a vital role in generating meetings that convert to qualified opportunities to support early-stage pipeline growth. This program focuses on exposure to core prospecting and outreach techniques that engage buying group members and develop foundational knowledge of ServiceNow.

Global Business Acceleration’s mission is to drive high-quality pipeline that fuels predictable growth. We pioneer AI and innovation to transform go-to-market strategies with precision. We are the launch pad for top talent to develop into the leaders of tomorrow at ServiceNow.

What you get to do in this role:

jobs.description: DescriptionAWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We achieve these objectives by working closely with customers to develop runbooks and response plans customized to the context of each workload onboarded to the service. Onboarded workloads are monitored 24x7 by a team of Incident Management Engineers (IMEs) to detect and engage customers on a call bridge within 5 minutes of a critical alarm.ABOUT YOU Incident Management Engineers have a broad skill set with demonstrated career progression and a proven track record of delivering results. We are looking for an Incident Management Engineer to join our team to provide incident response and account ownership. In this position you will play a pivotal role in providing communication emergency response technical resolver engagement and incident management for our customers.Please note as a follow-the-sun organisation IMEs work the core hours of 7am-3pm UTC. jobs.title: Cloud FinOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Dublin, Ireland | Full time | Home-based | R1557137


Cloud FinOps Engineer

London, UK



The Cloud FinOps Engineer is responsible for the financial governance, optimization, reporting, forecasting, and commercial management of the organization's public cloud estate across Azure, AWS, and GCP. The role ensures that cloud investments are managed effectively, costs are transparent and attributable, financial controls are maintained, and optimization opportunities are identified and realized.



Working closely with Cloud Engineering, Platform Operations, Business Unit leaders, Finance teams, Procurement, and Cloud Service Owners, the Cloud FinOps Engineer provides the financial discipline and governance necessary to maximize business value from cloud consumption while maintaining visibility and accountability across a distributed administration model.



Key Responsibilities



Cloud Financial Governance



  • Establish and maintain cloud financial governance processes and standards.
  • Ensure cloud costs are accurately allocated and attributed to products, applications, business units, and cost centres.
  • Maintain and improve chargeback, show back, and cost allocation models.
  • Govern cloud financial controls, tagging standards, ownership validation, and cost accountability processes.
  • Act as the primary subject matter expert for cloud financial management and FinOps practices.


Cost Management & Optimization



  • Identify, track, prioritize, and manage cloud cost optimization opportunities across Azure, AWS, and GCP environments.
  • Work with cloud platform and application teams to implement rightsizing, storage optimization, reserved capacity, and licensing optimization initiatives.
  • Operate effectively within a distributed administration environment where cloud resources may be managed by numerous business units and technical teams.
  • Monitor realization of savings opportunities and report achieved versus forecast benefits.


Financial Analysis & Reporting



  • Develop and maintain executive, operational, and financial dashboards for: Cloud account owners, Product owners, Business unit leaders, IT Finance teams and Executive leadership.
  • Produce regular and ad-hoc reporting on: Cloud spend, Consumption trends, Unit economics, Cost allocation, Savings realization, forecast accuracy, Budget performance


Forecasting & Budget Management



  • Develop and maintain cloud expenditure forecasts across multiple cloud platforms.
  • Monitor forecast versus actual spend and identify root causes of variances.
  • Partner with Finance teams to develop annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and financial outlooks and improve forecast accuracy and financial planning processes.


Financial Data Analytics



  • Mine and analyze cloud billing and consumption data from cloud providers and FinOps tooling.
  • Perform forensic analysis of spend anomalies, emerging trends, and cost drivers before they materially impact budgets or forecasts.
  • Investigate unexpected cost increases, billing discrepancies, and forecast deviations.
  • Build models to improve visibility into cloud consumption and business value metrics.


Reservations & Savings Plan Management



  • Manage cloud commitment-based discount programs including Azure/AWS Reserved Instances & Savings Plans.
  • Perform monthly utilization reviews and true-up activities such as reservation renewals, exchanges, modifications, and optimization strategies.
  • Develop recommendations to maximize coverage and utilization while minimizing waste.


Contract & Vendor Management



  • Provide financial and consumption input to cloud vendor negotiations and contract renewals.
  • Support Procurement and Vendor Management teams with commercial analysis, evaluating vendor proposals, cloud pricing models, discount structures, and consumption commitments.
  • Assist with cloud vendor business reviews and strategic planning activities.


Marketplace & Commercial Operations



  • Execute and govern cloud marketplace purchases and subscription-based vendor offerings.
  • Ensure appropriate approvals, financial controls, and ownership attribution are maintained.
  • Validate commercial alignment between marketplace purchases and approved budgets.


Shared Services Cost Allocation



  • Maintain, and improve financial allocation methodologies for shared cloud services.
  • Calculate and administer recharge models for centrally provided cloud capabilities.
  • Create and manage allocation formulas used to distribute shared platform operational costs.
  • Validate allocation accuracy and stakeholder acceptance of resulting chargeback models.


Required Skills & Experience



Technical & Cloud Experience



  • Strong experience in Cloud Financial Operations, FinOps, IT Financial Management, Technology Business Management (TBM), or related disciplines.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one large scale enterprise major cloud platform from: Azure, AWS.
  • Strong understanding of cloud consumption, billing models and cloud technologies at an operations level.


FinOps & Cost Management Tools



  • Demonstrated experience with one or more of the following:
  • Apptio Cloudability, Apptio One, Apptio TBM frameworks and methodologies
  • Azure Cost Manageme

jobs.title: Health and Safety Officer
jobs.description:
The Health & Safety Officer is responsible for promoting, implementing, and monitoring a culture of workplace health and safety across all departments of the hospital.

The postholder will work to minimise risks to staff and other interested parties, ensure compliance with Irish occupational health and safety legislation, and support the delivery of a safe and healthy working environment. This role is critical in aligning hospital practices with national guidelines including those from the HSE, HSA, HIQA, and relevant statutory requirements, and accreditation criteria for CHKS.

Key Responsibilities
1. Health & Safety Governance

  • Ensure compliance with the Safety, Health and Welfare at Work Act 2005, associated regulations, and hospital policies.
  • Development, implementation, and review of the Hospital Safety Statement, hazard identification and risk assessments, and health and safety policies and procedures.
  • Conduct health and safety audits and inspections across clinical and non-clinical areas to proactively identify risks to safety, health and welfare.

2. Incident Management and Risk Mitigation

  • Investigate health and safety accidents and incidents including injuries, exposures, slips/trips, manual handling injuries, and violence/aggression events.
  • Facilitate and document root cause analysis and support development of corrective actions.
  • Participate actively in new projects or developments to ensure there is effective health and safety input in the design stage.
  • Ensure timely incident reporting through the hospital’s risk management system (e.g., NIMS).
  • Provide support as required with the H&S requirements of all contractors.

3. Staff Training & Awareness

  • Deliver and / or coordinate mandatory safety training for hospital staff (e.g., manual handling, sharps safety, PPE use, fire safety, lone worker safety).
  • Participate in staff induction programmes with a focus on health and safety awareness.
  • Promote continuous staff engagement and consultation on health, safety and welfare through campaigns, posters, and communication channels.

4. Collaborative Working

  • Liaise with Occupational Health, Infection Prevention & Control, Facilities Management, and Security to manage cross-functional risks.
  • Participate actively in the hospital’s Health & Safety Committee, Risk Committee, and Environment of Care groups.
  • Support and coordinate the hospital's fire safety management arrangements in conjunction with Facilities Management and other designated responsible persons, including fire risk assessments, fire prevention measures, evacuation procedures, fire drills, staff training and maintenance of appropriate fire safety records. Monitor identified fire safety actions and support compliance with applicable fire safety legislation, guidance and hospital policies.

jobs.title: Process Specialist – Trade Compliance
jobs.description:
DON’T BE IN THE DARK ABOUT YOUR CAREER…….

WE WANT YOU TO HELP US CREATE THE DIGITAL FUTURE OF OUR COMPANY

HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE OF TRADE COMPLIANCE PROCESSES ACROSS SANDVIK MINING


Sandvik Mining is continuing to evolve how we work, with a stronger focus on common processes, clearer ownership, digital enablement and scalable ways of supporting the organisation. Within this operating model, Trade Compliance processes play an important role in enabling compliant, efficient and sustainable business flows across the Mining organisation.

We are looking for a structured, curious and collaborative person to join our process organisation as a Process Specialist, with a dedicated focus on Trade Compliance. This is an opportunity to drive process development, data-driven improvement and digital transformation in an area that is business-critical and increasingly important in a changing regulatory environment.

We are now recruiting for a Process Specialist, Trade Compliance (hybrid) for a permanent role in our Dublin, Ireland, Sweden or Finland office.

Area of responsibility

Are you passionate about process improvement, digital transformation and making complex business requirements easier to understand and implement?

We are looking for a structured, curious and collaborative Process Specialist with a focus on Trade Compliance. This is a key role for someone who enjoys working across functions, connecting business needs with process design, data, systems and practical ways of working.

Trade Compliance is becoming increasingly important in a complex and changing global regulatory environment. In this role, you will help shape scalable and sustainable processes that support compliant and efficient international business operations.

Job purpose

As Process Specialist – Trade Compliance, you will play a key role in driving the development, alignment and continuous improvement of Trade Compliance processes. You will help translate business and compliance needs into clear process requirements, support digital solutions and enable adoption across an international organisation.

The role requires strong process understanding, stakeholder engagement and the ability to work across business, system and data topics.

You will support process areas such as:

  • Import and export compliance
  • Sanctions and denied party screening
  • Customs documentation and customs procedures
  • Product classification, country of origin and trade preference processes
  • Trade Compliance reporting, analytics and data quality
SAP S/4HANA and SAP GTS enabled process solutions

  • Contribute to the alignment and development of Trade Compliance processes across the Mining organisation, ensuring that common ways of working are clear, practical and fit for purpose.
  • Engage with Trade Compliance stakeholders, process owners, Business Areas and divisions to understand business needs, process pain points, regulatory requirements and improvement opportunities.
  • Translate business and compliance needs into clear process requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and documentation to support solution design and delivery.
  • Take an active role in SAP S/4HANA and SAP GTS related process design, testing, implementation and post go-live support from a Trade Compliance process perspective.
  • Support and continuously improve process documentation, including future process models, work instructions, training material and other artefacts required for sustainable process ownership.
  • Support data quality, reporting and analytics initiatives by helping define business requirements, validate outputs and promote self-service reports for Trade Compliance users.
  • Participate in SAP GTS and other relevant system implementations by supporting testing activities, including preparation of test scenarios, execution of process tests, defect follow-up and user acceptance testing.
  • Contribute to change impact assessments and contribute to adoption activities, helping business users understand process changes and how they affect daily operations.
  • Monitor process performance, collect feedback and support continuous improvement activities in close collaboration with the wider process organisation.
  • Act as a knowledgeable point of contact for Trade Compliance process questions, supporting issue clarification and helping distinguish between process, training, data and system-related topics.

Experience

You are analytical, structured and comfortable working with complexity. You enjoy asking the right questions, connecting different perspectives and turning business needs into clear and practical process solutions.

You have experience in process work, business analysis, continuous improvement, projects or change initiatives. Experience in Trade Compliance, logistics, customs, SAP S/4HANA, SAP GTS is an advantage, but curiosity, collaboration and a strong process mindset are equally important.

jobs.title: Curation Specialist, EMEA
jobs.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways. We help organizations build skills and stay compliant through a high-quality content catalog, seamless LMS/LXP integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills-based curation and multilingual content creation. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.
Learn more: www.opensesame.com/about

About the Role

Most people see a marketplace of over 60,000 training courses. We build something bigger: the chance for companies across the world to upgrade the skills of every employee they have. Global 2000 companies across the region rely on our training programs to build their most productive and admired workforces, and we back that trust with strategic partnerships.

The Curation Team turns a broad, global learning marketplace into focused, effective learning experiences for EMEA customers, prospects, and publishers. As a Curation Specialist, you will pair strong marketplace knowledge with a consultative approach to recommend the right content, build curated programs, and help EMEA customers make progress toward their workforce development goals — while accounting for the region's language diversity, local compliance needs (including GDPR), and varied working cultures.

What You Will Do

  • Translate the learning goals of EMEA customers and prospects into high-quality course mappings, curated lists, learning paths, and other recommendations that make the OpenSesame marketplace easy to use.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the EMEA Sales and Customer Success teams, and bring marketplace expertise to customer conversations, pre-sales calls, RFPs, and presentations across the region.
  • Create reusable programs, resources, documentation, and best practices that let OpenSesame deliver curation value consistently across EMEA markets and at scale.
  • Share marketplace and learning-industry insights relevant to EMEA with internal teams, and contribute to customer-facing resources, webinars, or other thought-leadership efforts.
  • Manage a portfolio of EMEA publisher relationships: act as the primary point of contact, coordinate internal support, share constructive feedback, and identify opportunities to strengthen the publisher offering in the region.
  • Surface content gaps, quality issues, and opportunities that improve how EMEA customers discover and use learning content — including content localized for the region's languages and regulatory requirements.
  • Keep requests, project details, and stakeholder communication organized and current in the team's operating systems. Deliver clear updates and dependable follow-through in a fast-moving environment, across time zones spanning the EMEA region.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives aligned to team and company priorities, including improvements to curation processes, product experiences, and go-to-market enablement for EMEA.
  • Overlap your working hours with core EMEA business hours to stay accessible to regional customers, publishers, and colleagues.
  • Travel as needed for department and full-team events, both within EMEA and, occasionally, to global company gatherings — typically less than 10% of your time.

Performance Objectives

Within 30 Days

  • Build a comprehensive understanding of the OpenSesame curation process and tools.
  • Identify the needs of EMEA customers and see where curation fits into their journey.

Within 60 Days

  • Establish yourself as the internal and external expert on OpenSesame's course offering for the EMEA region.
  • Perform course mappings for EMEA customers regularly and navigate the OpenSesame catalog skillfully on a daily basis.
  • Establish relationships with at least 5 publishers serving the region.

Within 90 Days

  • Complete curation projects on behalf of 50 unique EMEA customers, and establish relationships with at least 15 publishers serving the region.
  • Curate elearning course curricula confidently to support the launch and expansion of customer training initiatives across EMEA markets.

Within 120 Days

  • Complete curation requests consistently.
  • Serve as each publisher's primary point of contact within OpenSesame, and coordinate internal efforts to support and maintain strong, ongoing publisher relationships across the region.

Within 1 year

  • Build strong relationships with 10 or more EMEA publishers, and earn consistently positive feedback from customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Support EMEA customers at every stage of the course curation process, and create actionable project plans based on their unique business skills training goals.

Within 18 months

  • Become the go-to resource on the team for questions related to OpenSesame's business skills catalog in EMEA. Think strategically about curation, and identify opportunities to develop programs that help EMEA customers curate at scale.
  • Earn trust as an expert for both internal and external stakeholders across the region.

Within 2 years

  • Earn promotion to Senior Curation Specialist, EMEA, after building a reputation of excellence with regional publishers, customers, and OpenSesame teammates

You might notice we don't list a traditional set of requirements or buzzwords here. That's intentional. We're looking for proven examples from your career that show your attention to detail, your drive to constantly improve, and your motivation to support your teammates

jobs.title: Production Operative
jobs.description:
The Colas Group operates internationally in all aspects of transport infrastructure. As part of the global organisation, Colas Ireland is primarily involved the distribution of bitumen products, emulsion and emulsifier manufacturing, and the provision of specialist road maintenance services on the national, regional and local road network. In Ireland Colas operates from 14 locations across the island of Ireland.

Purpose of the Role

The purpose of this role is to run the day-to-day operations in our manufacturing facility in Dublin. The role would suit applicants from any industrial, production or warehousing environment who wish to be trained, developed and progressed into a worldwide company offering stability and job security. The salary for this role is €18.36 per hour plus overtime and excellent benefits listed below. Applications from D12 and surrounding areas would be preferred.

Main Responsibilities


In this role you’ll be trained and supported in running our automated and manual production systems, setting up and maintaining equipment, monitoring quality and output, and handling raw material requests and reporting. You’ll load, package and ship products as needed, safely offload bitumen, and report any faults, incidents or near misses to the maintenance or safety team. Safety and good housekeeping are essential: follow SOPs, wear PPE, take part in drills and safety meetings, and help maintain a tidy workplace. You’ll also help train new starters, suggest cost-saving ideas, meet production targets, and provide excellent customer service. We’ll provide friendly, hands-on onboarding, ongoing training and daily support from an experienced team so you can succeed and grow. Other reasonable duties may be required.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will have experience in an industrial or manual environment or have the desire and willingness to learn and develop into a production operative role. You will demonstrate high ethical standards, reliability and adherence to our health and safety procedures.

Package Description

Here at Colas Group, we offer a great total compensation package of €18.36 per hour plus overtime , including:

  • Contibutory Pension Scheme
  • Life Assurance Scheme / Death in Service
  • Safety Award Bonus
  • Sick Pay & Compassionate Leave
  • 21 days annual leave per year + Public Holidays and service days (one for every 5 years worked, capped at 20 years)
  • RediCare Health and Wellbeing Support
  • Employee Assistance Programme for employees, their spouse/partner and any dependents over the age of 16 years living at home.
  • Mental Health, Legal, Financial, Career and Child and Elderly Care Support
  • Free car parking.
  • Professional subscriptions – role related
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoptive, and Paternity Benefit

At Colas, our culture is guided by four core values: Respect, Commitment, Pioneering, and Sharing. These values shape how we work, collaborate, and grow together. We believe that respect is the foundation of every relationship. By treating others as we wish to be treated, we foster fairness, transparency, and inclusion within our teams and with our clients, communities, and partners. Commitment means dedicating ourselves fully to everything we do. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels valued, supported, and empowered to make a meaningful impact. With a pioneering spirit, we prioritise bold innovation over blind ambition. We welcome new ideas, invest in our people, and work to deliver sustainable infrastructure solutions that shape the future. Through sharing, we build trust and solidarity, encouraging collaboration and growth at all levels of the business.

Colas Group is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce that mirrors the communities we serve. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you want a workplace where your voice is valued and your potential is developed, Colas is the right choice.

Description


The successful candidate will join the Technical team as a junior team member on a structured two-year Graduate Programme. Role Responsibilities


  • Asset Management - Assist the team with monitoring assigned engine assets on lease, in repair or in storage. Liaise with customers, engine manufacturers, MRO facilities, aviation authorities and external agencies on delivery and redelivery, inspections, maintenance, warranty, shipping and storage, and other technical aspects of engine management.
  • Project Management - Support the relevant technical team with lease delivery and redelivery activity, off-lease storage, transportation, maintenance planning, and cost control for assigned engine assets as required.
  • Technical Records Management - Collate, review and archive engine technical records packages in a timely and accurate manner to ensure full traceability, compliance with aviation authority requirements, and alignment with expected market standards.

  • Regional Office Secondment – Participate in a secondment to a regional office outside headquarters to gain exposure to local market activity, customer engagement, and support regional technical operations.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise


Essential
  • Degree in Aeronautical or Mechanical Engineering, or qualified aircraft/powerplant engineer status with an EASA/FAA Part 145 company approval for a commercial turbofan engine.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel.
Desired
  • Good working knowledge of engine technical records requirements, experience with engine record keeping, and familiarity with ongoing EASA and FAA records certification industry standards.
  • General familiarisation or type rating training for new generation aircraft/engines.
  • Prior involvement in areas such as project management, team leadership, coding, data analysis or business.

  • Proven ability to use own initiative and perform in a professional and composed manner in a pressurised environment.

  • Excellent project management, organisation and time management skills.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Must be willing to travel. The position will be primarily Shannon based, with occasional short- and long-distance travel requirements that may vary in frequency.

About elfc

elfc is the world’s leading engine financing and leasing company, specialising in the provision of flexible, short to long-term engine support packages for the commercial aviation industry.

Headquartered in Shannon, Ireland, elfc is owned by Mitsubishi HC Capital (MHC) based in Tokyo. The ownership structure provides elfc with the underlying financing strength and stability required to satisfy the long-term financing needs of airlines and to meet the commercial challenges presented by today’s rapidly changing world markets.

The company was founded in 1989, with the purpose of satisfying the industry’s demand for a quality, truly independent, engine leasing company providing operating leases for modern aircraft engines to airlines worldwide. The company now owns and/or manages over 300 engines worth more than $2.8bn. The current customer base includes more than 80 airlines and MRO organisations worldwide.

We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


About the Team


The Agent Measurement & Forecasting (AMF) team builds Workday's single source of truth for how the company measures and forecasts AI agent performance. We own the data pipeline, metric governance, and semantic layer that turn raw agent telemetry into consistent, auditable metrics used across Agents. Our stack runs on dbt, Apache Iceberg, and MetricsFlow, backed by CI/CD schema enforcement, so every metric we publish carries the same rigor as production code. As Workday scales via a broader agentic transformation, the metrics AMF governs are what let the company trust, and act on, how its agents are performing.

About the Role


As a Software Engineer, you will work towards technical design and execution for core components of AMF's metrics platform. You'll build and operate the pipeline that lands agent telemetry into Iceberg via dbt, enforce schema contracts through CI/CD gates, and extend the MetricsFlow semantic layer that serves governed metrics to the Product Data Store and downstream consumers. This is a hands-on role: you'll work on multi-tenant data isolation, low-latency query performance for metric serving, and the migration path from today's per-tier governance model. You will drive engineering excellence within the team and act as a domain expert for pipeline design, schema governance, and semantic-layer serving.

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks such as Spark, Flink, or Kafka within complex distributed architectures
  • Practical experience with API development (gRPC, REST) for serving metrics and data products to downstream consumers
  • Understanding of multi-tenant data isolation and security principles, including data encryption and tenant-scoped authorization, relevant to governing tenanted (Tier 0) vs. non-tenanted (Tier 1) data
  • Strong grasp of distributed systems principles: data partitioning, eventual consistency, and fault tolerance
  • Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Design (OOD) principles and architectural patterns for scalable, maintainable data systems

jobs.title: Junior Buyer
jobs.description:
Role Introduction:

Established in 1992, Applegreen is a leading convenience roadside retailer in the Republic of Ireland, the UK and the US in both large-scale Motorway Service Areas and Travel Plazas, as well as smaller petrol stations. The business has grown to over 3BN in annual revenue, operating 600 Motorway Service Plazas and forecourt sites internationally and employing over 16,000 people.

Applegreen is in a rapid growth phase and, to support this ambition, we are seeking to appoint a Junior Buyer to assist with the commercial and operational performance of the coffee team. This role reports to the Commercial Coffee Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

As Applegreen expands, the responsibilities will evolve and change over time. The core responsibilities will centre around the following areas:

1. Commercial Analysis & Insight

  • Build, maintain and continuously improve BI dashboards and reporting tools to track sales, margin, pricing and performance KPIs
  • Analyse performance across sales, margin %, ATV, product mix and site performance and translate into clear commercial actions
  • Support forecasting, budgeting and performance tracking across the category
  • Identify trends, risks and opportunities and proactively make recommendations
  • Provide board-ready summaries and insights for senior stakeholders

2. Reporting & Data Management

  • Own and manage all core reporting outputs (weekly, monthly and ad hoc)
  • Extract, clean and structure data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency
  • Deliver automated and scalable reporting solutions using BI tools
  • Maintain data integrity and governance, ensuring one version of the truth
  • Build user-friendly dashboards for cross-functional teams (Commercial, Ops, Finance, Brand)

3. Pricing & Commercial Support

  • Support development and maintenance of pricing models, including margin analysis and cost/ retail tracking
  • Track and validate supplier pricing (/kg, rebates, cost movements) in line with open-book agreements
  • Model impact of pricing changes, promotions and cost fluctuations

4. Buying & Supplier Management / NPD pipeline

  • Support and manage day-to-day buying activities across allocated product areas
  • Raise and manage purchase orders, pricing files and supplier communications
  • Track cost prices, volumes and supplier performance
  • Support negotiations with data and cost analysis
  • Ensure product availability, continuity of supply and issue resolution
  • Maintain accurate product, pricing and supplier records
  • Lead out on managing a strong NPD pipeline in coffee, food and merchandise from research to launch

5. Cross-Functional Delivery

  • Work closely with Operations, Finance, Brand and Technical teams to align data and commercial plans
  • Support product launches, promotions and menu changes with data and reporting
  • Help track execution performance in-store and highlight gaps

The Candidate should have the following:

Qualifications, experience & skills

  • Minimum of two years experience in a commercial analyst, data analyst or similar role (ideally within retail, foodservice or FMCG)
  • Advanced Excel skills(must-have), including:

o Complex formulas (INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS)

o Pivot tables and data modelling

o Scenario modelling and forecasting

  • Proven experience building and managing BI tools / dashboards (e.g. Power BI, Tableau or similar)
  • Ability to extract, manipulate and interpret data from multiple sources
  • Strong commercial awareness with understanding of margin, pricing and cost drivers
  • High level of attention to detail and accuracy
  • Experience with buying, procurement or supplier management (desirable)
  • Exposure to open-book pricing models or commodity-led categories (desirable)
  • Understanding of foodservice or coffee category (desirable)

Additional key skills & attributes:

  • A dynamic individual who adapts well to change and can thrive in a rapidly growing organisation that continues to evolve.
  • Proven track record of delivering to tight deadlines.
  • A highly organised individual with ability to plan and prioritise workloads effectively for maximum impact and adapt around changing priorities as required.
  • Ability to execute directly at high quality and pace.
  • Excellent drive, enthusiasm and commitment and a keen interest in developing a career in Applegreen.
  • A can do attitude and a positive solution focused mindset.
  • Has strong commercial acumen and a focus on delivering value to the business.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, and ability to engage and develop relationships with individuals at all levels of the organisation.
  • Be a self-starter, and also be able to work collaboratively as a member of a highly interdependent team across many parts of Applegreen.
  • Is resilient, calm under pressure and comfortable dealing with ambiguity.
  • Has sound judgement and objective logical decision-making skills.
  • Has strong leadership potential and management skills, who will be a role model for the people and culture at Applegreen.

Willing to travel ad hoc.

jobs.title: Services - Summer Analyst, Ireland - Dublin, 2027
jobs.description:

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview

You're the brains behind our work.

You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the workplace, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success comes with growth. Our program equips you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility—career growth is not a question of if, but when.



What is Services?

Citi’s Services organization plays a crucial role in supporting institutional clients through a wide range of innovative solutions, enabling them to navigate complex financial landscapes. Our business provides integrated cash management and trade finance solutions to help multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations optimize liquidity, working capital, and streamline transactions globally. Our business also delivers custody, fund administration, collateral management, and performance analytics, helping asset managers, institutional investors, and financial institutions efficiently manage and safeguard assets. With our global reach, including presence in over 90 countries, cutting-edge technology, and client-first approach, we provide seamless solutions that drive business success in an evolving financial world.

In this rapidly evolving landscape, we are increasingly leveraging advanced analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance our offerings, improve efficiency, and provide deeper insights to our clients. This includes utilizing AI-powered tools for predictive analytics, automation of routine tasks, and generating actionable insights from vast datasets to inform strategic decisions across our services portfolio.



We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

The Citi Services 10-week Summer Analyst Program gives entry-level employees hands-on experience through training sessions and real, on-the-job learning. Summer Analysts work closely with their teams, owning projects that drive meaningful impact. After an initial week of training and a placement process based on your interests and our needs, you’ll be assigned to a team where you’ll focus on financial analysis, business development, client engagement, and market research.



Your time here will look something like this:

  • Conduct market research to assess industry trends and the impact of macroeconomic factors.
  • Develop materials that support business development, product commercialization, and revenue growth, identifying opportunities where data-driven insights and AI capabilities can add value. This may involve contributing to business cases for new AI-driven product features or improvements to existing services.
  • Assist with process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk, potentially exploring how AI/ML tools can automate tasks or improve decision-making. Evaluate the effectiveness of AI-powered automation in improving operational workflows and reducing manual effort.
  • Analyze client data to identify opportunities and improve service offerings, leveraging various analytical techniques, including interpreting insights derived from advanced analytical models. You will be exposed to how AI models are used to segment clients, predict behaviors, and personalize service delivery.
  • Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior leadership, effectively communicating complex data analysis and potentially insights from AI-driven tools. Clearly articulate the implications and benefits of AI-generated insights for business strategies.
  • Participate in networking events, training sessions, and leadership discussions to strengthen your personal and professional development.


We want to hear from you if…

  • You are a university student graduating in Summer 2028, and on track to achieve a 2.1(or equivalent)
  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Account Executive - On Trade
jobs.description:
Job Description :

About us

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.


Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.


Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more


About the function

Sales is where our brands meet the real world.

This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter everywhere.


It’s a dynamic, people-focused environment where curiosity, commercial thinking and strong relationships make the difference. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your network, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your work every day.


About the role
The mission is to deliver profitable growth and best-in-class execution across a defined portfolio of On Trade customers and outlets in Ireland. Build trusted customer relationships, translate channel and brand priorities into outlet action, grow distribution and rate of sale, and use CRM and performance insight to prioritise the next best action while protecting quality, compliance and investment return.


Level: Analysts are individual contributors who require conceptual knowledge in own area of expertise; develops practical experience; understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. No supervisory responsibilities but may provide guidance to new analysts/associates. Solves standard problems by identifying solutions based on standard practices. Impacts quality of own work; works within guidelines and policies. Explains information to others in straightforward situations.


Roles in this job family work to sales performance targets. They are typically selling to and supporting customers who sell directly to the consumers or resellers/third party partners who sell directly to the customers within a given territory. Sales can occur in a wide range of settings including premium venues, and therefore some roles within this job family require a curated knowledge or Diageo’s most prestigious reserve brands portfolio.


Key Accountabilities:

  • Own customer and outlet delivery: Manage an agreed customer portfolio and call plan, build simple growth actions, complete business reviews and ensure customer and internal commitments are delivered on time.
  • Grow portfolio performance in outlet: Win and maintain distribution, availability, menu placement, visibility, serve quality and advocacy across priority beer and spirits brands, targeting white-space and rate-of-sale opportunities.
  • Land activation and innovation brilliantly: Execute promotions, launches, outlet activations and customer training with Customer Marketing, Advocacy, Quality and external partners; track standards, outcomes and follow-through.
  • Use data, CRM and forecasting to act: Maintain accurate EDGE/CRM records; coordinate forecast inputs with Commercial teams, collect volume and trade investment inputs and update Vision directly; use rate-of-sale, quality and customer data to prioritise action and escalate risks early.
  • Resolve issues and protect trust: Lead customer follow-through on supply, delivery, quality, pricing, claims, credit and execution issues, working cross-functionally and ensuring all activity meets Diageo, legal and responsible-retailing standards.


About you

Key Competencies:

  • Customer and outlet execution: Builds trusted relationships and converts customer, channel and brand plans into disciplined action that improves availability, visibility, quality and rate of sale.
  • Commercial judgement and data-led prioritisation: Uses CRM, rate-of-sale, forecast and customer performance data to focus time and investment on the opportunities that create the most value.
  • Ownership and collaboration: Operates with pace, accuracy and resilience, resolving issues through Sales, Customer Marketing, RGM, Supply, Finance, Quality and external partners.

Qualifications and Experience Required:

  • Relevant FMCG, beverage alcohol, hospitality, field sales, customer operations or account execution experience.
  • Strong customer relationship, influencing and negotiation capability, with a practical understanding of On Trade outlet economics and consumer occasions.
  • Proven ability to deliver distribution, activation, quality and rate-of-sale improvements across a customer or outlet portfolio.
  • Confident using CRM/EDGE, Excel, performance reporting and forecasting tools such as Vision to maintain accurate data and prioritise action.

jobs.title: Kerry Graduate Programme 2027 - Finance
