jobs.description:
Company Description


Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our

services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.


Job Description


About Our Team:

Our multidisciplinary water environment team are looking to recruit Water Science Graduates to join our team in either our Dublin office, joining from January 2027 through to October 2027.

Our team includes specialists in hydrogeology, hydrology, hydro-morphological water quality and water resource management.

We work for clients from across the public and private sectors, including the Environment Agency, Local Authorities, Highways England, Natural England, Water Utilities, Rivers and Wildlife Trusts as well as commercial developers and overseas clients. We are also involved in major ongoing projects such as HS2 and the Thames Tideway Tunnel and as a team are responsible for coordinating/ leading water environment chapters in ES’s as well as coordinating WFD assessments.

All members of the Water Environment team take an active role in client contact and commercial aspects of our projects. Health, safety and environmental considerations underpin everything that we do.

We have an impressive portfolio of water science projects including technical investigation, restoration projects, and impact and WFD assessment for major national and international infrastructure projects. A selection of our current and recent projects includes:

We are seeking to recruit a Water Scientist to assist with a range of projects. Most of our work is in the fluvial environment, although a significant proportion is also focused on estuaries, lakes and the marine environment, and so experience of these environments is beneficial.

This is a fantastic opportunity to further your career by gaining valuable work experience within a specialist surface water environment team in an established consultancy. Your work will cover a broad range of hydrological, water quality, hydro-morphological and hydro-ecological activities including on the following types of projects.

Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Water quality studies (e.g. baseline studies, environmental impact assessment, nutrient loading studies and pollution studies including monitoring and modelling).
  • Hydrological investigations (e.g. flood, drought and water resource allocation).
  • Geomorphological studies, including supporting channel enhancement/ restoration projects, Natural Flood Management studies and Fluvial Audits.
  • hydro-morphological l studies (e.g. assessing the effects of schemes on aquatic organisms such as salmonids, freshwater pearl mussels, invertebrates and macrophytes).
  • WFD / Environmental Compliance studies.
  • EIA (e.g. highway, rail, aviation, utilities, power generation including renewables, mixed use/commercial/residential and other development types).
  • Pollution prevention advice including preparing Water Management Plans, acting as Environmental Clerk of Works, and developing sustainable treatment trains; and
  • Applications for various permissions (e.g. Environmental Permits for flood risk activities and discharges, Water Abstraction / Impoundment Licences, and Land Drainage Consents).

Enjoy the Perks

At AECOM, you'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well-being, customised to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days.

Here is what you will get from us!

On the job support and learning

When a graduate starts at AECOM, we pair them with a senior member of the team who will guide and mentor them through their initial period working on live projects and business development tasks, to support with any technical queries.

Graduate Development Programme

Our 2-year graduate ADVANCE programme is designed to help you build your career in AECOM. You will attend several instructor-led training sessions where you will meet and hear from people across the business and take part in a series of interactive activities to equip you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed in your role. Alongside the instructor-led elements of the ADVANCE programme, you will also engage with an online curriculum via AECOM University and can join the ADV ANCE webinar series. We will provide you with all the support and tools you need to achieve your professional development ambitions, which may include Chartership with the relevant international professional institution ie, Chartered Institution of Water and Environmental Management (CIWEM).

We have more than 750 graduates on our programmes across the UK and Ireland from more than 40 different disciplines, each making a tangible difference to the environment in which we live and work.

Job Description :

Process Controller

Type: 1 year Fixed-Term Contract

About us

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

About the Function

Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.

With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.

It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.

Join our Beer Team in St. James

In 1759, Arthur Guinness made the bold decision to sign a 9,000 year lease on a brewery site at St. James’s Gate in Dublin, heralding the arrival of what would become one of Ireland’s most iconic brands and best loved beers, GUINNESS® Beer is the primary liquid supply chain of the ISC brewing Business, producing all of Diageo’s outstanding collection of brands like Guinness, Hop House 13, Rockshore and Smithwicks. Beer & Brewing has a constant focus on the marriage of craft & productivity through manufacturing excellence techniques - standardisation and simplification in everything we do. Our success is thanks to the strength of our people, in every role. It’s why we trust them with our legacy. And it’s why we reward them with the career-defining opportunities that they deserve.

About the role

Our Beer operations are made up of approximately 400 employees who are engaged in roles across four locations (St James's Gate, LittleConnell, Belfast Packaging and Runcorn Packaging). As a Process Controller, you'll:

Manufacture products of the highest quality to agreed customer service levels, safely and efficiently.
Operate 2 keg lines and related Process Plant which produces almost 7 million kegs annually consisting of 25 different beer types, 4 different keg sizes and 50 different SKU’s.
Drive the Process Continuous Improvement agenda in the Keg Plant.

Your key responsibilities and accountabilities will be as follows:

At all times adhere to Diageo health and safety, environmental, and food safety standards.
Understand the functions and workings of machines and perform autonomous maintenance tasks.
Manage and control all processes including operation of packaging machinery.
Carry out quality analyses relevant to the role, and ensure quality is right the first time and all data input.
Apply Manufacturing Excellence tools and techniques.

Work Pattern

In this role you'll primarily be on day shift (Mon-Fri) however some shift cover, and flexibility will be required at times.

About you

We’re looking for people with character: driven, resilient, and open-minded. You’ll be commercially astute, target-driven driven, and flexible – as our work can change quickly.

jobs.description:
We are currently seeking analysts with a minimum of 1 year’s relevant experience working within an energy, safety, water, process industry or a related sector.

‌

The Position

Job Title : Analyst

Starting Salary : *€44,678 (Salary scale: €44,678 - €63,230) *Please see below for further information.

Location : The Exchange, Belgard Square North, Tallaght, Dublin 24.

Working Hours : 37.5 hours per week

Hybrid working : Up to 3 days per week remote working available

Closing Date : 12.00 noon, Monday, 19th October, 2026.

Tenure : Appointment will be on a permanent basis, subject to successful passing of the probationary period.

‌

The Role of Analyst

We are seeking candidates with experience in economics, engineering, legal, public policy and other relevant fields to fill posts in the following areas:

Security of Supply and Wholesale

Ensuring a secure energy transition to 2030, delivering on our 80% renewable electricity target and overseeing the wholesale all-island Single Electricity Market (SEM) in co-operation with the Utility Regulator in Belfast.

Networks and Economic Regulation

Working with Uisce Éireann and energy companies, enhancing the CRU’s economic regulation of these critical networks, ensuring that they support customers, underpin economic growth and play a transformational role in climate change adaptation and mitigation.

Customer Policy and Protection (incl. Legal)

Empowering and protecting customers, overseeing competition and consumer protection across Ireland’s energy retail markets and playing an important role in supporting the National Energy Affordability Taskforce. The Legal, Compliance and Enforcement teams are also part of this Division, providing legal advice and support and compliance and enforcement duties across the organisation on a broad range of regulatory and corporate matters.

Energy Safety

Regulating safety of gas (networks, supply, storage, use and liquefied petroleum gas distribution), petroleum (upstream onshore and offshore exploration and production of hydrocarbons), gas installers and electrical contractors.

Decarbonisation

Delivering new CRU regulatory frameworks for offshore renewables, green hydrogen, district heating and other new technologies and leading cross-cutting decarbonisation projects, including electricity connection policy, interconnector regulation and Projects of Common Interest.

Operations and Organisational Development

Supporting and empowering the CRU teams to achieve outcomes in our Strategic Plan in the areas of process improvement, finance and governance, human resources, information technology, and communications.

‌

Duties and Responsibilities

Reporting to a manager, the successful candidate will be involved in a varied role working to tight deadlines in a dynamic environment. CRU Analyst roles typically include activities such as:

Preparing CRU consultation and decision papers, preparing reports and making presentations both internally and externally.
Working as a member of a team and on specific cross-functional project teams as required.
Engaging with internal and external stakeholders in a constructive manner in order to further CRU objectives.
Engaging with NI, GB or EU counterparts on all-island or EU policy, markets or industry developments.
Maintaining an awareness of policy developments and best practice within the energy and water industry and related industries, both in Ireland and internationally.
Researching policy issues and identifying data/trends, using this to suggest policy courses of action for the CRU.
Analysing spreadsheets of energy/water/safety data, and financial modelling.
Carrying out such other functions as may be required from time to time to fulfil the business objectives of the CRU and as appropriate to the grade.

The above list is not exhaustive. While the successful candidate will be assigned to a particular team within the CRU, they will also be expected to contribute to the work of the wider Division/CRU as requirements dictate.

The CRU may establish a shortlist of suitable candidates for potential future positions that may arise within the organisation.

‌

Qualifications and Experience

Essential Requirements

Candidates must have on or before the closing date for applications the following:

1. An appropriate NFQ Level 8 or higher qualification, preferably in economics, law, engineering, science, health and safety (process safety), business or other closely related discipline;

2. A minimum of 1 year’s relevant experience working within an energy, safety, water, process industry or a related sector.

Desirable Requirements

1. Knowledge/experience of existing and developing policy frameworks in the regulated energy sectors;

2. Experience working in a regulated sector or governmental organisation.

‌

The Package

Salary

*Starting salary of €44,678 (Salary scale: €44,678 - €63,230)

*Candidates should note that entry will be at the minimum point of the scale.
The rate of remuneration may be adjusted in line with the Government pay policy.
Candidates should note that different pay and conditions may apply if, immediately prior to appointment, the appointee is a serving civil or public servant.
Salary increments will be awarded annually, subject to satisfactory performance.

Benefits

Attractive Pension Scheme.
Opportunity to work remotely up to 3 days per week, in addition to up to 6 weeks fully remote.
Access to the cycle-to-work scheme.
Opportunity for further education
25 days of annual leave upon appointment, rising to 29 days after 5 years’ service and 31 days after 10 years’ service.
11 bank holidays/public holidays.
Flexible working arrangements.
Tax saver Bus / Luas scheme available to assist with travel costs to and from work.
Access to CRU’s Employee Assistance Programme.

The CRU will provide you with ongoing support and training, and there will be ample opportunity for professional development, allowing you to maximise your potential and progress you

jobs.title: Laboratory Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Description

We are SGS – the world’s leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 97,000 employees operate a network of 2,650 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

Job Description

ROLE OVERVIEW

Job Title: Laboratory Analyst
Job Type: Permanent
Location: Unit 1C N11 South Point Business Park, Charvey Lane,, Rathnew, Ireland
Hours: 39 hours p/w
Salary: €35000-52000 pa

Main Purpose of Role

The primary function of this role is to work in the Gas Chromatography laboratory in Rathnew. This includes testing of gas samples using SGS GAS and Pharmacopeia procedures, develop SGS GAS procedures for new & existing GC testing methods and compile reports for the testing.

In this role you will work to cGMP standards and complete work under GAS ISO17025 accreditation.

You will also complete validation testing for new equipment and methods being brought into service under direction and support from the laboratory manager or technical manager. You will develop a knowledge and competence of Gas Chromatography using TCD, FID, PDHID, DID, SCD, MS, and other detection technologies and must have the willingness to learn. Full training will be provided from our offices in Ireland and by external vendors when necessary.

You will work with a team of passionate hands-on engineers, scientists, and other departments of SGS GAS such as the quality team and the field-testing team. You will also work with the wider SGS group.

Good communication skills are required. You must be self-motivated with a “can-do” attitude and be customer focused.

Primary Responsibilities

Work independently and provide guidance and role modelling for Junior staff.
Focus on customer requirements and prioritise workload in the GC lab.
Run the operation meeting for gas testing and instrumentation reports.
Role model clean as you go policy in the GC laboratory and act of the area owner.
Perform a variety of routine sample testing to quantitatively measure gas quality in a variety of products and for different applications.
Execute validated analytical methods with minimal supervision.
Analyse, compile and format results of testing into clear reports for lab and field-testing work in a timely manner.
Prepare GCs for testing and complete system suitability testing.
Assist in development and validation of new basic and complex analysis for GC-TCD/FID/MS/SCD/DID/ECD under supervision.
Problem-solve basic and complex GC technical issues and utilise internal and external expertise to identify and address problems with the minimum impact.
Report issues to the quality department and take part in the relevant investigations.
Comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), ISO17025 requirements and all internal processes.
Participate in internal and external laboratory audits under the direction of the SGS-GAS quality manager.
Be willing and able to work as a team member to ensure continuous improvement relative to laboratory functions.
Adhere to all safety protocols.
Be available for occasional weekend work (short shifts – 2 to 4 hours).
On rare occasions travel to customer sites to complete testing and/or technical meetings and reviews.
Complete project work within the SGS laboratory network and SGS customers – potentially on another site for a defined duration.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in science. With 2 years minimum experience in analytical chemistry & Gas Chromatography techniques.

Additional Information

The ideal candidate should possess the following attributes/skillsets

Lead by example in promoting a Health & Safety culture.
Strong attention to detail.
Analytical decision maker.
Be dependable and reliable and able to work in a process driven environment.
To be organised, self-motivated and able to prioritise and manage conflicting needs of the business.
High level of computer literacy.
You should be a strong communicator and have the ability to negotiate both internally and externally with, contractors, customers and colleagues.

jobs.title: QC Sample Management Analyst (QCSM)
jobs.description:
QC Sample Management Analyst (QCSM)

Dublin 22, Grange Castle

Job Purpose

Responsibility for carrying out sample management tasks pertaining to GC and external site manufactured products, regulatory reserve, stability, and Board of Health samples.

Job Responsibilities

Routinely receive manufacturing test samples and distribute to the appropriate analytical laboratories.
Oversee and maintain appropriate procedures to ensure chain of custody for QC samples is maintained.
Manage the incoming shipment processes from external sites, verification of sample inventory, processing of samples and distribution to QC test laboratories.
Shipment of Drug Product and associated bulk Drug Substance regulatory samples to BOH sites.
Management of stability sample processes including study enrolment, time-point pulls, sample shipment, and study disposal.
Maintenance of the reserve program, including inspection of reserve and retention samples, documentation of inspection results, and maintenance of reserve/retention equipment.
Reference material inventory management.
Perform review and approval of QCSM standard operating procedures, sampling and analysis plans, and stability protocols to ensure compliance.
Facilitate laboratory investigations and support associated product investigations.
Support the preparation and review of QC APQR and periodic review reports.
Partner closely and proactively engage with customers and key stakeholders to understand and deliver samples within specified turnaround times, participating in cross-functional teams as required.
Represent QCSM at product, technical and robustness team meetings and lead/drive associated deliverables.
Contribute to the completion of complex projects, managing own time to meet agreed targets and developing plans for work activities on own projects within a team.
Participate in new initiatives such as the 5S, Standard Work, Data Integrity and IMEX programs as they arise.
Engage with the business to identify and define scope for continuous improvement, robustness, and Best Practice initiatives assisting with improving the efficiency of local and across-site processes and procedures.
Ensure compliance with cGMP, corporate standards/Pfizer Quality System (PQS), site policies/procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Technical writing assignments such as SOPs, trend reports, risk assessments, laboratory investigations, and change controls.
Assist in the maintenance and development of training programs and perform training of other analysts.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

jobs.title: Android Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
Department Description
Innovation is the oxygen of our company, and in 2023, we invested more than US$850 million in research and development (R&D). We have opened a new Research & Development Centre in Cork, Ireland focused on designing software for the company’s comprehensive land mobile radio (LMR) portfolio, with plans for expansion across other technologies in the future.

Motorola Solutions’ ecosystem of technologies is centred on safety and security, with LMR representing a foundational core. The company has deployed more than 13,000 LMR networks worldwide, trusted by governments and enterprises for highly secure communications designed to work in the most extreme conditions. Modernised with broadband and advanced data applications, LMR remains at the forefront of providing public safety agencies with the communications they rely on and need.

You’ll be part of our diverse and experienced global team, developing meaningful solutions that support thousands of public safety agencies and enterprises worldwide in solving complex safety and security challenges. Come join our team to work on real-world projects with a real-world impact.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Android Platform Engineer to join our Astro Device Software team. This role focuses on the "under the hood" customization of the Android OS. You will be responsible for tailoring the Android Open Source Project (AOSP) to meet specific hardware requirements, with some emphasis on optimizing the LTE/Cellular stack and overall network connectivity.

We're looking for a leader who:

Takes initiative, with a hands-on approach to ensuring quality and stability in our applications.

Is a mentor at heart, ready to guide and inspire other engineers with your expertise.

Communicates effectively, capable of sharing your ideas and solutions with team members and leadership alike.

Is a quick learner, eager to embrace new technologies and apply them effectively.

Thrives in a distributed team environment, collaborating with colleagues across locations to achieve remarkable results.

Proven track record of successful delivery of multiple products or projects.

It would be an advantage if you have previous hands-on experience of the Android Open Source Project. You may have experience in other large scale frameworks such as Eclipse or other open source libraries or significant open source projects such as linux. This may include previous experience with AOSP (or equivalent platforms) in performing some of the following:

AOSP Customization: Modify and extend Android framework layers (Telephony, ConnectivityService, and Hardware Abstraction Layers).

Connectivity Optimization: Fine-tune LTE, 5G, or Wi-Fi performance, ensuring seamless handover and stability in mission-critical environments.

System Integration: Integrate vendor-specific RIL (Radio Interface Layer) and modem firmware.

Performance Tuning: Debug complex system-level issues using tools such as ADB or Wireshark to resolve latency or connectivity drops.

Additional Qualified Skills:

Core Android: 5+ years of experience working with AOSP and Android internals.

Languages: Expert-level proficiency in Java (JNI experience is a must) and C++.

Wireless Protocols: understanding of the LTE/5G protocol stack , NAS, AS, and RRC layers.

Architecture: Proven experience with the Android Telephony Framework and Radio Interface Layer (RIL) .

jobs.description:
Research Assistant- AI assisted design ICs capture BioSignals

About Tyndall
Tyndall National Institute is an international leader in semiconductors, photonics and deep-tech research and innovation. As a leading collaborative European research institute, Tyndall is a key actor and hosting partner in the delivery of the ‘Chips for Europe Initiative’ (EU Chips Act).

Tyndall is Ireland’s leading research and innovation organisation and it is the national focal point for excellence in deep-tech research, development and graduate training at the convergence of nanotechnology, microelectronics, photonics, electronics and AI. Tyndall is recognised as an international research leader in semiconductor, chip and digital technologies, particularly as applied to the fields of Information & Communications, Health & Life Sciences, Agritech & Food Security, Energy and Climate Mitigation, emerging fields such as quantum, and novel computing paradigms.

The Institute’s key objective is to see frontier research activities having a significant impact on economic development and societal challenges in Ireland, Europe and beyond. Central to Tyndall’s mission is delivering economic impact through research excellence in partnership with industry and academia. With an annual turnover of more than €50m, the Institute has a community of over 600 researchers, engineers, support staff, postgraduate students, interns and industry researchers-in-residence.

With significant committed Irish government support, Tyndall will grow to be 1,000 people by 2030, with approximately 750 researchers, including 250 PhD students. A new 17,000 m2 research building is under development adjacent to the Cork headquarters and there are developing plans to expand Tyndall’s existing Dublin research labs and to establish other research sites within Ireland.

Tyndall’s expansion is also supported by recent national and EU funding wins for significant (M€10’s) additional research equipment across a range of areas such as semiconductor processing, microscopy, quantum technologies, heterogeneous integration, ultra-high speed optical communications and RF through THz characterisation.

About the Team
The integrated circuits group at Tyndall National Institute consist of a large team of researchers in silicon chip design, at various stages of their careers; from Masters researcher through to Principal Researcher. All are creating advanced, innovative and high impact Integrated Circuit technologies, which will shape our future lives. Excellent research is being carried out in areas such as Analog Precision Circuits, RF and Millimeter-wave Communications circuits, Cryogenic CMOS and Integrated Power Systems.

About the Role
Design of a Wide-bandwidth (RF) low noise amplifier
The objective of this position is to apply AI assisted circuit design methods to design amplifiers and Analog to Digital converter blocks. The circuit blocks will be used to build a system to capture Bio electrical signals like ECG and EMG.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
The candidate is expected to be creative, self-motivated, and should help create an efficientl and friendly atmosphere within the Integrated Circuits Group and beyond to all teams at Tyndall.
Propose AI assisted design methods to Simulate, Design and Layout analogue circuits either using Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools from industry standard vendors like Cadence or custom or open source tools.
With guidance from the senior Tyndall design team propose innovative circuits to meet the bio sensing application
Perform schematic design, simulation and analysis across PVT corners and relevant operating conditions.
Work with guidance from experienced layout engineers to ensure effective layout implementation of analogue circuits, including matching, parasitics, shielding, grounding, isolation and other layout considerations
Prepare presentations and reports.
Support project management.
Participate in Education and Public Engagement activities, as required.
Ensure compliance with Tyndall’s Quality Management Systems, Health and Safety standards, and other regulations.
Carry out any additional duties as may reasonably be required within the general scope and level of the post.
Essential Criteria

The successful candidate must have:
a MEng or equivalent experience (e.g. BEng + 2 years’ experience) in a relevant discipline such as electrical/electronic engineering, physics or related relevant discipline;
experience in designing integrated circuits in the areas of Analogue, Mixed-Signal or RF circuit design;
experience with designing and simulating integrated circuits using tools such as Cadence/Siemens-Mentor/Synoposys;
strong communication skills, as evidenced by prior experience such as working with/in industry, scientific paper writing, conference presentation and report writing.
Knowledge of analogue circuits e.g. amplifiers or comparators.
Knowledge of AI algorithms
Desirable Criteria
Knowledge of Integrated circuit layout
Good mathematical ability and knowledge of statistics.
Experience programming with Python
What We Offer

Apart from offering a position in a highly successful and positive research environment, with a collaborative ethos full of diverse competencies to boost your career, we offer the following:

Impactful Work: Opportunities to contribute to ground-breaking research and innovation that shape Ireland’s economy and the society at large.
Continuous Learning: Strong support for formal training, further study and professional development.
Interdisciplinary Environment: Where academia, industry, and innovation intersect - supported by cutting-edge infrastructure and expert knowledge.
Blended Working: Flexibility to work remotely and on-site, where the role allows.
Comprehensive Benefits: Access to UCC pension, long-term illness benefit, life assurance, and more.
Generous Leave: Competitive annual leave entitlements.
Equity & Inclusion: Athena Swan Bronze award holder, with ongoing initiatives

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Exposure Analysis and Identification Management Analyst

Corporate Title: Up to Vice President

Location: Chester or Dublin


Company Overview:


At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.


Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being a diverse and inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve.


At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


Location Overview:


Chester


Find us in the city of Chester, a destination renowned for its culture, history, and beauty. Working at Bank of America Chester offers a far-reaching global career for a world-renowned organisation, whilst being ideally situated against the backdrop of the rolling North Wales hills and the banks of the serene River Dee.


Central Park


Overlooking the spectacular Iveagh Gardens with access to all amenities in the beating heart of central Dublin is our Park Place office. Travel options include the LUAS, Dublin Bus networks as well as the Dublin Bikes station, positioned just outside our front doors. As part of our commitment to supporting staff travel to and from work in the most sustainable way possible, we also provide tax saver tickets as part of our award-winning benefits package which means getting to work has never been easier


Role Description:


This role will be dedicated to the overall Exposure Analysis and Identification team within EMEA with the role being split between Exposure Analysis and Attack Surface Research.



The Exposure Analysis (EA) team is a global function responsible for the evaluation and prioritization of security vulnerabilities and exposures to enable appropriate remediation across the company. This individual contributor role will join a team of Exposure analysts around the globe who support Exposure management activities by leveraging analytic and technical skills to assess cyber security related risks.



The Attack Surface Research (ASR) role maintains and performs queries across a wide array of asset enumeration and research toolsets, spanning on-premises and cloud platforms, to effectively map, measure, and report on the topography of the Bank’s network endpoints and other assets for exposure risk.

The role requires a highly collaborative, analytical and detail-oriented mindset, with a focus on ensuring conclusions and/or insights reflect innovative thinking as well as accurate information gathering under time pressure to fully answer three core questions as quickly as possible.


  • Do we have it?
  • Are we vulnerable?
  • Is it exploitable?

Persons in this role operate as part of a team developing methods to quickly reference systems of record (SORs), systems of origin (SOOs) and other available data stores to provide a comprehensive, reliable and timely view of the Bank’s Attack Surface, both as it relates to exposure exploitation risk as well as other concerns.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:



Exposure Analysis:



  • Analyse and triage disclosed exposures, vulnerabilities, threat scenarios, and mitigating controls from a number of workstreams.
  • Research and evaluate threats and vulnerabilities to assist in prioritization of remediation actions.
  • Review and validate exposures using available data sources, tools and identifying new data sources as needed.
  • Leverage creativity and influence to enhance the Vulnerability Management program.
  • Analysing Vendor Advisories and Open-Source Intelligence with a view to make informed decisions regarding the Bank’s attack surface and exposure.
  • Work alongside partner teams during System Vulnerability Incidents to achieve resolution.


Attack Surface Research:



  • Create SQL and Python scripts within Qualys, Tanium and BladeLogic to query datasets, to support Attack Surface Review.
  • Perform hands-on analysis of large scale datasets to correlate map, measure, and report on the overall vulnerability attack surface of the Bank.
  • Leverage Python, SQL, and other languages/platforms to automate data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and quality validation (ETL)
  • Develop and maintain visualizations and reports in Power BI or MS-Reporting Services (SSRS) / SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) that support operational teams, cyber leadership, and stakeholders across Information Security and broader risk teams.
  • Possesses network architecture experience sufficient to reasonably speak to the Bank’s data network and architecture in a timely manner to major inquiries as both an individual and as part of projects by the larger team.
  • Clearly communicate findings through written analysis and live discussions, including executive‑level summaries

What we’re looking for:


  • Experience in Cyber Security or a related technology field
  • Bachelor’s degree

jobs.title: Middle Office Analyst/Associate
jobs.description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

Position Description:

The candidate will be working in the Middle Office team in Dublin processing OTC and non-OTC trades encompassing Bond trades, FX, Derivatives Repos and Swaps with the aim being to provide support to the Portfolio Managers for any product traded. The primary responsibilities include regular contact with brokers to confirm trades, acting as escalation contact for settlement queries and monitoring the inhouse STP trade capture system. Thus, strong trade flow management ability and good settlement experience are vital. Furthermore, the Associate will be involved in interaction with the Dublin and the Newport Beach offices.

Daily interaction with Portfolio Managers, Compliance, and Investment Operations.
Monitor proprietary trade capture system: ensure accurate trade capture and completeness of tickets.
Complete initial confirmation with the broker for trades executed in London office
Trade floor support: run various daily trade-flow reports and any ad hoc reports requested by Portfolio Management team.
Interaction with Back Office support functions: escalation contact for trade settlement. The back-office support is outsourced to State Street, daily contact through telephone and email. There is also direct contact with Brokers to resolve issues and support State Street as point of escalation.
The team work on a weekly alternating shift pattern of 8.00am – 5.00pm, 9.30am – 6.30pm and 11.30am until close. On average the late shift is shorter, but a willingness to work later hours as required is essential for the role.

Position Requirements:

Proven experience in a similar role within Asset Management or Investment Banking.
Excellent attention to detail. Strong analytical ability is essential
Strong verbal and written communication skills are vital to work within the firm’s demanding and focused environment.
Capability to manage multiple tasks with tight time deadlines and possess strong problem-solving ability.
Flexibility and ability to work under pressure with a fair degree of autonomy as well as in a team environment is essential. PIMCO works on a flat structure so ability to work with all levels of firm.
Good working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, Access, MS Outlook and Bloomberg. Basic knowledge of other MS programs such as PowerPoint preferred. SQL and programming skills are a plus.
Educated to degree level or equivalent is an advantage.
Clear commitment to PIMCO’s culture, values and approach

jobs.title: Portfolio Analyst - Credit
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

THE TEAM

KKR is hiring an Analyst/ Associate in its growing Private Credit Corporate business.

The Portfolio Monitoring Unit (PMU) plays a central role in the ongoing management and oversight of KKR’s credit investments. The team is responsible for performance analytics, transaction modelling, valuation, and strategic optimisation across a growing portfolio. Operating across a wide range of asset types and industries, the PMU team supports both institutional and insurance-related mandates.

To enhance our ability to actively manage and optimize investments, KKR established the Portfolio Monitoring Unit (PMU) in Dublin in 2016. This dedicated team plays a pivotal role in overseeing our global Private Credit portfolio, ensuring disciplined risk management and long-term value creation.

AREA OF FOCUS
Financial & Performance Analysis – Conducting in-depth evaluations of company financials to assess trends
Asset Valuation & Financial Modelling – Applying advanced methodologies to ensure accurate valuations.
Portfolio & Risk Management – Identifying and mitigating risks across a diverse set of investments.

Since its inception, the Corporate PMU team has grown to 19 investment professionals, now responsible for monitoring 165 investments across Europe, the U.S., and APAC. These investments span a wide range of industries, including technology, healthcare, industrials, and consumer goods.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Experience: 2-5 years in investment banking, private equity, corporate or leveraged lending, corporate finance, transaction services, restructuring, corporate audit, or valuations.
Analytical Acumen: Strong problem-solving skills and a keen eye for financial analysis.
Academic Excellence: A solid educational background in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.
Commercial Awareness: A deep understanding of financial statements, valuation methodologies, and corporate structures.
Communication & Organizational Skills: Ability to synthesize complex financial data into clear, actionable insights.

This role presents a unique opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a high-performing investment team. If you have the expertise and ambition to excel in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Account Executive - On Trade
jobs.description:
Job Description :

About us

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more

About the function

Sales is where our brands meet the real world.

This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter everywhere.

It’s a dynamic, people-focused environment where curiosity, commercial thinking and strong relationships make the difference. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your network, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your work every day.

About the role
The mission is to deliver profitable growth and best-in-class execution across a defined portfolio of On Trade customers and outlets in Ireland. Build trusted customer relationships, translate channel and brand priorities into outlet action, grow distribution and rate of sale, and use CRM and performance insight to prioritise the next best action while protecting quality, compliance and investment return.

Level: Analysts are individual contributors who require conceptual knowledge in own area of expertise; develops practical experience; understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. No supervisory responsibilities but may provide guidance to new analysts/associates. Solves standard problems by identifying solutions based on standard practices. Impacts quality of own work; works within guidelines and policies. Explains information to others in straightforward situations.

Roles in this job family work to sales performance targets. They are typically selling to and supporting customers who sell directly to the consumers or resellers/third party partners who sell directly to the customers within a given territory. Sales can occur in a wide range of settings including premium venues, and therefore some roles within this job family require a curated knowledge or Diageo’s most prestigious reserve brands portfolio.

Key Accountabilities:

Own customer and outlet delivery: Manage an agreed customer portfolio and call plan, build simple growth actions, complete business reviews and ensure customer and internal commitments are delivered on time.
Grow portfolio performance in outlet: Win and maintain distribution, availability, menu placement, visibility, serve quality and advocacy across priority beer and spirits brands, targeting white-space and rate-of-sale opportunities.
Land activation and innovation brilliantly: Execute promotions, launches, outlet activations and customer training with Customer Marketing, Advocacy, Quality and external partners; track standards, outcomes and follow-through.
Use data, CRM and forecasting to act: Maintain accurate EDGE/CRM records; coordinate forecast inputs with Commercial teams, collect volume and trade investment inputs and update Vision directly; use rate-of-sale, quality and customer data to prioritise action and escalate risks early.
Resolve issues and protect trust: Lead customer follow-through on supply, delivery, quality, pricing, claims, credit and execution issues, working cross-functionally and ensuring all activity meets Diageo, legal and responsible-retailing standards.

About you

Key Competencies:

Customer and outlet execution: Builds trusted relationships and converts customer, channel and brand plans into disciplined action that improves availability, visibility, quality and rate of sale.
Commercial judgement and data-led prioritisation: Uses CRM, rate-of-sale, forecast and customer performance data to focus time and investment on the opportunities that create the most value.
Ownership and collaboration: Operates with pace, accuracy and resilience, resolving issues through Sales, Customer Marketing, RGM, Supply, Finance, Quality and external partners.

Qualifications and Experience Required:

Relevant FMCG, beverage alcohol, hospitality, field sales, customer operations or account execution experience.
Strong customer relationship, influencing and negotiation capability, with a practical understanding of On Trade outlet economics and consumer occasions.
Proven ability to deliver distribution, activation, quality and rate-of-sale improvements across a customer or outlet portfolio.
Confident using CRM/EDGE, Excel, performance reporting and forecasting tools such as Vision to maintain accurate data and prioritise action.
High ownership, organisation and judgement, with the ability to work responsibly in a regulated category and resolve issues at pace.
Full driving licence and flexibility to spend significant time in trade, including occasional evening or event activity.

Working with us

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Contemporary work life balance policies and wellbeing activities
On site gym or subsidised gym membership
Contributary pension scheme
Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family
Annual bonus of circa 20% of your base salary (dependent on performance)
Share options

jobs.title: Graduate Transport Planner - Dublin (2027 start)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our
services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

At AECOM we have a number of exciting opportunities across the UK & Ireland for graduates to work within our Transport Planning Team. We provide advice and support to address the challenges facing society, environment and the economy.

Our team covers all areas of transport planning, including transport strategy development, transport modelling and appraisal, feasibility studies, business case development, development planning, and monitoring and evaluation. For many of our projects, we work collaboratively with colleagues across AECOM’s many disciplines, including planners, designers, architects, engineers, regeneration and environmental specialists. The majority of our projects are based in the North of England, but we also support offices across the UK and Ireland and undertake some national and international work.

We are looking for an ambitious team player who wishes to assist in developing and communicating proposals for transport schemes and strategies, working in a collaborative environment. The role would suit a self-motivated individual looking to begin their career in a dynamic team helping to solve real-world, practical, challenges.

We will, of course, provide you with all the training and support you need to progress your career and develop professionally. You will be working within a positive culture where learning and development is not only supported, but also actively promoted.

Early work with us will typically be supporting senior staff with technical input into a variety of projects. Key responsibilities will include:

Data collection and analysis
Development of transport strategies and plans
Developing and applying transport models
Scheme development and appraisal
Preparation of transport assessments for developments
Preparation of business cases for transport schemes
Assisting in the preparation of reports, presentations, bids and proposals
Attending meetings and workshops with clients, other discipline members and stakeholders.

Qualifications

 Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering, Geography, Economics, Maths, or an MSc in Transport Planning with a 2:1 classification (or equivalent) or above
A Masters degree in Civil Engineering, Geography, Economics, Maths, or Transport Planning would be an advantage
Transport Planning modules or experience would be an advantage
Ability to demonstrate a good technical understanding of Transport Planning
Demonstrable interest in Transport Planning and developing a career in this industry
Willing and able to work towards chartership with the TPS, CIHT, or ICE
Good Microsoft Office skills essential such as Word, Excel & PowerPoint
Ability to communicate effectively to internal and external clients, both verbally & in writing with the confidence to engage with a variety of people (clients, colleagues, stakeholders and sub-contractors alike) and the aptitude to rationally explain, explore and discuss technical issues and capture feedback
Enthusiastic, hard-working, with ambition and drive
Ability to structure & prioritise work effectively through close cooperation with the team as a whole
Ability to work in a team and independently without losing initiative & focus

Additional Information

Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible since CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected for an advanced offer start.
Please include a covering letter with your application and provide all predicted and/or obtained academic grades.

Research

Vacancy Summary

Project Title: Formulation Innovation to Enhance Thermal Stability and Deployability of a Lassa Fever Vaccine

Vaccine deployment is severely constrained by the need for logistics including cold chain distribution. Infectious diseases remain a major threat to health and health security in the EU and globally and thus a proactive approach to the development of vaccines in preparedness for future infectious disease outbreaks is needed. One such threat is Lassa mammarenavirus, which remains a major epidemic threat in West Africa and a priority pathogen for global health security. Our partners have successfully developed a live recombinant virus vector Lassa vaccine to clinical testing. However, this vaccine currently requires ultra-cold chain storage with limited refrigerator stability. This creates challenges for broad deployment and storage, particularly for rapid use in an outbreak response and for routine preventive use in endemic settings in resource-limited regions.

In this Horizon-EU funded project, the consortium will advance this Lassa vaccine candidate toward a next-generation formulation optimized for epidemic deployment. Specifically, the partners will develop and eval-uate a thermostable formulation manufactured using scalable, production technologies and advance it through required preclinical testing and first in human clinical evaluation. Scientists in the Vaccine Immun-isation Technology and Access (VITAL) group in NIBRT will collaborate with the vaccine manufacturing part-ner to identify, develop and verify thermostabilising formulations and processes for this live virus vector vac-cine. We will focus on developing a liquid and a lyophilised form vaccines.

The primary focus is to identify, develop and verify thermostabilising formulations and processes for this live virus vector vaccine using pharmaceutical and virology methodologies. The successful candidate will have a background in the pharmaceutical and vaccine sciences, with an ability to work to a high standard. This role represents a step change from Post-Doctoral researcher roles as it combines high-quality, collaborative vaccine biopharmaceutical research with operational leadership. jobs.title: PhD in Compact Short Pulse Semiconductor Lasers
jobs.description:
SPEAR Centre: Fully Funded PhD in ‘Compact short pulse semiconductor lasers’

The Semiconductor and Photonics Education and Research (SPEAR) Centre, funded by PEACEPLUS and managed by the Special EU Programmes Body (SEUPB), is an €8.5 million cross-border project by Atlantic Technological University, Ulster University, Tyndall National Institute and their associate partner Seagate Technology. The Centre aims to build research capacity in integrated photonics and semiconductor technologies, contributing to the development of Ireland’s and Northern Ireland’s deep-tech innovation ecosystem. It seeks to train the next generation of scientists and engineers to support growth in sectors such as healthcare, telecommunications, advanced manufacturing, and sensor networks.

The following position is available at Tyndall National Institute in Cork:

Compact short pulse semiconductor lasers

Project Description

Semiconductor lasers are the compact light source for emerging waveguided photonic integrated circuits (PICs). As such, the laser needs to meet many application-dependent criteria such as wavelength, power, energy, tuning range, polarization, for example. One of the most exciting high-volume application for integrated lasers is for high density data storage enabled by heat assisted magnetic recording (HAMR). The aim of the PhD is to design and realise lasers capable of generating and delivering sub-picosecond light pulses with high peak power all within a limited footprint for the laser and waveguide.

This requires careful analysis of the materials and the device physics. Mode locking with saturable absorbers along with dispersion control is one approach, and this requires detailed modelling and simulation. Varying the repetition rate and imprinting of data onto these light pulses will also be investigated. Finally, the student will design, fabricate (cleanroom), integrate and characterise the devices and the final optical circuits.

Key Responsibilities

Performing research with responsibility and integrity.
Adhering to health and safety rules.
Completing modules for PhD.
Presenting results at conferences.
Participating in education and public engagements annually.
Providing weekly updates.

Essential Criteria

First or upper second-class honours degree in Physics, Electronic Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent international degree).
Highly self-motivated, be able to demonstrate initiative and have a desire to learn.
The candidate must demonstrate proficiency in English.

Desirable Criteria

Masters degree in Physics/Engineering/Photonics

What We Offer

A fully funded PhD position that includes a stipend of €25,000/year for up to four years and full coverage of academic fees. The successful candidate will be registered as PhD student at University College Cork.
Doctoral students are going to be equipped with the highest level of scientific and engineering research skills needed to address the challenges of developing new integrated photonic technologies for diverse applications, as well as with the entrepreneurial, leadership and teamwork capabilities needed to lead and operate at the highest levels in industry.

As a student in the SPEAR Centre you will join a vibrant, supportive and engaging cohort of 15 students and will have the chance to travel and attend a bespoke induction programme with students from all three partners, an annual training school and have access to advanced training courses in areas such as semiconductor fabrication, packaging, biophotonics and entrepreneurship.

Closing date for application is 6th November 2026.

As soon as possible.

Any queries concerning this PhD position can be sent to Brendan Roycroft

We are a community of scientists, strategists, creatives, technologists and problem-solvers united by a shared ambition: to improve healthcare through better communication, engagement and experiences.

What makes Song unique is the opportunity to work across the entire healthcare ecosystem. We don’t operate in silos. Our medical experts collaborate with creatives, experience designers, AI specialists, digital practitioners and marketing strategists to solve complex client challenges in ways that would not be possible within a traditional agency model.

We are naturally curious, relentlessly collaborative and always learning. We challenge each other to think bigger, innovate faster and bring fresh perspectives to every brief. Together, we create work that not only informs and educates but also changes behaviours, strengthens relationships and ultimately improves outcomes for patients.

Joining Song means joining a team that values expertise, embraces innovation and believes the best ideas emerge when different disciplines work as one. Here, you’ll have the freedom to grow your career, explore new areas of healthcare and contribute to work that makes a genuine difference.

In our team you will learn:

How to shape scientific and content strategy around complex medical affairs and healthcare challenges.
How to transform evidence, insights and scientific understanding into clear, differentiated and compelling narratives.
How to provide senior scientific counsel and become a trusted strategic partner to clients.
How to connect medical strategy and scientific content with creative, experience, data, digital and technology capabilities.
How to lead multidisciplinary teams while protecting scientific integrity, clinical accuracy and audience relevance.
How to identify opportunities to evolve client programmes, strengthen scientific engagement and create meaningful growth.
How emerging technologies, including AI, can support more effective, efficient and connected approaches to scientific content.

As an Associate Scientific Director/Strategist you will:

Act as a senior scientific and content partner to clients, providing confident, evidence-led counsel that helps shape their scientific strategy and communications priorities.
Lead the scientific and strategic direction of complex medical communications and marketing programmes, from interpreting the evidence and defining the core narrative through to guiding content development across audiences, channels and formats.
Translate complex scientific, clinical and strategic information into clear communication objectives, compelling stories and content experiences that are relevant to healthcare professionals, patients and other priority audiences.
Shape each client’s scientific strategy, evidence base, therapy area, stakeholder landscape and unmet needs, using this understanding to challenge constructively and add value beyond the immediate brief.
Set the scientific vision and content framework for projects, ensuring that every deliverable is connected to a clear strategic purpose and contributes to the wider programme ambition.
Lead scientific workshops, content planning discussions and narrative development sessions, bringing together diverse perspectives to create alignment and unlock stronger ideas.
Provide scientific leadership across multidisciplinary teams, working with medical writers, strategists, account leads, creatives, experience designers, digital specialists and technologists to deliver joined-up solutions.
Ensure the highest standards of scientific accuracy, editorial quality and clinical integrity, providing decisive review, guidance and sign-off across complex deliverables.
Consider the full content ecosystem rather than individual deliverables, identifying opportunities to improve consistency, connectivity, reuse and impact across programmes and campaigns.
Identify opportunities to deepen client relationships by anticipating emerging scientific and communication needs and translating them into valuable new programmes or solutions.
Lead the scientific strategy and storytelling within new business proposals and pitches, helping to create differentiated responses grounded in insight, evidence and audience needs.
Coach and mentor writers and scientific colleagues, helping them strengthen their strategic thinking, scientific storytelling and confidence as client-facing advisers.
Contribute to the continued development of our scientific content capability, identifying ways to improve quality, efficiency, innovation and collaboration across the team.

We are looking for experience in the following skills:

Significant medical communications or related healthcare agency experience, with a strong understanding of pharmaceutical codes of practice, governance requirements and scientific standards.
Leading scientific and content strategy across complex medical affairs, medical education or scientific communications/marketing programmes.
Interpreting clinical data, scientific evidence, publications and medical strategy to identify the most relevant insights and implications for communication.
Developing scientific narratives, communication platforms, content strategies, educational programmes and marketing campaigns for healthcare audiences.

jobs.description:
Mercury is the European leader in construction solutions.

We build and manage complex engineering & construction projects for the world’s leading corporations. Our solutions help deliver technologies and life changing advancements that connect people, communities and businesses, giving them the power to achieve incredible things. Our people have the courage to be innovative. Their determination and sharp focus enable us to deliver with certainty, time and time again.

We deliver our clients’ visions through leading edge construction solutions across multiple sectors, including Enterprise Data Centres, Advanced Technology & Life Sciences, Hyperscale Data Centres and Fire Protection.

At Mercury, it is our duty to encourage and back our people to realise their vision of themselves. We place them at the heart of what we do, providing challenging opportunities to develop within a great team in a supportive environment that allows them to reach their full potential.

Mercury employs the best people, invests heavily in training and education, and ensures that the highest standards of health, safety and governance are applied throughout the organisation.

When joining Mercury, you and your career can benefit in several ways, including:

• A work environment that encourages creativity and innovative ideas from every level
• Excellent career advancement opportunities
• Experience in a diverse range of specialisations and projects
• Opportunity to work internationally
• Continuous Training and Development
• Team atmosphere where every individual is considered a vital part of the team.
• The opportunity to be a part of the Graduate Programme after your successful Internship with subject to specific Graduate Requirements.

Role Overview

The Risk & Compliance Intern will support the Risk & Compliance function in helping Mercury maintain strong governance, ethical business practices, and effective risk management across operations.

The role provides exposure to a broad range of compliance, ethics, third-party risk management, and corporate risk activities, offering valuable insight into how risk and compliance frameworks operate within a leading international engineering and construction organisation.

Role & Responsibilities:

-Risk Management

Support the maintenance and enhancement of Project, Business Unit and Corporate Risk Registers.

Assist in monitoring Mercury's principal corporate risks, associated controls, current mitigations and planned future mitigation actions.

Support risk owners with risk updates, reporting and tracking of mitigation actions.

Assist with the preparation of presentations, reports and governance materials.

Contribute to continuous improvement of risk templates, processes and reporting.

-Compliance & Ethics

Support Mercury's third-party due diligence, including screening subcontractors, suppliers and other business partners.

Conduct enhanced due diligence reviews, including sanctions screening, adverse media checks and Dun & Bradstreet (D&B) assessments.

Assess corruption risks associated with third parties using country risk indicators such as the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI).

Support compliance activities relating to anti-bribery and corruption, conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, fair competition, anti-fraud, information security, supplier integrity and Speak Up reporting.

-Policies, Training & Awareness

Assist with the review and updating of compliance policies, (including Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Conflicts of Interest, Gifts & Hospitality and Speak Up policies)

Support the development and maintenance of compliance awareness and training materials.

Assist with employee communications and awareness campaigns around key compliance topics.

Contribute to the preparation of presentations for Board training, Speak Up awareness and other initiatives.

Essential Criteria:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Good attention to detail

Ability to work with high volumes of information.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Interest in risk management, governance, ethics and compliance.

Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

Ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders across different business functions.

Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

 Mercury is an equal opportunities employer.

At Jensen Hughes, we've been helping make our world safe, secure and resilient since 1939. Today, our global network of experts works across fire protection engineering, security and risk-based fields, including

skills.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

About Futureforce University Recruiting

Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Fixed-term contract
Duration: 12 months
Start Date: February 2027

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path .

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddys who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced Solution Engineer Buddies during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions.

By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career . We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards.

Who are we looking for?
You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathmatics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds.
You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business
You are a creative problem-solver
You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
You thrive in a team environment
You have excellent interpersonal skills
You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
You are fluent in English & German is essential

What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?
The program is structured as follows:

Introduction Month

During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations

During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles . The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.

jobs.title: Kerry Graduate Programme 2027 - Procurement
jobs.description:
Key Programme Details

  • Start date: September 2027
  • Structure: you will be hired on a permanent contract, beginning with a 2-year rotational programme. You will complete two rotations across different Procurement teams.
  • Location: you will be based in Naas - Ireland. Please note that you may be required to travel and/or relocate as part of your rotations.
  • Working model: hybrid

Grow Your Future at Kerry

At Kerry, our purpose - Inspiring Food, Nourishing Life - comes to life through science, innovation and sustainable nutrition. From food and beverage to pharma, our teams use insight, technology and science-backed solutions to help solve real-world challenges for people, society and the planet.
Our impact reaches billions, but it starts with curious people, fresh ideas and teams who care about making a difference. If you’re looking for a place to learn, contribute and grow, Kerry could be the place for you.


Our Graduate Programme: Your First Step Towards Leadership

The programme combines:

  • Rotations: complete two main rotations over the 2-year programme, building breadth of exposure and readiness for future leadership roles.
  • Leadership development: develop formal leadership skills through dedicated learning modules and ongoing career-focused mentoring.
  • Strategic projects: work on projects that help solve real business challenges and give you the chance to make a meaningful contribution.
  • Senior leader exposure: gain access to senior leaders who will help inspire, motivate and connect you to Kerry’s purpose and strategy from the start.
  • Graduate networks: build relationships through our global and regional graduate networks, connecting with other graduates across the business.

Your Procurement Journey at Kerry

As a Procurement Graduate, you’ll work with category buyers across the sourcing process, helping Kerry secure the materials and services we need to deliver for our customers, teams and consumers. You’ll gain exposure to how global supply markets work, how supplier relationships are managed, and how procurement decisions support quality, service, cost, innovation and sustainability.

Across your rotations, you’ll build hands-on experience in strategic sourcing, supplier management, market analysis and cost-saving projects, while working closely with Kerry’s manufacturing sites, supply partners and cross-functional teams.

You could gain exposure to areas including:

  • Category and market analysis to support sourcing and supply plans
  • Strategic sourcing, tendering and supplier selection
  • Cross-functional work with site supply chains, R&D, Quality and Commercial teams
  • Cost-saving projects and pipeline execution
  • Supplier performance, contract support and relationship management
  • Responsible sourcing, waste reduction, circular economy and recyclable packaging commitments

What We’re Looking For

  • You’re a graduate or soon-to-be graduate, on track for a 2:1 degree or equivalent in Business, Procurement, Supply Chain, Economics, or a related discipline
  • You’re ambitious, open-minded and ready to learn through hands-on, lab-based work and real customer innovation projects
  • You’re fluent in English and ideally another language
  • You’re excited by science, technology and new ways of working, and keen to use data, digital tools and AI thoughtfully to improve how products are developed, tested and scaled
  • You’re eligible to work permanently in Europe
  • You’re open to travel and relocation as part of the programme

What’s in It for You

  • Competitive package: a graduate salary and benefits package aligned to the Country and location you join.
  • International experience: opportunities to work with different teams, functions, and locations as part of a global business.
  • A long-term career path: a permanent role from day one, with a structured programme designed to help you grow beyond your first placement.

Ready to Take the Next Step? Apply Now!

If this sounds like the kind of experience you’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you!
Please apply for one graduate programme only, so we can consider your application for the opportunity that best matches your interests. Multiple applications will be withdrawn.

Our graduate selection process includes:

  • Application review
  • Psychometric assessment
  • Short virtual interview
  • Final-stage virtual assessment centre
