jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Working at EBARA Precision Machinery Europe (EPME) means you are connected to the top 20 micro-chip manufacturers. The semiconductor manufacturing market continues to grow. Our customers are using high-precision manufacturing technologies to provide; IoT, cloud servers, silicon technology, 5G, sensors for autonomous vehicles, flat panel displays, smartphones and tablets. As a part of the EBARA Group with over 19,000 employees worldwide, we drive this technology development. We are a team with more than 200 employees in 8 countries. Shape the future with us!

Join us in a perspective-rich workplace in a growing industry. We are looking for ambitious and passionate candidates who want to push boundaries to drive our customers' success. Join us in a company with a successful culture and team spirit.

THE ROLE

This is a cleanroom-based Field Service Engineer role, working directly on advanced planar semiconductor equipment — specifically Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) systems. If you are passionate about working hands-on with the cutting-edge tools that make modern chip manufacturing possible, this is the role for you.

Please note: While EBARA is widely known for vacuum and pump technology, this position sits within our Systems division. You will be working exclusively on CMP tools on the fab floor — not on pumps or vacuum systems.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Our Field Service Engineers provide on-site field service support through the performance of installations, upgrades, repairs, and maintenance of complex CMP capital equipment in a cleanroom environment. Working to a shift pattern of days and night shifts, you will analyse, diagnose, and troubleshoot EPME CMP equipment problems. You will also perform installations, repairs, upgrades as well as preventive maintenance on CMP systems installed at the customer site. You will be in charge of maintaining an assigned installation equipment base.

Duties include:

Analyse, diagnose and troubleshoot all hardware and software issues on state-of-the-art CMP semiconductor manufacturing equipment in a cleanroom setting.
Understand and implement factory issued hardware and software upgrades.
Ability to read and understand technical drawings, electrical schematics and P&ID drawings, and utilise these in the resolution of complex system issues.
The successful candidate will take an active role in the management and control of the spare parts that we supply to the customer in support of the CMP Systems business.
Report out to both the onsite customer and local management on weekly basis detailing system performance and ongoing activities.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

Higher Certificate/Apprenticeship (NFQ level 6) in a technical field with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a HVM environment or an Ordinary Bachelor’s Degree (NFQ level 7) in a technical field with a minimum of 1 year experience.
Extensive experience in troubleshooting mechanical, electrical and software (PLC) systems is desirable.
Must be able to demonstrate effectively and clearly the ability to deliver clear and concise information to both the internal and external customers.
Eligible to live and work in Ireland.

YOUR PROFILE

You will be proactive, highly motivated and a self-starter.
You will be able to work without direct instruction or supervision taking ownership for tasks and activities associated with our systems business.
You will have a can do/will do attitude towards customer requests to help to improve equipment performance in the field.
You will demonstrate the ability to work both alone and within a team environment, ensuring that projects and assignments are followed through to completion within a customer defined schedule.
You will have the ability to follow detailed work instruction, and execute same to a high level of professional workmanship, with high attention to detail.
You will be willing to work shift which includes nights and weekends.
The role is 100% onsite in a cleanroom fab environment — you must be based in Ireland.
You will be willing to travel internationally for training purposes from time to time as required.

 WHAT WE OFFER

Join our team and unlock a world of opportunities! We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, including a competitive base salary, shift allowance, discretionary bonus, contributory pension, and medical cover, which even extends to your family.

But that's not all! We invest in our employees' growth through individualised and comprehensive training programs, both on the job and beyond. You'll have access to continuous learning and development opportunities to further enhance your skills and career prospects.

Plus, as part of our global team, you'll have the chance to travel and train with industry experts across our extensive EBARA network, opening doors to new experiences and professional connections worldwide. Join us and embark on a fulfilling journey of career advancement and personal growth!

Have we attracted your interest?

We look forward to receiving your detailed online application, stating your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Zeynep Spinelli at zspinelli@ebara-pm.eu.

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Analyst, Warehouse, AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL), AWS Cloud Logistics
jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Cloud Logistics Warehousing team are looking for a talented, driven, and highly analytical Inventory Controller with demonstrated experience driving process improvement and managing 3rd party vendors.

This individual will be responsible for leading inventory management strategies to maximize customer experience, inventory levels and warehouse capacity utilisation. Inventory Management is critical to protecting manufacturing capacity and delivering the end product to our customer at the right time.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Key job responsibilities
Materials Management
• Act as point of escalation for vendor related issues
• Perform functional Data Analysis and Reporting for warehouse operations
• Drive Warehousing operational excellence through data driven metrics
• Drive material positioning and availability in multiple warehouses to maximize utilization

Supply Chain
• Protect continuity of supply for AWS managed manufacturing
• Drive cross-functional and cross-regional strategic initiatives to improve supply chain efficiency and overall cost structure
• Drive complex business analysis to identify business opportunities to improve internal and external processes
• Work cross-functionally to identify and apply best practices and continuous process improvements
• Provides input on System Integration, User Acceptance and Performance test plans for accuracy and completeness.

Automation Enhancement
• Provide scalable solutions for specific issues
• Sets project requirements and drives agendas across internal and external teams
• Provides input on System Integration, User Acceptance and Performance test plans for accuracy and completeness
• Collaborate with IT teams, Implementation Consultants, and Business Stakeholders to capture accurate functional and non-functional requirements

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in supply chain
- Experience working within a similar role to Inventory management/warehouse manager/Leader
- Ability to communicate effectively with internal and external teams

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
- Experience with Excel
- Experience working with 3rd Party Vendors
- Understanding transport and wider logistics can be helpful (mainly Air/Sea) but is not essential

jobs.title: Aesthetician & Skin Specialist
jobs.description:
We’re Hiring: Advanced Aesthetician & Skin Specialist

*Cosmedic Clinic & Institute*

Cosmedic Clinic & Institute is looking for a passionate, experienced, and knowledgeable *Advanced Aesthetician & Skin Specialist* to join our growing team on a freelance or partnership basis.

We are seeking a dedicated skin expert with a strong understanding of skin health, advanced aesthetic technologies, and professional skincare treatments. If you are passionate about transforming skin, delivering outstanding results, and helping clients achieve healthy, radiant skin, we would love to hear from you!

About the Role

As an Advanced Aesthetician & Skin Specialist, you will be responsible for providing personalised skin consultations and delivering a range of advanced, non-surgical aesthetic treatments. You will work alongside our professional team to develop tailored treatment plans, address a variety of skin concerns, and help clients achieve their skin goals safely and effectively.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with advanced aesthetic devices, a strong knowledge of skin anatomy and skin conditions, and a commitment to maintaining the highest standards of treatment quality, hygiene, and client care.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct detailed skin consultations and assessments to understand clients’ concerns and skincare goals.
* Develop personalised treatment plans and recommend suitable professional skincare products and home-care routines.
* Perform advanced aesthetic treatments, including:
* *HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound)*
* *MNRF (Microneedling Radiofrequency)*
* *BBL (BroadBand Light) treatments*
* *Laser hair removal*
* *Advanced chemical peels*
* *Advanced facials and skin rejuvenation treatments*
* *Acne, pigmentation, uneven skin tone, texture, and ageing-related skin treatments*
* *Other professional skin treatments and advanced skincare procedures within your training and scope of practice*
* Educate clients on treatment options, expected results, aftercare, and appropriate home skincare.
* Maintain accurate client records, treatment notes, consent forms, and progress photographs where appropriate.
* Follow strict hygiene, infection prevention, equipment safety, and treatment protocols.
* Deliver an exceptional client experience while building trust, long-term relationships, and client satisfaction.
* Keep up to date with the latest developments in aesthetic technology, skin science, and professional skincare.

Essential Requirements

* *Relevant Qualifications:* A recognised qualification in aesthetics, beauty therapy, skin therapy, or a relevant clinical discipline appropriate to the treatments offered.
* *Advanced Treatment Experience:* Hands-on experience with advanced skin procedures and aesthetic technologies, particularly HIFU, MNRF, BBL, laser hair removal, and advanced chemical peels.
* *Skin Expertise:* Strong knowledge of skin anatomy, skin types, common skin concerns, treatment indications, contraindications, and appropriate treatment protocols.
* *Technical Competence:* Confidence in operating aesthetic devices safely and selecting appropriate treatment settings within your training and authorised scope of practice.
* *Consultation Skills:* Ability to assess clients’ skin concerns, explain treatment options clearly, and recommend personalised treatment plans.
* *Client Care:* A professional, friendly, and confident approach, with excellent communication skills and a genuine passion for skin health and results-driven treatments.
* *Safety and Professionalism:* Commitment to infection control, client consent, accurate documentation, aftercare, and appropriate escalation or referral when necessary.
* *Insurance and Compliance:* Must hold appropriate professional insurance and any registrations, certifications, or authorisations required for the treatments performed.
* *Language Skills:* Good communication skills in English.

What We Offer

* Flexible working opportunities on a freelance or partnership basis.
* The opportunity to work with a professional team in a clinical aesthetic environment.
* Access to a range of advanced skin treatments and aesthetic technologies, as applicable to the role.
* An opportunity to grow professionally within the aesthetics and skincare industry.
* A supportive environment focused on quality treatments, client satisfaction, and excellent results.

Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is more than just a beauty therapist — we want a *true skin expert* who understands skin health, enjoys working with advanced technology, and is passionate about delivering personalised, results-focused treatments.

If you are motivated, professional, knowledgeable, and enthusiastic about helping clients achieve their best skin, we would love to hear from you.

Interested in Joining Cosmedic Clinic & Institute?

If you have the experience, skills, and passion to be part of our team, we would love to hear from you.

*Contact Cosmedic Clinic & Institute today to discuss this exciting opportunity!*

Pay: €18.00-€22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Adult, Children and Young People’s Digital Psychotherapist
jobs.description:
About us:

Spectrum.Life is a whole-of-health digital partner that guides organisations and their people to thrive, delivering clinically backed digital health, mental health and wellbeing solutions.

Our HealthTech delivers digital transformation for Insurers, Educators and Employers through Co-creation or seamlessly integrated out-of-the-box solutions, that decrease digital fragmentation and engage, empower, and transform their people’s lives.

Established in 2018 by Stuart McGoldrick and Stephen Costello, Spectrum.Life provides services internationally to over 7.2m insurance members, 3,000 corporate clients, 60 universities and 650,000 university students. Spectrum.Life currently employs over 450 people.

Our vision is to change and save as many lives as possible.

Role Brief:

The role of Adult, Children and Young People’s Digital Psychotherapist is suited to fully qualified and fully accredited psychotherapists. The Adult, Children and Young People’s Digital Psychotherapist is a key part of the Spectrum clinical team, providing access to evidence-based talking therapies to adults, children and young people, such as integrative psychotherapy pulling on techniques such as CBT and Goal Based Intervention (GBI) as clinically appropriate. Sessions are for adults aged 18 and over and for children and young people aged 6 to 17, last up to 50 minutes, are delivered online, and are booked through the member platform once our 24/7 clinical team has completed clinical triage and activated the service. Minimum of two to three years of post-qualification experience working with adults and children, adolescents, and families

Responsibilities:

Provide goal-focused therapeutic support to adults, children, adolescents, using age- and developmentally appropriate interventions to address a range of emotional and psychological difficulties, including anxiety, depression, trauma, grief and complex presentations.
Conduct a comprehensive assessment at the start of each episode of care, building on the clinical triage completed by our 24/7 clinical team, to identify the individual's needs, developmental stage (for children and young people), risk factors, and protective factors, ensuring appropriate intervention strategies.
Deliver evidence-based psychological interventions, including but not limited to:
Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) for anxiety, depression, and trauma.
Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT) skills for emotional regulation and self-harm reduction.
Play Therapy and Art Therapy for younger children with attachment or developmental needs.
Family-Based Interventions (FBT, Systemic Therapy) for eating disorders, behavioural challenges, and family distress.
Provide immediate crisis interventions through telephone or video support, including risk assessment, suicide prevention strategies, and emotional regulation techniques.
Assess and manage risk effectively, identifying and escalating concerns related to self-harm, suicidal ideation, abuse, neglect, or exploitation in line with child protection procedures, adult safeguarding procedures and safeguarding policies.
Follow safeguarding protocols by recognising, reporting, and responding appropriately to child protection and adult safeguarding concerns, liaising with relevant agencies (e.g., TUSLA, education, and law enforcement).
Determine the appropriate service response level based on the severity and complexity of the individual's presenting difficulties, following case response level standards.
Work collaboratively with families, caregivers, and educational staff, where appropriate, to provide psychoeducation and support strategies that reinforce therapeutic goals.
Recommend liaison with multidisciplinary teams (MDTs), including social workers, psychiatrists, teachers, GPs, and other healthcare professionals, ensuring a holistic approach to care.
Maintain accurate, professional, and confidential clinical records, adhering to GDPR, service policies, and ethical guidelines for data protection on our internal clinical case management system.
Engage in research, evaluation, and clinical audits to support service development and ensure the continuous improvement of therapeutic outcomes.
Operate within all clinical governance frameworks, policies, and procedures, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and ethical guidelines.
Attend clinical supervision, safeguarding training, and CPD activities to maintain high standards of practice and stay updated on emerging evidence-based practices.
Contribute to service development and expansion, working on projects related to improving mental health provision for adults, children and young people, including digital innovations and accessibility.
Advocate for the needs and rights of adults, children and young people, ensuring interventions are inclusive, neuroaffirmative, culturally sensitive, and trauma-informed.
Deliver online sessions of up to 50 minutes to adults aged 18 and over and to children and young people aged 6 to 17 who have been triaged by our 24/7 clinical team and who book directly into your diary once the service has been activated for them.
Keep your availability up to date so that first appointments can be offered within 10 working days of clinical activation, in line with our agreed service levels.
For children and young people, work within our child and adolescent pathway, in which parental or guardian consent is embedded, and ensure consent is documented before therapy begins.
Apply our cancellation and missed-appointment policies
Make informed clinical decisions, including modality, session frequency and discharge, within our clinical governance framework.

Requirements:

Essential Qualifications and Registration:

Full accredited membership with one of the following:
Irish Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy (IACP)
Irish Council for Psychotherapy
British Association of Behavioural and Cognitive Psychotherapy
Irish Association of Behavioural and Cognitive Psychotherap

jobs.title: Platform Owner - Public Cloud
jobs.description:
Company Description

Because we strive to put people first.
Culture, our way.

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Job Description

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

Qualifications

What You’ll Do as a Platform Owner – Public Cloud

We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities:

Lead and scale Cloud Engineering & Operations, partnering with strategic technology vendors to deliver secure, self‑service cloud platforms that accelerate product team delivery and customer value.
Establish robust cloud governance and standards, ensuring excellence across cost management, security operations, deployment practices, compliance, and policy adherence.
Drive operational performance and service quality, defining metrics and controls to improve availability, workload utilisation, SLA performance, service transition rigour, and security posture.
Provide hands‑on technical leadership, setting cloud strategy and architecture direction, resolving complex escalations, and communicating clearly with senior stakeholders.
Build and develop high‑performing engineering teams, including line management, mentoring, talent strategy execution, and fostering accountability through servant leadership.
Support cloud transformation and strategic alignment, ensuring roadmaps, backlogs, and operating models align with business objectives while strengthening senior stakeholder and partner relationships.

Additional Information

What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:

Proven cloud leadership experience (8+ years) leading Cloud Engineering and/or SRE teams, with a strong engineering background across enterprise‑scale systems, platforms, and operational environments.
Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, delivering secure, scalable, and fault‑tolerant architectures using PaaS, serverless, containerisation, and Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform preferred), with working knowledge of GCP as an advantage.
Strong operational and financial acumen, including cloud cost management, budgeting, forecasting, workload optimisation, and governance across security operations, compliance, and policy enforcement.
Advanced DevOps, CI/CD and observability capabilities, with hands‑on experience in logging, monitoring, reliability engineering, enterprise‑grade deployments, and advocating modern Agile, Lean, and DevOps practices.
Visionary and forward‑thinking technologist, able to identify emerging technologies, translate them into business value, inspire new ways of working, and successfully lead transformation initiatives.
Exceptional people and partner leadership skills, including managing and influencing third‑party providers, mentoring high‑performing engineering communities, and excelling in stakeholder management, problem solving, and multi‑stream delivery.

Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

If you need any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request, during your recruitment journey, such as extended time or breaks between online assessments, a sign language interpreter, mobility access, or assistive technology please contact your talent acquisition specialist.

 All offers of employment are subject to background checks, including right to work, reference education and for some roles criminal, and financial checks. If you have any concerns, please reach out to our talent acquisition team to discuss.

jobs.title: Sales Compensation Analyst
jobs.description:
At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

Why this role matters

Sales, channel, renewals, BDR, and corporate bonus participants across Semperis count on being paid correctly and on time. As our Senior Sales Compensation Analyst, you'll own the system and the monthly cycle that make that happen. You'll run calculations in Xactly Incent, tie every result back to its source data, and give Finance a close it can trust. The hardest part of the job is judgment: knowing when a variance is a data fix you can make yourself, and when it's a plan question that needs a leader's approval before anything moves.

What you'll own

  • Run the recurring commission and incentive calculation cycle, from source data validation to an approved payment file delivered to Payroll within the monthly close window.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies in assignments, splits, credits, quotas, rates, currencies, and adjustments, and document every true up and correction before payment is released.
  • Reconcile Xactly Incent against Salesforce, HR, payroll, and Finance systems each month and quarter, and support close, including commission accruals, in partnership with our Revenue Analyst.
  • Build and maintain audit ready documentation and controls so the commission process is repeatable and any reviewer can follow it.
  • Administer Xactly Incent across all company plans, keeping participant data, access, hierarchies, quotas, rates, and plan assignments current as people join, move, and leave.
  • Lead the annual implementation of every compensation plan in Xactly, working with Revenue Operations and the Global Compensation Director through configuration, testing, and approvals.
  • Own plan letter administration end to end, from preparation and issuance through signature tracking.
  • Turn large datasets into clear reporting on attainment, commissions, and payments, and help managers and employees understand their plans and statements, including findings they may not want to hear.

What success looks like

  • Every cycle closes on time, with an approved payment file and every discrepancy investigated and documented before sign off.
  • Each period ties out across systems, with variances explained and evidence ready for auditors.
  • Every approved plan is configured, tested, and live before the plan year opens, and every participant holds a current signed plan letter.
  • Participants understand their statements, and disputes are resolved with facts rather than escalation.

Who you'll work with

You'll report to our Director of Finance and work closely with the CFO, Revenue Operations leaders and plan owners, and department heads across sales and channel. You'll also partner with HR, Legal, Payroll, Accounting, FP&A, our Xactly technical account manager, and external auditors.

What you'll bring

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in incentive compensation or commission operations
  • Hands on experience administering Xactly Incent, including plan configuration, participant data, hierarchies, quotas, and rates
  • Strong reconciliation skills, with a track record of tracing variances to root cause across multiple systems
  • Advanced Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and lookups
  • Experience maintaining documented procedures and audit evidence
  • Clear, steady communication when explaining plan mechanics or delivering unwelcome findings
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

  • Experience with Workday and NetSuite
  • Experience supporting global incentive programs across multiple countries or currencies
  • Experience in a public company, high tech or SaaS environment,
  • Familiarity with US GAAP including ASC 606, and background in variable pay payroll, Sales or Revenue Operations, accounting, audit or financial analysis.

Why Join Semperis?
You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you.

6 to 9 years of experience with designing and building front-end and webservice applications while incorporating test automation frameworks;

Working experience with: Ruby (or Java); Cucumber; Javascript; HTTP; RESTful web services; Jenkins.

AngularJS (2 or above); NodeJS; Docker; Genesys Contact Center Platform; Working experience with test automation frameworks (Cucumber w/ Ruby, SOATest, Selenium);

Hands-on experience with creating and using Test Doubles and Virtual Assets; Knowledge of software engineering practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations; Experience in delivering software in the Agile environment. .

jobs.description:
Join Our Team:
PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027


With 29 locations, Cundall’s global presence allows our structural engineers to be involved in many challenging and exciting building projects.


Working across a variety of industry sectors, our Structures teams are renowned for producing innovative and award-winning sustainable engineering solutions throughout the lifecycle of any building project. To build on our great work so far, we are looking for graduates who want to create, improve and protect the environment in which we live and provide the facilities for day-to-day life, transport and industry to function effectively.

The Structural engineering teams provide industry-leading expertise – and offer a pro-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence. Join us and you could be a part of a team who built a state-of-the-art faculty of medical sciences for a university campus, Eton College Sports and Aquatic Centre, The All England Lawn Tennis Club (AELTC’s) Somerset Road project or King's College School, Wimbledon - new music school.

In this graduate role, you’ll join our Structural Engineering team to work on the design of some of the most exciting construction design projects in Ireland and worldwide. Working closely with colleagues across our multi-disciplinary practice, you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across a wide range of sectors.

Join us as a Graduate Structural Engineer and you’ll work with and be guided by a team of expert engineers to carry out conceptual as well as detailed structural engineering design and analysis, using your maths, science, and problem-solving skills to design inspirational and sustainable structures and more.

This role will require you to use your knowledge and expertise to define and translate clients’ needs into designs for buildings, infrastructure, facilities, and services with sustainability at the forefront of the design.

You’ll have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, and with accredited professional development programmes from the IStructE or ICE, you’ll be supported towards Chartership.

We offer a competitive starting salary which grows as you develop, as well as many training and development opportunities to make sure you keep progressing.


Aside from this, those who successfully join our graduate scheme also enjoy:

  • A €2,000 bonus on gaining chartered status with a relevant professional body.
  • 22 days' holiday per annum (plus statutory holidays).
  • A flexible benefits package which enables you to select additional benefits to suit your personal circumstances.

jobs.title: Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
*About Minerex Environmental:*
Minerex Environmental is a leader in providing specialised environmental services, with a core focus on *dewatering, over-pumping, water treatment*, and *environmental management* for the construction, mining, and pharmaceutical industries. We offer innovative and sustainable solutions to water management challenges, ensuring efficient resource utilisation while minimising environmental impact. Our commitment to excellence and regulatory compliance ensures that we help our clients achieve operational goals while protecting ecosystems and maintaining the highest safety standards.

*Position Overview:*

We are seeking a motivated and versatile Engineer or Engineering Technician to join our multidisciplinary electromechanical engineering team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on technical work (fabrication, wiring, testing). The successful candidate will support ongoing R&D projects, assist with product prototypes, help maintain and troubleshoot equipment, and contribute to internal engineering tools and automations. Where training is needed, time and resources will be provided.

You will work within a closely knit team of electrical and mechanical engineers and gain exposure to real-world engineering workflows, from concept through to prototyping and testing.

*Key Responsibilities:*

*1. Fabrication & Electrical Assembly*

* Assist in the fabrication of prototype components using hand tools, power tools, and workshop equipment.
* Build and wire electrical devices, including sensors, control panels, small switchboards, and test rigs.
* Assemble control boxes, cable harnesses, and low-voltage systems under supervision.
* Interpret wiring diagrams, assembly drawings, and schematics.

*2. Equipment Testing, Troubleshooting & Repair*

* Support testing of mechanical and electrical systems, recording and analysing results.
* Assist in diagnosing faults in equipment, including circuit-level debugging, sensor verification, and component replacement.
* Conduct preventive maintenance on lab/test equipment.
* Set up and run small experiments, collect data, and document results.

*3. General Engineering Support*

* Prepare test reports, wiring schedules, SOPs, and documentation.
* Assist with inventory management, parts sourcing, and project organisation.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions, design reviews, and prototype evaluations.
* Carry out ad-hoc engineering tasks that support the team’s priorities.

*Additional requirements*:

*1. Technical Skills*

_Experience in all areas is not required — training will be provided, but enthusiasm is essential._

* Basic understanding of mechanical and electrical systems (AC and DC Circuits).
* Ability to use hand tools and workshop equipment safely.
* Familiarity with wiring and basic electronics (advantageous).
* Some exposure to programming (Arduino, Python, or similar).
* Understanding of engineering drawings and schematics.
* Comfortable running tests and collecting structured data.

*2. Soft Skills*

* Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn.
* Good communication and documentation habits.
* Ability to work independently on tasks once trained.
* Positive, proactive attitude and comfort asking questions.
* Good organisational skills and attention to detail.

*Employment Outcomes*

* Hands-on experience with electrical assembly, fabrication, prototyping, and troubleshooting.
* Exposure to real engineering environments and multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience using tools, meters, PLCs, sensors, industrial hardware, and modern web technologies.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to engineering projects and see your work implemented.
* Mentorship from experienced engineers across electrical, mechanical, and software disciplines.
* A portfolio of completed tasks, test results, prototypes, or software features you can bring to future roles.

To apply, please submit your CV and a short cover letter describing your background and interest in engineering and hands-on work, along with any relevant project samples (GitHub, university work, personal builds etc…)

jobs.title: Portfolio Analyst - Structured Finance
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

THE TEAM

The Portfolio Monitoring Unit (PMU) plays a central role in the ongoing management and oversight of KKR’s ABF investments. The team is responsible for performance analytics, transaction modelling, valuation, and strategic optimisation across a growing portfolio of 200+ deals. Operating across a wide range of asset types and industries, the PMU team supports both institutional and insurance-related mandates.

Headquartered in Dublin, with team members in London and Gurugram, the ABF PMU team has grown to 13 investment professionals. As part of the business’s strategic expansion, KKR has launched a rapidly growing High Grade ABF platform. This business focuses on public and private ABF investments primarily in the investment grade or near-investment grade space.

We are now hiring an Analyst/ Associate to help manage this portfolio, with an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of a key strategic initiative at KKR.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Proactive monitoring of the performance of public and private ABF transactions, including regular engagement with servicers and originators.
Preparation of quarterly portfolio reviews and participation in Investment Committee presentations.
Financial modelling, conducting scenario and sensitivity analyses.
Maintaining performance data and risk metrics within KKR’s internal portfolio management systems.
Collaborating cross-functionally with Investor Relations, Risk, ESG, and other teams on reporting, investor materials, and ad hoc portfolio requests.
Coordinating with third-party valuation agents to support valuations of private transactions.
Identifying underperforming or high-risk assets and supporting trade or repositioning recommendations.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

~3+ years of relevant experience in credit risk, structured finance, ABF/securitisation, transaction services, leasing, restructuring, or a rating agency.
A proven ability to quickly absorb new information and a commitment to learning new asset classes and analytical tools.
Direct experience with ABF, structured credit, or secured lending is highly advantageous.
Familiarity with tools such as Excel, Intex, Bloomberg, Tableau/PowerBI, and FactSet is beneficial.
A strong academic background, ideally in a quantitative or finance-related discipline.
Excellent quantitative and analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly.
A self-starter mindset, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Solid understanding of financial statements, cash flow modelling, and deal structuring.
Strong written communication and presentation skills.

KKR is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by applicable law.

KKR will provide reasonable accommodations as required by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. Individuals seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process should email Benefits@kkr.com. Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors.

jobs.title: Clinical Database Programmer
jobs.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

As a Clinical Database Programmer (internally referred to as Database Programmer), you will support the development, testing and maintenance of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems used in clinical trials.

Working within a collaborative and innovative technical team, you will be involved in building clinical studies, developing electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs), configuring edit checks and supporting data integrations, primarily using Medidata Rave.

You will also have opportunities to contribute to new initiatives, explore AI-driven solutions and support continuous improvements in study development and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, test and maintain clinical study databases within EDC systems.

Develop and configure eCRFs, edit checks and study-specific database requirements.

Support clinical data transfers, integrations and database validation activities.

Troubleshoot technical issues and provide ongoing EDC study support.

Collaborate with Data Management, project teams and sponsors to ensure successful study delivery.

Contribute to process improvements, automation and innovative solutions, including the use of AI.

Support multiple clinical studies and progressively take ownership of study builds.

Ensure database documentation, quality standards and study timelines are maintained.

Requirements & Qualifications

Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Previous experience in clinical database development, EDC programming or clinical study builds.

Previous experience within a CRO or pharmaceutical environment.

Knowledge of eCRFs, edit checks, database testing and clinical data management processes.

Understanding of programming principles, logic and database development.

Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.

Experience supporting EDC integrations, technical initiatives or bid defence activities.

Proactive team player with excellent communication skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

Nice to Have

Hands-on experience with Medidata Rave, including study builds and configuration.

Knowledge of C# programming and development of custom functions within Medidata Rave.

Experience with AI tools, automation or AI-assisted programming to improve study development and efficiency.

Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services
End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio
How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. ThreatLocker® is a global cybersecurity leader that stops cyberattacks before they happen. The company’s Zero Trust Platform prevents breaches from both known and unknown threats by allowing only explicitly trusted software and activity across endpoints, networks, and cloud systems. Built to deploy quickly and scale across complex environments, the platform reduces operational overhead while keeping business running uninterrupted. Headquartered in Orlando, Florida, with offices in Dublin, Dubai, and Brisbane, ThreatLocker protects over 70,000 organizations worldwide.

POSITION OVERVIEW

ThreatLocker is seeking a Linux Kernel Developer to join our cybersecurity product team. In this role, you will design, develop, debug, and maintain low-level Linux components that support endpoint security, application control, and threat prevention across multiple Linux distributions and architectures.

DEVELOPMENT — Full-Time

RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop, debug, test, and maintain Linux kernel-level components using C/C++
Work with kernel modules, eBPF, system calls, filesystems, networking, memory management, and process monitoring
Validate kernel functionality from user space and work with user-space APIs
Debug complex kernel, performance, compatibility, and system-level issues
Support compatibility across Red Hat, Debian, Ubuntu, SUSE, and other Linux environments
Support kernel and platform enablement across x86_64 and ARM64
Contribute to build, packaging, CI/CD, and automated kernel testing processes
Support platform and Linux distribution porting where required
Collaborate with development, QA, DevOps, and security teams

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

5+ years of software development experience
Strong C/C++ development skills
Strong understanding of Linux kernel internals
Experience with Linux kernel modules and/or eBPF
Experience with processes, scheduling, memory management, concurrency, filesystems, networking, or storage subsystems
Experience debugging kernel and low-level system issues
Strong understanding of computer architecture and system-level software
Experience working across multiple Linux distributions and kernel versions

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience developing endpoint security, EDR, antivirus, or similar security software
Experience with eBPF-based monitoring or enforcement
Experience with ARM64 and x86_64
Experience with Python for tooling, testing, or automation
Experience with Linux packaging, kernel build systems, and CI/CD
Experience with virtualization technologies such as KVM, VMware, Xen, or Hyper-V
Knowledge of PCIe, DMA, SR-IOV/SIOV, or related low-level system interfaces
Experience contributing to or maintaining upstream Linux kernel code

A background check and drug/substance screening are required after a conditional offer. Employment will proceed only upon receiving clear results from both.

ThreatLocker also conducts randomized drug and substance testing approximately every 60 days, in line with the same screening standards.

• Build and maintain enterprise storage systems (NAS/SAN), including volume/LUN creation, host mapping, multipathing, and data replication.

• Experience in enterprise storage systems (e.g., NetApp, Dell EMC) and advanced storage architectures (NAS, SAN), including volume/LUN management, host mapping, multipathing, data replication, and snapshots.
• Experience in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, GitOps).
• Experience with IPv4/IPv6 networking and experience with cloud network architecture and automation.
• Experience with scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell) for infrastructure automation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in data center operations, including hardware installation, rack management, cabling, power management, and environmental monitoring.

• Experience in automation and modern DevOps practices.
• Experience with Source Code Control Management and CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, Argo, Harness, etc.).
• Experience with Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
• Experience in development of next gen agentic AI ops agents

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Bentley Systems is seeking a talented Mid-Level software Engineer to join our Facilities Engineering team. Facilities Engineering group is responsible for advancing software and services for Building and Structural engineering domains. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer (R-20005)
jobs.description:
The Quality Assurance Engineer II creates and maintains tests to ensure software meets user and product needs. The role develops project test plans, defines and tracks quality assurance metrics, analyses software-quality data, documents defects, and supports issue resolution and continuous process improvement. The role also adopts AI tools and integrates automated testing within CI/CD pipelines to improve test design, automation, defect analysis, requirements review, release quality and overall QA productivity.


Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with development and product teams to ensure product quality in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  • Create and maintain test strategies, test plans, test cases, test data and traceability for new features and defect fixes.
  • Write and maintain automated tests for web applications, REST APIs and data-validation workflows.
  • Integrate and maintain automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing, quality gates and release validation throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Execute manual functional, regression, integration and exploratory testing where automation is not yet appropriate.
  • Validate multi-tiered, data-driven applications processing large volumes of records.
  • Define and track quality metrics including defect counts, severity, test execution, coverage and release status.
  • Identify, document, report, track and verify issues through resolution.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and collaborate on preventive quality improvements.
  • Support product deployments, release validation and QA sign-off.
  • Partner with support teams to reproduce and troubleshoot customer-reported issues.
  • Proactively improve quality through collaboration, automation, process improvement and innovative thinking.

Key Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Typically 5-8 years of relevant experience, including 5+ years in software quality assurance or quality engineering.
  • Experience in manual testing across web, API, database and enterprise applications.
  • Experience in test automation using Playwright, Selenium, Robot Framework or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating automated test frameworks into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of continuous integration, continuous delivery, quality gates, automated test reporting and release validation processes.
  • Proficiency in Java, Python or C# for test automation and scripting.
  • Strong knowledge of API testing using Postman, REST Assured or equivalent tools.
  • Experience in SQL and database validation, including complex queries and joins.
  • Experience designing and executing functional, integration, system, regression and UAT testing.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong defect management, root-cause analysis and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience with JIRA, Zephyr, Azure DevOps or similar test management tools.
  • AI tools adoption: Demonstrated experience using Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, ChatGPT or Claude for test case generation, test automation, defect analysis, requirements review, CI/CD pipeline optimisation and QA productivity improvements.
  • Excellent analytical, written and verbal communication, cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

As an AI Platform Engineer on the AI Productivity Platforms team, you will own the secure operation, governance, and adoption of Docusign's enterprise AI tools. You will manage platform configuration, identity and access, policy controls, and employee enablement while designing and deploying agentic AI solutions. Partnering with IT, Security, and business teams, you will build secure, compliant, and scalable AI workflows that improve the employee experience and protect enterprise systems and data. Your mission is to bring tools such as Claude, Gemini, Slackbot, and Rovo into a cohesive, trusted platform that empowers every employee to use AI safely and effectively.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Cloud Apps.

Responsibility

Build, deploy, and enable enterprise AI capabilities using tools such as Claude, Gemini, Antigravity, Atlassian Rovo, and Slack, including SSO, access controls, and integrations with enterprise systems
Design and deploy agentic AI solutions using frameworks and platforms such as CrewAI and Vertex AI to autonomously resolve common EUS service requests, incidents, and routine tasks
Monitor platform health, usage, and license utilization, and coordinate with vendors to resolve escalated issues
Partner with Security and IT to implement data handling, retention, and compliance policies across AI tools and integrations
Lead rollouts of new AI tools and features, from initial pilots through company-wide deployment
Own employee onboarding, documentation, and self-service guidance to simplify adoption and reduce support requests
Develop and deliver training, office hours, and champion programs that help teams apply AI effectively in their daily work
Define and maintain the AI platform roadmap for the Employee Productivity Platform, aligning priorities with business needs and employee productivity goals
Evaluate emerging enterprise AI tools and agent capabilities, and recommend investments that advance Docusign's AI strategy

Job Designation

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 3+ years of relevant experience
3+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, IT automation, or enterprise systems development
Experience with agentic AI frameworks, workflow automation, or intelligent IT service management
Experience with large language models (LLMs) and integrating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines into enterprise solutions
Experience with at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python or Java
Experience implementing security and compliance controls within AI or automation solutions
Experience with IT operations, incident management, and enterprise ticketing systems
Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD)
Experience creating user documentation, supporting onboarding, or delivering technical training

Preferred

Experience designing, building, and deploying enterprise AI solutions using platforms such as Claude, Gemini, Antigravity, Glean, or Atlassian Rovo
Experience developing secure integrations between AI agents and enterprise systems such as Slackbot, Jira, Confluence, and Google Workspace using APIs, permission-aware connectors, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Hands-on experience developing and evaluating AI agents, enterprise search capabilities, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, with attention to retrieval quality, data permissions, and governance
Experience engineering agent deployment and lifecycle automation, including testing, versioning, observability, token management, and secure service identities
Track record of taking AI solutions from proof of concept to production, incorporating user feedback and delivering measurable improvements in employee productivity
Experience shaping technical roadmaps, evaluating AI platforms and frameworks, and optimizing solution reliability, performance, scalability, and cost
Strong communication skills

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Summary

Do you want to have a significant impact on how work is done at Apple? Radar is used by every major organization across Apple to help teams organize and track their work. As Apple’s primary tool for defining, tracking, and testing issues, Radar has been used for decades across various teams, including hardware and software engineering. It serves as a unified platform for bug tracking, test case management, and product management, facilitating seamless coordination among team members. The Radar Engineering team at Apple seeks an early-career Performance Engineer to help keep Radar fast at Apple scale.

As a Performance Engineer for Radar, you will help make Apple’s platform for product development, bug tracking, and work management fast and able to scale. You will receive structured mentorship, comprehensive training in Apple’s development practices, and the support to learn and develop your skills quickly. You will measure, profile, and find bottlenecks, and learn how a platform at this scale remains fast while it constantly evolves. As you ramp up, you will take on increasing ownership of performance testing, help shape capacity planning, and help bring new performance tools and technologies onto the platform.

Solid programming or scripting skills in Java, Python, or similar language.
Understanding of how web services, databases, and networks affect application performance.
Experience with version control (Git) and a working understanding of the software development lifecycle.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Exposure to load testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6.
Exposure to profiling and monitoring tools.
Familiarity with relational databases and SQL.
Interest or experience in agentic workflows, MCP integrations, or AI-assisted development tools.
Ability to triage problems, prioritize accordingly, and propose a resolution.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

jobs.title: Database Engineer III, RDS for Oracle
jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION

Amazon Web Services is hiring a Database Engineer III for the RDS for Oracle team. We are looking for a Senior Database Engineer to join the RDS Oracle Database Engineering team and take a leadership role in ensuring customer success and shaping the future of our managed database service.

About the Role

As a Database Engineer III on the RDS Oracle team, you will serve as an expert in Oracle database architecture and internals, operating with high autonomy and limited guidance to lead complex investigations and deliver solutions that span multiple engineers and teams. You will lead design reviews for new features, architect solutions to systemic issues, and standardize approaches across the broader RDS organization. During critical customer escalations, you will rapidly assess scope and urgency, implement effective mitigations, and drive cross-functional efforts to permanently eliminate root causes, collaborating across RDS engine teams where solutions can be shared.

Beyond reactive support, you will proactively establish monitoring, testing, and prevention strategies that identify and address potential issues before they impact customers. You will bring customer learnings back to the engineering org to influence roadmaps, validate feature designs through end-to-end test scenarios, and build automation that improves operational efficiency at scale. You will lead complex projects requiring multiple engineers, mentor junior DBEs and SDEs, and establish best practices that become team and organizational standards.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about databases, customer-obsessed, and ready to own ambiguous, high-impact problems end to end with minimal direction. Your work directly impacts how enterprises run their most critical databases on AWS. If you want to lead technical strategy for how enterprises run Oracle workloads in the cloud, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
You will own database architecture for Oracle on RDS, driving best practices and setting team standards while proactively identifying and addressing architectural deficiencies. You will work on Oracle database internals, storage architecture, replication, performance optimization, and integration with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, and IAM. You will lead design and implementation of complex features that scale to millions of database instances, from database automation and infrastructure to operational tooling. You will perform on-call duties encompassing incident response, troubleshooting, and customer support. Acting as the voice of the customer, you will bring learnings into the engineering process to design new features and plan end-to-end test scenarios. You will present database best practices at conferences and workshops, mentor junior DBEs and SDEs, and influence team strategy to resolve complex or systemic problems across the organization.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and five years of progressive post-baccalaureate experience in the job offered or a related occupation. Must have five years of experience in the following skill(s): (1) designing, architecting, and leading development of robust and scalable database automation solutions; (2) mentoring software engineers and database engineers on database internals and best practices; (3) leading execution of and building comprehensive automation frameworks around database benchmarking and performance validation; (4) with code database management tooling in PL/SQL and Java, including establishing coding standards and reusable patterns; (5) defining specifications and driving technical strategy for database-specific roadmap items; and (6) leading on-call operations for managed database services, including incident response, root cause analysis, and driving permanent resolution of systemic issues.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 10 or more years of experience working with relational database systems, with deep knowledge of Oracle database internals including storage engines, query optimization, PGA/SGA memory management, and replication mechanisms. Experience designing and operating Oracle high availability solutions including Multi-AZ deployments, Data Guard configurations, and read replicas on Amazon RDS. Experience with RDS Custom for Oracle, including migration planning and enterprise-scale optimization. Experience architecting Oracle database solutions integrated with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch. Experience building operational tooling and automation for managed Oracle database services at scale, leading customer engagements for Oracle database migration and optimization on AWS, and presenting database best practices at conferences or workshops.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Dublin, Ireland (Hybrid/On-site)

Position Summary

Operating directly within our global Product & Technology organisation, this role functions as an internal Forward Deployed Software Engineer. We are looking for an adaptable, highly autonomous senior engineer to tackle rapid prototyping, architectural de-risking, and tactical engineering initiatives.

Rather than maintaining a traditional product lifecycle, you will partner closely with our leadership team, including the CTO, senior engineers and architects on short-cycle strategic initiatives. Your customers are Bentley's global Product & Technology (P&T) organization - the teams responsible for building and operating the products and solutions that power our customers' success.

You will take on complex, ambiguous technical challenges, rapidly evaluate solution options across the full stack, from architecture and design to hands-on implementation, build functional proof-of-concepts, and transition successful solutions to our core product teams.

Responsibilities:

Full-Spectrum Problem Solving: Fluidly navigate across varied technical domains depending on the project. One month you may be addressing deep performance profiling and cloud reliability; the next, you may be building modern front-end spikes or evaluating microservice patterns.
De-Risk Architecture: Architect, code, and benchmark functional proof-of-concepts (PoCs) to validate performance and evaluate emerging technologies before Bentley makes a company-wide commitment.
Operate Across the Stack & Cloud: Leverage a wide range of technologies, acting as a polyglot across multiple programming languages and major cloud platforms to deliver the right solution for the business.
Ensure Frictionless Hand-offs: Package your validated architectures, write the technical summary, and hand the clean, maintainable deliverables over to our global P&T teams so you can pivot to the next strategic unknown.

Qualifications:

0-to-1 Experience: 7+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrable track record of designing, building, and delivering complex, high-performance software in fast-paced environments.
Ownership and Bias for Action: You are highly self-directed, comfortable operating autonomously without extensive supervision, and driven to turn ambiguity into actionable solutions.
Curiosity and Learning Agility: You possess an aptitude to select the best tool for the specific problem at hand. You have working fluency across multiple programming languages (such as C#, TypeScript, Python, Java, or C++) and continuously learn new ones.
Empathy and Partnership: You view the global P&T organization as your customer, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring your prototypes are built with their eventual operational needs in mind.
AI-Amplified Output: Practical experience leveraging generative AI APIs, vector retrieval/RAG patterns, or daily integration of AI-assisted engineering tools to amplify output.
High-Signal Communication: Ability to synthesize complex technical discoveries, trade-offs, and architectural recommendations into direct, high-signal summaries for technical leadership.
Big Picture Architecture: Solid foundational knowledge of distributed systems, multi-tenant patterns, containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

#LI-Hybrid

This is a Hybrid role.

Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
An attractive salary and benefits package.
Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.
Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform.
A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.

jobs.title: Wireless Network Development Engineer , ONE-NAT, ONE Access Engineering (LAN/Wireless)
jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION

Are you strong in network automation? then this might be a great opportunity for you.

Join Amazon's Network Access Technology team and build automation that keeps the world's largest enterprise wireless network running smoothly and healing itself. You'll design and deploy next-generation access infrastructure across thousands of global sites, solving complex problems at massive scale while your work directly enables every package Amazon delivers.

Your primary focus is building automation that makes our global wireless network self-sufficient and resilient. You'll analyze patterns across thousands of sites, develop workflows that resolve issues without human intervention, and validate new hardware before it reaches production environments.

You partner with firmware, field operations, and infrastructure engineers—pressure-testing designs and influencing decisions through data-driven insights. You'll mentor newer engineers, conduct technical reviews, and occasionally visit sites for hands-on validation and troubleshooting.

No two weeks look the same, but the constant is this: you're solving complex problems at unprecedented scale, and your work directly impacts the reliability of our fulfillment network worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
  • Design and Deploy Network Solutions: Lead the design, development, and deployment of network access solutions spanning wireless (Wi-Fi 5/6/6E/7), wired (802.1X, NAC), and emerging network access technologies across Amazon's global fulfillment network.
  • Own End-to-End Project Delivery: Take ownership of complex, multi-milestone network engineering projects from requirements gathering through deployment and validation, ensuring alignment with internal processes and stakeholder expectations.
  • Build Automation and Tooling: Develop and enhance automation frameworks for network configuration, compliance validation, and zero-touch deployment pipelines that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
  • Enable Self-Healing Operations: Contribute to our automation platform by developing automated remediation workflows, anomaly detection models, and predictive maintenance capabilities for wireless infrastructure.
  • Drive Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with engineering, field operations, network operations, and program management teams to develop solutions that balance performance, cost, and operational simplicity while validating new device types and configurations.

About the team
We own the design, planning, deployment, and support of the largest wireless and wired access network in the world. We operate at an unprecedented scale—assisting fulfillment, sortation, and delivery sites globally. Our team manages access interconnection that ensures every Amazon associate, robot, and IoT device stays reliably linked to power Amazon's fulfillment promise.

We're focused on transforming network engineering and operations through AI-driven automation, self-healing infrastructure, and next-generation access technologies. We don't just maintain reachability—we architect the network that enables Amazon to deliver for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a team that values operational excellence, continuous improvement, and collective problem-solving.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with automation or working with scripting languages like Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell, or equivalent
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or other related discipline
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
  • 4+ years experience developing engineering, deployment, or operations mechanisms to support IP network and/or networking systems
  • 4+ years experience in a network focused hands-on technical role working with IP routing protocols/technologies and platforms in large scale enterprise wireless network environments
  • 4+ years of experience in network engineering, with deep expertise in wireless (802.11ac/ax/be) and wired (802.1X, RADIUS, DHCP, DNS) access technologies

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Thorough understanding of TCP/IP networking, IP routing, Server Load Balancing, and Network Security architecture and core technologies such as IP, TCP, OSPF/IS-IS, BGP, MPLS, Server Load Balancers, Firewalls, ACLs, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, LDAP, NFS, etc.

  • Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, site survey methodologies, and wireless capacity planning
