jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About the Team

The Forward Intelligence team owns the skills that power Workday's agent platform responsible for customer onboarding through the full post-deployment lifecycle - turning the deep configuration expertise and hard-earned wisdom of our Domain Experts and Deployment Consultants into production-grade, fully tested skills that the agent can execute unattended in live customer tenants.

What we own: The end-to-end skill engine and governance ecosystem, spanning skill knowledge extraction, promotion pipelines, evaluation frameworks, self-correcting drift detection, and developer authoring environments.

How we build: Developer-first authoring environments and automated platform tooling that enable engineers to rapidly craft, test, and publish deterministic skills with built-in guardrails.

Agentic engineering: We build IDE tooling, prompt templates, .cursorrules configurations, and context-ingestion pipelines that allow AI-assisted editors (like Cursor) to natively generate compliant Model Context Protocol (MCP) schemas on the first try.

How we work: Close end-to-end collaboration across domain experts, AI platform engineers, and site reliability teams to transform domain knowledge into trustworthy, production-ready AI skills.

About the Role

We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to serve as a high-impact bridge between human domain expertise and production AI execution. In this role, you will own the end-to-end authoring, prompt architecture, and API integration of AI skills that power Workday's core agentic capabilities.

This is a pivotal, high-visibility engineering position with cross-organizational impact. You will work directly with top Subject Matter Experts across business units to translate complex enterprise logic, tribal configuration knowledge, and standard operating procedures into deterministic, schema-compliant AI tools using state-of-the-art AI-assisted development environments.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Skill Authoring & Domain Codification: Partner directly with domain experts and senior consultants across business units to translate complex business logic, prose, and raw scripts into optimal, structured AI skill definitions.
AI-Assisted Editor Mastery: Operate at the cutting edge of AI-driven software development (using Cursor, Claude Code, and custom tooling) to rapidly generate, refactor, and refine prompt logic, tool descriptions, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls.
API & Capability Orchestration: Connect skills to backend systems by wiring up enterprise REST APIs, MCP servers, and complex data structures for seamless agent execution.
Logic Optimization & Deduplication: Abstract messy business procedures into clean, modular logic—separating prose from executable code while optimizing prompt structures for minimal token consumption and maximum execution reliability.
Edge-Case Stress Testing: Design and implement automated test suites to stress-test skill edge cases, API parameter bounds, fallback logic, and error-handling routines before deployment.
Enablement & Code Review: Scale authoring standards across Workday by establishing best practices, training domain experts on self-serve authoring workflows, and reviewing submitted skill pull requests for schema compliance and API integrity.
Enforce Evaluation-Driven Development (EDD): Partner with Domain Experts to curate benchmark eval datasets, implementing LLM-as-a-Judge scoring, trajectory trace analysis, and CI/CD quality gates to validate skill accuracy and prevent regressions prior to production promotion.
Production Telemetry & Drift Analysis: Establish feedback loops using production agent trace logs to identify trajectory failures, update eval benchmark suites, and continuously improve skill deterministic behavior.

About You

Basic Qualifications

4+ years of professional software engineering experience in Python or TypeScript with a focus on API integrations, backend services, or scripting.
1+ years of hands-on experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to author, refactor, and debug production code.
Strong experience working with REST APIs, JSON/YAML schemas, and structured data transformations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Other Qualifications

Strong technical communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with non-technical domain experts and translate requirements into clean technical specs.
Generative AI & Tool Calling: Solid grasp of prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and agentic specifications (e.g., Model Context Protocol / MCP).
Code Refactoring & Systems Rigor: Ability to dissect complex domain scripts or unstructured documentation and refactor them in

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
About Prudentia Sciences

Prudentia Sciences is the scientific intelligence layer powering life sciences dealmaking. We bring together expert-developed scientific diligence frameworks, AI reasoning trained on drug development, and a unified evidence base to accelerate investment in breakthrough therapies. As a trusted third party operating between buyer and seller, we help build conviction through every stage of the deal, faster. We replace fragmented workflows with a single system that surfaces what matters earlier.

Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, Iaso Ventures, Virtue, and SignalFire — and built by people who have sat on every side of the table in life sciences dealmaking — we're on a mission to bring expert scientific judgment to every deal decision, at AI scale.

The Opportunity

Our clients don't buy software in the abstract. A BD team at a top-20 pharma company, a biotech evaluating its pipeline, or an investment fund running diligence on a drug asset each arrives with its own data, its own workflows, its own security review, and its own definition of a good answer. Closing the gap between what our platform does out of the box and what that client needs this quarter is engineering work, and it's this role.

We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to be Prudentia's senior technical presence inside client engagements. You'll scope problems with client stakeholders, integrate our platform with their systems and data, build the configurations, workflows, and extensions that make it indispensable, and turn what you see in the field into product and platform improvements. You'll work across engineering, data, AI/ML, and the commercial team.

Why This Role is Hard (in a Good Way)

Forward deployed work at Prudentia sits where several demanding worlds meet:

  • Sophisticated, high-stakes users: BD leaders, portfolio strategists, scientists, and investors who know the domain cold and will spot a wrong number immediately. Trust is earned one answer at a time.

  • Messy enterprise reality: client data in internal systems, data rooms, spreadsheets, and licensed databases; SSO and security reviews; IT teams with their own timelines and constraints.

  • AI that has to be right: applying LLMs and retrieval to clinical trial data, scientific literature, deal history, and multi-language sources, where hallucination isn't a quirk but a credibility risk.

  • A product still taking shape: every engagement is a chance to decide whether something should be a one-off configuration, a reusable pattern, or a core platform feature. You'll help make that call.

You'll need to be as comfortable in a client steering meeting as you are in a pull request, and able to switch between them in the same afternoon.

What You'll Own

Client Deployment & Integration

  • Lead the technical side of client onboarding and deployment, from discovery and scoping through go-live and expansion.

  • Integrate Prudentia with client systems and data: internal databases, data rooms, document repositories, licensed datasets, and identity providers, working within their security and compliance requirements.

  • Build client-specific workflows, configurations, models, and extensions on top of our AWS-based platform, written to production standards rather than as throwaway scripts.

Applied AI & Data in the Field

  • Apply our AI capabilities (LLMs, retrieval, extraction, scenario and risk modeling) to client-specific questions, and evaluate whether the outputs are accurate and defensible.

  • Partner with the data team on onboarding new client and third-party data sources, and on the provenance and quality standards that let clients trust the results.

  • Build evaluations and guardrails for client use cases so that quality is measured, not assumed.

Product Feedback Loop

  • Be the field's voice in engineering and product: bring back patterns, gaps, and requests with enough technical depth that they can be acted on.

  • Turn repeated one-off solutions into reusable components, templates, and platform features, contributing directly to the core codebase.

  • Help decide what should be productized, what should stay configurable, and what we should say no to.

Trusted Technical Advisor

  • Act as the technical point of contact for your accounts, from day-to-day users through to executive sponsors.

  • Support the commercial team in pre-sales technical discovery, pilots, and proofs of value with strategic prospects.

  • Help build the forward deployed playbook, and help shape the team as it grows.

Who You Are

Essential Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time in client-facing, forward deployed, solutions engineering, or technical consulting roles where you shipped code that clients depended on.

  • Strong full-stack or backend engineering skills: Python and SQL as a minimum, comfort with APIs and integrations, and the ability to work across a modern web stack.

  • Hands-on AWS experience: you've deployed and operated production systems on AWS and can reason about security, networking, and cost in client environments.

  • Practical experience with LLMs and AI applications: retrieval, prompting, extraction, evaluation, and the judgment to know when an AI output is good enough to put in front of a cli

jobs.title: Telecom Operations Engineer, Amazon Connect, Amazon Connect
jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, our vision is to provide business applications leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' success through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions which solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Amazon Connect Customer is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect Customer has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

The Amazon Connect Customer Telecom Engineering team is responsible for provisioning and maintaining connectivity to global telecom carriers, managing the backend telecom infrastructure, and troubleshooting customer issues related to telephony. The SBC (Session Border Controller) service is owned by the team and is used to route calls between Amazon Connect Customer and telecom carriers.

We are seeking Systems Engineers who are experts in SIP/VoIP to join our team to help us support and expand the Amazon Connect Customer's telecom infrastructure. Amazon Connect Customer supports thousands of concurrent customer calls and tens of thousands of agents using an internally developed SIP based Call Center Platform. Our technology is compelling, as it solves a common problem in a novel way — and it is unique in the industry. We are looking for engineers to help us expand our infrastructure to new global regions, support existing implementations, and innovate telecom network operations through tooling and processes to improve customer productivity. Be part of the team that handles large amount of phone calls, among the largest in contact center platforms globally.



About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience
  • Experience in site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration
  • Experience working with Linux
  • Experience in systems engineering
  • Experience in any of the following: Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell or equivalent
  • 4+ years of solving problems with technology in the Telecommunications industry experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security
  • Experience working in 24/7 production environment
  • Experience with service-oriented architecture and web services

jobs.title: Field Support Engineer
jobs.description:
The Role:

We are working with a growing technology company specialising in residential and commercial charging infrastructure, who are looking for a Field Services Engineer to join their team. This is a hands-on technical role supporting the hardware, software, connectivity and backend systems associated with installed charging equipment.

The Role:

You will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, both remotely and on-site, working closely with customers, engineers, suppliers and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide 1st and 2nd level technical support for charging equipment and associated software platforms.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity and user-access issues.
  • Attend customer and project sites to investigate and repair faulty equipment.
  • Guide customers through remote troubleshooting and corrective procedures.
  • Manage technical tickets from initial diagnosis through to resolution, working within agreed SLAs and KPIs.
  • Escalate complex issues to engineering, product, suppliers or field service teams where required.
  • Manage supplier tickets and RMAs through to completion.
  • Monitor backend systems and live networks for performance, connectivity and alerts.
  • Set up and support electrical equipment following installation and commissioning.
  • Maintain accurate records of technical issues, repairs and resolutions.
  • Support customer onboarding and provide basic product training.
  • Manage equipment stock and assist with regular stock checks.

Required:

  • 5+ years' experience in technical support, field service, electrical equipment or a similar technical environment.
  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills across both hardware and software.
  • Good understanding of electrical systems and networking fundamentals.
  • Experience working with ticketing systems such as Salesforce, Freshdesk, Zoho or HubSpot.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to take ownership of issues from start to finish.
  • Experience with IoT, connected devices, telecoms, energy technology or charging infrastructure is desirable.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word and Excel, with strong general PC and IT skills.
  • Knowledge of OCPP, cloud platforms, APIs or IoT protocols would be advantageous.
  • Full clean driving licence and willingness to travel to customer/project sites.

If you have a strong technical background and enjoy diagnosing problems, working hands-on with equipment and finding solutions for customers, we'd love to hear from you.

Ability to commute/relocate:

  • Dublin, County Dublin: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

  • Do you hold a valid, full driving licence?

Work authorisation:

  • Ireland (required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: LINUX KERNEL DEVELOPER
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

ThreatLocker® is a global cybersecurity leader that stops cyberattacks before they happen. The company’s Zero Trust Platform prevents breaches from both known and unknown threats by allowing only explicitly trusted software and activity across endpoints, networks, and cloud systems. Built to deploy quickly and scale across complex environments, the platform reduces operational overhead while keeping business running uninterrupted. Headquartered in Orlando, Florida, with offices in Dublin, Dubai, and Brisbane, ThreatLocker protects over 70,000 organizations worldwide.

POSITION OVERVIEW

ThreatLocker is seeking a Linux Kernel Developer to join our cybersecurity product team. In this role, you will design, develop, debug, and maintain low-level Linux components that support endpoint security, application control, and threat prevention across multiple Linux distributions and architectures.

DEVELOPMENT — Full-Time

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop, debug, test, and maintain Linux kernel-level components using C/C++
  • Work with kernel modules, eBPF, system calls, filesystems, networking, memory management, and process monitoring
  • Validate kernel functionality from user space and work with user-space APIs
  • Debug complex kernel, performance, compatibility, and system-level issues
  • Support compatibility across Red Hat, Debian, Ubuntu, SUSE, and other Linux environments
  • Support kernel and platform enablement across x86_64 and ARM64
  • Contribute to build, packaging, CI/CD, and automated kernel testing processes
  • Support platform and Linux distribution porting where required
  • Collaborate with development, QA, DevOps, and security teams

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of software development experience
  • Strong C/C++ development skills
  • Strong understanding of Linux kernel internals
  • Experience with Linux kernel modules and/or eBPF
  • Experience with processes, scheduling, memory management, concurrency, filesystems, networking, or storage subsystems
  • Experience debugging kernel and low-level system issues
  • Strong understanding of computer architecture and system-level software
  • Experience working across multiple Linux distributions and kernel versions

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience developing endpoint security, EDR, antivirus, or similar security software
  • Experience with eBPF-based monitoring or enforcement
  • Experience with ARM64 and x86_64
  • Experience with Python for tooling, testing, or automation
  • Experience with Linux packaging, kernel build systems, and CI/CD
  • Experience with virtualization technologies such as KVM, VMware, Xen, or Hyper-V
  • Knowledge of PCIe, DMA, SR-IOV/SIOV, or related low-level system interfaces
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining upstream Linux kernel code

A background check and drug/substance screening are required after a conditional offer. Employment will proceed only upon receiving clear results from both.

ThreatLocker also conducts randomized drug and substance testing approximately every 60 days, in line with the same screening standards.

Solid knowledge of software architecture, system design, secure engineering, code review and maintainable development practices. Experience with TCP, UDP, BLE, Thread or comparable connectivity technologies, plus hardware interfaces, device communication or firmware-update workflows. Demonstrated technical leadership, with the ability to establish direction, influence decisions, mentor engineers and guide multidisciplinary teams through complex engineering challenges. Practical experience with Agile/Scrum delivery, backlog refinement, risk management and cross-functional collaboration in a global, matrixed organisation. Five to eight years of software development experience and previous experience as a technical lead, Squad Leader or similar role. Hands-on experience with C++, Python, Node.j

jobs.title: Product Owner (Customer Experience)
jobs.description:
Social Discovery Group (SDG) is a group of social discovery companies. SDG solves the problems of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection - transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. SDG's products redefine the way people interact and connect with one another.

Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world.

We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world.

We're proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025).

We are looking for a Product Owner (Customer Experience).

In this role, you will own the end-to-end customer journey across our products, from the first visit to meaningful long-term connections. Your mission is to find the biggest growth opportunities in a product used by a million-strong audience, remove whatever stands between users and a great experience, and turn every improvement into measurable business results.

Your main tasks will be:

Own the customer journey end-to-end, from registration to quality conversations, identifying friction points and growth opportunities across the whole funnel.
Dig into data yourself: explore analytics with AI tools (e.g., querying BigQuery via MCP), validate insights, and turn them into strong, evidence-backed hypotheses.
Write concise product briefs and drive ideas through specs, prototyping, and release together with developers, analysts, and designers.
Build and prioritize the backlog based on the value each initiative brings to users and the business.
Connect every initiative to business impact (revenue, net profit) rather than isolated conversion gains.
Scale successful experiments across our product portfolio.

We expect from you:

Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Project Manager, or Team Lead in B2C products; startup experience is welcome.
A hands-on approach: you do the analysis, write the briefs, and push ideas through to results yourself.
Practical experience using AI tools for product analytics and documentation.
Strong command of product metrics and funnel analytics, combined with a solid understanding of unit economics.
Track record of owning a business metric (revenue, turnover, net profit), not only conversion rates.
Strong prioritization skills and comfort working with a broad scope.
Persistence and drive to achieve results in challenging conditions.
A technical background (degree in a technical field or previous development experience) is a strong plus.

Why join:

Real influence on the user experience of a product with a million-strong audience.
Freedom to improve anything along the customer journey, from small UX fixes to bold product changes.
A role for people who want challenging problems and a fast path to growth.

What do we offer:

REMOTE OPPORTUNITY to work full-time;
The initial pay level or pay range for this role will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before the commencement of employment;
Vacation 28 calendar days per year;
7 wellness days per year (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave;
Bonuses up to $5000 for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company;
50% payment for professional training, international conferences, and meetings;
Corporate discount for English lessons;
Health benefits. According to the paychecks, if you are not eligible for corporate medical insurance, the company will compensate you with up to $1,000 gross per year per employee. This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor's fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children);
Workplace organization. The company provides all employees with an equipped workplace and all the necessary equipment (table, armchair, wifi, etc.) in our offices or co-working locations. In the other locations, the company provides reimbursement of workplace costs up to $1000 gross once every 3 years, according to the paychecks. This money can be spent on the rent of the co-working room, on equipping the working place at home (desk, chair, Internet, etc.) during those 3 years;
Internal gamified gratitude system: receive bonuses from colleagues and exchange them for our merchandise, team building activities, massage certificates, etc.

Sounds good? Join us now!

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Security
jobs.description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



We are building an internal engineering function dedicated to owning the reliability, code-ification, and continuous delivery of our enterprise and product security tooling — replacing legacy security practices with modern security engineering methodologies. As our Security Site Reliability Engineer, you will build and drive the infrastructure-as-code, automation, and operational maturity across our entire security platform portfolio — including SIEM/SOAR, EDR/NDR/XDR, SAST/DAST, CNAPP/CSPM. Partnering closely with Core Platform and DevOps engineering teams, you will establish high availability, self-service developer tooling, and automated guardrails at scale.


This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Identity Security and Security Solutions Engineering.


Responsibility
  • Build and manage the underlying infrastructure, monitoring, telemetry, and compute environments to relieve downstream security teams of infrastructure overhead
  • Drive engineering and IaC strategy for Microsoft Sentinel, including ingestion pipelines, workspace governance, detection frameworks, and cost optimization
  • Develop reusable, hardened Terraform and Bicep/ARM modules deployed via automated CI/CD pipelines with integrated policy-as-code gates
  • Support cross-functional orchestration workflows connecting ITSM, messaging channels, and SIEM/SOAR platforms to streamline evidence collection and incident remediation
  • Support automated, on-demand security sandboxes to support offensive security exercises and adversary simulation testing
  • Establish infrastructure and monitoring capabilities to support dynamic safety validation and testing of AI-driven tools prior to production rollout
  • Contribute to an internal developer portal offering visibility into vulnerability metrics, automated fix workflows, and guardrails
  • Streamline compliance reporting by automating evidence gathering against regulatory benchmarks and industry security frameworks


Job Designation



Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)


Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic
  • 5+ years of experience in SRE, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or security engineering, with 1+ years leading a production platform as a senior or lead engineer
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Azure Monitor/Log Analytics (workspace topology, connectors, KQL, automation rules, and playbooks)
  • Experience with Terraform (custom modules, state architecture, multi-environment design)
  • Experience building and managing automated release pipelines using Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms
  • Experience with Python development
  • Experience defining SLOs/SLIs, error budget management, observability strategies, incident response rotation design, and blameless postmortems
  • Experience aligning stakeholders across Security, DevOps, and Product engineering
Preferred
  • ARM or Bicep familiarity
  • Experience with C#/.NET, Kubernetes, or container runtimes
  • Experience extending security platform patterns to AWS or GCP environments
  • Familiarity with OPA/Rego, Azure Policy, or static analysis tools like Checkov
  • Prior experience automating compliance controls for SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP benchmarks
  • Microsoft SC-200, AZ-500, AZ-400, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate


Life at Docusign



Working here
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.


We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

jobs.title: Bilingual Sales Engineer, Channel (Italian or Spanish) - EMEA
jobs.description:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring an experienced Bilingual (Italian or Spanish) Channel Sales Engineer to work with our EMEA channel sales team. Qualified candidates must permanently reside in Ireland. This is a hybrid position for those living within a commutable distance to our Cork, Ireland office, or fully remote for those living outside a commutable distance.

Keeper's cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organisations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for navigating our customers through the technical landscape of our products.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of public sector IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. Learn why agencies trust Keeper to defend against today's sophisticated adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Role

As a bilingual Channel Sales Engineer you will work alongside the Keeper Security sales force by supporting the pre-sales and post-sales cycle from a technical perspective. You will be responsible for identifying the technical requirements within an opportunity, matching them to Keeper Security solutions, and supporting the sale by positioning and demonstrating differences. You will provide product trials and evaluations to Keeper Security partners, assist with implementation and integration, and provide level-2 technical assistance to existing customers.

Responsibilities

Provide and manage pre-sales technical support for the technical sales process of Keeper products for Channel partners in EMEA
Work closely with the Channel Account Management team to support and develop strategic partners technical capability and drive incremental partner revenue
Conduct product demonstrations and technical presentations remotely, at customer locations, or on-site at a Keeper facility
Collaborate with product development and engineering teams to stay updated on product features, enhancements, and updates
Communicate with Italian or Spanish and English-speaking partners, customers, vendors and other stakeholders, both written and verbal
Address technical questions, concerns, and objections during the sales process to ensure customer confidence and satisfaction
Act as a technical advisor to partners, helping them understand how our solutions can solve their business challenges and achieve their goals
Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies relevant to the business
Analyse complex multivariate problems and use a systematic approach to gain quick resolution, often under pressure
Works on issues that affect design/selling success or address future concepts, products or technologies
Establish relationships and engage with the technical personnel to identify opportunities and sell Keeper Security products and services
Ensure accurate and timely activity, issue updates in Salesforce and report to management
Create and deliver technical product presentations and/or training sessions to channel partners and customers
Participates as part of a sales team to achieve or exceed revenue targets
Contribute to the execution of company objectives to achieve goals in creative and effective ways
Ability to travel to and from customer meetings (locally and nationally) & rent and/or operate a vehicle on behalf of the company
Willingness to travel up to 50%

Requirements

5+ years of experience in a pre-sales technical role (Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, Solutions Engineer, etc.)
Bilingual fluency in English and an additional language, Italian or Spanish, with excellent written and verbal communication skills in both languages
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and a strong entrepreneurial drive
Strong experience with Windows/Active Directory administration and knowledge of UNIX/Linux
Outstanding presentation skills and the ability to build and demonstrate a high quality product overview to both technical and executive level audiences
Technical background in networking and security applications as well as cloud technologies (AWS, Azure)
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent work experience

Preferred Requirements

Experience working with the channel
Industry recognised certifications
Scripting and DevOps experience a plus
Exposure to Identity Providers like Azure and Okta
Experience providing solutions to and understanding the requirements of Enterprise Customers
Prior experience with cybersecurity solutions or relevant experience with IAM or other security SAAS solutions

Benefits

Onsite lunches
Private healthcare (no wait period)
Pension contribution (no wait period)
Sick Pay
Bike-to-Work Scheme (if local)

Keeper is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. jobs.title: Hybrid Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Meet the Team

Join Cisco's Cloud and Data Center Engineering team - a collaborative group of engineers, architects, and operations specialists dedicated to designing, implementing, and optimizing Cisco's cloud-based and hybrid infrastructure with a strong focus on network engineering and data center operations. Our team partners with product managers, security, and IT operations to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable solutions, while staying aligned with Cisco's security standards and industry best practices. We thrive on cross-functional collaboration, continuous learning, and delivering high-impact solutions that power Cisco's business.

Your Impact

  • Design, develop, and implement cloud-based and data center network solutions, combining cutting-edge technologies to optimize architecture in line with Cisco's security standards and policies.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and security teams to develop detailed specifications for new cloud-based products, services, and applications, focusing on network security optimization, scalability, and performance.
  • Plan and execute compute and storage migration activities for data center relocation or consolidation projects, including assessing environments, creating migration strategies, and mitigating risks.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, OpenStack), performing both live and cold VM migrations and decommissioning with minimal service disruption.
  • Build and maintain enterprise storage systems (NAS/SAN), including volume/LUN creation, host mapping, multipathing, and data replication.
Minimum Qualifications

  • A completed degree in Computer Science, or Engineering, combined with 5 + years of experience such as network engineering or data center operations
  • Experience in deploying, administering, and operating virtualization platforms (VMware, OpenStack, Hyper-V).
  • Experience in building, operating, tuning, and troubleshooting Linux and Windows Server environments for high availability and performance.
  • Experience in enterprise storage systems (e.g., NetApp, Dell EMC) and advanced storage architectures (NAS, SAN), including volume/LUN management, host mapping, multipathing, data replication, and snapshots.
  • Experience in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, GitOps).
  • Experience with IPv4/IPv6 networking and experience with cloud network architecture and automation.
  • Experience with scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell) for infrastructure automation.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in data center operations, including hardware installation, rack management, cabling, power management, and environmental monitoring.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.).
  • Experience in automation and modern DevOps practices.
  • Experience with Source Code Control Management and CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, Argo, Harness, etc.).
  • Experience with Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Experience in development of next gen agentic AI ops agents
Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
*Job Purpose*

The Maintenance Technician is responsible for the hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and preventive maintenance of production equipment, utilities, and facility systems at Athlone Laboratories, working to maximise equipment uptime and reliability while ensuring full compliance with GMP and Health & Safety requirements.

*Principal duties and responsibilities*

* Carry out troubleshooting, fault-finding, and repair of mechanical, electrical, and utility equipment across the site, escalating complex issues to the Maintenance Supervisor or Facilities Engineer as required.
* Perform preventive and planned maintenance tasks in line with the maintenance schedule, and accurately complete all associated logging and task tracking.
* Carry out spare parts identification, storage, and procurement.
* Maintain regular, consistent, and professional attendance, punctuality, and personal appearance, and adhere to all relevant GMP and Health & Safety procedures, including safe systems of work (e.g. permit-to-work, lock-out/tag-out) and correct use of PPE.
* Develop and maintain standard changeover manuals, set-up/settings lists, and consistent timelines for equipment changeovers, and identify opportunities to reduce changeover time.
* Track equipment performance and report on it at regular intervals, forming the basis of the site's Continuous Improvement programme, with the aim of moving maintenance from a reactive to a proactive approach.
* Work with the Maintenance Team and Operations to understand and resolve equipment performance issues.
* Use techniques such as "one point" lesson plans to share information on fault correction, and support operators in developing their equipment knowledge.
* Build agreement among key operators and technicians on the most effective method of operating equipment.
* Liaise with onsite and external contractors on equipment repairs and in detailing the jobs and projects required of them, ensuring all learnings are captured.
* Liaise with the Maintenance Facilities Engineer to source and order parts, machinery, and maintenance equipment as required.
* Communicate with all departments to ensure schedules are achieved.
* Support the coordination of teams for new equipment installation projects, ensuring effective installation.
* Support adherence to maintenance budgets, ensuring spending is geared to business benefit.
* Undertake any other duties reasonably required, in line with the needs of the business.

*Skills and Experience*

· Recognised trade qualification (e.g. QQI Level 6 or equivalent) in Mechanical, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience, would be an advantage but is not essential.

· Experience in a pharmaceutical, medical device, or other regulated manufacturing environment would be an advantage but is not necessary.

· Hands-on experience troubleshooting and repairing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and/or hydraulic equipment.

· Familiarity with PLC-controlled equipment and automated production lines would be an advantage.

· Relevant safety certifications (e.g. Safe Pass, Manual Handling) and any applicable plant or equipment licences.

· Strong leadership/team management skills and experience.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

· Ability to prioritise, demonstrating good time management skills.

· Excellent attention to detail with the ability to work in a busy and demanding environment.

· Willingness to work flexible hours/shifts, and to participate in an on-call/call-out rota as required.

Pay: €35,500.00-€50,000.00 per year

Benefits:
* Company pension
* On-site parking
* Sick pay

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Server Structural FEA Engineer
jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary:

Qualcomm's Data Center team is developing high-performance, energy-efficient server solutions for data center applications. We are looking for highly talented, innovative, and collaborative individuals to contribute to cutting-edge server technology development.

Our Mission

We are dedicated to transforming the industry by reimagining silicon and developing next-generation computing platforms. By joining our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers to create innovative solutions that advance performance, energy efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Our focus is on developing reference platforms based on Qualcomm Snapdragon SoCs and delivering comprehensive hardware and software solutions, reference designs, user guides, SDKs, and related enablement.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Staff / Senior Staff Server Structural FEA Engineer with deep expertise in semiconductor package mechanics, structural reliability, and advanced finite element analysis. The role focuses on structural integrity and reliability of server SoCs, spanning die- and package-level behavior through interaction with the server platform. The scope includes both soldered and socketed SoC packages and their mechanical interaction with PCBs, sockets and retention systems, cooling solutions, and thermal interface materials, including TIM1.5.

The ideal candidate is a recognized subject matter expert who can develop predictive methodologies, evaluate failure mechanisms, quantify design margins and uncertainty, and translate analysis into actionable package and platform design guidance. The engineer will assess structural behavior across package assembly, system integration, qualification, and operation, with emphasis on chip-package interaction (CPI), warpage, die and interconnect integrity, solder-joint reliability, and mechanically coupled thermal interface risks.

This senior individual contributor will work closely with package engineering, computational modeling, thermal, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, reliability, and system/platform engineering teams to align assumptions, material properties, boundary conditions, failure criteria, and correlation approaches. The engineer will develop independent analyses where needed and partner with system-level structural FEA engineers to connect SoC/package mechanical behavior to broader platform and lifecycle assessments.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and apply advanced structural and thermo-mechanical FEA methodologies for server SoCs and advanced semiconductor packages, including CPI, package assembly, warpage, stress, deformation, and structural reliability.
Evaluate both soldered and socketed packages under package assembly, SMT, socket and retention loading, cooling-system loading, temperature cycling, qualification, and operating conditions.
Analyze package-to-platform mechanical interaction among the SoC package, PCB, socket or retention system, heatsink or cold plate, and thermal interface materials, including TIM1.5.
Apply advanced FEA techniques including submodeling, contact analysis, material and geometric nonlinearity, viscoelasticity, creep, fatigue, fracture or damage mechanics, and coupled structural-thermal analysis as appropriate.
Develop physics-based reliability and life-prediction models for relevant failure mechanisms, including solder and bump fatigue, die and BEOL stress, substrate and interposer cracking, delamination, and creep. Perform BLR and solder-joint reliability analyses to quantify damage accumulation, design margins, and expected life.
Perform sensitivity, uncertainty, and bounding analyses to identify dominant parameters, quantify structural risk, and guide package and platform architecture decisions before hardware is available.
Define model-validation and correlation strategies using material characterization, package/board measurements, reliability and qualification testing, manufacturing data, and system-level test results, including development of test vehicles and methods where needed.
Partner with package engineering and computational modeling teams to align modeling assumptions, material properties, process inputs, boundary conditions, revision control, correlation methodologies, and failure criteria.

Qualcomm's Data Center team is developing high-performance, energy-efficient server solutions for data center applications. We are looking for highly talented, innovative, and collaborative individuals to contribute to cutting-edge server technology development.


Our Mission

We are dedicated to transforming the industry by reimagining silicon and developing next-generation computing platforms. By joining our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers to create innovative solutions that advance performance, energy efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Our focus is on developing reference platforms based on Qualcomm Snapdragon SoCs and delivering comprehensive hardware and software solutions, reference designs, user guides, SDKs, and related enablement.


Position Summary

We are seeking a Staff / Senior Staff Server Structural FEA Engineer with deep expertise in semiconductor package mechanics, structural reliability, and advanced finite element analysis. The role focuses on structural integrity and reliability of server SoCs, spanning die- and package-level behavior through interaction with the server platform. The scope includes both soldered and socketed SoC packages and their mechanical interaction with PCBs, sockets and retention systems, cooling solutions, and thermal interface materials, including TIM1.5.


The ideal candidate is a recognized subject matter expert who can develop predictive methodologies, evaluate failure mechanisms, quantify design margins and uncertainty, and translate analysis into actionable package and platform design guidance. The engineer will assess structural behavior across package assembly, system integration, qualification, and operation, with emphasis on chip-package interaction (CPI), warpage, die and interconnect integrity, solder-joint reliability, and mechanically coupled thermal interface risks.


This senior individual contributor will work closely with package engineering, computational modeling, thermal, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, reliability, and system/platform engineering teams to align assumptions, material properties, boundary conditions, failure criteria, and correlation approaches. The engineer will develop independent analyses where needed and partner with system-level structural FEA engineers to connect SoC/package mechanical behavior to broader platform and lifecycle assessments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and apply advanced structural and thermo-mechanical FEA methodologies for server SoCs and advanced semiconductor packages, including CPI, package assembly, warpage, stress, deformation, and structural reliability.
  • Evaluate both soldered and socketed packages under package assembly, SMT, socket and retention loading, cooling-system loading, temperature cycling, qualification, and operating conditions.
  • Analyze package-to-platform mechanical interaction among the SoC package, PCB, socket or retention system, heatsink or cold plate, and thermal interface materials, including TIM1.5.
  • Apply advanced FEA techniques including submodeling, contact analysis, material and geometric nonlinearity, viscoelasticity, creep, fatigue, fracture or damage mechanics, and coupled structural-thermal analysis as appropriate.
  • Develop physics-based reliability and life-prediction models for relevant failure mechanisms, including solder and bump fatigue, die and BEOL stress, substrate and interposer cracking, delamination, and creep. Perform BLR and solder-joint reliability analyses to quantify damage accumulation, design margins, and expected life.
  • Perform sensitivity, uncertainty, and bounding analyses to identify dominant parameters, quantify structural risk, and guide package and platform architecture decisions before hardware is available.
  • Define model-validation and correlation strategies using material characterization, package/board measurements, reliability and qualification testing, manufacturing data, and system-level test results, including development of test vehicles and methods where needed.
  • Partner with package engineering and computational modeling teams to align modeling assumptions, material properties, process inputs, boundary conditions, revision control, correlation methodologies, and failure criteria.
  • Develop independent analyses, sensitivity studies, or targeted model cross-checks as needed to reconcile differing predictions, quantify uncertainty, and evaluate server-specific package-to-platform boundary conditions.
  • Work closely with system/platform structural-analysis engineers to provide package mechanical properties, load limits, deformation behavior, and failure criteria supporting broader platform, system, and rack-level lifecycle analyses.
  • Apply expertise in package architectures and substrate technologies, including FCBGA, FCLGA/HFCBGA, chiplet-based designs, HBM integration, 2.5D interposers or bridges, and 3D packaging technologies.
  • Develop scalable workflows, automation, modeling standards, best-known methods (BKMs), and validation frameworks. Experience with ANSYS APDL-based workflow development is strongly preferred.
Translate complex simulation results into clear design requirements and recommendations for cross-functional engineering teams, leadership, customers, and suppliers.

Our client is delivering a major industrial water infrastructure project involving the construction and commissioning of a Water Treatment Plant (WTP), Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP), and Water Recovery Plant (WRP). Role Purpose
The Commissioning Engineer will be responsible for taking new water and wastewater treatment facilities from mechanical completion through commissioning, start-up, performance testing and operational handover.
Working closely with process, automation, construction and operations teams, you will ensure systems are commissioned safely, efficiently and in line with project performance requirements.

  • Water testing

  • Degree in Chemical, Process, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Blowers
  • Valves
  • Membrane systems (MBR, UF, RO)
  • Chemical dosing equipment

The Property Mapping Executive ensures that the boundaries of IDA land banks are accurately recorded for asset management and marketing purposes and that correct mapping and title information is provided to existing and prospective clients in our marketing and transactional interactions.

jobs.title: Swift Engineer, Radar Engineering
jobs.description:
Summary

Do you want to have a significant impact on how work is done at Apple? Radar is used by every major organization across Apple to help teams organize and track their work. As Apple’s primary tool for defining, tracking, and testing issues, Radar has been used for decades across various teams, including hardware and software engineering. It serves as a unified platform for bug tracking, test case management, and product management, facilitating seamless coordination among team members. The Radar Engineering team at Apple seeks an early-career Swift Engineer to help build the native Radar apps used across Apple on macOS and iOS.

Description

As a Swift Engineer on the Radar Client team, you will help build the native Radar apps that engineers across Apple use every day to track bugs, plan work, and ship products. Radar is a high-traffic, business-critical system used by teams across all of Apple, and the apps you will work on are the frontend clients of the platform. You will join a growing team distributed across California, Texas, and Ireland. In our highly collaborative environment, you will work closely with a team of passionate builders to deliver end-to-end features critical to Apple’s engineering workflows. You will receive structured mentorship, comprehensive training in Apple’s development practices, and the support to learn and develop your skills quickly. You will write, test, and ship Swift code across Radar’s macOS and iOS apps. You will build new features, fix bugs, and learn how to keep a large, long-lived codebase fast and reliable while it constantly evolves. As you ramp up, you will take on increasing ownership of features, contribute to design discussions, and help bring new frameworks and technologies into the apps.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Solid programming skills in Swift or similar language, with a good grasp of protocol-oriented and object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Experience with SwiftUI, AppKit, or UIKit.
  • Familiarity with building apps for Apple platforms using Xcode.
  • Experience with version control (Git) and a working understanding of the software development lifecycle.



Preferred Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience consuming REST APIs from a client app.
  • Experience with unit and UI testing frameworks such as XCTest.
  • Interest or experience in agentic workflows, MCP integrations, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Ability to triage problems, prioritize accordingly, and propose a resolution.

jobs.description: At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. As a Site Reliability Engineer II, a part of the Operational Support Systems (OSS) organization under the Security & Distributed Cloud organization, you will ensure all infrastructure is functioning properly and securely to support the business operations and F5 products and services. You will collaborate closely with U.S.-based IAM counterparts as part of a follow-the-sun support model to ensure smooth global operations.What You’ll Do:Be kind. IAM Operations: Manage IAM workflows such as access provisioning, deprovisioning, permissions updates, and identity-related escalations to support secure and efficient operations. Ticket Management: Resolve IAM-related tickets via Jira and ServiceNow, meeting SLA requirements and ensuring high-quality resolutions. Automation and Workflow Optimization: Write and maintain scripts using Python, Bash, Selenium, or PowerShell to automate provisioning, compliance reporting, and repetitive IAM tasks such as access management updates. Build and Enhance Automation Pipelines: Collaborate with IAM and engineering teams to design, configure, and troubleshoot automation pipelines for managing deployments and ensuring efficient identity-related workflows. Documentation: Write and maintain clear and thorough documentation for IAM workflows, automation scripts, pipeline configurations, and system troubleshooting processes to ensure operational clarity for the team. Identity Provider Migrations & Consolidation: Assist in Identity Provider (IdP) migrations for systems such as Okta and Entra ID, and consolidate duplicative IAM systems as part of mergers and acquisitions (M&A). Ensure scalability, availability, and security during integration efforts. Monitoring and Alerting: Deploy monitoring tools, such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Splunk, to track IAM system health and resolve potential risks before they impact operations. On-Call Support: Participate in an on-call rotation, responding to urgent escalations and restoring services quickly for IAM-related outages. What You’ll Bring:Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or 4+ years of relevant technical experience. Experience managing IAM workflows, including provisioning, deprovisioning, and auditing role-based access control systems. Familiarity with Identity Provider systems, such as Okta and Entra ID. Proficiency in scripting and workflow automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell. Experience designing and optimizing automation pipelines for workflow deployment and integration. Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible. Deep hands-on experience in AWS and GCP supporting Identity and Access Management (IAM), including creating and managing service accounts, designing custom roles, and implementing tailored security policies. Knowledge of monitoring platforms like Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk to observe and optimize IAM systems. Strong technical writing skills with the ability to create and maintain detailed documentation that supports operational workflows and troubleshooting processes. Experience working with ticket management systems, such as Jira and ServiceNow. Proven ability to troubleshoot issues, address technical escalations, and collaborate across geographically distributed teams. Preferred:Certifications such as Certified Identity and Access Manager (CIAM), ITIL, or public cloud certifications (AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Google Professional DevOps Engineer). Familiarity with container orchestration platforms, such as Kubernetes or Docker. Experience supporting Identity Provider (IdP) migrations and consolidating systems during M&A. jobs.title: Digital Solution Engineer - Sales & Service (German Speaking)
jobs.description:
Overview

The mission of Microsoft Business Applications is to help our customers digitally transform their businesses to drive new sources of revenue, create new and engaging ways to serve their customers, and to transform the way in which their business runs to drive new levels of profitability for their organization.

At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team—one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation.

SME&C is more than a sales organization—it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business.

In this role you will be the AI Business Process Sales and Service Solution Engineer (SE) for the SME-C segment for your assigned workload and a member of the sales team that consists of Digital AI Business Process Specialists, partners and engineering.

As an AI Business Process Sales and Service Solution Engineer (SE), you will lead AI transformation engagements with a focus on Sales and Service domain expertise. Your role involves owning the technical win strategy and supporting AI Business Process Sales Specialists (DSS) by forming relationships with C-Suite executives, Business Decision Makers (BDMs), and Technical Decision Makers (TDMs) such as CIOs, CTOs, and IT Leaders. You will engage partners for co-sell and implementation considerations, engineering to assist with emerging technologies and Customer Success Unit for deal support. The demo will focus on solving the technical proof requirements while highlighting our business value and differentiators and should result in securing the customer’s solution design endorsement.

You will develop relationships with the decision makers and with our customers and position yourself as a trusted advisor in your domain. You are responsible for sharing your technical, industry knowledge, and practices with your peers.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Advance qualified pipeline revenue by demonstrating solution capabilities, addressing technical proof requirements, and securing the customer’s solution design endorsement.
Own the technical win strategy for each opportunity. Engage with Business Decision Makers (BDMs) and Technical Decision Makers (TDMs) to translate their priorities and goals to solution vision by addressing business challenges
Orchestrate customer envisioning workshops, whiteboard design sessions, and compelling technical demos across Dynamics 365 Sales & Service applications (Sales, Customer Service, Contact Center, Field Service, Customer Insights), Copilot Studio, AI Agents.

Translate these findings into detailed technical plans – including migration pathways to D365, recommended migration tools – with clear milestones and risk mitigation strategies, captured in a Technical Close Plan for seamless hand-off to SI partners.
Showcase Microsoft’s unique value in AI-powered business process D365 solutions to win technical decisions against major competitors (e.g. Salesforce, Oracle, IFS, ServiceNow, Amazon Connect). Anticipate and address technical blockers – such as AI-related compliance, privacy, or security concerns – early in the sales process, developing mitigation plans that instill confidence in D365 solutions. Drive proof-based differentiation (architecture design sessions, pilot deployments) to highlight how Dynamics 365 meets customer needs better than the competition, ultimately improving win rates and displacing incumbent solutions.
Leverage the Microsoft partner ecosystem to enhance and scale solution delivery from early stages to assist with complex demos, POCs, and solution builds, ensuring their industry or domain expertise complements the sales strategy. Orchestrate co-selling and co-innovation with partners (including FastTrack, and ISV providers).
Work closely with the Customer Success Unit (CSU)/Partners to ensure customers realize value from their Dynamics 365 investments. Secure a clear deployment plan for every deal, including agreed success metrics and adoption milestones. Drive early adoption of high-value, consumption-based features like Copilot Studio and Dynamics 365 AI Agents by capturing usage intent during pre-sales and incorporating it into the Technical Close Plan.
Commit to ongoing professional development to maintain product knowledge and strategic sales skills. Complete 100% of required traini

Microsoft Elevate is chartered with the mission of bringing the power of technology to every non-profit and humanitarian organisation to accelerate Social Good. This organisation brings together our donation and grants programmes, industry solutions, commercial sales efforts and partner ecosystems to empower non-profits globally to address the world's most pressing needs.

As Digital Solution Specialist for Cloud & AI, you drive the Azure business for Microsoft Elevate in the DACH Market. You work with organisations that exist to do good, and in this market that means care above all: mental healthcare, disability care and elderly care providers. These are organisations under real pressure from staff shortages, rising demand and tight budgets, and cloud and AI are becoming central to how they keep delivering quality care. You translate those business challenges into practical, AI-powered Azure solutions and help customers adopt them responsibly.

This is a digital role. You work Hybrid from Dublin or German office alongside an experienced team covering the market. Your day is built around customer conversations and team collaboration.

That means planning to overachieve rather than planning to land exactly on target, qualifying honestly, and raising risks early enough that the team can still do something about them. Pipeline is created together, but nobody grows an account for you: the specialists who do best here are the ones who keep adding to what the team has built rather than waiting for it to arrive.

The people who thrive here are pro-active, commercially curious, good teammates and comfortable being accountable for a number. If that description fits, you will enjoy both the freedom and the support this role gives you.

jobs.title: Content Creator
jobs.description:
*Marketing Content Creator*

Infinite Energy | Carlow town | Full-time, on-site with field travel

*About Infinite Energy*

Infinite Energy is a solar PV company based in Carlow. We install across Leinster and the south-east, and are a well established, rapidly growing solar company.

The business is built on electrical engineering. Every system is designed, specified and signed off by people who understand the load, the roof and the grid connection. That is a good story, and almost none of it is on film.

*The role*

Make Infinite Energy the most visible solar installer in the south-east by turning real installs, real customers and real engineering into video, photography and written content that runs every week without being chased.

That is what this job does. The website, the social channels, the referral engine and the material the sales team carries into a kitchen — all of it comes from this seat.

This is a production role, not a strategy role. The output is content, shipped on a schedule.

Video — about half the job

* Film on site at installs across Carlow, Kilkenny, Wexford, Wicklow, Kildare and Dublin. Expect two to three shoot days a week, most of them out of the office.
* Cut short-form vertical video for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube Shorts: install timelapses, before and after, engineer explainers, what a 7.14 kWp system actually does to a bill.
* Film and edit customer testimonials. These are the highest-value asset the sales team has and there are nowhere near enough of them.
* Produce longer pieces two or three times a year: company film, system explainer, recruitment video.
* Own the full chain. Shoot, edit, grade, subtitle, export to spec for each platform. Nobody is editing behind you.

Photography — about a fifth

* Build a proper library of install photography: roof work, array detail, inverter and battery installs, crews at work, finished systems in situ.
* Shoot customer and team portraits, van and site photography, and product shots of GoodWe and Sigenergy hardware.
* Keep the library tagged and organised so sales, quoting and web can pull from it without asking you.

Written content — about a third

* Website copy: service pages, county and area pages, case studies.
* Case studies built from completed installs. System size, what the customer was paying before, what they pay now, what the engineering decision was and why.
* Blog and SEO articles on grants, SEAI, battery storage, export tariffs and system sizing.
* Email content for the customer and prospect lists.
* Social captions, ad copy support, and copy for sales collateral.

*What the job is judged on*

Alongside the three disciplines you keep the calendar, get written release consent from customers before filming or photographing their home, and report monthly on what was published and what it did — reach, engagement, video views, website sessions, form fills.

What we're looking for

Essential

* Two to four years producing content in-house or at an agency, with a reel and a writing portfolio you can show. The reel matters more than the CV.
* Able to shoot and edit alone. Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, Photoshop or Lightroom, and comfortable on a camera in bad Irish weather on a roof-adjacent site.

The ideal candidate will operate, secure, troubleshoot, and continuously improve cloud and hybrid network services that support business-critical platforms.

This role combines strong cloud operations capability with advanced knowledge of network architecture and protocols. The successful candidate will take ownership of Azure connectivity and network security services, support hybrid connectivity with on-premises and other cloud environments, automate network deployment and configuration, and lead the diagnosis and resolution of complex connectivity and performance issues.

Who you are

  • Extensive hands-on experience operating Microsoft Azure infrastructure, with advanced expertise in Azure networking.

  • Deep experience with Azure Virtual Network, peering, routing, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link, Private DNS, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Front Door, and Network Watcher.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot end-to-end connectivity and performance across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments using packet captures, flow logs, route analysis, DNS tools, and platform telemetry.
  • Experience with enterprise firewalls, network virtual appliances, web application firewalls, and traffic management technologies.
  • Experience using Terraform for repeatable, controlled Infrastructure as Code deployments.
  • Experience operating production services, responding to incidents, managing changes, and completing root cause analysis.
  • Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to produce accurate technical documentation and explain complex network issues to technical stakeholders.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Fortinet, F5, or comparable enterprise firewall and application delivery platforms.
  • Experience with Azure Virtual WAN, Azure Route Server, multi-region connectivity, and multi-cloud networking.
  • Knowledge of Zero Trust networking, PCI-DSS controls, and network segmentation in regulated environments.
