About Planet

Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers.

We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day.

Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time.

Founded over 35 years ago and with our headquarters in London, today we have more than 2,500 employees located across six continents serving our customers in more than 120 markets.

Role overview:

This is a fixed-term contract designed to support Planet’s AI-first engineering scale-up project.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to join Planet's AI team and lead our commercial data science work. You'll partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to turn customer and revenue data into models and insights that directly move the top line — reducing churn, surfacing cross-sell opportunities, and giving the business a clear view of what's driving revenue.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who enjoys working close to the business, owns problems end-to-end, and can balance rigorous modelling with pragmatic delivery.

What you will do

Churn modelling — Build, deploy, and iterate on customer churn prediction models. Identify leading indicators, segment at-risk cohorts, and work with Customer Success on retention playbooks.
Cross-sell & upsell — Develop propensity models and next-best-action recommendations to help commercial teams prioritise accounts and product conversations.
Revenue attribution & tracking — Design attribution frameworks across marketing channels, sales motions, and product touchpoints. Build the data products that let leadership see what's actually driving revenue.
Experimentation — Design and analyse A/B tests and quasi-experiments for commercial initiatives. Bring statistical rigour to business decisions.
Productionisation — Take models from notebook to production. Own the full lifecycle: feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring, retraining.
Stakeholder partnership — Translate ambiguous commercial questions into well-scoped analytical problems. Communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences.

Who you are

5+ years in applied data science, with significant experience on commercial problems (churn, LTV, propensity, attribution, pricing, or similar).
Strong SQL and Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels). Comfortable building production-grade code, not just notebooks.
Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse — BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
Experience deploying models on AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, ECS, or similar).
Solid grounding in statistics, experimentation, and causal inference — you know when a correlation isn't enough.
Track record of shipping models that are actually used by the business, not just built.
Excellent communication — you can explain a model to a CFO and debug a feature pipeline with an engineer in the same afternoon.

Nice-to-have

Experience with n8n or other workflow automation tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster).
Exposure to payments, fintech, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue businesses.
DBT experience for analytics engineering.
Experience integrating LLMs or GenAI into commercial workflows.

Why Planet:

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

We would love to hear from you – Apply now.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.
About Us

Company Background

Planet provides integrated software, payment and technology solutions for its customers in the Hospitality and Retail sectors and worldwide via a network of global Financial Services Partners.

Founded over 35 years ago, we have evolved our services, delivering an innovative digital commerce platform that puts customer experience first.

With headquarters in London and around 3,000 expert employees located across six continents we serve customers in over 120 markets.

The role

We're looking for a product designer who can make complex software clear and usable, and carry a design from understanding the problem through implementation and review.

You'll work closely with another designer, engineers, and product and technology leadership to make complex software clear and usable. We're looking for someone who enjoys hands-on design, asks thoughtful questions, and can explain the reasoning behind their work.

We welcome junior, mid-level, and senior candidates. Junior designers will work on defined projects with guidance and regular review from an experienced designer. Mid-level designers will independently carry defined product work through implementation. Senior designers will take broader ownership of ambiguous problems and patterns shared across the product.

What you'll do

  • Understand the workflow. Learn what users are trying to accomplish, where the current experience breaks down, and which parts of the problem matter most. Use conversations, support feedback, research and usage data to inform your work.
  • Design coherent experiences. Map flows and create designs and prototypes in Figma. Work with teammates to identify what each user role needs, including permissions, empty states, errors, and other important edge cases.

  • Make your work easy to build and review. Keep designs, intended behavior, edge cases and decision notes clear enough that teammates can follow them without a live walkthrough. Seek critique early and use it to improve the work.
  • Follow the design into the product. Review implementations with teammates, identify confusing or broken interactions, and help resolve them. Learn how design decisions translate into the shipped product.
  • Learn from real use. Look for places where people get stuck or behave differently than expected, and bring those findings back into the next design decision.

For senior candidates, we'd also look for evidence of framing ambiguous problems, improving patterns across multiple workflows and helping teammates make stronger design decisions.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is growing quickly across EMEA, and we need recruiters who can help us hire exceptional people into the teams that bring our work to customers. We’re looking for a Recruiter, GTM to join our Talent team in Dublin and own full-cycle recruiting across our Go-To-Market organization, with a particular focus on Applied AI.

This is a full-cycle individual-contributor role. You’ll partner with Applied AI and GTM leaders to define what great looks like, build pipelines in markets where these roles are still new, and close candidates who have competing offers. Some of the roles you’ll run won’t have an established market benchmark, so you’ll help build the playbook as well as follow it. Priorities shift quickly, and you’ll have real ownership of the searches you run.

Key responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Applied AI and broader GTM roles across EMEA, with a focus on London, Paris and Munich, from intake through offer and close
  • Run intake sessions that scope the role, calibrate the bar, and challenge hiring managers where expectations don’t match the market
  • Screen candidates against the JD with enough technical judgment to separate strong from merely well-presented
  • Source and engage active and passive candidates, building diverse and competitive pipelines in markets where talent is scarce
  • Run structured, rigorous and candidate-centric interview processes that uphold Anthropic’s hiring bar
  • Work with the broader Talent team, People Partners and Compensation to structure offers and guide candidates to close
  • Own pipeline health, tracking conversion, calibration and time-in-stage, and use the data to give hiring managers clear recommendations
  • Help build and document the Applied AI and GTM hiring playbooks as the team scales

Minimum qualifications

  • 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a track record of closing strong candidates in competitive markets
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting GTM or customer-facing roles in the UK and European markets, with working knowledge of local talent dynamics, compensation norms and employment practices
  • Strong stakeholder partnership: you build trust quickly with senior hiring managers in fast-moving environments
  • Willingness and ability to build technical depth quickly enough to run credible intake sessions and screens for Applied AI roles
  • Proven ability to maintain quality under volume pressure and manage multiple searches at once
  • Comfort with ambiguity and with building something new rather than running an established playbook
  • Self-starter who works autonomously while staying aligned with global hiring strategy
  • Genuine interest in Anthropic’s mission and an understanding of the role recruiting plays in achieving it

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience hiring technical customer-facing talent (Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, Sales Engineers, or Applied AI/ML-adjacent roles) at an AI, SaaS or high-growth technology company
  • Experience recruiting across Sales, Partnerships or Marketing in addition to technical GTM roles
  • Experience scoping roles that have no established market benchmark
  • Experience hiring across multiple EMEA markets, including the UK, France and Germany
  • Familiarity with Greenhouse or similar ATS platforms
  • Additional European language skills (French or German especially)

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

€125.000 - €170.000 EUR

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

About Planet


Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers.

We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day.

Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time.


Founded over 35 years ago and with our headquarters in London, today we have more than 2,500 employees located across six continents serving our customers in more than 120 markets.


Role overview:


This is a fixed-term contract designed to support Planet’s AI-first engineering scale-up project.


We're hiring a Data Scientist to join Planet's AI team and lead our commercial data science work. You'll partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to turn customer and revenue data into models and insights that directly move the top line — reducing churn, surfacing cross-sell opportunities, and giving the business a clear view of what's driving revenue.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who enjoys working close to the business, owns problems end-to-end, and can balance rigorous modelling with pragmatic delivery.


What you will do

  • Churn modelling — Build, deploy, and iterate on customer churn prediction models. Identify leading indicators, segment at-risk cohorts, and work with Customer Success on retention playbooks.
  • Cross-sell & upsell — Develop propensity models and next-best-action recommendations to help commercial teams prioritise accounts and product conversations.
  • Revenue attribution & tracking — Design attribution frameworks across marketing channels, sales motions, and product touchpoints. Build the data products that let leadership see what's actually driving revenue.
  • Experimentation — Design and analyse A/B tests and quasi-experiments for commercial initiatives. Bring statistical rigour to business decisions.
  • Productionisation — Take models from notebook to production. Own the full lifecycle: feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring, retraining.
  • Stakeholder partnership — Translate ambiguous commercial questions into well-scoped analytical problems. Communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences.


Who you are

  • 5+ years in applied data science, with significant experience on commercial problems (churn, LTV, propensity, attribution, pricing, or similar).
  • Strong SQL and Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels). Comfortable building production-grade code, not just notebooks.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse — BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
  • Experience deploying models on AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, ECS, or similar).
  • Solid grounding in statistics, experimentation, and causal inference — you know when a correlation isn't enough.
  • Track record of shipping models that are actually used by the business, not just built.
  • Excellent communication — you can explain a model to a CFO and debug a feature pipeline with an engineer in the same afternoon.


Nice-to-have

  • Experience with n8n or other workflow automation tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster).
  • Exposure to payments, fintech, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue businesses.
  • DBT experience for analytics engineering.
  • Experience integrating LLMs or GenAI into commercial workflows.


Why Planet:

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.


We would love to hear from you – Apply now.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.


Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.


About Us

Company Background

Planet provides integrated software, payment and technology solutions for its customers in the Hospitality and Retail sectors and worldwide via a network of global Financial Services Partners.

Founded over 35 years ago, we have evolved our services, delivering an innovative digital commerce platform that puts customer experience first.

With headquarters in London and around 3,000 expert employees located across six continents we serve customers in over 120 markets.

Exceptional personal development, training and progression plans, designed to allow you to shine in your career, all in line with your personal ambition

24 days annual leave, plus bank holidays - holiday structure
Family friendly policies for new parents or if you provide care for a dependant

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us:

Spectrum.Life is a whole-of-health digital partner that guides organisations and their people to thrive, delivering clinically backed digital health, mental health and wellbeing solutions.

Our HealthTech delivers digital transformation for Insurers, Educators and Employers through Co-creation or seamlessly integrated out-of-the-box solutions, that decrease digital fragmentation and engage, empower, and transform their people’s lives.

Established in 2018 by Stuart McGoldrick and Stephen Costello, Spectrum.Life provides services internationally to over 7.2m insurance members, 3,000 corporate clients, 60 universities and 650,000 university students. Spectrum.Life currently employs over 450 people.

Our vision is to change and save as many lives as possible.


Role Brief:

We are looking for a Junior Product Manager with around two years’ experience to join our Product team at Spectrum.Life. You will support the delivery of products from discovery through to launch and ongoing improvement, working across our full product portfolio, with connected mental health at its core, under the guidance of the Head of Product and alongside more experienced Product Managers. This role suits someone who has built a solid foundation in product management and is ready to grow their scope, confidence and ownership.

You will bring a good grounding in product management practice and a willingness to learn how modern software is built. A technical understanding is desirable rather than essential, and we will support you to develop it. You won’t be expected to write code. You will be expected to turn needs into clear requirements, apply our prioritisation approach with discipline, and help take products to market and keep them improving.

You will work closely with our clinical, commercial, technical and data teams, so that what we build is clinically safe, commercially sound and valued by the organisations and people who use it. A clinical background is not required, though some understanding is desirable and we will help you build it. We operate in a regulated healthcare environment, and you will learn how to help us deliver at pace without compromising safety, quality or governance.

Product strategy and roadmap


  • Support the product vision, strategy and roadmap, bringing insight from clients, users, clinicians and delivery teams.
  • Contribute to business cases that set out customer value, commercial impact, effort and risk.
  • Use market insight, client feedback, usage data and outcomes data to help identify opportunities and inform what we build next.
Working as part of the Product team
  • Work as part of the wider Product team, alongside the other Product Managers and the Head of Product, sharing knowledge, standards and good practice.
  • Take part in roadmap, prioritisation and planning sessions, offering constructive challenge and aligning on shared decisions.
  • Track dependencies with other product workstreams and flag risks early, so that delivery across the portfolio stays joined up.
  • Take part in peer review of requirements and documentation, giving and receiving feedback, and cover for colleagues where needed.
Discovery and requirements

  • Support stakeholder workshops and produce clear documentation, process flows and system diagrams.
Delivery
  • Manage and refine the product backlog for your products, prioritising features, enhancements and technical debt based on value, risk and effort, with guidance from senior colleagues.
  • Work with engineering, QA, architecture and UX to plan, refine and deliver high-quality releases on time.
  • Run sprint ceremonies and product demos, and escalate blockers promptly to keep delivery moving.
  • Plan releases and publish clear release notes for stakeholders after each deployment.
  • Review and respond to small works and change requests, and manage them against roadmap priorities with support from the Head of Product.
Clinical governance and quality
  • Work with the Head of Product and internal clinical teams to embed clinical requirements and safety considerations from the start.
  • Support clinical sign-off, risk assessment and change control, keeping documentation audit ready.
  • Contribute to regulatory and quality documentation where products fall within a regulated framework, including requirements traceability.
Go-to-market and commercial support
  • Support Commercial and Marketing to position products and respond to bids and tenders, and join client meetings, with increasing responsibility, to explain product capability.
  • Help define and track success measures, including adoption, engagement, clinical outcomes and commercial performance, and act on what they show.
  • Support launch readiness with Customer Success and Operations, and provide post-launch support and iteration.
Ways of working
  • Work with the team to apply our product standards and ways of working consistently, sharing ideas and learning so that we keep improving together.

jobs.title: Database Engineer III, RDS for Oracle
jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION

Amazon Web Services is hiring a Database Engineer III for the RDS for Oracle team. We are looking for a Senior Database Engineer to join the RDS Oracle Database Engineering team and take a leadership role in ensuring customer success and shaping the future of our managed database service.

About the Role

As a Database Engineer III on the RDS Oracle team, you will serve as an expert in Oracle database architecture and internals, operating with high autonomy and limited guidance to lead complex investigations and deliver solutions that span multiple engineers and teams. You will lead design reviews for new features, architect solutions to systemic issues, and standardize approaches across the broader RDS organization. During critical customer escalations, you will rapidly assess scope and urgency, implement effective mitigations, and drive cross-functional efforts to permanently eliminate root causes, collaborating across RDS engine teams where solutions can be shared.

Beyond reactive support, you will proactively establish monitoring, testing, and prevention strategies that identify and address potential issues before they impact customers. You will bring customer learnings back to the engineering org to influence roadmaps, validate feature designs through end-to-end test scenarios, and build automation that improves operational efficiency at scale. You will lead complex projects requiring multiple engineers, mentor junior DBEs and SDEs, and establish best practices that become team and organizational standards.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about databases, customer-obsessed, and ready to own ambiguous, high-impact problems end to end with minimal direction. Your work directly impacts how enterprises run their most critical databases on AWS. If you want to lead technical strategy for how enterprises run Oracle workloads in the cloud, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
You will own database architecture for Oracle on RDS, driving best practices and setting team standards while proactively identifying and addressing architectural deficiencies. You will work on Oracle database internals, storage architecture, replication, performance optimization, and integration with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, and IAM. You will lead design and implementation of complex features that scale to millions of database instances, from database automation and infrastructure to operational tooling. You will perform on-call duties encompassing incident response, troubleshooting, and customer support. Acting as the voice of the customer, you will bring learnings into the engineering process to design new features and plan end-to-end test scenarios. You will present database best practices at conferences and workshops, mentor junior DBEs and SDEs, and influence team strategy to resolve complex or systemic problems across the organization.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and five years of progressive post-baccalaureate experience in the job offered or a related occupation. Must have five years of experience in the following skill(s): (1) designing, architecting, and leading development of robust and scalable database automation solutions; (2) mentoring software engineers and database engineers on database internals and best practices; (3) leading execution of and building comprehensive automation frameworks around database benchmarking and performance validation; (4) with code database management tooling in PL/SQL and Java, including establishing coding standards and reusable patterns; (5) defining specifications and driving technical strategy for database-specific roadmap items; and (6) leading on-call operations for managed database services, including incident response, root cause analysis, and driving permanent resolution of systemic issues.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10 or more years of experience working with relational database systems, with deep knowledge of Oracle database internals including storage engines, query optimization, PGA/SGA memory management, and replication mechanisms. Experience designing and operating Oracle high availability solutions including Multi-AZ deployments, Data Guard configurations, and read replicas on Amazon RDS. Experience with RDS Custom for Oracle, including migration planning and enterprise-scale optimization. Experience architecting Oracle database solutions integrated with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch. Experience building operational tooling and automation for managed Oracle database services at scale, leading customer engagements for Oracle database migration and optimization on AWS, and presenting database best practices at conferences or workshops.

jobs.title: Energy Engineer - CEOs Office
jobs.description:
Energy Engineer, CEO's Office

Climeaction | Cork, Ireland | Permanent, full time | Regular travel to the US

Compress ten years of industrial energy experience into two. Work directly with the CEO of an Irish B Corp industrial decarbonization consultancy, on live pharmaceutical, medical device, food and dairy sites in Ireland and the US, and come out the far side leading your own assessment team.

This is the fastest route we know into senior industrial energy engineering. It is also demanding, with regular international travel. Read the section on what it demands before you apply.

What you will do

You work for one person: the CEO. You join every client site visit he makes, and within months you run them.

Walk industrial sites with the CEO, interview utilities managers and gather the data that others miss.

Build site mass and energy balances and model heat recovery, heat pumps, thermal storage, electrification and fuel switching.

Write the FAST reports, Basis of Design studies and Measurement and Verification (MV) plans that clients act on.

Write the technical content of proposals and join the calls that win them.

Present findings to site leadership and client boards, first alongside the CEO, then on your own.

Document the method as you learn it. You will teach it to the team you build.

Why this accelerates your career

Breadth in two years, not ten. Steam, refrigeration, compressed air, heat pumps, thermal storage, process heat integration and MV, across four manufacturing sectors. Most engineers see two or three of these in a decade on one site.

The method from the person who built it. One-to-one with the founder for 24 months, on every site visit, every report and every client call. No one else in the firm gets this.

The rooms that matter. You present to engineering directors, site heads and client boards from your first year. That is normally a ten-year wait.

Two markets. Cork base, Boston office, client sites in Ireland and the US. Few Irish engineers at this stage get to work the US industrial market.

A named destination. Establish and lead a FAST delivery team, reporting to the CEO, with a planning target of 18 to 24 months. You leave this role as a team lead, not as a senior engineer.

Backing to match. Chartership support, a salary that steps up at each development gate.

What it demands

Read this twice. It is written to put off anyone who wants a steady desk job.

If that list reads as a challenge rather than a warning, keep going.

Hours .Assessment weeks mean early starts, late finishes and 2 to 4days on site. We work within Irish working time law, and this role uses the room inside it.

Travel. Regular international travel, mainly to the US, sometimes at short notice. A valid passport and the ability to travel to the US without restriction are required. Expect several trips a year, each typically one to two weeks.

Scrutiny. The CEO reviews your work line by line until it no longer needs it. You take direct feedback daily and act on it the same day.

Ambiguity. Priorities move with the client pipeline. You are often the only engineer on the task and the structure around you is thin by design.

Duration. Two years of this before you lead a team. There is no shortcut.

Who we are looking for

Degree in mechanical, process, chemical or energy engineering. Working towards chartership.

2 to 5 years in industrial utilities, energy consulting, site engineering or a graduate programme in one of these.

Exposure to plant-scale steam, hot water, refrigeration, compressed air or HVAC systems and how they are metered.

Can build a basic energy balance from site data with guidance. Writes clearly and takes editing without complaint.

Full driving licence. Based in Cork or willing to relocate.

Has no issue / restrictions with travel to the USA for 1 - 3 weeks at a time on a regular basis.

Wants to lead a team and says so.

Package

Salary: early-career engineer grade, stepping up at each development gate. Band confirmed at first interview.

Start: Q 4 2026 / Q1 2027.

About Climeaction

Climeaction is a B Corp certified industrial decarbonisation and carbon intelligence consultancy, headquartered at 11 South Mall, Cork, with offices in Boston. We run FAST assessments, Basis of Design studies, MV programmes and multi-year carbon reduction programmes for pharmaceutical, medical device, food and dairy manufacturers in Ireland and the US. Our deliverables are engineering documents that get built, not slide decks that get filed.

Graduate Materials Engineer

Are you looking to kick-start your career as a Graduate Materials Engineer and gain valuable experience in a growing organisation? If so, we are looking for an ambitious graduate to join our Manufacturing Team. We want to be part of your career journey and help you development your career.

At the end of your 2-year Graduate Programme, you will have gained: International work experience, a qualification reliant to your field, fully trained in-house auditor and 2-years work experience. The successful candidate must be available to relocate to a sister company for a period of 6 months should the opportunity present itself.


Duties Include:

  • Assist in the selection and evaluation of materials for new and existing products
  • Conduct material testing and analysis to assess performance, durability and compliance with specification
  • Support investigations into material failures, defects and quality concerns, identifying root causes and recommending corrective actions.
  • Assist with product development projects by providing material- related technical input and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, quality and engineering teams to improve product performance and production efficiency.
  • Analyse test results and prepare reports, presentations and recommendations for stakeholders.
  • Assist with supplier evaluations and the qualification of new materials and components.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, regulations and internal quality requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on material performance, sustainability and cost reduction.
  • Stay informed of developments in materials technology, manufacturing processes and industry best practices.
  • Adhere to all health, safety and environmental procedures while carrying out engineering activities.
  • Ad hoc duties as assigned by management.

Skills and Characteristics

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Science or Engineering
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to analyse data effectively.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Effective teamwork skills are essential

What do we offer?

At Tricel, we care about you and your progression. As well as a competitive salary and benefits package, we offer:

  • Excellent development and growth opportunities
  • A supportive and collaborative culture
  • Opportunities to Travel
  • A fun and dynamic work environment
  • Team oriented atmosphere
  • Good work, life balance
  • Opportunity to work across countries and cultures
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Tax-free vouchers up to the value of €1,500
  • Sports and Social club
  • Health and Wellbeing initiatives
  • Enhanced Maternity leave
  • Health Insurance Contribution
  • Free onsite parking

About Tricel

Tricel, a family-run business, was founded in 1973 by Anne Stack and Con Stack. This year marks the company’s 50th year in business. The company began by producing products from glass-reinforced plastics (GRP). It expanded its exports and established manufacturing facilities throughout the UK and Europe by implementing a comprehensive growth strategy in the 1990s and 2000s. The Stack family leads Tricel, which provides market-leading solutions in over 50 countries. Among the markets served by the company are storage tanks, pumps, sewage treatment tanks, construction products, and lubricant and composite distribution. With its headquarters in Killarney, the Tricel Group consists of 15 companies across Europe, including seven manufacturing facilities. The company employs more than 600 people at these locations. The company has grown domestically and internationally by manufacturing locally, exporting, partnering with local distributors, and acquiring companies that enhance its product capabilities and geographical reach. In the next five years, the

company’s roadmap for growth will continue to be based on three main pillars: Customer Excellence, Innovation & Sustainability.

  • Good inter-personal and communication skills
  • Strong engineering, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong collaborative skills with an ability to work effectively in a team environment
  • Have a willingness to learn and be challenged in the water and wastewater Industry
  • Interest in implementing opportunities and initiatives in a time restricted schedule
  • Develop specific goals and plans to prioritise, organise and accomplish stated deadlines

  • Strong communication skills and an enthusiasm about working in a highly driven team
  • Full EU/ Irish driving licence

  • Robust graduate programme
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth
  • CPD accredited employer
  • A collaborative and supportive work environment
  • Laptop or desktop and work mobile phone provided

Our vision is to be the best and most rewarding place to work for our teams, to be our customer's outstanding partner of choice and we are committed to being a Net Zero, sustainable business.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Bioquell, an Ecolab company, is a world leader in providing high-tech bio-decontamination equipment and services within healthcare, life sciences and military environments. Our unique low temperature, residue-free hydrogen peroxide vaporization (HPV) technology has been proven to provide rapid, repeatable, safe and reliable eradication of microbiological pathogens from rooms and other interior spaces.

The role of Bioquell Service Engineer, within part of Ecolab’s Life Science Division. You will be responsible for the service, installation, commission, breakdown, repair, and calibration of a wide range of innovative bio-decontamination equipment, utilised within life sciences, healthcare and pharmaceutical environments.

The role will report into the Services Supervisor and be part of a team of UK and Irish engineers. The quality and care that we put into our products and services saves lives, and a key part of this role is delivering a great customer experience; the ideal candidate will demonstrate experience in a customer facing role. Our customers expect great service and we’re focused on providing exceptional products combined with a world-class level of aftercare.

What you'll do

Technical

Install, commission, and verify medical devices/systems at customer sites in accordance with project plans, approved procedures, and safety requirements.
Perform equipment qualification and verification activities as applicable (e.g., IQ/OQ/PQ, GCD), including documenting results, deviations, and customer sign-off.
Perform preventive and corrective maintenance, diagnostics, and on-site repairs to restore system performance and minimise downtime.
Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, software, and network-related faults using appropriate tools, procedures, and controlled documentation.
Execute preventive and corrective maintenance, calibration checks (where applicable), and on-site repairs to restore performance and minimise downtime.
Complete accurate service documentation (service reports, checklists, device history records as applicable), ensuring traceability and compliance with quality system requirements.

Safety & Compliance

Comply with relevant regulations and standards as applicable, as well as customer site policies (GMP).
Coordinate with customers (lab managers, biomedical/clinical engineering, QA) to complete site work, manage access, and communicate status, risks, and next steps.
Escalate complex or recurring issues with clear evidence (logs, photos, measurements) and participate in root cause analysis and corrective actions/preventive actions (CAPA) as required.
Ensure compliance with applicable standards and site rules (HSE, permits, access control, tool calibration, ESD as relevant).

Administrative

Provide customer training and operational guidance; support handover, acceptance, and readiness for audit/inspection where relevant.
Maintain readiness for extensive travel and regular overtime, including after-hours support during critical deployments or incident response.
Support acceptance testing, handover, and performance verification; contribute to continuous improvement of procedures and knowledge base articles.

What you'll need

HND / degree in Engineering (Biomedical, Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electronics, or similar) or equivalent practical industry experience.
Proven experience in field service, commissioning, maintenance or technical support for complex equipment - preferably in life science, healthcare, or other regulated environments.
Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware and software; ability to read schematics, wiring diagrams and technical manuals.
Working knowledge of quality documentation practices in GMP (e.g., following controlled procedures, completing checklists, recording results, and maintaining clear service records).
Familiarity with test equipment and tools, and safe working practices (including electrical safety where applicable).
Basic understanding of networking concepts (IP addressing, cabling, switches) and working with logs/configurations.
Ability to work independently at customer sites, manage multiple priorities, and maintain professionalism in customer-facing settings.
Valid UK / Ireland driving licence and ability to travel extensively, including frequent overnight hotel stays and regular overtime.
Clear written and verbal communication skills; customer-facing professionalism
No immigration sponsorship available for this role
Not allergic to penicillin

If you are excited about this opportunity, don’t be put off by all the experiences and qualifications in our job descriptions, we encourage you to apply anyways. You never know you could be just the right candidate for this position or for other roles.

At Ecolab, we believe the best teams are diverse and inclusive, and we are on a journey to create a workplace where every associate can grow and achieve their best. We are committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants. We recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement on the basis of individual qualifications and job performance. jobs.title: CNC Operator
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about precision engineering, cutting-edge technology, and creating components that make a real impact? Join EireComposites as a CNC Operator and play a key role in producing high-performance composite components for aerospace, renewable energy, industrial, and R&D projects.

Working with advanced 3-axis and 5-axis CNC machines, you will be involved in everything from machine setup and programming to quality inspection and continuous improvement. Whether you're an experienced CNC operator or a technically minded individual eager to develop your skills, we offer the opportunity to work on exciting, innovative projects while receiving ongoing training and development.

This role would suit a candidate looking to work locally in Connemara in a friendly environment that is teams based, supportive and friendly.

About Us

Established in 1998, ÉireComposites operates an accredited composites design, manufacturing and testing facility in Inverin, Galway. With over 60 employees, we have the experience, depth expertise and knowledge supplying into aviation, space, renewables and mobility sectors.

ÉireComposites is dedicated to improving society through the commercialisation of cutting-edge research on composite materials.

Job Summary

The CNC (Computer Numerical Control) Operator role is responsible for setting up, operating and maintaining the CNC machines to produce precision parts and components for EireComposites aerospace and non-aerospace in multi sectors including Research and Development.

Key Responsibilities

1. Machine Setup and Operation:

  • Set up and operate CNC machines according to technical drawings and specifications.
  • Load and unload materials into machines. Ensure proper machine alignment and calibration for accurate operation.
  • Select and install the appropriate tools required for each job.
  • Ensure the equipment is operated safely & maintained according to manufacturer’s recommendations.
  • Work as key contributors within a cross-functional team delivering projects in a time and cost-effective manner.
  • Loading & unloading of parts.

2. Programming and Adjustments:

  • Review engineering drawings & models to determine part specifications, tolerances, and tooling requirements.
  • Create and modify CNC programmes & simulations for specific tasks.
  • Monitor machine performance and feedback details to key stakeholders.

3. Quality Control:

  • Inspect parts using measuring tools to ensure they meet required tolerances and specifications.
  • Perform routine checks on the machine and finished products to maintain quality standards.
  • Document and report any deviations from specifications and work with quality control and engineering teams as appropriate to resolve issues.

4. Machine Maintenance:

  • Perform basic maintenance on machines, including cleaning, lubrication, and tool replacement.
  • Report any mechanical or electrical issues to maintenance and manager.
  • Ensure machines are in optimal working condition to reduce and avoid downtime.

5. Safety and Compliance:

  • Follow all safety protocols and procedures to maintain a safe working environment.
  • Ensure machines and tools are properly maintained to avoid accidents or malfunctions.
  • Comply with company operation, company policy, environmental, and health and safety policies.

6. Team Collaboration:

  • Work closely with engineers, production team and manager to optimize production efficiency.
  • Complete ongoing training and seek mentoring to support learning needs.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and manager to address production issues and improve processes working together.
  • 7. Performing other duties as requested.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Leaving certificate or equivalent, technical diploma or associate degree in CNC machining, manufacturing technology or related fields of study.
  • A relevant technical or engineering discipline, to a minimum of FETAC Level 6 or hold equivalent experience in setting and operating multi-axis machining centres.
  • A qualification in and or working knowledge of CAD is desirable, not essential.

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience with CNC machines, including 3 and 5-axis machines. Experience with CAD/CAM software such as SolidWorks and or Hypermill.
  • Knowledge and experience of core composite manufacturing methods are desirable, not essential.

Skills

  • Skill in reading and interpreting technical drawings. Use of precision measuring tools and understanding of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
  • Strong knowledge of machine tooling and set-up techniques.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications such as WORD and EXCEL.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve machine or production issues quickly ensuring precision and quality.

Other

jobs.description:
Engineer


Amey are a leading provider of full life-cycle engineering, operations and decarbonisation solutions, for transport infrastructure and complex facilities.

Working for us, you’ll be delivering sustainable infrastructure solutions that enhance life and protect our shared future.

Our people are driven by a set of strong values, based on safety, insight and collaboration.

The Opportunity


The Opportunity

We have a fantastic opportunity for a permanent Bridge Engineer to join our Consulting Structures team in Dublin.

With our network of offices across the UK and now Ireland, we are open to discussing working options that match your needs, with the flexibility to change how you work as your life evolves.

Located in Dublin's thriving Docklands, our new office at The Freight Building is at the heart of our expansion in Ireland. It provides a modern, flexible workspace designed for collaboration and innovation. You will join a vibrant team of engineers, project managers, data analysts, commercial experts, safety specialists and operatives working together to support national and regional infrastructure priorities.

Amey’s growth in Ireland is supported by strong partnerships with transport authorities such as Transport Infrastructure Ireland (TII) and Iarnród Éireann through various infrastructure frameworks. These include projects to improve strategic road and rail networks, enhancing safety, strengthening resilience, and improving connectivity for communities across Ireland.


The role

As a Structures Engineer you will provide effective support and assistance to your Design Team Leader on a variety of Structures schemes whilst taking the lead on projects and mentoring junior engineers and technicians. Responsibilities include:

  • Leading a team, producing technically sound engineering solutions.
  • Taking ownership and leading projects from start to finish, from preparing the quotation all the way to handover.
  • Preparation and checking of designs, calculations, drawings and documentation as part of the production of scheme deliverables that satisfy the criteria of quality, cost and programme.
  • Overseeing the actions of more junior members of staff undertaking similar tasks and taking responsibility for their actions.
  • Contributing to the professional development of junior staff and acting as a Delegated Engineer.
  • Liaising with Client and supplier representatives at peer level, attending progress meetings, and responding to queries.
  • Managing a small, locally based single discipline technical team and taking responsibility for delivery of their workload.
  • Contributing to the preparation of bids and general work winning function.
  • Drive effective Health and Safety practices within the team.


What you will bring to us:

  • Developed experience and expertise within Structures field, probably gained in an Engineer role or equivalent.
  • An ability to produce or oversee the production of technically sound engineering solutions, complying with all relevant technical standards and Client’s requirements.
  • Takes ownership for the preparation and checking of deliverables and can check deliverables to a reasonable standard.
  • Very good working knowledge of relevant software and similar analytical tools (e.g LUSAS, Autodesk Structural Bridge Design).
  • Demonstrates good commercial awareness.
  • Has a good understanding of CDM and risk assessment.
  • Substantially experienced in the management and communication of hazards and risks on projects and ensures appropriate risk mitigation and transference has been applied.
  • Demonstrates a good understanding of interface management, and ensures own deliverables align with deliverables produced by other disciplines.
  • Incorporated or Chartered status with the ICE or IstructE. or an equivalent professional licence gained through the professional institution to which the individual is aligned is desirable and may be essential on particular contracts.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in an appropriate subject or demonstrable equivalent further learning.


What we can offer

Our benefits are designed to help you thrive at work and in your home life. You will have the flexibility to choose benefits and development opportunities that are best for you.


Some of our benefits include:

  • Exceptional personal development, training and progression plans, designed to allow you to shine in your career, all in line with your personal ambition
  • Competitive salary and compensation
  • Generous pension scheme, with extra contributions from Amey
  • 24 days annual leave, plus bank holidays - holiday structure
  • Family friendly policies for new parents or if you provide care for a dependant
  • Membership of our Affinity Networks who connect, support and inspire diverse communities within Amey
  • Two Social Impact Days each year, for volunteering and fundraising opportunities


About Amey

Who we are

Amey is a global, integrated infrastructure consultancy and operations partner. We design, deliver, protect, and maintain critical assets and systems.

What we do

We advise, design, finance, deliver, and enhance civic, transport, and defence systems. By combining strategic intelligence, engineering, infrastructure finance, and operational expertise, we create secure, resilient, compliant, and high-value outcomes across the lifecycles of new and legacy assets.

To find out more visit our website amey.co.uk/careers

jobs.title: Graduate Programme 2027 - M&E Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role
What if your next step made a real difference?

We are BAM. One of Europe's leading construction and civil engineering businesses.

For over 150 years, we have been creating the places, spaces and infrastructure that people rely on every day. But what drives us is not just what we are building, it is how and why we are building it.

We want to leave a lasting legacy, improving local communities, protecting our environment and benefiting society as a whole. So, no matter where you join us, you will be part of something bigger.

Because here, the world we all want to live in will be made by you.

About our Graduate Programme

As a graduate at BAM, you will take on real responsibility from day one, contributing to projects that make a lasting difference while continuing to build your technical knowledge, professional skills and commercial understanding.

You will follow a structured development programme, receive support from experienced colleagues and work towards the professional chartership that is right for your discipline. Along the way, you will build confidence, broaden your experience and discover where your career can take you.

About the Role

As a Graduate M&E Engineer, you will play an important role in the successful delivery of some of Ireland's most exciting construction and infrastructure projects.

Working alongside project teams, design consultants, specialist subcontractors and experienced engineers, you will gain practical experience across all stages of the project lifecycle, helping to ensure mechanical and electrical systems are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest quality standards.

You will develop your technical knowledge across building services systems, including mechanical, electrical, public health and associated specialist installations. You will gain hands-on experience supporting design coordination, technical reviews, commissioning activities, quality assurance processes, programme management and project delivery.

This role offers the opportunity to work on landmark projects across a range of sectors while developing a strong understanding of modern construction methods, sustainable building solutions and industry best practice.

Supported by experienced colleagues and our dedicated Early Careers Team, you will take on real responsibility from day one while building the knowledge, skills and experience needed for a successful career in building services and M&E engineering.

What You Will Need

The best opportunities do not always come with an easy day. Whether you are working on site or in the office, you will be someone who enjoys getting stuck in, taking on new challenges and learning through experience. You will be resilient, positive and ready to make the most of every opportunity that comes your way.

To be considered for this programme, you will:

• Be studying towards, or have recently completed, a relevant degree in Building Services Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline at an Irish third-level institution or university.

• Be due to graduate in Summer 2027 or have recently graduated.

• Have a genuine interest in the construction industry and the delivery of building services systems.

• Demonstrate strong communication and teamwork skills.

• Be eager to learn, broaden your experience and take on responsibility.

• Have strong analytical, technical and problem-solving abilities.

• Be committed to delivering work professionally and to a high standard.

• Have a desire to work towards professional accreditation and chartership.

Most importantly, we are looking for individuals who are enthusiastic, motivated and excited to help build a more sustainable tomorrow.

What's in it for you?

Joining BAM means becoming part of a business that is committed to developing people and creating places that make a lasting difference.

Alongside a competitive salary, you will benefit from structured development, support from experienced mentors and opportunities to work towards professional qualifications.

You will also have access to a wide range of benefits, including:

• Competitive salary

jobs.description:
Centre Administrator – Innovation & Industry Engagement

Tyndall National Institute is an international leader in semiconductors, photonics and deep-tech research and innovation. As a leading collaborative European research institute, Tyndall is a key actor and hosting partner in the delivery of the ‘Chips for Europe Initiative’ (EU Chips Act).

Tyndall is Ireland’s leading research and innovation organisation and it is the national focal point for excellence in deep-tech research, development and graduate training at the convergence of nanotechnology, microelectronics, photonics, electronics and AI. Tyndall is recognised as an international research leader in semiconductor, chip and digital technologies, particularly as applied to the fields of Information & Communications, Health & Life Sciences, Agritech & Food Security, Energy and Climate Mitigation, emerging fields such as quantum, and novel computing paradigms.

The Institute’s key objective is to see frontier research activities having a significant impact on economic development and societal challenges in Ireland, Europe and beyond. Central to Tyndall’s mission is delivering economic impact through research excellence in partnership with industry and academia. With an annual turnover of more than €50m, the Institute has a community of over 600 researchers, engineers, support staff, postgraduate students, interns and industry researchers-in-residence.

With significant committed Irish government support, Tyndall will grow to be 1,000 people by 2030, with approximately 750 researchers, including 250 PhD students. A new 17,000 m2 research building is under development adjacent to the Cork headquarters and there are developing plans to expand Tyndall’s existing Dublin research labs and to establish other research sites within Ireland.

Tyndall’s expansion is also supported by recent national and EU funding wins for significant (M€10’s) additional research equipment across a range of areas such as semiconductor processing, microscopy, quantum technologies, heterogeneous integration, ultra-high speed optical communications and RF through THz characterisation.

About the Team

The Innovation and Industry Engagement Centre is composed of a team of mostly industry experienced individuals tasked with creating the environment to commercialise Tyndall’s breakthrough innovations to support the growth of Ireland’s semiconductor sector. The team works closely with Tyndall’s researchers to co-develop, and transfer, next generation technologies and to commercialise our platform technologies through spin-out companies. In addition, the Centre hosts the Irish Chips Competence Centre (I-C3), whose role is to support semiconductor start-ups and SMEs with design, access to the EU Pilot Lines, funding and training.

About the Role

You will be an integrated team member in Tyndall’s Innovation & Industry Engagement (I&IE) Centre, supporting the Director and centre staff across a range of administrative activities in the day to day management of the centre. This will involve working closely with the team members to ensure that the centre operates effectively and delivers on its objectives, while also supporting the development and implementation of effective financial, budgetary, quality, client engagement and marketing processes which are key to the institute’s success.

You will also act as the Administrator for hosted I&IE awards, such as the Irish Chips Competence Centre (IC-3). Here you will support the I-C3 team across our partner organisations, MIDAS and Nova UCD in the day to day management of the award and the efficient operation of the centre.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
Efficiently manage all aspects of administration for the centre on a day-to-day basis.
Assist the I&IE Director in the development and management of appropriate administrative structures and procedures.
Assist the centre team with KPI reporting.
Deal with complex and non-routine queries from staff and external contacts where relevant.
Organisation of, and full participation in team meetings with accurate minute taking and coordination of follow up actions.
Organisation of industry visits and events and assist with events organised by Tyndall centrally as required.
Maintain an awareness of the industry engagement activities of the centre, from client engagement to marketing and out-reach, so as to maximise the effectiveness of the team.
Own the administration of the Salesforce CRM and team databases, working with the Director and external service providers to ensure effective implementation and effectiveness of the platform.
Manage and assist with any external requirements of the team, including board meetings, conference organisation, external committees and liaison with external clients and stakeholders.
Administer all relevant budgetary tasks including purchasing and cost controls for the Centre.
Define and publish financial updates and analysis as may be required by the centre and other functional units in Tyndall.
Provide support for incoming visitors and for related seminars/workshops, including any travel arrangements/accommodation and facilities arrangements as required.
Provide support for the centre team’s travel arrangements/accommodation and facility needs.
Process all procurement for the centre, including related paperwork.
Process expenses claims for the centre team and liaise with finance and other operational functions as required.

Provide assistance to the Office of the CEO and other centre administrator positions from time to time as required.
Develop and manage an efficient tracking and filing system to allow for immediate access and retrieval of all documentation.

PhD - Wideband Balun Technologies and Advanced IC Packaging

About Tyndall

Tyndall National Institute is an international leader in semiconductors, photonics and deep-tech research and innovation. As a leading collaborative European research institute, Tyndall is a key actor and hosting partner in the delivery of the ‘Chips for Europe Initiative’ (EU Chips Act).

Tyndall is Ireland’s leading research and innovation organisation and it is the national focal point for excellence in deep-tech research, development and graduate training at the convergence of nanotechnology, microelectronics, photonics, electronics and AI. Tyndall is recognised as an international research leader in semiconductor, chip and digital technologies, particularly as applied to the fields of Information & Communications, Health & Life Sciences, Agritech & Food Security, Energy and Climate Mitigation, emerging fields such as quantum, and novel computing paradigms.

The Institute’s key objective is to see frontier research activities having a significant impact on economic development and societal challenges in Ireland, Europe and beyond. Central to Tyndall’s mission is delivering economic impact through research excellence in partnership with industry and academia. With an annual turnover of more than €50m, the Institute has a community of over 600 researchers, engineers, support staff, postgraduate students, interns and industry researchers-in-residence.

With significant committed Irish government support, Tyndall will grow to be 1,000 people by 2030, with approximately 750 researchers, including 250 PhD students. A new 17,000 m2 research building is under development adjacent to the Cork headquarters and there are developing plans to expand Tyndall’s existing Dublin research labs and to establish other research sites within Ireland.

Tyndall’s expansion is also supported by recent national and EU funding wins for significant (M€10’s) additional research equipment across a range of areas such as semiconductor processing, microscopy, quantum technologies, heterogeneous integration, ultra-high speed optical communications and RF through THz characterisation.

About the Role
Tyndall National Institute, University College Cork, in collaboration with AMD, is offering a fully funded PhD opportunity as part of a joint research programme between the two organisations. The programme is designed to foster close collaboration and knowledge exchange between Tyndall National Institute and AMD, while developing advanced RF technologies for next-generation integrated circuits and packaging.

The PhD study will focus on the investigation, design, characterisation, fabrication, and optimisation of wideband balun technologies and their integration into advanced IC packages. Baluns are critical components in many RF and high-frequency systems, providing balanced-to-unbalanced signal conversion and enabling efficient interfacing between various circuit architectures. As operating frequencies and bandwidth requirements continue to increase, the integration of high-performance baluns within compact IC packages presents significant challenges in terms of bandwidth, insertion loss, impedance matching, parasitic effects, electromagnetic coupling, and manufacturability.

The project will investigate innovative approaches to addressing these challenges, with research spanning:
Investigation of different balun architectures and their performance limits
Electromagnetic modelling and RF/mm-wave characterisation of balun structures
Fabrication and experimental validation of prototype structures
Investigation of electromagnetic interactions and parasitic effects associated with IC packaging
Optimisation of balun performance for package-level integration
Development and validation of simulation and measurement methodologies
Evaluation of the resulting technologies for relevant high-frequency integrated-circuit applications
The project will combine electromagnetic simulation, RF/mm-wave measurements, device fabrication and advanced packaging, providing the candidate with broad multidisciplinary research experience.

Industrial Collaboration
A key feature of this PhD is close collaboration with AMD. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to engage with researchers and engineers from AMD and gain exposure to industrial research and development practices. The collaboration will provide an environment in which fundamental research can be translated towards practical semiconductor and packaging applications. The candidate will benefit from knowledge exchange between academia and industry and will have the opportunity to develop an understanding of the challenges associated with taking advanced RF technologies from concept through to experimental validation and integration.

Research Environment
The research will be conducted at Tyndall National Institute, one of Europe's leading research centres in integrated ICT technologies. The candidate will have access to Tyndall's extensive research infrastructure for RF, microwave and mm-wave device development, simulation, fabrication and characterisation. The student will join a multidisciplinary research environment involving researchers working across RF and mm-wave technologies, integrated circuits, advanced materials, semiconductor devices, packaging, electromagnetics and wireless systems.

Key Responsibilities
This is an exciting PhD project in a rapidly evolving and highly industrially relevant area of RF/mm-wave technologies and advanced IC packaging. The successful candidate will work under the direction of the Principal Investigator and co-supervisors and will become an integral member of a collaborative research team at Tyndall National Institute, working closely with researchers and engineers from AMD.

jobs.title: Graduate Programme 2027 - M&E Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

What if your next step made a real difference?

We are BAM. One of Europe's leading construction and civil engineering businesses.

For over 150 years, we have been creating the places, spaces and infrastructure that people rely on every day. But what drives us is not just what we are building, it is how and why we are building it.

We want to leave a lasting legacy, improving local communities, protecting our environment and benefiting society as a whole. So, no matter where you join us, you will be part of something bigger.

Because here, the world we all want to live in will be made by you.

About our Graduate Programme

As a graduate at BAM, you will take on real responsibility from day one, contributing to projects that make a lasting difference while continuing to build your technical knowledge, professional skills and commercial understanding.

You will follow a structured development programme, receive support from experienced colleagues and work towards the professional chartership that is right for your discipline. Along the way, you will build confidence, broaden your experience and discover where your career can take you.

About the Role

As a Graduate M&E Engineer, you will play an important role in the successful delivery of some of Ireland's most exciting construction and infrastructure projects.

Working alongside project teams, design consultants, specialist subcontractors and experienced engineers, you will gain practical experience across all stages of the project lifecycle, helping to ensure mechanical and electrical systems are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest quality standards.

You will develop your technical knowledge across building services systems, including mechanical, electrical, public health and associated specialist installations. You will gain hands-on experience supporting design coordination, technical reviews, commissioning activities, quality assurance processes, programme management and project delivery.

This role offers the opportunity to work on landmark projects across a range of sectors while developing a strong understanding of modern construction methods, sustainable building solutions and industry best practice.

Supported by experienced colleagues and our dedicated Early Careers Team, you will take on real responsibility from day one while building the knowledge, skills and experience needed for a successful career in building services and M&E engineering.

What You Will Need

The best opportunities do not always come with an easy day. Whether you are working on site or in the office, you will be someone who enjoys getting stuck in, taking on new challenges and learning through experience. You will be resilient, positive and ready to make the most of every opportunity that comes your way.

To be considered for this programme, you will:

  • Be studying towards, or have recently completed, a relevant degree in Building Services Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline at an Irish third-level institution or university.
  • Be due to graduate in Summer 2027 or have recently graduated.
  • Have a genuine interest in the construction industry and the delivery of building services systems.
  • Demonstrate strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Be eager to learn, broaden your experience and take on responsibility.
  • Have strong analytical, technical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Be committed to delivering work professionally and to a high standard.
  • Have a desire to work towards professional accreditation and chartership.

Most importantly, we are looking for individuals who are enthusiastic, motivated and excited to help build a more sustainable tomorrow.

What's in it for you?

Joining BAM means becoming part of a business that is committed to developing people and creating places that make a lasting difference.

Alongside a competitive salary, you will benefit from structured development, support from experienced mentors and opportunities to work towards professional qualifications.

You will also have access to a wide range of benefits, including:

  • Competitive salary
  • Company car or travel allowance (where applicable)
  • Matched pension contributions
  • Private healthcare
  • Life assurance
  • 26 Days annual leave
  • Wellbeing and volunteering days
  • Flexible working opportunities
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • BAM Benefits retail discounts
  • Professional membership support (where applicable)

Because when you grow, we grow too.

About your business area: Construction

Made by creating places that matter.

From schools and hospitals to commercial buildings and public spaces, you will work alongside talented people who are passionate about delivering projects that leave a lasting positive impact.

You will help bring complex buildings to life through the delivery of critical mechanical and electrical systems, ensuring the environments we create are efficient, sustainable and ready for the future.

You will see ideas become reality while building your own skills, confidence and career along the way.

jobs.title: Sustainability Engineer
jobs.description:
Due to continued growth and expansion, Building Envelope Technologies (BET), one of Ireland's leading specialists in airtightness, building performance and compliance, is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Mechanical / Sustainability Engineer to join our expanding team at our headquarters in Ferns, Co. Wexford.

This is an excellent opportunity for an individual with an engineering background who is interested in developing their career in sustainability, energy efficiency and building performance.

Requirements

  • A relevant qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Sustainability Engineering, Energy Engineering, Building Services Engineering or a related discipline.
  • An understanding of building energy performance, sustainability and energy efficiency principles.
  • Knowledge of Building Regulations, particularly TGD Part L & Part F (NZEB), would be an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, technical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings.
  • Good communication, organisational and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate technical documentation.
  • Previous experience in thermal assessments or building performance testing would be beneficial but is not essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the delivery of sustainability, energy efficiency and building performance projects.
  • Carry out technical assessments and calculations relating to energy performance and Building Regulations compliance.
  • Provide guidance and technical support to clients on TGD Part L & Part F (NZEB) requirements.
  • Review architectural drawings, engineering specifications and other relevant technical documentation.
  • Prepare drawings and supporting information for technical calculations, assessments and reports.
  • Support SEAI grant applications and building energy upgrade projects.
  • Assist with energy assessments and recommend practical improvements to building performance.
  • Work closely with clients, architects, engineers, contractors and other project stakeholders.
  • Prepare technical reports, findings and recommendations.
  • Attend site surveys and inspections as required.
  • Collaborate with BET's technical departments, including airtightness, ventilation, acoustics and sustainability.
  • Support thermal assessments and analysis where required.
  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of Building Regulations, SEAI requirements and relevant industry standards.

The Ideal Candidate

We are interested in hearing from graduates, junior engineers and experienced professionals who have a relevant technical background and a keen interest in sustainability and building performance.

We also welcome applications from individuals currently working within the construction or engineering industry who are interested in retraining or transitioning into the sustainability sector.

While previous experience would be an advantage, it is not essential. We value a positive attitude, willingness to learn and a genuine interest in developing technical knowledge and skills.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, depending on experience.
  • Full training and ongoing professional development.
  • Career progression opportunities within a growing company.
  • Exposure to a wide variety of projects across the construction industry.
  • A supportive working environment with an experienced technical team.

If you're looking for an opportunity to develop your skills and build a rewarding career in sustainability and building performance, we'd love to hear from you.

Join the BET team and be part of our continued growth and success!

Pay: From €34,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Bike to work scheme
  • Company events
  • On-site parking

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Controls Engineer - Job Description
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an Controls Engineer to take responsibility for delivering PLC, SCADA/HMI and MES projects for manufacturing and life sciences customers, and to lead and develop our junior engineers.

You’ll need at least two years’ experience delivering PLC and SCADA/HMI projects, including hands-on programming and on-site commissioning. You should be comfortable working directly with customers, defining requirements, making engineering decisions and taking projects through testing, commissioning and handover.

The role involves:

  • Designing, programming and commissioning PLC and SCADA/HMI systems.
  • Understanding customer processes and translating them into clear requirements and practical automation solutions.
  • Managing project scope, budget, schedule and customer commitments.
  • Planning and directing junior engineers’ work, reviewing their output and developing their skills.
  • Troubleshooting and improving systems on customer sites.

Essential experience and qualifications:

  • Two or more years delivering PLC and SCADA/HMI projects, including on-site commissioning.
  • Hands-on programming experience with Rockwell Studio 5000, Siemens TIA Portal or an equivalent PLC platform.
  • Experience with Ignition, FactoryTalk View, WinCC or an equivalent SCADA/HMI platform.
  • Proven experience leading projects and managing customer relationships.
  • A Level 8 honours engineering degree or equivalent.
  • A full, clean driving licence, eligibility to work in Ireland and willingness to travel regularly to customer sites.

Experience in pharmaceutical, medical device or food and nutrition manufacturing, together with knowledge of MES, batch control or validation, would be an advantage.

This is a permanent, full-time role based in Newbridge, Co. Kildare, with hybrid working and regular customer-site travel. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, ongoing technical training and opportunities to progress into Lead Engineer and management roles.

When applying, please include a short summary of the PLC and SCADA/HMI platforms you’ve used, your commissioning experience and a project you personally led, explaining your responsibilities.
