jobs.title: Digital Investigations Specialist
jobs.description: Role Overview:The Digital Investigations Specialist will support the newly established Digital Investigations Unit within the Wholesale Compliance and Governance unit, which is responsible for compliance investigations and enforcement. This role involves undertaking the preservation, collection, analysis, and reporting of digital evidence, supporting electronic discovery activities, and assisting with the operation of eDiscovery review platforms. The Specialist will also provide digital investigation support and technical expertise to the Wholesale Compliance and Governance team, along with other teams within ComReg. The role requires a strong practical foundation in digital forensics, together with the ability to prepare clear, accurate, and evidentially supported technical reports. The Digital Investigations Specialist will report directly to the Digital Investigations Manager.Key Responsibilities:Technical Expertise and Support:Provide practical digital forensic and eDiscovery support to investigative teams, assisting in the identification, acquisition, preservation, processing, examination, analysis, interpretation and reporting of digital evidence.Respond to technical enquiries related to digital investigations and provide practical technical guidance to investigative teams, escalating matters requiring the Digital Investigations Manager as appropriate.Evidence Handling and Management:Undertake and support the collection, preservation, processing, examination and analysis of digital evidence using approved tools, methods and procedures while maintaining accurate contemporaneous records, chain-of-custody information and a clear audit trail.Apply approved protocols for the secure handling and storage of digital evidence within the Digital Investigations Unit and provide practical input to their development and review.Prepare clear, accurate and evidentially supported reports setting out the work undertaken, the methodology applied, relevant findings, and technical limitations.Digital Evidence Review Platforms:Operate and support digital evidence review platforms, including the ingestion, processing, filtering, searching, review preparation, export, and controlled production of electronically stored information. Support and provide practical guidance to investigative teams in the use of digital evidence review tools and technologies, including search, review, tagging, and the controlled export of relevant material.Assist investigative teams in refining search criteria, identifying potentially relevant data sources, preparing material for review, and documenting the steps applied.Collaboration and Communication:Work closely with investigative teams to integrate digital forensic findings into broader investigations.Communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.Quality Assurance and Compliance:Carry out assigned digital forensic activities in accordance with approved procedures and adhering to industry best practices and legal requirements.Support quality reviews, testing, and audit activities, and contribute to the technical and evidential review of reports, examination records, and other work products in accordance with approved quality-assurance arrangements. Continuous Improvement:Stay informed about the latest developments in digital forensics, eDiscovery and identify tools or methodologies that may improve the Unit’s work.Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the Digital Investigations Unit.Please note that there will be an element of travel to client site from time to time.Qualifications and Experience required Essential:Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics, cybercrime investigations or a related field. jobs.title: Data Operator (Human In The Loop)
jobs.description: Our Data Operations team analyses, investigates and accurately processes the information held on the Equifax UK database, capturing, loading and amending consumer and commercial data to make sure the highest possible standards are maintained. Increasingly, this work is automated or part-automated, where AI and automated rules load incoming data, validate it, flag discrepancies, match records and propose amendments. All of this activity requires supervision and management, and this is where the  Human in the Loop (HITL)  comes in.As a Human in the Loop (HITL) Data Operator, you will work as part of a dedicated, successful and focused team, monitoring automated data processing and providing assurance that data is loaded, amended and maintained correctly, in line with the quality models, policies and processes that govern the regulated environment within which we operate. Where data requires intervention, you will perform remedial action, analyse what went wrong, and feed back on the process to continuously improve and evolve the performance of the automation. You'll have the authority to challenge, override or pause automated decisions where you believe the outcome is wrong, and you'll use the appropriate escalation channels for technical obstacles, incident management, data security and individual client or consumer complaints.We believe great things happen when teams connect. Our schedule is built around  4 days of high-impact, in-office collaboration (Monday–Thursday)  , paired with  Friday Flexibility  to wrap up your week remotely.What You’ll Do Supervise the automated and part-automated loading, amendment, maintenance and deletion of consumer and commercial data on Equifax databases, forming your own view from the source data rather than relying on the system's recommendation.  Intervene, override or pause automated processing where data is being handled incorrectly, such as a record matched to the wrong consumer or an amendment that would compromise data accuracy, and record your reasons each time.  Load, amend, maintain and delete consumer and commercial data directly where cases fall outside the automation or require manual handling.  Analyse data information, applying your knowledge, training and support to bring queries to resolution, including those the automation could not resolve.  Strictly adhere to quality control procedures, carrying out quality sampling of data the automation processed without intervention, and highlight any discrepancies or anomalies as required.  Act on defined escalation triggers, such as low system confidence, unusual error rates, unexpected changes in submitted data, potential consumer impact or data security concerns, and escalate data issues so that data quality is maintained and not compromised.  Spot patterns in automation errors (incorrect matching, misread fields, false discrepancy flags, inconsistent amendments) and log them in a structured way so the system can be improved.  Watch for data issues that could unfairly or inconsistently affect particular groups of consumers, and raise concerns.  Ensure authentication and permission is valid for submitted data from both closed user groups and data pools, including where this is checked automatically, and assist where necessary with the on-boarding of new clients.  Liaise with inter-departmental agents, their managers and Technology to progress resolution of issues, support the development of new and improved automated solutions, and demonstrate “as is” or “to be” approaches as required.  Liaise with internal and external departments or customers in an engaged, professional and pleasant manner, and advise as required on data compliance and legislation.  Ensure full compliance with data protection requirements and accuracy of input, whether processed by you or by the automation, in line with quality protocols, training and instruction received.  Manage and receive urgent requests to support your manager in delivering prompt resolutions to escalated issues or complaints.  Undertake ad-hoc tasks to help improve the integrity of the Equifax databases.  Assist with the training and development of new team members as required, including sharing what you learn about how the automation performs.  Maintain system, tool and skills awareness, consistently seeking to develop your knowledge of your own and other team members' core roles.  Act as an ambassador for the Equifax brand, support our core values and our mission of “helping our consumers live their financial best”, and contribute positively to a productive team culture that delivers both quality and efficiency of service to our customers. What Experience You Need An extremely high attention to detail.  A questioning mindset: confident enough to challenge a system output or a colleague's assumption.  Comfortable working with AI-generated outputs and automated checks, while knowing they can be wrong.  An extremely high standard of written communication, including being able to explain your reasoning clearly for audit trails and feedback.  Excellent interpersonal skills to communicate effectively and concisely with colleagues, stakeholders and customers.  Problem resolution and analytical skills, with the ability to identify problems and proactively contribute to a suitable resolution.  Excellent organisational, planning and time management abilities, with effective prioritisation of workloads.  The ability to coordinate multiple tasks at the same time while staying calm.  A professional, respectful and courteous manner, and the ability to build effective relationships with team mates, clients and internal and external stakeholders.  Enthusiasm, energy and flexibility in achieving shared goals, and a positive approach to embracing change.  Eagerness to learn new tasks and develop cross-trained, multi-skilled competencies.  A team player with strong emotional maturity, keen to contribute ideas that help continually improve our working processes.  Minimum

jobs.title: Aviation Noise & Flight Tracking Coordinator
jobs.description: Job DescriptionCareer Level: 7 | Career Family: Data Intelligence | Career Sub-Family: Business Data Analytics and Data ScienceThe Aviation Noise & Flight Tracking Coordinator supports the Aviation Noise Operations Manager in the delivery of Dublin Airport's aircraft noise management and noise mitigation programmes. The role is responsible for aircraft noise monitoring, flight track analysis, complaint investigation, stakeholder engagement, environmental reporting, regulatory compliance and the implementation of noise mitigation initiatives.Working closely with internal departments, consultants and community stakeholders, the coordinator provides technical analysis and operational support to ensure effective noise management, compliance with environmental obligations and continuous improvement in aviation noise performance. The role also supports the management and development of the airport's noise monitoring infrastructure, flight tracking systems, environmental monitoring programmes and community engagement activities.Responsibilities Manage aircraft noise complaints, conducting investigations using noise monitoring and flight tracking data, and provide timely, evidence-based responses.  Monitor aircraft noise performance, flight tracks, NPR adherence and operational procedures using our noise and flight track monitoring system, identifying trends, anomalies and operational issues.  Investigate noise events, flight track deviations and operational irregularities, producing reports, maps and technical assessments as required.  Maintain, analyse and enhance noise, flight tracking and complaint databases, supporting performance monitoring and continuous improvement.  Prepare regulatory submissions, compliance reports, environmental reports and responses to audits, inspections and regulatory requests.  Coordinate the deployment, maintenance and operation of permanent and temporary Noise Monitoring Terminals (NMTs), including stakeholder liaison for site access and installations.  Prepare technical reports, presentations, briefing materials and performance updates for internal stakeholders, community groups, airport forums and external stakeholders.  Support community engagement initiatives and maintain public-facing noise information resources, including WebTrak, the Noise Information Portal and airport noise webpages.  Provide technical advice on aircraft noise management, flight tracking, environmental monitoring and noise mitigation measures, supporting compliance with regulatory and ICAO requirements.  Support the delivery of aircraft noise management projects, monitoring initiatives and system enhancements, working with internal stakeholders and service providers to improve monitoring, reporting and analytical capabilities. Experience QUALIFICATIONS  Minimum one year of experience in an aviation, environmental or analytical role.  Experience analysing and interpreting complex datasets and preparing technical reports.  Experience working with specialist monitoring, reporting or operational systems.  Experience engaging with internal and external stakeholders and managing competing priorities.  Experience in environmental monitoring, aviation operations, flight tracking, community engagement or regulatory compliance would be advantageous.  Experience using noise monitoring systems, GIS software, Power BI or similar analytical tools would be desirable. Skills Strong analytical and investigative skills with the ability to interpret technical and operational data.  Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.  Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel (including pivot tables, formulas and data analysis), Word and PowerPoint.  Strong written communication skills, including technical report writing and stakeholder correspondence.  Effective presentation and stakeholder engagement skills.  Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary team.  Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.  Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines simultaneously.  Experience with Power BI, GIS platforms and data visualisation tools is advantageous.  Commitment to continuous improvement and professional development.  Demonstrates daa values and behaviours. Education & Qualifications Educated to diploma or degree level in Aviation, Environmental Science, Environmental Management, Data Analytics, Engineering or a related discipline.  Understanding of airport operations, aircraft flight procedures, air traffic management and aircraft noise management principles is desirable.  Knowledge of environmental regulations, regulatory reporting and aviation industry practices is desirable.  Understanding of GIS, data visualisation and environmental monitoring systems would be advantageous.  Knowledge of GDPR and data management requirements. Mandatory Practicing/Training/Compliance Certification Valid driving licence is desirable , as occasional travel to noise monitoring sites and stakeholder locations may be required. About UsWe're an airport industry leader with operations in four continents and over 3000 employees working together to ensure we deliver the best services for all our customers globally. We are a fast paced, energetic and diverse company. Offering careers that range from IT, Finance, Technical, Airport Operations to frontline security and customer focused roles and many more. Whether you are starting your career or looking for your next move, we have lots of great opportunities to choose from.

If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Software Developer – Quality & Test Automation
jobs.description: Meet the TeamAs a global technology leader, Cisco has been transforming how people connect, communicate, and collaborate for decades. Our innovation in networking, security, and cloud-based solutions enables organizations to drive digital transformation and achieve their business goals. The Collaboration Employee Experience organization creates workspace solutions that connect people, places, and experiences.Located in Galway, Ireland, you will be part of our engineering team, working closely with colleagues both locally and as part of a wider international team spanning Oslo and the United States. You will work closely with Cisco’s Devices organization — a team of 300+ passionate engineers across hardware, software, mechanics, audio, media processing, and artificial intelligence — from concept to product. Together we strive to create best-in-class video conferencing experiences by bringing diverse engineering disciplines under one mission.Your ImpactYou are a software developer with a quality and automation mindset. You enjoy taking ownership of test strategy, building automation that others can rely on, and helping the team move from ad-hoc verification to a systematic, scalable quality practice. You thrive as part of a team and contribute to our culture of shared learning, yet you are equally comfortable taking ownership and figuring things out independently when needed.You WillBuild and maintain automated tests and test infrastructure in Python (and related languages as needed), covering unit, integration, and device-level scenariosHelp design and take our quality and testing approach to the next level — from test strategy and coverage through CI integration, reporting, and debug workflowsWork across the software stack, from Linux-level behaviour on our devices through to application and meeting-platform integration, to identify gaps and close them with automationSet up metrics, dashboards, and alarms that make product quality and test health visible and actionableImprove developer workflows by building tooling — including AI-assisted test generation, triage, and operational support where it adds real valueBuild software with quality and attention to detail, and help the team focus on continuous improvement — whether related to code quality or internal processesMinimum QualificationsDegree in computer science or equivalent6 years+ of professional software or test automation engineering experienceExperience in Python, C++, including writing clean code, testing, and debuggingExperience writing unit and integration tests, and building or extending automated test suitesExperience working with Linux and NetworkingPreferred QualificationsFamiliarity with core DevOps tools such as Git, Linux/Unix environments, CI/CD pipelines, and basic containerization (Docker)Experience testing or automating against embedded, Android, or device platformsFamiliarity with building or integrating APIsInterest or experience in using AI tools (for example AI agents, MCP, or LLMs) to automate development, test, and operational workflowsStrong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skillsExcellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence quality practices across a teamWhy Cisco?At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Solution Engineering, you will then join the Sales Graduate Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will gain exposure to both roles. The time spent mastering the fundamentals of these complementary disciplines will enable you to be more productive and impactful upon promotion.Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. jobs.description: EHR Medication Management Build Team MemberLocation: Swift Square, Dublin 9 and Kilkenny (Hybrid)Job type: Specified PurposeOverview of role: The Medication Management Build Team Member will play a pivotal role in supporting the Cúram Electronic Health Record (EHR) system across UPMC Ireland. Reporting to the Medication Management Workstream Lead, this role focuses on assisting with the configuration, testing, and validation of Medication Management-related applications, including the Medication Management module and supporting capabilities, with a primary focus on medication management services. The Medication Management Build Team Member will contribute to aligning system functionality with medication management staff under the guidance of the Medication Management Workstream Lead. Primary Duties and Responsibilities: The Medication Management Build Team Member will support the Medication Management Workstream Lead in delivering the Medication Management workstream for the Cúram EHR implementation within UPMC Ireland. The role involves assisting in executing tasks within the project scope and governance, including stakeholder coordination and milestone tracking. The member will collaborate with the Medication Management Workstream Lead and other workstream members to ensure alignment with medication management operations and programme goals. Additionally, the role includes contributing to the documentation of workflows, system configurations, and testing different outcomes (e.g. interoperability, data migration, reporting, end-user devices) to support a seamless end-user experience.  System Design & Workflow Support: Assist in the design and validation of medication management workflows within MEDITECH Expanse and associated applications, working closely with analysts and operational leaders. Review and provide feedback on system functionality related to medication management processes. Support the integration of medication management workflows with financial processes to ensure clinical/financial integrity and compliance with quality requirements. Collaborate with clinical and technical teams to maintain end-to-end clinical integrity across modules.  Implementation Support, Data Validation & Testing: Assist in Medication Management system configuration, data migration validation, and integration with existing or planned enterprise platforms. Participate in testing activities for Medication Management modules, including integrated testing and user acceptance testing (UAT), under the guidance of the Medication Management Workstream Lead. Help identify and troubleshoot issues in collaboration with IT, finance, and clinical teams. Support the integration of Medication Management-facing modules with other clinical systems (e.g., Physician Care Manager, Order management, laboratory, pharmacy) to ensure seamless care delivery and documentation. Assist in validating statutory, management, and operational reporting requirements for Medication Management functions. Support change management efforts by addressing workflow impacts, practice changes, and documentation requirements for Medication Management staff. Contribute to go-live readiness and stabilization efforts, including supporting real-time issue resolution and workflow adjustments. Contribute to standards development processes and engage with Medication Management SMEs during design and optimization discussions. Ensure compliance with regulatory, accreditation, and safety standards (e.g., HIQA) as directed.  Team Collaboration & Support: Assist in coordinating cross-functional provider systems implementation activities across consultants, advanced nurse practitioners, resident medical staff etc. Participate in workgroup meetings, documenting decisions, risks, and issues as directed. Act as a secondary liaison between Medication Management services and the Cúram implementation team, escalating issues to the Medication Management Workstream Lead as needed. Assist in the development and delivery of training materials for Medication Management staff and other relevant end-users. Provide hands-on support during go-live and stabilization phases, helping to ensure continuity of Medication Management operations. Support the training team in delivering education on Medication Management workflows within MEDITECH Expanse and associated applications. Contribute to the handover process by supporting training delivery to the future EHR BAU team members.  Documentation & Governance: Maintain accurate project documentation, including current state/future state maps, risk/issue logs, and change logs, as assigned by the Medication Management Workstream Lead. Assist in preparing materials for governance processes, such as the Clinical Design Forum and senior management meetings. Support the tracking of key performance indicators (KPIs) for Medication Management readiness, adoption, and post-go-live performance. Contribute to documenting lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements related to clinical safety and digital health as directed. Qualifications & Experience:Required: Minimum 3 years of hospital medicines management experience, including direct involvement in medication-use processes - as a pharmacist, pharmacy technician or similar roles (e.g. nurse). Familiarity with medication management workflows, clinical documentation, and interdisciplinary care models. Good project coordination, stakeholder engagement, and change management skills. Good analytical thinking, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work across clinical and operational teams.  Preferred:Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy (BPharm) or Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD), or pharmacy technician qualifications. Minimum 2 years of experience supporting or leading system implementations (preferably MEDITECH or similar ERP/EHR platforms). Experience as a user of MEDITECH Expanse medication management m

jobs.title: 2027 Graduate Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Want to work with the technology that keeps factories, utilities and critical infrastructure running? Interested in PLCs, SCADA, instrumentation and control systems? Want to see the systems you engineer come to life on site?Launch your career with us and open a world of opportunities!OverviewNeoDyne is a leading engineering company specialising in industrial automation, digital manufacturing, and electrical engineering solutions. With a strong presence across multiple sectors, including Life Sciences, Food & Beverage, and Energy, NeoDyne delivers leading-edge solutions that drive efficiency, safety, and performance for its customers worldwide.We develop high-availability automation and electrical systems for mission-critical industries, including pharmaceutical manufacturing, data centres, and energy infrastructure, ensuring continuous operation and compliance. We additionally integrate emerging technologies to enhance control, scalability, and operational insight. Our expertise also extends to power generation, natural gas transmission, and high-voltage system design, delivering robust solutions that strengthen critical infrastructure.With a team of 230+ skilled engineers, our expertise spans the entire project lifecycle, from design and implementation to commissioning and operations. From our offices in Ireland, the UK, Romania, and the US, we operate on a global scale, combining technical expertise with local delivery. We support customers across Europe, North America, and Asia, delivering tailored engineering services that drive long-term success.Position SummaryNeoDyne are recruiting a Graduate Automation Engineer to join our expanding System Integration team. Our graduate programme is all about learning new and developing your existing skills. Over a two-year period, you will be placed in projects where you get to do meaningful work and contribute to the business.This Graduate opportunity is offered as a full-time permanent contract, based at our Cork Office, with an excellent salary and benefits package. If successful, you will enjoy NeoDyne's "People First" company culture, built on mutual respect, trust, and honesty, where each individual actively contributes as a valued team member.What might I be doing?Over a two-year period, you will be placed in projects where you get to do meaningful work and contribute to the business. Projects will be spread across all areas of Industrial Automation and could include PLC and SCADA design, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), control logic programming, control panel hardware design, and site testing & commissioning. They learn from every result and keep going.People still run the system. jobs.title: DSP Engineer (Digital Signal Processing)
jobs.description: About MBRYONICSMBRYONICS is at the forefront of free space optical communications. Our product portfolio covers a wide range of emerging technologies from photonic integrated circuits to advanced optical systems and embedded software solutions. Our optical communications systems are integrated and deployed in satellite communications systems. The work is exciting and challenging and is at the forefront of the technology domains. As part of our expansion, we are currently looking for a suitably motivated - DSP Engineer - to join our group.As a Digital Signal Processing (DSP) Engineer at MBRYONICS, you'll be a key player on our engineering team, translating advanced communication theory into reality for our cutting-edge optical communication systems. This role is ideally suited for a fresh PhD graduate looking to transition deep academic expertise into high-impact, space-bound hardware. You will dive into algorithm design, system modeling, and cross-functional hardware integration in a fast-paced, high-tech setting.What you'll doAlgorithm Development: Design and simulate advanced Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and Forward Error Correction (FEC) algorithms in both floating-point and fixed-point precision to optimize link performance, enhance functionality, and minimize power consumption.Hardware Co-Design: Collaborate closely with the FPGA engineering team to provide clear fixed-point models and specifications, ensuring a smooth transition of your DSP algorithms into RTL implementation.System Modeling: Develop comprehensive end-to-end models of analog RF and optical components (including lasers, modulators, photodetectors, and amplifiers) to accurately evaluate and predict system performance under real-world conditions.Cross-Functional Integration: Partner with optical testing and firmware teams to create robust, automated algorithms for transceiver calibration, beam alignment, and run-time optimization in dynamic space environments.Validation & Testing: Conduct system-level validation of your models against actual hardware performance, utilizing lab data to refine and iterate your designs.Documentation: Document your algorithm architectures, simulation results, and fixed-point specifications to support the wider engineering lifecycle.Who you areEducation: This role would be ideally suited to a Post Doctorate (or nearing completion) with a PHD in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a highly related field with a research focus on DSP or digital communications. We would also welcome applications from candidates with experience in industry rather than academia.Simulation Mastery: Extensive hands-on experience using MATLAB and Simulink for complex modeling, system simulation, and algorithm development.Theoretical Grounding: A deep, foundational understanding of digital communication theory, signal modulation, noise modeling, and error-correction techniques.Fixed-Point Familiarity: Experience converting floating-point algorithms into optimized, bit-true fixed-point models suitable for FPGA or ASIC implementation (academic or project-based experience is highly valued).Coding Skills: Proficiency in C/C++ or Python for scripting, data analysis, or rapid prototyping is a strong plus.Problem-Solving Mindset: Strong analytical and mathematical skills, with the academic rigor required to tackle open-ended, complex engineering challenges.Soft Skills & Passion: Excellent technical communication skills, a collaborative mindset eager to work across disciplines, and a genuine interest in space technology and free space optics.What's In It For YouCareer Growth: Contribute to a world-class space-age communication program while developing your leadership skills in a state-of-the-art manufacturing environmentCollaboration: Work with talented professionals across disciplines to drive impactful solutionsInnovation: Be part of a team pioneering advancements in manufacturing engineering for cutting-edge FSO systemsWork-Life Balance: Enjoy flexible work schedules and a comprehensive benefits packageIf you're ready to take your career to new heights and drive the future of space-age communication, apply now and join the MBRYONICS team as our DSP EngineerDiversity, Inclusion and Equal OpportunitiesCore ethical values, diversity and inclusion are invaluable to MBRYONICS’ business success. We recognise that the broad perspectives that result from recruiting, developing and retaining a globally diverse workforce promotes innovation and helps us succeed as a business enterprise. It is the policy and practice of the Company to provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants. The Company will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, civil status, family status, disability, age, or membership of the Traveller community.MBRYONICS is committed to providing a fair, accessible, and equitable recruitment process for everyone. If you require any assistance or a reasonable accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know.

jobs.description: Company Background:  Réaltra Space Systems is a growing SME that delivers high-performance electronic units and avionics systems for world-leading space companies. Our activities include launcher cameras and avionics for Ariane 6 and the payload interface unit for ESA’s PLATO mission. We build innovative space products in a collaborative and supportive environment. We are proud supporters of the Irish space sector. Réaltra are now increasing our team to address the growing demand from the global space commercial and institutional sectors. If you are driven to deliver ambitious projects in space, we want to hear from you. Position Overview Réaltra is looking for a hands-on Mechatronics Engineer to design, integrate, assemble and test the mechanical, electronic and embedded computer systems that make up our avionics products for space applications. The role will focus on the design, build, integration and verification of flight and engineering units, taking them from kits of parts and sub-assemblies through to fully tested, documented hardware ready for delivery. The successful candidate will build on existing design, assembly, integration and test processes and functions. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.About UsNotion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. jobs.title: Test Validation Engineer
jobs.description: Validation Tester - CSV/CSA Role Overview We are seeking a Validation Tester to support a global programme delivering Computer System Validation (CSV), Computer Software Assurance (CSA) and risk management activities across GxP-regulated systems within the Life Sciences sector.Key Responsibilities 1. Requirements Analysis and Testability Assessment Review URS, FRS, Design Specifications and related documentation to assess completeness, consistency and testability.Identify gaps, ambiguities, missing acceptance criteria and traceability concerns prior to test execution.Collaborate with Business Analysts, System Owners and Project Teams to clarify functional requirements.2. Protocol Authoring and Review Independently author and review validation test protocols aligned with CSA and risk-based validation principles.Develop both positive and negative test scenarios based on system risk, intended use and requirement criticality.Ensure adequate requirement coverage and traceability within test protocols.3. Dry Run and Test Readiness Activities Conduct protocol dry runs in development or lower environments to verify protocol accuracy and completeness.Identify protocol improvements and requirement gaps before formal qualification testing.Support review activities and incorporate feedback from Validation Leads and project stakeholders.4. Controlled Environment Testing Execute formal qualification testing in controlled QA environments following approved procedures and validation documentation.Independently assess test results and determine compliance against defined acceptance criteria.Required Experience and Qualifications Minimum 3-5 years experience in Computer System Validation (CSV), Computer Software Assurance (CSA) or regulated software testing within a GxP environment.Demonstrated experience independently authoring, reviewing and executing validation test protocols.Experience performing protocol dry runs, identifying requirement gaps and refining test coverage.Experience reviewing Functional Requirements Specifications (FRS), User Requirements Specifications (URS) and Design Specifications.Ability to independently assess functionality against requirements and document testing outcomes with minimal supervision.Experience managing deviations, incidents, defects and retesting activities through to closure.Desirable Experience Familiarity with Computer Software Assurance (CSA) and risk-based assurance principles.Knowledge of GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and relevant data integrity guidance.Experience testing enterprise systems such as MES, ERP, LIMS, QMS or other regulated business applications.Exposure to automation or AI-enabled tools used in testing and validation.12 MONTHSFIXED TERM CONTRACTWORKING FULLY REMOTEFULL TIMEWORKING US HOURS 11 - 7 APPROXSALARYPENSIONHEALTHCAREHOLIDAYSMUST HAVES;LIFE SCIENCE EXPERIENCEVALID WORK VISA

As a result, our people get to enjoy working on some of the most exciting projects in the world.Job DescriptionOur Graduate Development Programme (GDP) is a structured learning environment providing graduates with the skills and experience they need to be a successful consultant. Over the two-year programme, you will receive market-leading training through our technical training academy as well as a range of soft-skills and on-the-job learning. The GDP is blended with external qualifications and professional accreditation including SCSI , APM, CIOB and ICE to ensure you become an industry-leading professional. Project managers are responsible for the day-to-day management of the various aspects of the project, working collaboratively with different disciplines. In your role, you will support the project management commissions, taking responsibility for effectively delivering a vast range of tasks to the highest quality standard. Some of the key responsibilities will be establishing effective processes and systems to be used throughout the project, producing project plans and preparing written project communication materials. You will support the commission manager by delivering a wide range of tasks to the highest quality standards. Key responsibilities include: estimating and producing cost plans, drafting the procurement documentation, checking and analysing tenders, conducting cost checks and valuations, analysing the numbers for the final accounts and liaising with the client, contractors and designers. If you have completed or are completing a degree in quantity surveying this is the programme for you. Controls and Performance Controls and performance is a vital part of modern project delivery. Working with big data, software and complex systems, the project team will look to you as the oracle of knowledge to support informed decision making. If you are interested in risk, project planning, cost control or implementing the latest project management software, then a career in controls and performance may be for you. Suitable for both the analytical mind and the social butterfly, you will excel as you build project delivery plans, interrogate million pound cost estimates and roll out the processes and tools necessary to track and control project performance. jobs.title: Aftersales Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description: About Ashgrove: Ashgrove Renewables is one of Ireland’s longest-established renewable energy specialists, delivering a range of sustainable energy-efficient solutions to homeowners and businesses nationwide for over 25 years. A trusted SEAI-registered contractor and One Stop Shop partner, Ashgrove supports a diverse client base, providing both single-measure installations, and end-to-end energy upgrade solutions. We also support a wide range of grant schemes, including CEG, One Stop Shop and the Vacant & Derelict Housing schemes.   Role overview:As an Aftersales Technical Support Engineer, you will be the first point of technical contact once a system has been installed. Your main focus will be solar PV, batteries and EV chargers, and you will also support our heat pump customers. You will diagnose and resolve issues, mostly remotely, for customers, installers and colleagues, and prepare energy monitoring reports for our service contract customers.Key Responsibilities: PV troubleshooting (main focus): Diagnose and resolve faults on PV systems, inverters, batteries and EV chargers using remote monitoring platforms and guided checks with customers and installers. Brands include GoodWe, Huawei, Sofar, Solis, SAJ, Sigenergy and myenergi.    Heat pump troubleshooting: Support Mitsubishi and Thermia heat pump systems, including error codes, controls, commissioning settings and  performance issues, and arrange manufacturer warranty call-outs where needed.    Customer support: Respond to customer calls and emails, explain technical issues in plain language and keep customers updated until their issue is resolved.    Installer and colleague support: Give technical guidance to installers and subcontractors on site, and support the sales, design and scheduling teams with technical queries.    Energy monitoring reports: Prepare energy monitoring reports for service contract customers, highlighting system performance, any issues found and recommended actions.    Case management: Log, update and close support cases in Zoho CRM, assigning work to engineers or subcontractors and recording the outcome.    Continuous improvement: Spot recurring faults and feed them back to the install and design teams, and help keep our troubleshooting guides up to date.   Requirements Experience in a technical support, field service or installation role, ideally in solar PV, heat pumps or the electrical/mechanical sector, is an advantage but not essential. A relevant electrical or mechanical qualification is equally welcome.  Comfortable reading electrical and mechanical schematics and wiring diagrams.  A logical, methodical approach to fault-finding, including working through problems remotely.  Clear communication by phone and in writing, with the ability to explain technical issues to nontechnical customers.  Well organised, able to manage a busy caseload and prioritise urgent issues.  Takes ownership of issues and sees them through to resolution.  Full training will be provided on our products, systems and processes, so if you have the right attitude and technical aptitude, we want to hear from you.   Benefits Competitive salary commensurate with your experience  Company Pension  Performance related bonus  Bike to Work scheme  Onsite parking  Employee Discounts  Company Paid Leave  Further educational support, training and development opportunities  Sports and Social events and activities

jobs.title: Infrastructure Operations Engineer
jobs.description: OverviewTensorX is a sovereign AI infrastructure platform headquartered in Dublin. We run frontier open-weight large language models on our own NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs in European datacentres, under EU jurisdiction. Customers reach them through a drop-in OpenAI-compatible API. Nothing they send is retained after the request completes. We serve regulated enterprises in finance, healthcare and government as well as developers and AI platforms. We help them adopt AI without compromising on data privacy, compliance or performance.We are looking for an Infrastructure Operations Engineer to join our growing engineering team. Reporting to the CTO, you will keep our server estate configured, patched, monitored and working. Everything we sell runs on our own hardware: Dell PowerEdge servers, Dell switches, SAN storage, fibre and copper. The estate is growing fast.Most of your days will be in our Dublin office with the team. You will set up servers, run maintenance windows, look after monitoring and chase down errors. When hardware needs hands, you will go to the datacentre to rack, cable, swap parts or meet a Dell engineer. The servers happen to be GPU servers, but you do not need to be a GPU specialist or know how the AI models run on them. We are an AI-native team. Tools such as Claude Code and Codex are part of our daily workflow and materially accelerate how we build and operate systems.You will work with our platform and inference engineers every day to make sure the servers underneath them are ready, stable and up to date. You own each server up to a healthy, patched and monitored machine with an operating system on it. Kubernetes, the inference engines and the model-serving layer belong to other teams.We will hire at mid or senior level.This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning server builds, patching, monitoring, hardware faults and day-to-day network and storage changes.ResponsibilitiesServer build & configuration - Install, configure and update the operating system on our servers, which are mostly Dell PowerEdge. Build each server to a standard and hand it to the team in a known good state.Patch management - Keep operating systems, BIOS, iDRAC and other firmware on an agreed baseline. Plan and run maintenance windows one server at a time, with a rollback plan if something goes wrong.Observability - Set up and look after monitoring, logging and alerting for servers, storage and network. Make sure we hear about a failing disk or a flapping link before a customer does.Error management & on call - Triage hardware and OS errors and alerts. Find the cause, then fix it or escalate it. Write up what happened so it does not happen twice. Share the on-call rota for hardware and server faults.iDRAC & out-of-band management - Configure iDRAC and keep management access tidy and documented. Use it to diagnose and recover servers remotely.Hardware faults - Diagnose failed disks, DIMMs, PSUs, fans, NICs and boards. Collect logs and swap parts. Open Dell support cases and chase them to a fix.Network & firewall changes - Make day-to-day changes on our Dell switches. Move a port to a VLAN, change port speeds, set up port channels or reconfigure the LAN when needed. Make light changes on our edge gateways (rules and port forwards) under the agreed change process. Work within the existing design rather than redesign it.Storage - Make changes on our SAN and the servers attached to it: LUNs, iSCSI, multipath, disk health and capacity management.Racking & cabling - Rack, stack and cable new servers in copper and fibre to a clean, labelled standard.Documentation - Keep the asset register, rack diagrams, cabling records and runbooks accurate.Skills & Experience3+ years of professional experience as a server, systems or infrastructure engineerHands-on experience with Dell PowerEdge servers: iDRAC, Lifecycle Controller, BIOS setup, firmware updates and hardware diagnosticsLinux administration on Ubuntu or Debian: OS installs, package updates, systemd, logs and basic shell scriptingExperience running maintenance windows on production servers. You check before you rebootExperience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK or similar)Confidence making network changes at a switch command line: VLANs, trunks, LACP and port speedsConfidence making storage changes: SAN, iSCSI, RAID and multipathRacking and cabling to a professional standard, including fibre and opticsA methodical approach to troubleshooting. You change one thing at a time and write down what you findComfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) as part of your daily workflowA clear and concise communicator with engineers, datacentre staff and vendor supportNice to HaveDell Technologies Proven Professional certifications (the successors to the old DCSE), such as PowerEdge Operate (D-PE-OE-01), PowerEdge Foundations (D-PE-FN-01), Enterprise SONiC Deploy (D-SNC-DY-00) or the PowerVault ME5 Achievement (D-PV-DY-A-00)Dell Enterprise SONiC or other Dell switchingDell PowerVault ME-series storageAutomation with Ansible, racadm or the Redfish APICompTIA Server+, CompTIA Network+, CCNA or a similar certificationExperience with GPU servers or high-density, high-power racksA full clean driving licence and your own carEducation & QualificationsA relevant technical qualification OR equivalent practical experience. We care more about what you have built, fixed and kept running.RemunerationHighly competitive package, dependent on experience25 days paid annual leaveHybrid working from our centrally located Dublin office, with remote flexibilityDatacentre visits as neededFree inference tokens! ******* NO AGENCY ASSISTANCE REQUIRED *******

jobs.title: Facility Operations Center Engineer, Facilities Operation Center
jobs.description: DescriptionAWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.The Data Center Global Services organization is looking for an individual with proven and tested leadership skills to help bring to fruition a newly developed Facilities Operations Center. The Facility Operations Center is responsible for 24X7 monitoring of the data center’s physical infrastructure and will serve as a facilitator for all Large Scale Events. This team will ensure that the customer experience will be optimal and gratifying by way of consistency, reliability and attention to detail.The ideal candidate will need to have an understanding of data center IT Infrastructure and data center Facilities infrastructure and how the two entities co-exist. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing assistance and support to the onsite team. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels. Qualified candidates must also have experience functioning in a large-scale data center and have demonstrated and displayed the ability to think outside of the box. This skill is essential, as the candidate will assist with aligning the Facility Operations Center with the larger objectives of other business and peer organizations. You will need to play a role with growing the team to a standard of operational excellence.If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think and act globally; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon Data Centers, then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!Key job responsibilitiesMonitors the global data center Amazon facilities infrastructure platformServes as a Point of Contact for internal and external teamsAssists with the development of communication and escalation protocols designed to improve the team’s performanceContributes to outage post mortem analysisEnsures records are updated in a timely mannerAssists with coordination and communication during emergency recovery effortsAssists with the development of tools that will enhance the team’s performanceAbility to support a 24X7 environment (This is shift work which may require that you work weekends and holidays)Internal Job DescriptionAbout the teamDiverse ExperiencesAWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.Why AWS?Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.Work/Life BalanceWe value work-life harmony. You’ll collaborate closely with our Support and Engineering teams to ensure we deliver a best-in-class customer experience while meeting our service SLAs.Our goal is to provide best-in-class Technical Support to our customers. jobs.title: Technology Risk Analyst
jobs.description: OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Technology Risk and Controls Analyst to join Susquehanna's Dublin Technology Risk team.Working with technology and business teams, you will help identify and assess risks, strengthen controls and deliver practical improvements. You will contribute across a varied portfolio of reviews, projects and ongoing activities, adapting as priorities and business needs evolve.We are looking for someone who is curious, practical and comfortable tackling unfamiliar problems. You should enjoy learning how things work, making sense of incomplete information and working with others to find solutions. Strong judgement, clear communication and the ability to take ownership and follow through are central to the role.You will work closely with experienced technology teams in a trading environment, take ownership of meaningful risk work and have the opportunity to improve how the team operates. The variety of assignments will allow you to apply your existing strengths and broaden your experience.What you will doAssess technology risks. Review applications, infrastructure and operational processes to understand potential business impacts, evaluate existing safeguards and recommend proportionate improvements. Contribute to risk and control self-assessments and keep assigned risk records current.Review controls and evidence. Assess control design and evidence of operation, identify gaps and document clear findings. Carry out assigned technology and trading application reviews, support audit requests and work with owners to improve evidence quality.Drive remediation and reporting. Agree actions, owners and target dates with technical teams, assess completion evidence and escalate material issues. Prepare accurate risk reports and key risk indicators that explain progress, emerging concerns and decisions required.Support resilience and lifecycle improvements. Contribute to business continuity exercises, application load and resilience testing, incident follow-up and technology lifecycle reviews. Use findings and operational data to identify dependencies, unsupported technology and other exposures, then track agreed improvements.Improve processes and tools. Help refine risk workflows, dashboards and evidence collection. Define requirements, test changes and use data analysis, automation and AI tools to reduce repetitive work while validating the results.Contribute across the team's priorities. Support policy and procedure reviews, risk awareness activities and assessments of emerging technologies. Work with colleagues and specialists on new assignments, applying sound judgement as requirements evolve.You will manage an agreed portfolio within the first line, working with control owners and partnering with second-line Risk, Compliance and Audit. The Technology Risk Manager will support prioritisation and significant escalations; material risk acceptance and formal approvals will follow established responsibilities.What We're Looking ForWhat we are looking forTypically 4–7 years of relevant experience in technology risk, technology controls, IT audit, operational resilience, or a technical role with substantial risk and control responsibilities. jobs.title: Service Management Analyst
jobs.description: Job description:Service Management Analyst - KilkennyGlanbia Management Services Limited Join this dynamic team focused on delivering better nutrition for every step of life’s journey.  The OpportunityThe Service management analyst is responsible for driving the rationalisation, standardisation, quality, and automation of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes. They lead the continuous optimisation of Service  desk and service management processes to ensure alignment to business needs, while enhancing service quality and reducing inefficiencies.They explore opportunities to streamline ITSM processes, ensuring they are data-driven and leverage automation / AI where possible, working closely with IT and partner teams to implement best practices and innovation in service management. Primary responsibilities for this role will include: Drives the optimisation and standardisation of ITSM processes to improve efficiency and consistency across the IT landscape. Explores opportunities to implement automation and AI-driven solutions within ITSM processes (e.g., automated incident resolution, predictive analytics for problem management). Contributes to continual service improvement by analysing service performance data, identifying trends, and implementing enhancements. Ensures high-quality execution of Service management processes by defining and refining quality assurance standards and best practices, providing guidance to partner teams where required. Collaborates with the Service Management Lead to assess and refine partner service delivery to ensure alignment with performance expectations. Drives the rationalisation of ITSM processes by removing redundant steps, reducing complexity while still ensuring services are fit-for-purpose and meet business needs. Collaborates with the Service Management Lead to ensure ITSM tooling (e.g., ServiceNow) is fully leveraged to automate and enhance service control processes where feasible. Acts as an internal consultant on ITSM best practices, working across IT teams to embed efficient service control processes. Acts as an advisor to IT and the Business on ITSM processes and delivery.  The skills and experience you will bring to the team Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Schience, Information Technology, Engineering), or equivalent experience. Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g ITIL 4, CompTIA, KCS). 5+ years of experience in IT Service Management, Service Desk or Service Operations roles. Proven experience managing ITSM processes to design, plan, deliver and optimise IT services. Strong knowledge of ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC Helix ITSM), ITIL frameworks, and ITSM workflow automation. Familiarity with AI-driven ITSM solutions, including predictive incident and problem management. Proven ability to drive self-service adoption within IT and the Business, fostering a cultural / mindset shift towards automation and self-help solutions.  Experience collaborating with third-party service providers, monitoring performance and driving continuous improvement. Familiarity with Agile and DevOps practices to align ITSM processes with fast-paced delivery models.  Where and how you will work  The opportunity is based in our Leggettsrath Kilkenny office with hybrid working arrangements available, which allows you a greater choice in how you work and live, giving you a better work-life balance.    About Glanbia   Glanbia is a better nutrition company with three divisions: Performance Nutrition, Health & Nutrition and Dairy Nutrition. Collectively and with our partners we offer an incredible breadth of expertise in nutrition. We employ a team of 5800 people, work with global food and beverage companies, and sell our award-winning and market-leading brands and ingredients in more than 100 countries worldwide   At Glanbia, we celebrate diversity, because we know that our individual strengths make us stronger together. We welcome and encourage interest from a variety of candidates, we will give your application consideration, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. At Glanbia, our culture celebrates individuality, knowing that together we are more.

jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description: Our research principlesSweat the details. Technical excellence requires obsessing over every detail. We operate with urgency as a unified team, concentrating resources on a few high-conviction bets where research and impact intersect.Metrics that matter. The most intelligent system will increasingly be defined by building an algorithm that can interact with the world. Research ideas are tested through working products. If it doesn't improve what users can do, we question whether it matters. We share what moves the field; we don't optimize for paper count.The roleThis is a research role which is focused on real world impact. We care about building our frontier innovation around efficiency, gradient free exploration, real time learning and interface design. A revolution is underway where the cost of generating synthetic data is now low enough that we can treat the data space as malleable and something which can be optimized. We can steer synthetic data towards desirable properties and make previously invisible worlds with limited data coverage more visible. The most intelligent system will increasingly be defined by building an algorithm that can interact with the world. This means for the first time researchers who care about intelligence need also be obsessed with how a model interacts. If any of these statements resonate with you, we would like to hear from you.ResponsibilitiesInnovation: innovate on our product to co-design algorithms that react real-time to product signal and feedback. Design new ways of giving feedback that drive better algorithms. Cross-Stack Optimization: collaborate across software, hardware, and algorithmic domains to achieve system-wide efficiency gainsMeasure what matters: we believe strongly that the ultimate signal of value is whether we have real world impact. Our current algorithms are capable of interacting with the world which is why product matters so much. QualificationsA PhD or equivalent research experience in a computer science field4-5+ years of industry experience Deep expertise in at least one area: model efficiency, real time alignment or algorithmic optimizationSystems thinking ability to understand and optimize across the full ML stackStrong programming skills in Python. Experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow)Knowledge of model optimization techniques (RLHF, finetuning)Experience in an industry lab with computing at scaleAbove all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. We think that's backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, personalized, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible - it's how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few. jobs.description: Applications are invited from suitably qualified candidates for a full-time, fixed term position as a Postdoctoral Researcher within the Digital Metabolic Twin Centre, School of Medicine at the University of Galway, Ireland.This position is funded by Vistamilk and is available from 16/3/2027 to contract end date of 15/3/2028, with the possibility of further extension.The Digital Metabolic Twin Centre hosts an international, multidisciplinary team of researchers and is dedicated to advancing precision medicine through computational modelling. Our focus lies on creating a Digital Metabolic Twin for each person, based on their own data, to provide bespoke health insights and inform health decisions.The Centre uses a computational modelling approach, termed constraint-based modelling to develop models of human metabolism and the gut microbiome to investigate how nutrition, genetics, and microbial communities interact to influence human health and disease. By integrating biological and experimental data, our research aims to improve understanding of complex biological processes and support the development of personalised approaches to health, with applications in inherited, gastrointestinal, and neurodegenerative diseases.Vistamilk is an SFI funded centre focusing on three strategic goals: sustainable growth, food security, and prosperity and societal enrichment for the Irish dairy and agri-tech industry. The Digital Metabolic Twin Centre’s research endeavors to enable the design of healthier dairy products by creating a better understanding of the role of dairy food on microbial and human metabolism on human health.Salary: Postdoctoral Researcher salary scale €47,273 - €60,250 per annum, (subject to the project’s funding limitations), and pro rata for shorter and/or part-time contracts.The default position for all new public sector appointments is the 1st point of the salary scale. jobs.title: Quantitative Trading Internship: Summer 2027
jobs.description: OverviewSusquehanna’s 10-week quantitative trading internship offers a rare insight into working at one of the world’s leading quantitative trading firms. Designed for intellectually curious and driven individuals with strong quantitative skillsets, our internship combines rigorous classroom-based education with real-world trading experience.Run by a team of dedicated senior traders, our education programme is widely recognised as being the best in the industry. Successful interns will be invited to join our full-time graduate programme in either September 2027, January 2028 or August 2028, depending on availability.What’s In It For YouEducation: You will attend classes covering a vast range of topics (Finance, Options, Mock Trading, Game Theory, Tech, Trader Talks, Poker, Speaker Seminars, In-house trading games… the list goes on!) from some of the most experienced employees at Susquehanna.Collaboration: You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology.Decision-making: Game theory is central to Susquehanna’s history as a firm and our trading philosophy. Weekly poker classes, strategy board games, and proprietary trading games will challenge you to optimise outcomes, anticipate moves, and maximise your winnings.Culture: Our non-hierarchical, casual, and collaborative culture allows employees of every level to thrive.Perks: We offer a highly competitive compensation package to our interns. Located in Ireland’s Financial Services Centre, in the heart of Dublin’s city centre, our office features free onsite catering, a games room, and a fully equipped in-house gym. Throughout the summer, interns enjoy weekly social events. For those joining us from outside Dublin, we also provide accommodation for the duration of the internship.About SusquehannaSusquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.Applicants must be legally eligible to work in IrelandOur Summer Internship is 10 weeks and runs from late June to late August. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Ireland.We hire for our quantitative trading internship on a rolling basis, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early. *Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. jobs.description: Junior Food Category AnalystRole Introduction: Established in 1992, Applegreen is a leading convenience roadside retailer in the Republic of Ireland, the UK and the US in both large-scale Motorway Service Areas and Travel Plazas, as well as smaller petrol stations. Applegreen is in a rapid growth phase and to support this ambitious growth, we are seeking to onboard a Junior Food Category Analyst to join our team.This role will form part of the Commercial Food team. The successful candidate will be a confident people person who can fit into Applegreen seamlessly and adopt a hands-on approach to their role. Assist the Food team with analysis of product, category and store performance, highlighting key trends and exceptions for further review. Maintain accurate trackers, reports and product information, ensuring data is kept up to date and issues are identified promptly. Support invoice administration and reconciliation, investigating invoice queries and working with internal teams and suppliers to resolve discrepancies. Assist with forecasting and stock management activities, particularly around promotions, new product launches and seasonal activity. Support the monitoring of waste and availability, helping identify products, stores or categories requiring further investigation. Liaise with suppliers and internal departments to obtain information and resolve day-to-day queries. Support category reviews and presentations by gathering and preparing relevant sales, customer and product information. Assist with competitor and market reviews to help the Food team understand emerging products, pricing and Food to Go trends. Maintain organised records, trackers, product files and documentation for the Food team. Support improvements to reporting and administrative processes, identifying opportunities to make routine tasks more efficient and accurate. Provide general analytical and administrative support across the Food team as required.The Candidate should have the following:Qualifications, experience & skills Experience in a commercial, retail, food, supply-chain or administrative environment would be beneficial. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, with strong Excel skills. Comfortable working with numbers and analysing data to identify trends or discrepancies. Previous exposure to Power BI or similar reporting tools would be beneficial but is not essential. Experience with SAP or another ERP system would be advantageous but is not essential. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Good organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines. Confident written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable working with colleagues across Commercial, Operations, Finance and Supply Chain. An interest in food, retail and the Food to Go / QSR market. A positive attitude with a strong willingness to learn and develop.Additional key skills & attributes: A dynamic individual who adapts well to change and can thrive in a rapidly growing organisation that continues to evolve. Comfortable working with data, reports and commercial informationHigh level of accuracy, particularly when dealing with invoices, prices, product information and reporting.Able to manage recurring reporting deadlines alongside day-to-day requests from the Food team.Interested in understanding what drives sales, margin, waste and availability.Willing to investigate issues rather than simply report them.Comfortable working across Commercial, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance and with external suppliers.Able to respond positively to changing priorities in a fast-paced retail environment.Takes a logical approach to resolving data, invoice, stock and administrative issues.Motivated to build analytical, food and commercial knowledge and take on greater responsibility over time.Willing to travel on an ad hoc basis if required.Further information about Applegreen can be found here https://applegreenstores.com/about-us/

jobs.title: Platform Distribution Analyst
jobs.description: Role Summary JOB DESCRIPTION The Platform Distribution Analyst is responsible for supporting the visibility, adoption, and commercial success of the firm's fund range across key third-party platforms and distribution channels.The role acts as a key support resource for platform relationships, ensuring accurate fund data, efficient onboarding, and ongoing engagement with platform partners, while coordinating internally with investment, operations, product, marketing, and compliance teams.This role is critical to supporting assets under management (AUM) growth, enhancing distribution efficiency, and strengthening the firm's presence within the intermediary and institutional marketplace.ResponsibilitiesPlatform & Distribution Support Assisting Head of Fund Platform Distribution in maintaining relationships with fund platforms, third-party distributors, pension platforms, and data providers.  Act as a key contact for platform due diligence, fund onboarding, and ongoing relationship management activities.  Support the maintenance of the firm's fund range across relevant platforms, ensuring fund information remains accurate and up to date.  Assist in responding to platform information requests, questionnaires, and RFPs. Fund Data Management & Validation Produce, maintain, and validate fund data supplied to platforms, data vendors, and distribution partners.  Coordinate the timely delivery of fund information, including performance data, fees, share class information, fund characteristics, ESG data, and regulatory disclosures.  Perform quality assurance reviews to ensure consistency and accuracy of fund data across all distribution channels.  Investigate and resolve data discrepancies with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and platform partners.  Support the publication and validation of fund factsheets, KIDs/KIIDs, sustainability disclosures, and marketing materials. Distribution & Asset Growth Produce reporting and analysis on platform assets, fund flows, sales activity, and distribution trends.  Support the evaluation of new platform opportunities and digital distribution channels. Product & Commercial Input Support the assessment of new share classes, platform-specific solutions, and distribution initiatives.  Assist in evaluating the commercial and operational feasibility of new distribution opportunities.  Contribute insights relating to competitor positioning, platform developments, and market trends. Governance, Compliance & Professional Standards Maintain adherence to CFIL policies, procedures, and compliance standards.  Ensure accurate record keeping relating to platform interactions, fund data submissions, and distribution activities. Requirements QUALIFICATIONS Skills & Competencies 1-3 years’ experience in either asset management, fund operations, fund distribution, platform services, or financial services.  Strong understanding of investment funds, fund platforms, intermediary distribution models, and fund structures.  Experience working with fund data, data validation, reporting, or operational processes.  Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret commercial data, fund flows, and market trends.  Excellent stakeholder (Internal and external) management, communication, and presentation skills.  Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.  Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency in PowerPoint.  Proven ability to build and maintain effective working relationships.  Highly organised, self-motivated, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes.  Minimum Level 8 qualification in a relevant discipline (Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, Data Analytics, or related discipline). Desirable Experience with platforms such as Allfunds, FNZ, Pershing and Clearstream.  Knowledge of UCITS funds and investment products.  Experience with Morningstar Direct, FE Fundinfo, Bloomberg, or similar research platforms.
